🟣 NET PROPOSAL: THE CONFIDENCE PROTOCOL
Prepared for: Qv & Wife From: Michael Hobbs, Founder of NET

SLIDE 1: THE TRUTH
Visual: Dark background, Neon Purple text. An image of a locked cage breaking open. Headline: Stop "Studying" English. Start Living It. Sub-headline: Most beginners are stuck in "Grammar Prison." We break them out.

The Core Philosophy:

"Vietnamese adults aren't bad at English. They are just scared. Traditional schools teach grammar first, which creates fear of mistakes. NET teaches Confidence First. We build the habit, then we build the accuracy."

SLIDE 2: THE METHOD (HOW WE LEARN)
Visual: 4 Icons representing the pillars (Gold/Purple).

1. Listen & Understand (Input)

We don't use boring textbooks. We use real conversations, stories, and content she actually enjoys.

Goal: Understand the message, not translate every word.

2. Speak & Mimic (Action)

No robot voice. We train "Tiger Voice"—speaking with volume and energy.

Goal: Speak from Day 1, even if it’s imperfect.

3. Context Learning (Memory)

No isolated word lists. We learn phrases in real-world situations.

Goal: Remember naturally, without memorizing.

4. The Safe Space (Confidence)

Critical for Beginners: A judgment-free zone where mistakes are celebrated, not punished.

SLIDE 3: THE ECOSYSTEM (WHAT SHE GETS)
Visual: A circular diagram showing the student in the center, surrounded by these tools.

It is not just a class. It is a Lifestyle System.

🤖 NET PET AI Coach: Her 24/7 pocket companion. It tracks her daily listening, reminds her to practice, and keeps her streak alive.

🏠 Home Study Protocol: A personalized daily plan (45 mins listening / 15 mins speaking) tailored to her level.

🤝 The Buddy System: Once she is ready, we pair her with a supportive partner for low-pressure practice.

🎉 Community Events: Access to our monthly networking nights in Saigon to practice in the real world.

SLIDE 4: THE RECOMMENDATION (THE HYBRID PATH)
Visual: Two distinct columns merging into one "Success Path."

For a beginner who wants fast results but needs safety, I recommend the Hybrid Protocol:

1. The Private Accelerator (1x Per Week)

Focus: 1-on-1 Private Coaching.

Why: To build her foundation, fix pronunciation issues privately, and build confidence before entering a group.

Investment: 600,000 VND / Hour

2. The Social Immersion (1-2x Per Week)

Focus: Small Group Class (Beginner Level).

Why: To practice listening to others, realize she isn't alone, and have fun in a social setting.

Investment: 300,000 VND / Hour

TOTAL WEEKLY RHYTHM:

Monday: Home Study (AI Coach)

Tuesday: Group Class (Fun & Social)

Wednesday: Home Study (AI Coach)

Thursday: Private Class (Deep Focus & Correction)

Friday: Home Study (AI Coach)

Weekend: Rest or Casual Listening

SLIDE 5: THE "ELEPHANT" PROMISE
Visual: An outline of an elephant breaking a small chain.

Our Commitment:

"Many students are like elephants tied to a small stick. They are strong enough to break free, but their minds are chained by old habits and fear.

My promise to you is not just to teach your wife vocabulary. My promise is to break that chain.

In 3 months, she won't just know more English. She will be a different person when she speaks it."

        :root {
            --neon-purple: #a855f7;
            --gold-accent: #f59e0b;
            --deep-dark: #0f0f1a;
            --glass-bg: rgba(20, 20, 30, 0.85);
            --glass-border: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
            --text-primary: #ffffff;
            --text-secondary: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
            --radius: 20px;
        }

        * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

        body {
            background-color: var(--deep-dark);
            background-image: 
                radial-gradient(circle at 10% 0%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 90% 100%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15) 0%, transparent 50%);
            background-attachment: fixed;
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.5;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        /* --- CONTAINER & SCROLL SNAP --- */
        .deck-container {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            overflow-y: scroll;
            height: 100vh;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .slide {
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            height: 100vh;
            width: 100%;
            padding: 30px 20px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            position: relative;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
        }

        /* --- TYPOGRAPHY --- */
        h1 {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            line-height: 1.1;
            font-weight: 800;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff, var(--neon-purple));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        h2 {
            font-size: 1.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--gold-accent);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        p {
            font-size: 1rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            max-width: 500px;
        }

        .tag {
            font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: var(--neon-purple);
            border: 1px solid var(--neon-purple);
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        /* --- CARDS --- */
        .glass-card {
            background: var(--glass-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 25px;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 400px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        /* --- PATHWAY OPTIONS --- */
        .option-card {
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: transform 0.3s;
        }
        
        .option-title {
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #fff;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }
        
        .price {
            font-size: 1.8rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--gold-accent);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .price span { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: 400; }

        .features { list-style: none; text-align: left; width: 100%; }
        .features li {
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            padding-left: 20px;
            position: relative;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
        }
        .features li::before {
            content: '✓';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            color: var(--neon-purple);
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        /* --- ANIMATION --- */
        .fade-up {
            animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) forwards;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(30px);
        }

        @keyframes fadeUp {
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        /* --- ELEPHANT ICON --- */
        .icon-large { font-size: 4rem; margin-bottom: 20px; }
        
        /* --- NAVIGATION DOTS --- */
        .dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: 20px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
            z-index: 100;
        }
        .dot {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }
        .dot.active { background: var(--gold-accent); }

        /* --- BUTTON --- */
        .btn {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--neon-purple), var(--gold-accent));
            color: #000;
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 15px 30px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            text-decoration: none;
            display: inline-block;
            margin-top: 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
        }

    </style>
</head>

    <script>
        // Simple Intersection Observer to update dots
        const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
        const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.dot');

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    const index = Array.from(slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                    dots.forEach(d => d.classList.remove('active'));
                    dots[index].classList.add('active');
                    
                    // Re-trigger animation
                    const animated = entry.target.querySelectorAll('.fade-up');
                    animated.forEach(el => {
                        el.style.animation = 'none';
                        el.offsetHeight; /* trigger reflow */
                        el.style.animation = null; 
                    });
                }
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.5 });

        slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
    </script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>NET Proposal: The Confidence Protocol</title>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;700;900&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    
    <style>
        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
           GOSPEL 444 AESTHETIC ENGINE (Responsive + Bilingual)
           NO BLUE. PURPLE + GOLD + DARK.
        ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        :root {
            --purple: #a855f7;
            --gold: #f59e0b;
            --dark: #0f0f1a;
            --glass: rgba(20, 20, 30, 0.85);
            --border: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
            --text: #ffffff;
            --text-dim: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
            --radius: 24px;
        }

        * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

        body {
            background-color: var(--dark);
            background-image: 
                radial-gradient(circle at 0% 0%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 100% 100%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
            background-attachment: fixed;
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        .container {
            max-width: 1000px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 40px 20px;
        }

        /* --- TYPOGRAPHY & TRANSLATION --- */
        .vi {
            display: block;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-weight: 400;
            margin-top: 4px;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        h1 {
            font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.1;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff, var(--purple));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        h2 {
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);
            color: var(--gold);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        /* --- SECTIONS --- */
        section { margin-bottom: 100px; }

        .hero {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 60px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
        }

        /* --- CARDS --- */
        .card {
            background: var(--glass);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 30px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            transition: transform 0.3s;
        }
        .card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); border-color: var(--purple); }

        /* --- METHOD GRID --- */
        .method-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .icon { font-size: 2.5rem; margin-bottom: 10px; display: block; }

        /* --- ECOSYSTEM --- */
        .eco-list {
            list-style: none;
        }
        .eco-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            padding-bottom: 20px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
        }
        .eco-item:last-child { border: none; }

        /* --- PRICING TABLES --- */
        .pricing-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr; /* Mobile default */
            gap: 30px;
        }
        
        @media (min-width: 768px) {
            .pricing-container {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; /* Side by side on desktop */
            }
        }

        .price-card {
            background: var(--glass);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 40px 30px;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
        }

        .price-card.highlight {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.05), rgba(20, 20, 30, 0.9));
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1);
        }

        .badge {
            position: absolute;
            top: -15px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            background: var(--gold);
            color: #000;
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .price-title { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 5px; }
        .price-amount { font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 900; color: var(--gold); margin: 20px 0; }
        .price-period { font-size: 1rem; color: var(--text-dim); font-weight: 400; }

        .features { text-align: left; margin: 30px 0; list-style: none; }
        .features li { margin-bottom: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); padding-left: 25px; position: relative; }
        .features li::before { content: '✓'; color: var(--purple); position: absolute; left: 0; font-weight: bold; }
        .features li strong { color: #fff; }

        /* --- BUTTON --- */
        .btn {
            display: inline-block;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple), var(--gold));
            color: #000;
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 15px 40px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            transition: transform 0.2s;
        }
        .btn:hover { transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4); }

        /* --- ELEPHANT SECTION --- */
        .elephant-box {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 60px 20px;
            border: 1px solid var(--purple);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.05);
        }

    </style>
</head>

        :root {

            --text-dim: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
            --radius: 24px;
        }

        * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

        body {
            background-color: var(--dark);
            background-image: 
                radial-gradient(circle at 0% 0%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 100% 100%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
            background-attachment: fixed;
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

            padding: 40px 20px;

        }

            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);
            color: var(--gold);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        /* --- SECTIONS --- */
        section { margin-bottom: 80px; }

        .hero {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 60px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
        }

        /* --- CARDS --- */
        .card {
            background: var(--glass);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 30px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            transition: transform 0.3s;
        }
        .card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); border-color: var(--purple); }

        /* --- METHOD GRID --- */
        .method-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .icon { font-size: 2.5rem; margin-bottom: 10px; display: block; }

        /* --- ECOSYSTEM --- */
        .eco-list { list-style: none; }
        .eco-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            padding-bottom: 20px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
        }
        .eco-item:last-child { border: none; }

        /* --- PRICING TABLES --- */
        .pricing-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr; /* Mobile default */
            gap: 30px;
        }
        
        @media (min-width: 768px) {
            .pricing-container {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; /* Side by side on desktop */
            }
        }

        .price-card {
            background: var(--glass);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 40px 30px;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
        }

        .price-card.highlight {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.05), rgba(20, 20, 30, 0.9));
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1);
        }

        .badge {
            position: absolute;
            top: -15px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            background: var(--gold);
            color: #000;
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .price-title { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 5px; }
        .price-amount { font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 900; color: var(--gold); margin: 20px 0; }
        .price-period { font-size: 1rem; color: var(--text-dim); font-weight: 400; }

        .features { text-align: left; margin: 30px 0; list-style: none; }
        .features li { margin-bottom: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); padding-left: 25px; position: relative; }
        .features li::before { content: '✓'; color: var(--purple); position: absolute; left: 0; font-weight: bold; }
        .features li strong { color: #fff; }

        /* --- BUTTON --- */
        .btn {
            display: inline-block;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple), var(--gold));
            color: #000;
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 15px 40px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 1.1rem;

        .elephant-box {

            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1), rgba(0,0,0,0));
            border-left: 4px solid var(--gold);
            padding: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            border-radius: 0 20px 20px 0;
        }

    </style>
</head>

<script>
    // --- RECORDING LOGIC ---
    let recorders = {};
    let audioChunks = { 1: [], 2: [] };
    let audioBlobs = {};

    async function toggleRecord(id) {
        const btn = document.getElementById(`rec${id}`);
        const status = document.getElementById(`status${id}`);

        if (!recorders[id] || recorders[id].state === "inactive") {
            // Start Recording
            try {
                const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
                recorders[id] = new MediaRecorder(stream);
                audioChunks[id] = [];

                recorders[id].ondataavailable = e => audioChunks[id].push(e.data);
                recorders[id].onstop = () => {
                    const blob = new Blob(audioChunks[id], { type: 'audio/webm' });
                    audioBlobs[id] = blob;
                    status.innerText = "✅ Audio Saved!";
                    status.style.color = "#10b981";
                    btn.classList.remove("recording");
                    btn.innerText = "↺"; // Retry icon
                };

                recorders[id].start();
                btn.classList.add("recording");
                btn.innerText = "⏹";
                status.innerText = "Recording... Tap to Stop";
                status.style.color = "#ef4444";

            } catch (err) {
                alert("Microphone access needed to record audio! Please enable permissions.");
            }
        } else {
            // Stop Recording
            recorders[id].stop();
        }
    }

    function generatePackage() {
        // 1. Gather Text Data
        const data = {
            q1: document.getElementById('q1').value,
            q2: document.getElementById('q2').value,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        };

        // 2. Create JSON Blob
        const jsonBlob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
        const jsonUrl = URL.createObjectURL(jsonBlob);

        // 3. Trigger Downloads
        downloadFile(jsonUrl, "NET_Assessment_Answers.json");

        if(audioBlobs[1]) {
            const audioUrl1 = URL.createObjectURL(audioBlobs[1]);
            setTimeout(() => downloadFile(audioUrl1, "Audio_Intro.webm"), 1000);
        }
        
        if(audioBlobs[2]) {
            const audioUrl2 = URL.createObjectURL(audioBlobs[2]);
            setTimeout(() => downloadFile(audioUrl2, "Audio_Weekend.webm"), 2000);
        }

        alert("Files downloaded! Please send them to Michael on Zalo to get your Free Report.");
    }

    function downloadFile(url, name) {
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = name;
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        document.body.removeChild(a);
    }
</script>

    <section style="text-align: center; margin-top: 100px;">

        <h2>The Promise</h2>
        <p style="max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;">
            "Many students are like elephants tied to a small stick—strong enough to break free, but mentally chained by fear. My promise isn't just to teach vocabulary. <strong>My promise is to break that chain.</strong>"
        </p>
        <p class="vi" style="max-width: 600px; margin: 10px auto;">

    </section>

</div>

<script>
    // --- RECORDING LOGIC ---
    let recorders = {};
    let audioChunks = { 1: [], 2: [] };
    let audioBlobs = {};

    async function toggleRecord(id) {
        const btn = document.getElementById(`rec${id}`);
        const status = document.getElementById(`status${id}`);

        if (!recorders[id] || recorders[id].state === "inactive") {
            // Start Recording
            try {
                const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
                recorders[id] = new MediaRecorder(stream);
                audioChunks[id] = [];

                recorders[id].ondataavailable = e => audioChunks[id].push(e.data);
                recorders[id].onstop = () => {
                    const blob = new Blob(audioChunks[id], { type: 'audio/webm' });
                    audioBlobs[id] = blob;
                    status.innerText = "✅ Audio Saved!";
                    status.style.color = "#10b981";
                    btn.classList.remove("recording");
                    btn.style.background = "#10b981";
                    btn.innerText = "↺"; // Retry icon
                };

                recorders[id].start();
                btn.classList.add("recording");
                btn.innerText = "⏹";
                status.innerText = "Recording... Tap to Stop";
                status.style.color = "#ef4444";

            } catch (err) {
                alert("Microphone access needed to record audio! Please enable permissions in your browser settings.");
            }
        } else {
            // Stop Recording
            recorders[id].stop();
        }
    }

    function generatePackage() {
        // 1. Gather Text Data
        const q1 = document.getElementById('q1').value;
        const q2 = document.getElementById('q2').value;

        if(!q1 || !q2) {
            alert("Please answer the text questions first!");
            return;
        }

        const data = {
            q1: q1,
            q2: q2,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        };

        // 2. Create JSON Blob
        const jsonBlob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
        const jsonUrl = URL.createObjectURL(jsonBlob);

        // 3. Trigger Downloads
        downloadFile(jsonUrl, "NET_Answers.json");

        let audioCount = 0;
        if(audioBlobs[1]) {
            const audioUrl1 = URL.createObjectURL(audioBlobs[1]);
            setTimeout(() => downloadFile(audioUrl1, "Audio_Intro.webm"), 500);
            audioCount++;
        }
        
        if(audioBlobs[2]) {
            const audioUrl2 = URL.createObjectURL(audioBlobs[2]);
            setTimeout(() => downloadFile(audioUrl2, "Audio_Weekend.webm"), 1500);
            audioCount++;
        }

        if(audioCount === 0) {
            alert("Warning: No audio recorded. Please record audio for a complete assessment.");
        } else {
            alert("Files downloaded! Please locate them in your phone/computer downloads folder and send them to Michael on Zalo.");
        }
    }

    function downloadFile(url, name) {
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = name;
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        document.body.removeChild(a);
    }
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
    let recorders = {}; let audioChunks = { 1: [], 2: [] }; let audioBlobs = {};
    async function toggleRecord(id) {
        const btn = document.getElementById(\`rec\${id}\`);
        const status = document.getElementById(\`status\${id}\`);
        if (!recorders[id] || recorders[id].state === "inactive") {
            try {
                const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
                recorders[id] = new MediaRecorder(stream);
                audioChunks[id] = [];
                recorders[id].ondataavailable = e => audioChunks[id].push(e.data);
                recorders[id].onstop = () => {
                    const blob = new Blob(audioChunks[id], { type: 'audio/webm' });
                    audioBlobs[id] = blob;
                    status.innerText = "✅ Audio Saved!";
                    status.style.color = "#10b981";
                    btn.classList.remove("recording");
                    btn.style.background = "#10b981";
                    btn.innerText = "↺";
                };
                recorders[id].start();
                btn.classList.add("recording");
                btn.innerText = "⏹";
                status.innerText = "Recording... Tap to Stop";
                status.style.color = "#ef4444";
            } catch (err) { alert("Microphone access needed to record audio! Please enable permissions in your browser settings."); }
        } else { recorders[id].stop(); }
    }
    function generatePackage() {
        const q1 = document.getElementById('q1').value;
        const q2 = document.getElementById('q2').value;
        if(!q1 || !q2) { alert("Please answer the text questions first!"); return; }
        const data = { q1: q1, q2: q2, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
        const jsonBlob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
        const jsonUrl = URL.createObjectURL(jsonBlob);
        downloadFile(jsonUrl, "NET_Answers.json");
        let audioCount = 0;
        if(audioBlobs[1]) { const audioUrl1 = URL.createObjectURL(audioBlobs[1]); setTimeout(() => downloadFile(audioUrl1, "Audio_Intro.webm"), 500); audioCount++; }
        if(audioBlobs[2]) { const audioUrl2 = URL.createObjectURL(audioBlobs[2]); setTimeout(() => downloadFile(audioUrl2, "Audio_Weekend.webm"), 1500); audioCount++; }
        if(audioCount === 0) { alert("Warning: No audio recorded. Please record audio for a complete assessment."); } else { alert("Files downloaded! Please locate them in your phone/computer downloads folder and send them to Michael on Zalo."); }
    }
    function downloadFile(url, name) {
        const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = name; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
    }
</script>

2. NET UNIVERSE: CORE PHILOSOPHY

2.1 THE MISSION

"We don't teach English. We build English speakers."

The Problem NET Solves:



Vietnamese adults study English for 10+ years

They can read and write (textbook knowledge)

Natural acquisition (like learning Vietnamese)

2.2 THE METAPHOR SYSTEM

ELEPHANT IN CHAINS

Story: Vietnamese students are like elephants in chains. From childhood, they're told "Don't speak until perfect." These invisible chains hold them back even as adults.

NET's Role: Break the chains. Show them they're free.

MOUSE → TIGER TRANSFORMATION

MOUSE VOICE:



Quiet, scared, apologizes constantly

Translates mentally before speaking

Studies grammar, never practices speaking

Freezes around native speakers

TIGER VOICE:



Loud, confident, owns mistakes

Thinks in English directly

Practices speaking first, grammar later

Approaches foreigners without fear

NET's Job: Transform every Mouse into a Tiger.

GRAMMAR PRISON

Prison: Traditional education system



Locks students in grammar rules

Shames mistakes

Tests memorization, not communication

Forces perfection before speaking

Escape: NET methodology



Natural conversation from Day 1

Mistakes celebrated as learning data

Real communication over textbook accuracy

PHOENIX REBIRTH

Old scared self burns away

New confident speaker emerges

Transformation is permanent

You can never un-learn confidence

2.3 THE PSYCHOLOGICAL INSIGHT

KEY INSIGHT: Fear, not ability, is the barrier.

Vietnamese students have the cognitive capacity to speak English. What's missing is:



Permission to make mistakes (shame-based education broke this)

Daily practice habit (traditional school didn't build this)

Supportive community (learning was isolated, not social)

Identity shift (they see themselves as "learners," not "speakers")

NET addresses all four.

3. THE FOUR PILLARS: PEDAGOGY

3.1 PILLAR 1: LISTEN & UNDERSTAND

Principle: Massive comprehensible input

The Rule: 60% comprehension



<60% = too hard (frustration, noise)

60-80% = optimal (flow state, learning)



90% = too easy (boredom, no growth)

Daily Practice:



45 minutes of English content (movies, podcasts, YouTube)

Student chooses topics they ENJOY (critical for consistency)

Subtitles okay initially, wean off over time

In Class:



Teacher speaks 70%+ English (beginners) to 90%+ (advanced)

Use visuals, gestures, context (not translation)

Repeat key phrases in multiple contexts

3.2 PILLAR 2: SPEAK & MIMIC

Principle: Output is the engine of fluency

The Method:



Listen to phrase → Repeat exactly (intonation, rhythm, emotion)

Don't analyze grammar — just copy

Build muscle memory in mouth and brain

Daily Practice:



15 minutes shadow-speaking

Record self, compare to native speaker

Focus on sounds, not perfection

In Class:



Choral repetition (whole class speaks together)

Pair practice (drills with partner)

Solo performance (builds confidence under pressure)

Volume = Confidence: Tiger Voice is loud. Always encourage louder speech.

3.3 PILLAR 3: LEARN IN CONTEXT

Principle: Real sentences stick. Word lists don't.

The Rule: Never teach vocabulary in isolation

WRONG:



"Sarcasm means... irony or... mocking tone..."

RIGHT:



"Oh great, another meeting. Just what I needed today."

[Student hears tone, sees eye roll, feels the sarcasm]

Always Show:



3-5 example sentences per concept

Real usage in authentic context

Emotional association (funny, shocking, relatable)

3.4 PILLAR 4: BUILD CONFIDENCE

Principle: Fear is the #1 barrier. Confidence comes before perfection.

The Method:



Celebrate mistakes ("Great! You tried!")

Never shame errors

Praise courage over accuracy

Create safe environment

Systems:



Buddy System: Weekly peer practice (reduces pressure)

Monthly Events: Community building (you're not alone)

Tiger Voice Training: Physical confidence through volume

CRITICAL: Mistakes are data, not shame.

3.5 THE 60% RULE (CRITICAL)

This is the master law of NET pedagogy.

If student understands:



<60% of content: TOO HARD → Go easier

60-80% of content: PERFECT → Stay here (flow state)

>90% of content: TOO EASY → Go harder

Why this matters:



Below 60% = Noise wins, brain shuts down

60-80% = Brain fills gaps naturally, optimal learning

Above 90% = No challenge, no growth

Your job as architect: Design lessons that hit 60-80% for each student level.

7. TEACHING SYSTEM: TRANSFORMATION

7.1 LESSON STRUCTURE: 10-5-5-3

Every 90-minute lesson follows this pattern:



10 Core Vocabulary words (in context, never isolated)

5 Idioms (real usage, cultural context)

5 Slang expressions (modern, authentic)

3 Games (Warm-up, Mid-lesson, Final challenge)

Timing Breakdown:



Warm-up (10 min)

Input (5 min) — present new content

Guided Practice (5 min) — choral repetition, drills

Free Practice (60 min) — conversation, role-plays

Feedback (10 min) — corrections, praise

7.2 THE 60 LESSON TOPICS

CATEGORY 1: PRAGMATICS (12 topics)

Sarcasm, Funny vs Funny, Understatement, Reading Between Lines

Vague Time, Passive Aggression, "Interesting", Cultural References

Taboo Topics, Compliments, Apologies, Small Talk

CATEGORY 2: WORKPLACE (12 topics)

Daily Standup, Polite Disagreeing, Interrupting, Bad News

Asking for Promotion, Explaining Bugs, Chasing Emails, Feedback

Difficult Coworkers, Networking, Phone Calls, Presentations

CATEGORY 3: SOCIAL (10 topics)

Ordering Coffee, Grocery Shopping, Doctor, Renting

Making Friends, Dating, Traveling, Emergencies, Complaining, Parties

CATEGORY 4: TECH & GAMING (8 topics)

Gaming Lingo, Tech Jargon, Social Media, AI & Chatbots

Cryptocurrency, Streaming, Memes, Remote Work

CATEGORY 5: EMOTIONS (6 topics)

Anxiety & Stress, Confidence vs Arrogance, Motivation

Relationships, Cultural Identity, Imposter Syndrome

CATEGORY 6: GRAMMAR (6 topics)

Conditionals, Passive Voice, Reported Speech

Modals, Relative Clauses, Phrasal Verbs

CATEGORY 7: PRONUNCIATION (4 topics)

TH Sounds, R vs L, V vs W, Word Stress

CATEGORY 8: BUSINESS (2 topics)

Negotiations, Professional Emails

TOTAL: 60 topics = 80 lesson templates (some topics split into multiple lessons)

7.3 CRISIS PROTOCOLS (10 SCRIPTS)

CRISIS #1: THE SILENCESituation: No one speaks when you ask a questionScript: "Everyone stand up! Popcorn Story. I start, then point to someone. 'Yesterday I went to the market and I saw...' Nhan, continue!"

CRISIS #2: ONE STUDENT DOMINATESSituation: Same person answers everythingScript: "Kiet, I love your energy! Now I need to hear from others. Everyone who HASN'T spoken, raise your hand. [Call on them]"

CRISIS #3: "I DON'T KNOW"Situation: Student gives up without tryingScript: "That's okay! What's your BEST GUESS? Mouse says 'I don't know.' Tiger says 'Let me try.' Go!"

CRISIS #4: STUDENT CRIESSituation: Emotional breakdown (frustration, stress)Script: "Hey, it's okay. Let's step outside together. [Privately] What's going on? English is hard, I get it. But you're doing great. Let's take a break."

CRISIS #5: TECH FAILURESituation: Zoom crashes, mic diesScript: "Tech is difficult today. No problem! Everyone grab pen and paper. Writing exercise while I fix this. [Assign task]"

CRISIS #6: RUDE STUDENTSituation: Interrupts, mocks, challenges teacherScript (In Class): "Let's pause. I need everyone's respect. If you have feedback, we can talk after class."Script (After Class): "What happened? That wasn't like you. I need you to respect this space. Can we agree?"

CRISIS #7: STUDENTS ARE LOSTSituation: Content too hard, blank staresScript: "I see confusion. Let me back up. This is too hard. Let's go simpler. [Repeat with basic English, gestures] Does this make more sense?"

CRISIS #8: RUNNING OUT OF TIMESituation: 10 min left, haven't finished lessonScript: "Short on time. The most important thing today is [X]. Let's spend last 10 minutes nailing that. [Cut non-essentials]"

CRISIS #9: CAN'T ANSWER QUESTIONSituation: Student asks something you don't knowScript: "Great question! Honestly, I don't know off the top of my head. Let me look it up for next class. In meantime, does anyone else know? [If no] Perfect homework — everyone research this."

CRISIS #10: STUDENT WANTS TO QUITSituation: Student says they're dropping outScript: "I hear you. English is frustrating. Before you decide, let's talk. What's making you want to quit? [Listen] Progress isn't linear. You're doing better than you think. Give it 2 more weeks. If you still feel this way, we'll talk again. Deal?"

7.4 BUDDY SYSTEM

Pairing Strategy:



Similar level (prevents domination)

Teacher provides 10 conversation topics

5 min each topic, switch speaker/listener

Report back: "Did you meet your buddy?"

Ongoing:



Students self-direct (own topics, format)

Meet at café, park, online

NET PET tracks attendance

Benefits:



Reduces pressure (peer vs teacher)

Builds friendships

+1 hour/week practice

90% retention rate (vs 60% solo)

8. PRODUCT SYSTEMS: TECHNOLOGY

8.1 PHOENIX ENGINE: SECURITY

Phoenix Engine is NET's security framework (P0-P5).



P0: BASELINE SECURITY (MANDATORY)

No Inline Event Handlers: Never use onclick=, use addEventListener

Input Sanitization: All user input escaped before processing

CSP Headers: Content Security Policy blocks unauthorized scripts

HTTPS Only: All traffic encrypted, no HTTP

Session Management: Secure tokens, httpOnly cookies, auto-timeout

P0 is non-negotiable. Violation = no deploy.

P1: DATA PROTECTION (MANDATORY FOR USER DATA)

Encryption at Rest: Passwords (bcrypt), PII (AES-256)

Encryption in Transit: TLS 1.2+ for all data transmission

PII Handling: Minimal collection, secure storage, GDPR compliance

Audit Logging: Log all security events (logins, changes, access)

P2: ATTACK PREVENTION (MANDATORY FOR PUBLIC APPS)

Rate Limiting: Prevent brute-force and DDoS

CSRF Protection: Tokens for state-changing requests

SQL Injection Prevention: Parameterized queries only

XSS Prevention: Escape all user content before rendering

P3-P5: ADVANCED (ENTERPRISE ONLY)

P3: GDPR compliance, SOC 2 certification, penetration testing

P4: Real-time threat detection, anomaly detection, security dashboards

P5: Zero-trust architecture, micro-segmentation, least-privilege access

🟩 2. THE TEACHING CORE (PEDAGOGY FOUNDATION)
The core philosophy is The Natural English Method: learning English the same way one mastered their first language—naturally, enjoyably, and effectively.

The Four Pillars of NET:
Pillar	Focus	Method/Rule
Pillar 1: Listen & Understand	

Comprehensible Input (60% Rule) 

Listen to material understood 60%+ of the time. Focus on context, not individual words. 45 minutes of fun content daily.

Pillar 2: Speak & Practice	

Mimic Native Speakers 


15 minutes of daily speaking practice. Master the 42 English sounds (Jolly Phonics system). Lessons are active conversations, not lectures.

Pillar 3: Learn in Context	

Association Learning 

Introduce vocabulary through FULL SENTENCES. Use Spaced Repetition (Today → Tomorrow → 3 Days → 1 Week). Effective expression over vocabulary quantity.

Pillar 4: Build Confidence	

Safe Environment 

Create a space where mistakes are learning opportunities. Make learning FUN. Supported by the Buddy System and Monthly Networking.

# 🟣 **2. THE NET PHILOSOPHY (FIRST PERSON)**



### *Your voice. Marketing + teaching identity.*



I created NET because the traditional English system in Vietnam is broken.



Vietnamese adults were never taught real English—they were taught *grammar*, *textbooks*, *tests*, and *fear*.

The entire country learned English backwards.



And the results are painfully obvious:



* They can read

* They can do grammar exercises

* But they freeze in real conversation

* They’re terrified of making mistakes

* They speak with low confidence

* They rely on translation

* They don’t know how to “think in English”



**NET exists to fix this.**



I teach natural English the way humans actually acquire language:



* **Listen first**

* **Mimic second**

* **Speak naturally**

* **Grammar later**

* **Reading/Writing last**



It’s how Vietnamese learned Vietnamese.

It’s how babies learn globally.

It’s how the brain is wired.



This is the **NET foundation**.

🟣 3. THE NET METHOD (FIRST PERSON)

1. Listen & Understand (45 minutes/day)

Shadowing and volume training. Master the 42 Jolly Phonics sounds [cite: uploaded:NET-Ultimate-Info-Packet-Complete.txt]. We will eliminate the "robot voice".

Never memorize isolated words. Always learn in full sentences. Use Spaced Repetition (0→1→3→7 days) [cite: uploaded:NET-Ultimate-Info-Packet-Complete.txt].

4. Confidence First
Vietnamese fear mistakes. I break the “prison of the mind” through tough love, humor, and safe practice.

<script>

// --- Simple App State (front-end only, no storage yet) ---

const state = {

activeView: "dashboard",

streakDays: 3,

minutesToday: 30,

buddies: [

{

id: "nhan",

name: "Nhan",

level: "B1 • Creative",

focus: "Confidence & volume",

sessionsThisWeek: 1,

archetype: "Low-volume / shy"

},

{

id: "kiet",

name: "Kiet",

level: "C1 • Teen Genius",

focus: "Deep topics & debates",

sessionsThisWeek: 0,

archetype: "Advanced / fast-thinker"

},

{

id: "quang",

name: "Quang",

level: "B1 • University",

focus: "Presentations & phrasing",

sessionsThisWeek: 0,

archetype: "Corporate / student"

}

],

selectedBuddyId: null,

lockedSession: null

};



// --- DOM references ---

const navButtons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".nav-btn"));

const eyebrowEl = document.getElementById("view-eyebrow");

const titleEl = document.getElementById("view-title");

const subtitleEl = document.getElementById("view-subtitle");

const metricStreakEl = document.getElementById("metric-streak");

const metricTodayEl = document.getElementById("metric-today");

const metricNextBuddyEl = document.getElementById("metric-next-buddy");

const views = {

dashboard: document.getElementById("view-dashboard"),

lessons: document.getElementById("view-lessons"),

buddies: document.getElementById("view-buddies"),

community: document.getElementById("view-community"),

settings: document.getElementById("view-settings")

};

const buddyListEl = document.getElementById("buddy-list");

const buddyStatusLine = document.getElementById("buddy-status-line");

const sessionGoalEl = document.getElementById("session-goal");

const sessionLengthEl = document.getElementById("session-length");

const sessionTopicEl = document.getElementById("session-topic");

const sessionNotesEl = document.getElementById("session-notes");

const sessionStatusLine = document.getElementById("session-status-line");

const btnFillTemplate = document.getElementById("btn-fill-template");

const btnLockSession = document.getElementById("btn-lock-session");



// --- View meta text ---

const viewMeta = {

dashboard: {

eyebrow: "NET • Buddy-First Build",

title: "Welcome back, Student",

subtitle: "1 hour a day, confidence for life. Buddy System is the core of V0."

},

lessons: {

eyebrow: "NET • Academies Overview",

title: "Your Lesson Worlds",

subtitle: "Sarcasm, Careers, Context, Pronunciation — all waiting for StoryFlow."

},

buddies: {

eyebrow: "NET • Buddy System Core",

title: "Practice with Real People",

subtitle: "You don’t beat fear alone. You beat it laughing with a partner."

},

community: {

eyebrow: "NET • Community Universe",

title: "Networking Nights & Events",

subtitle: "From Zoom calls to real tables in Saigon. English has to leave the classroom."

},

settings: {

eyebrow: "NET • Personal Settings",

title: "Tune Your Experience",

subtitle: "The right content at the right time makes the habit stick."

}

};



function setActiveView(view) {

state.activeView = view;



// Update nav

navButtons.forEach(btn => {

if (btn.dataset.view === view) {

btn.classList.add("nav-btn--active");

} else {

btn.classList.remove("nav-btn--active");

}

});



// Show/Hide sections

Object.entries(views).forEach(([key, section]) => {

if (key === view) {

section.classList.remove("hidden");

} else {

section.classList.add("hidden");

}

});



// Update header text

const meta = viewMeta[view];

if (meta) {

eyebrowEl.textContent = meta.eyebrow;

titleEl.innerHTML = ""; // rebuild carefully to allow span color

const text = meta.title;

const spanIndex = text.indexOf("Student");

if (view === "dashboard" && spanIndex !== -1) {

// simple span injection: static, not user content

const before = text.slice(0, spanIndex);

const after = text.slice(spanIndex + "Student".length);

const span = document.createElement("span");

span.textContent = "Student";

titleEl.append(before, span, after);

} else {

titleEl.textContent = text;

}

subtitleEl.textContent = meta.subtitle;

}

}



function renderMetrics() {

metricStreakEl.textContent = state.streakDays + " days";

metricTodayEl.textContent = state.minutesToday + " / 60 min";

// In V0 we keep buddy metric static; can link to real schedule later

metricNextBuddyEl.textContent = "This week";

}



function renderBuddyList() {

buddyListEl.innerHTML = ""; // static template, no user data HTML injection



state.buddies.forEach(buddy => {

const row = document.createElement("div");

row.className = "buddy-row";

row.dataset.buddyId = buddy.id;



const main = document.createElement("div");

main.className = "buddy-main";



const avatar = document.createElement("div");

avatar.className = "buddy-avatar";

avatar.textContent = buddy.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();



const info = document.createElement("div");

const nameEl = document.createElement("div");

nameEl.className = "buddy-name";

nameEl.textContent = buddy.name;

const metaEl = document.createElement("div");

metaEl.className = "buddy-meta";

metaEl.textContent = buddy.level + " • " + buddy.focus;



info.appendChild(nameEl);

info.appendChild(metaEl);



main.appendChild(avatar);

main.appendChild(info);



const statPill = document.createElement("div");

statPill.className = "buddy-stat-pill";

statPill.textContent = buddy.sessionsThisWeek + "x this week";



row.appendChild(main);

row.appendChild(statPill);



row.addEventListener("click", () => {

state.selectedBuddyId = buddy.id;

updateBuddyStatus();

highlightSelectedBuddy();

});



buddyListEl.appendChild(row);

});



updateBuddyStatus();

highlightSelectedBuddy();

}



function updateBuddyStatus() {

const span = buddyStatusLine.querySelector("span");

if (!span) return;

if (!state.selectedBuddyId) {

span.textContent = "None yet";

} else {

const buddy = state.buddies.find(b => b.id === state.selectedBuddyId);

if (buddy) {

span.textContent = buddy.name + " (" + buddy.level + ")";

}

}

}



function highlightSelectedBuddy() {

const rows = buddyListEl.querySelectorAll(".buddy-row");

rows.forEach(row => {

const id = row.dataset.buddyId;

if (id === state.selectedBuddyId) {

row.style.boxShadow = "0 0 18px rgba(245,158,11,0.85)";

row.style.borderColor = "rgba(245,158,11,0.9)";

} else {

row.style.boxShadow = "none";

row.style.borderColor = "rgba(30,64,175,0)";

}

});

}



function autoFillSessionIdea() {

// This uses only static templates; no user injection risk

const goal = sessionGoalEl.value;

const length = Number(sessionLengthEl.value);

const topic = sessionTopicEl.value;



let template = "";



const warmup = "5 minutes: warm-up small talk about your day.\n";

const review = "5 minutes: quick review — each person shares 1 thing they did well and 1 thing to improve.\n";



if (goal === "confidence") {

template += warmup;

template += (length - 10) + " minutes: take turns telling a story about the topic. The listener must ask follow-up questions.\n";

template += review;

} else if (goal === "small-talk") {

template += warmup;

template += (length - 10) + " minutes: imagine you just met at a networking event. Practice natural questions and reactions.\n";

template += review;

} else if (goal === "business") {

template += warmup;

template += (length - 10) + " minutes: role-play a short meeting or email discussion about work tasks.\n";

template += review;

} else if (goal === "pronunciation") {

template += warmup;

template += (length - 10) + " minutes: choose 5–8 sentences and drill volume, rhythm, and key sounds.\n";

template += review;

} else if (goal === "storytelling") {

template += warmup;

template += (length - 10) + " minutes: tell one strong story each. Focus on past tense, feelings, and details.\n";

template += review;

}



if (topic === "weekend") {

template += "\nTopic guide: what you did last weekend, funny moments, anything that went wrong.";

} else if (topic === "work") {

template += "\nTopic guide: this week at work — wins, problems, one conversation with your boss.";

} else if (topic === "dreams") {

template += "\nTopic guide: your dream job, country, or project in the next 5–10 years.";

} else if (topic === "travel") {

template += "\nTopic guide: best trip so far, where you want to go next, culture shocks.";

} else if (topic === "movies") {

template += "\nTopic guide: your favorite series or movie, why you like it, characters you relate to.";

}



sessionNotesEl.value = template;

sessionStatusLine.textContent = "Draft generated. Edit anything you want, then lock this session.";

}



function lockSession() {

if (!state.selectedBuddyId) {

sessionStatusLine.textContent = "Choose a buddy first. This session is for two people, not a textbook.";

return;

}

const buddy = state.buddies.find(b => b.id === state.selectedBuddyId);

const plan = sessionNotesEl.value.trim();

if (!plan) {

sessionStatusLine.textContent = "Write or auto-fill a simple plan. Keep it small and realistic.";

return;

}



state.lockedSession = {

buddyId: buddy.id,

goal: sessionGoalEl.value,

length: Number(sessionLengthEl.value),

topic: sessionTopicEl.value,

notes: plan

};



sessionStatusLine.textContent =

"Session locked with " + buddy.name +

" for " + state.lockedSession.length +

" minutes. The only job now: show up.";



// In future, this would also:

// - Save to backend / localStorage

// - Sync with NET PET

// - Trigger reminders

}



// --- Event wiring ---

navButtons.forEach(btn => {

btn.addEventListener("click", () => {

const view = btn.dataset.view;

if (!view) return;

setActiveView(view);

});

});



btnFillTemplate.addEventListener("click", autoFillSessionIdea);

btnLockSession.addEventListener("click", lockSession);



// --- Initial render ---

renderMetrics();

renderBuddyList();

setActiveView("dashboard");

</script>

// --- Security & Persistence Functions (P0/P1 Hardening) ---

// MANDATE: P1 Input Sanitation. Blocks script and tag injection.
function sanitizeInput(input) {
  // Use textContent property of a temporary element to safely escape HTML.
  const temp = document.createElement('div');
  temp.textContent = input;
  return temp.innerHTML; // This is safe because user-provided content is already escaped.
}

// MANDATE: P1 Persistence. Saves state (simulating hashState_SHA256 verification).
function saveState() {
  try {
    const stateToSave = JSON.stringify(state);
    // In full Phoenix, this would be encrypted and hashed before setting.
    localStorage.setItem('netAppState', stateToSave); 
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("PHOENIX AUDIT: Could not save state to local storage.", e);
  }
}

// MANDATE: P1 Persistence. Loads state on initialization.
function loadState() {
  try {
    const savedState = localStorage.getItem('netAppState');
    if (savedState) {
      const parsedState = JSON.parse(savedState);
      // Merge saved properties back into initial state
      Object.assign(state, parsedState);
      renderAll(); // Rerender UI based on loaded state
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("PHOENIX AUDIT: Corrupted state found. Starting new session.");
  }
}

// --- Hardened Lock Session Function ---
function lockSession() {
  if (!state.selectedBuddyId) {
    sessionStatusLine.textContent = "Choose a buddy first. This session is for two people, not a textbook.";
    return;
  }
  const buddy = state.buddies.find(b => b.id === state.selectedBuddyId);
  
  // *** HARDENING: SANITIZE USER INPUT BEFORE STORING ***
  const sanitizedPlan = sanitizeInput(sessionNotesEl.value);

  if (!sanitizedPlan) {
    sessionStatusLine.textContent = "Write or auto-fill a simple plan. Keep it small and realistic.";
    return;
  }

  state.lockedSession = {
    buddyId: buddy.id,
    goal: sessionGoalEl.value,
    length: Number(sessionLengthEl.value),
    topic: sessionTopicEl.value,
    notes: sanitizedPlan // Store the sanitized data
  };

  // *** PERSISTENCE MANDATE: SAVE STATE AFTER CRITICAL ACTION ***
  saveState(); 

  sessionStatusLine.textContent =
    "Session locked with " + buddy.name +
    " for " + state.lockedSession.length +
    " minutes. The only job now: show up.";
}

// --- Modified Initializer and Renders ---
function renderAll() {
  renderMetrics();
  renderBuddyList();
  setActiveView(state.activeView);
}

// --- INITIALIZATION ---
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  loadState(); // Load state on DOM ready
  renderAll(); // Initial render based on loaded or default state

  // Attach event listeners after loading state and rendering
  navButtons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const view = e.currentTarget.dataset.view;
      if (view) setActiveView(view);
    });
  });

  btnFillTemplate.addEventListener("click", autoFillSessionIdea);
  // Redefine lockSession listener to use the hardened version
  btnLockSession.addEventListener("click", lockSession); 
});

Introduction (30 Seconds)

2. VTV – Overview (1 Minute)
VTV is a national broadcaster. It is government-owned and trusted across Vietnam.

This includes politics, education, culture, and entertainment.

But the news reporting is always formal and very structured.

The tone is consistent and official. It must be.

4. Editorial Stance and Bias (1.5 Minutes)
VTV reflects the Party’s official stance. This is its core job.

5. Challenges (1 Minute)
VTV faces two main problems.

Challenge One: Attracting younger audiences.

Young people use social media every day. They want fast, short, interactive news.

VTV’s formal style is less appealing to them.

Challenge Two: Limited press freedom.

VTV must follow government rules. This is a limitation.

They cannot investigate deeply. They cannot present opposing views.

This limits their ability to do critical reporting.

Conclusion (30 Seconds)
In summary, VTV is reliable for official events.

But it lacks diversity in viewpoints.

Citizens mostly receive state-approved narratives.

This is why younger audiences are increasingly using social media.

The future of media in Vietnam will be about this balance: official news vs. alternative perspectives.

🧠 ARCHITECTURAL ANALYSIS: THE "V0 FINAL" HYBRID
Executor, adding my thoughts to this specific build—the fusion of V0 Functionality (The Buddy System) with V1 Aesthetics (The Marketing Website)—reveals a powerful strategic advantage.

Here is the breakdown of why this specific configuration is the correct "Final Test" candidate:

1. The "Trojan Horse" Interface
By wrapping the functional tool (Session Builder) inside the marketing narrative ("Break the Grammar Prison"), we solve the biggest problem in EdTech: The Empty State.

Standard Apps: When a user logs in, they see empty lists and blank forms. It feels like work.

NET V0 Hybrid: When a user logs in, they see the Mission. The Hero Banner reminds them why they are here ("You didn't learn grammar before you spoke"). This keeps the emotional buy-in high even while doing the administrative work of booking a session.

2. Psychological Anchoring via UI
We have embedded the Canon directly into the interface elements:

The "Tiger Voice" Toggle: It’s not just a setting; it’s a challenge.

The "No Blue" Rule: By strictly enforcing the Purple/Gold/Dark palette, the app feels like a "Night Club" or a "Gaming Lounge," not a "Classroom" or "Office" (which are almost always Blue/White). This subtle cue tells the brain: This is a lifestyle, not a chore.

3. Adversarial Hardening (P1)
Technically, this build is far more robust than the prototype.

Sanitized Inputs: We are stripping HTML tags from user notes, preventing basic script injection.

Persistence: The move to localStorage means the user can refresh the page without losing their streak or locked session. This creates trust.

State Management: We are operating on a Single Source of Truth (state object) rather than reading from the DOM. This is the foundation for connecting to a real backend later.

4. The "Buddy First" Strategy
Launching with only the Buddy System is brilliant. It forces human connection immediately. If we launched with content first, students would passively consume video and hide. By launching with the Session Builder, we force the Active/High-Energy path (StoryFlow Path B) right from Day 1.
