      width: 0%;

      border-radius: 999px;

      transition: width 0.4s ease-out;

    }



    .progress-fill.listen {

      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--neon-purple), #e9d5ff);

    }



    .progress-fill.speak {

      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), #facc15);

    }



    .tracker-buttons {

      display: grid;

      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

      gap: 8px;

      margin-top: 8px;

    }



    .btn-solid {

      width: 100%;

      border-radius: 14px;

      padding: 10px 8px;

      border: none;

      font-size: 0.82rem;

      font-weight: 600;

      cursor: pointer;

      transition:

        transform var(--transition-fast),

        box-shadow var(--transition-fast),

        background var(--transition-fast),

        color var(--transition-fast);

      display: inline-flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: center;

      gap: 6px;

      font-family: "Inter", sans-serif;

    }



    .btn-listen {

      background: var(--neon-purple);

      color: #0b0414;

      box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.46);

    }



    .btn-speak {

      background: var(--gold);

      color: #120706;

      box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.46);

    }



    .btn-solid:active {

      transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985);

      box-shadow: none;

    }



    .tracker-footnote {

      margin-top: 6px;

      font-size: 0.75rem;

      color: var(--text-dim);

    }



    /* Capabilities (COMET-style "AI that…") */

    .capabilities-card {

      border-radius: var(--radius-card);

      padding: 12px 12px 10px;

      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.74);

      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.06);

    }



    .capabilities-grid {

      display: grid;

      gap: 8px;

    }



    .capability-pill {

      border-radius: 18px;

      padding: 8px 10px;

      background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.92);

      border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.42);

      position: relative;

      overflow: hidden;

    }



    .cap-title {

      font-size: 0.84rem;

      font-weight: 600;

    }



    .cap-badge {

      font-size: 0.68rem;

      text-transform: uppercase;

      letter-spacing: 0.12em;

      color: rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.5);

      margin-bottom: 2px;

    }



    .cap-text {

      font-size: 0.78rem;

      color: var(--text-dim);

      margin-top: 2px;

    }



    .capability-pill::after {

      content: "";

      position: absolute;

      right: -30px;

      top: -30px;

      width: 80px;

      height: 80px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25), transparent 65%);

      opacity: 0.6;

    }



    /* FAQ */

    .faq-card {

      border-radius: var(--radius-card);

      padding: 10px 12px;

      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78);

      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.06);

    }



    .faq-item {

      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.08);

    }



    .faq-item:last-child {

      border-bottom: none;

    }



    .faq-header {

      padding: 8px 2px;

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: space-between;

      gap: 8px;

      cursor: pointer;

      font-size: 0.84rem;

    }



    .faq-question {

      flex: 1;

    }



    .faq-toggle {

      width: 16px;

      height: 16px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.4);

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: center;

      font-size: 0.7rem;

      color: rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.6);

    }



    .faq-body {

      max-height: 0;

      overflow: hidden;

      transition: max-height 0.25s ease-out;

      font-size: 0.78rem;

      color: var(--text-dim);

      padding: 0 2px;

    }



    .faq-body-inner {

      padding-bottom: 8px;

    }



    .faq-item.open .faq-body {

      max-height: 200px;

    }



    .faq-item.open .faq-toggle {

      border-color: var(--gold);

      color: var(--gold);

    }



    /* Footer */

    footer.app-footer {

      padding: 6px 14px 8px;

      font-size: 0.7rem;

      color: var(--text-dim);

      display: flex;

      justify-content: space-between;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 6px;

    }



    .footer-mark {

      font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;

      letter-spacing: 0.15em;

      text-transform: uppercase;

      color: rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.4);

      font-size: 0.62rem;

    }



    .foot-pill {

      padding: 4px 8px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.18);

    }



    @media (max-width: 380px) {

      .hero-title {

        font-size: 1.18rem;

      }

      .hero-subtitle {

        font-size: 0.82rem;

      }

      .pulse-card {

        grid-template-columns: 1fr;

      }

    }

  </style>

</head>

<body>

  <div class="app-shell">

    <div class="app-inner">

      <header class="app-header">

        <div class="brand-block">

          <div class="brand-line">NET PET AI · V1</div>

          <div class="brand-tagline">Your daily English coach, not a textbook.</div>

        </div>

        <div class="streak-chip">

          <span class="streak-dot"></span>

          <span><span id="streak-count">0</span> day streak</span>

        </div>

      </header>



      <main class="app-main" id="scroll-root">

        <!-- HERO -->

        <section id="section-hero">

          <div class="hero-card">

            <div class="hero-comet"></div>

            <div class="section-label">The coach that works for you</div>

            <h1 class="hero-title">

              Build your <span class="hero-accent">English lifestyle</span>

              <br />45 · 15 · Every day.

            </h1>

            <p class="hero-subtitle">

              NET PET tracks your listening, pushes your speaking, and refuses to let you stay a mouse.

            </p>

            <div class="hero-cta-row">

              <button class="btn-pill btn-primary" id="cta-log-today">

                Log today’s study

              </button>

              <button class="btn-pill btn-secondary" id="cta-what-can">

                What can NET PET do?

              </button>

            </div>

          </div>

        </section>



        <!-- PULSE + DIALOGUE -->

        <section id="section-pulse">

          <div class="section-label">Today’s energy</div>

          <div class="pulse-card">

            <div class="avatar-stack">

              <div class="avatar-ring"></div>

              <div class="avatar-ring inner"></div>

              <div class="avatar-core" id="pet-avatar"></div>

            </div>

            <div class="pulse-meta">

              <div class="pulse-title">Your English Energy</div>

              <div class="pulse-sub" id="pulse-status">

                Let’s see if today looks like a tiger or a mouse.

              </div>

              <div class="pulse-chip-row">

                <div class="chip chip-heat" id="chip-mood">Mood: Neutral</div>

                <div class="chip" id="chip-goal">Goal: Not complete</div>

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

          <div class="dialogue-card">

            <div id="ai-line">

              "Initializing neural link. I’m here to keep you honest, not comfortable."

            </div>

          </div>

        </section>



        <!-- TRACKER -->

        <section id="section-tracker">

          <div class="section-label">45 / 15 tracker</div>

          <div class="tracker-card">

            <div class="tracker-row">

              <div class="tracker-label">

                <span>Listening (Fun Input)</span>

                <span id="listen-label">0 / 45m</span>

              </div>

              <div class="progress-shell">

                <div class="progress-fill listen" id="bar-listen"></div>

              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="tracker-row">

              <div class="tracker-label">

                <span>Speaking / Mimic</span>

                <span id="speak-label">0 / 15m</span>

              </div>

              <div class="progress-shell">

                <div class="progress-fill speak" id="bar-speak"></div>

              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="tracker-buttons">

              <button class="btn-solid btn-listen" id="btn-log-listen">+15m Listening</button>

              <button class="btn-solid btn-speak" id="btn-log-speak">+5m Speaking</button>

            </div>

            <div class="tracker-footnote">

              Rule #1: 60% understanding minimum. Rule #2: No pausing. Rule #3: Make it fun.

            </div>

          </div>

        </section>



        <!-- CAPABILITIES — COMET STYLE AI THAT… -->

        <section id="section-capabilities">

          <div class="section-label">What NET PET can do</div>

          <div class="capabilities-card">

            <div class="capabilities-grid">

              <div class="capability-pill">

                <div class="cap-badge">AI that coaches</div>

                <div class="cap-title">Tough love when you’re hiding</div>

                <p class="cap-text">

                  If you only listen and never speak, NET PET flips into Coach Mode and pushes you out

                  of your comfort zone. No more “I’ll speak when I’m perfect”.

                </p>

              </div>

              <div class="capability-pill">

                <div class="cap-badge">AI that tracks</div>

                <div class="cap-title">Your 45·15 streak, day by day</div>

                <p class="cap-text">

                  It watches your listening and speaking time, day rollovers, and streaks – then

                  reacts when you break the habit or level up.

                </p>

              </div>

              <div class="capability-pill">

                <div class="cap-badge">AI that builds</div>

                <div class="cap-title">A lifestyle, not a cram session</div>

                <p class="cap-text">

                  Instead of “homework”, NET PET designs small, realistic daily wins so English becomes

                  part of your lifestyle, not a chore.

                </p>

              </div>

              <div class="capability-pill">

                <div class="cap-badge">AI that fixes</div>

                <div class="cap-title">Robot voice & mouse energy</div>

                <p class="cap-text">

                  It keeps reminding you to increase volume, mimic emotion, and laugh at mistakes –

                  so you stop sounding like a shy exam robot.

                </p>

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

        </section>



        <!-- FAQ -->

        <section id="section-faq">

          <div class="section-label">FAQ</div>

          <div class="faq-card">

            <div class="faq-item">

              <div class="faq-header">

                <div class="faq-question">What does NET PET actually track?</div>

                <div class="faq-toggle">+</div>

              </div>

              <div class="faq-body">

                <div class="faq-body-inner">

                  Your daily listening minutes, speaking minutes, and whether you’ve hit the 45/15 goal

                  for the day. It also tracks your streak and mood state (neutral, tough love, proud).

                </div>

              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="faq-item">

              <div class="faq-header">

                <div class="faq-question">What happens if I miss a day?</div>

                <div class="faq-toggle">+</div>

              </div>

              <div class="faq-body">

                <div class="faq-body-inner">

                  If you miss your goal, the next day NET PET resets your streak and switches into

                  Tough Love mode. It doesn’t punish you – it just refuses to lie about your progress.

                </div>

              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="faq-item">

              <div class="faq-header">

                <div class="faq-question">Do I have to log exact minutes?</div>

                <div class="faq-toggle">+</div>

              </div>

              <div class="faq-body">

                <div class="faq-body-inner">

                  No. The buttons are designed for quick logging. Each tap is a chunk of time:

                  15 minutes for listening, 5 minutes for speaking. You can tap multiple times

                  to match your real study.

                </div>

              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="faq-item">

              <div class="faq-header">

                <div class="faq-question">Is this a replacement for a teacher?</div>

                <div class="faq-toggle">+</div>

              </div>

              <div class="faq-body">

                <div class="faq-body-inner">

                  No. NET PET is the daily accountability partner. The real transformation comes from

                  the combination of human teacher, NET lessons, and this AI coach watching your habits.

                </div>

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

        </section>

      </main>



      <footer class="app-footer">

        <span class="footer-mark">GOSPEL·444</span>

        <span class="foot-pill">Phoenix Engine · Buddy System Ready</span>

      </footer>

    </div>

  </div>



  <script>

    // ========================================================================

    // PHOENIX EVENT BUS (COMET-STYLE CORE)

    // ========================================================================

    const EventBus = {

      _subscribers: {},

      on(event, fn) {

        if (!this._subscribers[event]) this._subscribers[event] = [];

        this._subscribers[event].push(fn);

      },

      emit(event, payload) {

        (this._subscribers[event] || []).forEach(fn => fn(payload));

      }

    };



    // ========================================================================

    // STATE & CANONICAL CONSTANTS

    // ========================================================================

    const DEFAULT_STATE = {

      streak: 0,

      listeningMin: 0,

      speakingMin: 0,

      lastLogin: new Date().toDateString(),

      mood: "NEUTRAL", // NEUTRAL, TOUGH_LOVE, HAPPY, PROUD

      dailyGoalMet: false

    };



    let state;

    try {

      const fromStorage = localStorage.getItem("netPetV1State");

      state = fromStorage ? { ...DEFAULT_STATE, ...JSON.parse(fromStorage) } : { ...DEFAULT_STATE };

    } catch {

      state = { ...DEFAULT_STATE };

    }



    const GOAL_LISTEN = 45;

    const GOAL_SPEAK = 15;



    // Voice matrix grounded in your canonical tones

    const VOICE_MATRIX = {

      GREETING: [

        "Let’s get to work. Consistency beats intensity.",

        "Welcome back. Ready to break the grammar prison again?",

        "Remember: you learned Vietnamese by listening first. We do the same here.",

        "Today is another chance to be a tiger, not a mouse."

      ],

      TOUGH_LOVE: [

        "You haven’t practiced speaking yet. You can’t learn to swim by reading the water.",

        "Grammar won’t save you in a real meeting. Confidence will. Open your mouth.",

        "You built a whole wall around your mistakes. Let’s kick one brick out today.",

        "Do you want fluency or just the feeling of ‘studying’? The difference is action."

      ],

      CELEBRATION: [

        "Boom. You hit 45 and 15. That’s real English work, not homework.",

        "That’s the energy I want. Small wins, every day. This is how you become fluent.",

        "You’re not ‘learning English’ anymore – you’re living with English.",

        "Outstanding. Tomorrow, we just repeat this. Simple. Heavy. Effective."

      ],

      NUDGE: [

        "Pick one show you actually enjoy and listen. No pausing. Just let it wash over you.",

        "Five more minutes of shadowing could change how you sound next month.",

        "60% understanding is enough. Your brain will fill the rest if you keep going.",

        "If it’s fun, you’ll keep coming back. Let’s make the next 10 minutes fun."

      ]

    };



    // DOM Refs

    const streakCountEl = document.getElementById("streak-count");

    const avatarEl = document.getElementById("pet-avatar");

    const chipMoodEl = document.getElementById("chip-mood");

    const chipGoalEl = document.getElementById("chip-goal");

    const pulseStatusEl = document.getElementById("pulse-status");



    const listenLabelEl = document.getElementById("listen-label");

    const speakLabelEl = document.getElementById("speak-label");

    const listenBarEl = document.getElementById("bar-listen");

    const speakBarEl = document.getElementById("bar-speak");



    const aiLineEl = document.getElementById("ai-line");



    const btnLogListen = document.getElementById("btn-log-listen");

    const btnLogSpeak = document.getElementById("btn-log-speak");

    const ctaLogToday = document.getElementById("cta-log-today");

    const ctaWhatCan = document.getElementById("cta-what-can");

    const mainRoot = document.getElementById("scroll-root");



    const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll(".faq-item");



    // ========================================================================

    // HELPERS

    // ========================================================================

    function saveState() {

      try {

        localStorage.setItem("netPetV1State", JSON.stringify(state));

      } catch {

        // ignore storage errors

      }

      EventBus.emit("state:updated", { ...state });

    }



    function pickRandom(arr) {

      return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];

    }



    function setLine(category) {

      const pool = VOICE_MATRIX[category];

      if (!pool || pool.length === 0) return;

      const line = pickRandom(pool);

      aiLineEl.textContent = `"${line}"`;

    }



    function todayString() {

      return new Date().toDateString();

    }



    // Check day rollover / slump detection

    function checkDayRollover() {

      const today = todayString();

      if (state.lastLogin !== today) {

        // New day

        if (state.dailyGoalMet) {

          state.streak += 1;

          state.mood = "HAPPY";

        } else {

          state.streak = 0;

          state.mood = "TOUGH_LOVE";

        }

        state.listeningMin = 0;

        state.speakingMin = 0;

        state.dailyGoalMet = false;

        state.lastLogin = today;

        saveState();

      }

    }



    function evaluateGoal() {

      if (state.listeningMin >= GOAL_LISTEN && state.speakingMin >= GOAL_SPEAK) {

        if (!state.dailyGoalMet) {

          state.dailyGoalMet = true;

          state.mood = "PROUD";

          setLine("CELEBRATION");

        }

      } else if (state.listeningMin > 0 && state.speakingMin === 0) {

        state.mood = "TOUGH_LOVE";

        setLine("TOUGH_LOVE");

      } else if (state.listeningMin === 0 && state.speakingMin === 0) {

        state.mood = "NEUTRAL";

      } else {

        state.mood = "HAPPY";

        if (Math.random() > 0.7) {

          setLine("NUDGE");

        }

      }

    }



    function renderUI() {

      // streak

      streakCountEl.textContent = state.streak.toString();



      // progress

      const listenPct = Math.min((state.listeningMin / GOAL_LISTEN) * 100, 100);

      const speakPct = Math.min((state.speakingMin / GOAL_SPEAK) * 100, 100);



      listenBarEl.style.width = listenPct + "%";

      speakBarEl.style.width = speakPct + "%";



      listenLabelEl.textContent = `${state.listeningMin} / ${GOAL_LISTEN}m`;

      speakLabelEl.textContent = `${state.speakingMin} / ${GOAL_SPEAK}m`;



      // mood + pulse

      chipMoodEl.textContent = `Mood: ${

        state.mood === "PROUD"

          ? "Proud"

          : state.mood === "TOUGH_LOVE"

          ? "Tough love"

          : state.mood === "HAPPY"

          ? "Positive"

          : "Neutral"

      }`;



      chipGoalEl.textContent = `Goal: ${state.dailyGoalMet ? "Complete" : "Not complete"}`;



      if (state.mood === "PROUD") {

        avatarEl.className = "avatar-core happy";

        pulseStatusEl.textContent =

          "You hit your goal. This is what real English training looks like.";

      } else if (state.mood === "TOUGH_LOVE") {

        avatarEl.className = "avatar-core slump";

        pulseStatusEl.textContent =

          "Streak broken or no speaking yet. I’m not angry, just honest. Let’s fix it today.";

      } else if (state.mood === "HAPPY") {

        avatarEl.className = "avatar-core happy";

        pulseStatusEl.textContent =

          "Good momentum. Keep stacking small wins – the tiger is waking up.";

      } else {

        avatarEl.className = "avatar-core";

        pulseStatusEl.textContent =

          "We start simple: 45 minutes listening, 15 minutes speaking. I’ll track the truth.";

      }

    }



    // ========================================================================

    // EVENT HANDLERS

    // ========================================================================

    btnLogListen.addEventListener("click", () => {

      state.listeningMin += 15;

      evaluateGoal();

      saveState();

    });



    btnLogSpeak.addEventListener("click", () => {

      state.speakingMin += 5;

      evaluateGoal();

      saveState();

    });



    ctaLogToday.addEventListener("click", () => {

      // Scroll to tracker section

      const section = document.getElementById("section-tracker");

      section && section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });

      // gentle nudge line

      setLine("NUDGE");

    });



    ctaWhatCan.addEventListener("click", () => {

      const section = document.getElementById("section-capabilities");

      section && section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });

    });



    // FAQ toggles

    faqItems.forEach(item => {

      const header = item.querySelector(".faq-header");

      header.addEventListener("click", () => {

        const isOpen = item.classList.contains("open");

        faqItems.forEach(i => i.classList.remove("open"));

        if (!isOpen) item.classList.add("open");

      });

    });



    // Listen to state:updated on EventBus (COMET-style pattern)

    EventBus.on("state:updated", renderUI);



    // ========================================================================

    // INIT

    // ========================================================================

    (function init() {

      checkDayRollover();

      renderUI();

      // initial greeting only if no goal yet for today

      if (!state.dailyGoalMet && state.listeningMin === 0 && state.speakingMin === 0) {

        setLine("GREETING");

      } else {

        evaluateGoal();

      }

      console.log("NET PET AI V1 :: ONLINE :: PHOENIX × COMET · GOSPEL 444 COMPLIANT");

    })();

  </script>

</body>

</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">

<head>

  <meta charset="UTF-8" />

  <title>NET PET AI Coach — V1</title>

  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />

  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;600;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />

  <style>

    /* =========================================================================

       GOSPEL 444 AESTHETICS — PHOENIX × COMET HYBRID

       Colors: Neon Purple, Gold, Deep Dark. NO BLUE.

       ========================================================================= */

    :root {

      --neon-purple: #a855f7;

      --gold: #f59e0b;

      --deep-dark: #0f0f1a;

      --glass-bg: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.82);

      --glass-border: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);

      --text-primary: #f9fafb;

      --text-dim: rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.7);

      --danger: #ef4444;

      --success: #22c55e;

      --radius-card: 24px;

      --blur-glass: 16px;

      --shadow-soft: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);

      --transition-fast: 0.18s ease-out;

    }



    * {

      box-sizing: border-box;

      margin: 0;

      padding: 0;

    }



    html, body {

      height: 100%;

    }



    body {

      font-family: "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;

      background:

        radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.16) 0%, transparent 55%),

        radial-gradient(circle at 85% 80%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.16) 0%, transparent 55%),

        var(--deep-dark);

      color: var(--text-primary);

      display: flex;

      justify-content: center;

      align-items: stretch;

    }



    /* Star / Comet backdrop */

    body::before {

      content: "";

      position: fixed;

      inset: 0;

      background-image:

        radial-gradient(circle at 20% 10%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) 0, transparent 40%),

        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 90%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 0, transparent 45%);

      opacity: 0.18;

      pointer-events: none;

      z-index: 0;

    }



    body::after {

      content: "";

      position: fixed;

      top: -40%;

      left: -20%;

      width: 140%;

      height: 140%;

      background: conic-gradient(

        from 200deg,

        rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.08),

        rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12),

        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0),

        rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.08)

      );

      mix-blend-mode: screen;

      opacity: 0.7;

      filter: blur(32px);

      pointer-events: none;

      z-index: 0;

    }



    /* App shell */

    .app-shell {

      position: relative;

      z-index: 1;

      width: 100%;

      max-width: 480px;

      height: 100vh;

      padding: 18px 14px 20px;

      display: flex;

      flex-direction: column;

    }



    .app-inner {

      flex: 1;

      background: var(--glass-bg);

      border-radius: 32px;

      backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-glass));

      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-glass));

      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);

      box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);

      overflow: hidden;

      display: flex;

      flex-direction: column;

    }



    header.app-header {

      padding: 14px 18px 10px;

      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.06);

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: space-between;

      gap: 10px;

    }



    .brand-block {

      display: flex;

      flex-direction: column;

      gap: 2px;

    }



    .brand-line {

      font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;

      font-size: 0.78rem;

      letter-spacing: 0.12em;

      text-transform: uppercase;

      color: var(--gold);

    }



    .brand-tagline {

      font-size: 0.78rem;

      color: var(--text-dim);

    }



    .streak-chip {

      display: inline-flex;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 6px;

      padding: 4px 10px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      background: radial-gradient(circle at 0% 0%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7));

      font-size: 0.78rem;

      font-weight: 600;

      color: var(--text-primary);

    }



    .streak-dot {

      width: 9px;

      height: 9px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      background: var(--gold);

      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.9);

    }



    main.app-main {

      flex: 1;

      overflow-y: auto;

      padding: 10px 14px 16px;

      scroll-behavior: smooth;

    }



    main.app-main::-webkit-scrollbar {

      width: 0;

    }



    /* Sections */

    section {

      margin-bottom: 16px;

    }



    .section-label {

      font-size: 0.7rem;

      text-transform: uppercase;

      letter-spacing: 0.12em;

      color: var(--text-dim);

      margin-bottom: 6px;

    }



    .hero-card {

      border-radius: var(--radius-card);

      padding: 14px 16px 16px;

      background: radial-gradient(circle at 10% 0%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2), transparent 60%),

        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 120%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35), transparent 60%),

        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78);

      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.07);

      position: relative;

      overflow: hidden;

    }



    .hero-title {

      font-size: 1.35rem;

      font-weight: 800;

      line-height: 1.25;

      margin-bottom: 6px;

    }



    .hero-accent {

      color: var(--gold);

    }



    .hero-subtitle {

      font-size: 0.9rem;

      color: var(--text-dim);

      max-width: 260px;

    }



    .hero-cta-row {

      margin-top: 12px;

      display: flex;

      gap: 8px;

    }



    .btn-pill {

      border-radius: 999px;

      padding: 8px 14px;

      font-size: 0.8rem;

      font-weight: 600;

      border: none;

      cursor: pointer;

      transition:

        transform var(--transition-fast),

        box-shadow var(--transition-fast),

        background var(--transition-fast),

        color var(--transition-fast);

      font-family: "Inter", sans-serif;

      display: inline-flex;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 6px;

      white-space: nowrap;

    }



    .btn-primary {

      background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--neon-purple), var(--gold));

      color: #0a0412;

      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);

    }



    .btn-secondary {

      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);

      color: var(--text-primary);

      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.14);

    }



    .btn-pill:active {

      transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98);

      box-shadow: none;

    }



    /* Hero comet arc */

    .hero-comet {

      position: absolute;

      top: 10%;

      right: -20%;

      width: 220px;

      height: 220px;

      background: conic-gradient(

        from 220deg,

        rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.9),

        rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.0),

        rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.8),

        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)

      );

      opacity: 0.22;

      filter: blur(22px);

      transform-origin: left center;

      animation: comet-glide 18s linear infinite;

      pointer-events: none;

    }



    @keyframes comet-glide {

      0% {

        transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) rotate(6deg);

        opacity: 0.24;

      }

      40% {

        transform: translate3d(-14px, 12px, 0) rotate(18deg);

        opacity: 0.4;

      }

      80% {

        transform: translate3d(-28px, -4px, 0) rotate(0deg);

        opacity: 0.18;

      }

      100% {

        transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) rotate(6deg);

        opacity: 0.24;

      }

    }



    /* Avatar / Pulse section */

    .pulse-card {

      border-radius: var(--radius-card);

      padding: 12px 14px 14px;

      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.74);

      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.06);

      display: grid;

      grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;

      gap: 12px;

      align-items: center;

    }



    .avatar-stack {

      position: relative;

      width: 84px;

      height: 84px;

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: center;

    }



    .avatar-ring {

      position: absolute;

      width: 100%;

      height: 100%;

      border-radius: 999px;

      border: 2px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);

      animation: spin-ring 18s linear infinite;

    }



    .avatar-ring.inner {

      width: 70px;

      height: 70px;

      border: 1px dashed rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.6);

      animation: spin-ring 18s linear infinite reverse;

    }



    @keyframes spin-ring {

      100% {

        transform: rotate(360deg);

      }

    }



    .avatar-core {

      width: 54px;

      height: 54px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--neon-purple), #3b0764);

      box-shadow: 0 0 26px rgba(168, 85, 247, 1);

      transition: all 0.28s ease-out;

    }



    .avatar-core.happy {

      background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--gold), #b45309);

      box-shadow: 0 0 32px rgba(245, 158, 11, 1);

      transform: scale(1.06);

    }



    .avatar-core.slump {

      background: radial-gradient(circle, #7f1d1d, #450a0a);

      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.9);

      opacity: 0.85;

    }



    .pulse-meta {

      display: flex;

      flex-direction: column;

      gap: 4px;

    }



    .pulse-title {

      font-size: 0.92rem;

      font-weight: 600;

    }



    .pulse-sub {

      font-size: 0.78rem;

      color: var(--text-dim);

    }



    .pulse-chip-row {

      display: flex;

      flex-wrap: wrap;

      gap: 6px;

      margin-top: 4px;

    }



    .chip {

      border-radius: 999px;

      padding: 2px 8px;

      font-size: 0.7rem;

      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.14);

      color: var(--text-dim);

    }



    .chip-heat {

      border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.5);

      color: var(--gold);

    }



    /* Dialogue */

    .dialogue-card {

      margin-top: 10px;

      border-radius: var(--radius-card);

      padding: 10px 12px;

      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.68);

      border-left: 3px solid var(--neon-purple);

      font-size: 0.9rem;

      line-height: 1.5;

      font-style: italic;

      color: var(--text-primary);

      position: relative;

      overflow: hidden;

    }



    .dialogue-card::before {

      content: "NET PET says";

      position: absolute;

      top: 6px;

      right: 10px;

      font-size: 0.65rem;

      text-transform: uppercase;

      letter-spacing: 0.14em;

      color: rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.28);

      font-style: normal;

    }



    /* Tracker */

    .tracker-card {

      border-radius: var(--radius-card);

      padding: 12px 14px 14px;

      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78);

      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.06);

    }



    .tracker-row {

      margin-bottom: 10px;

    }



    .tracker-label {

      display: flex;

      justify-content: space-between;

      font-size: 0.78rem;

      color: var(--text-dim);

      margin-bottom: 4px;

      text-transform: uppercase;

      letter-spacing: 0.08em;

    }



    .progress-shell {

      width: 100%;

      height: 10px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      background: rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.08);

      overflow: hidden;

    }



    .progress-fill {

      height: 100%;

      width: 0%;

      border-radius: 999px;

      transition: width 0.4s ease-out;

    }



    .progress-fill.listen {

      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--neon-purple), #e9d5ff);

    }



    .progress-fill.speak {

      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), #facc15);

    }



    .tracker-buttons {

      display: grid;

      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

      gap: 8px;

      margin-top: 8px;

    }



    .btn-solid {

      width: 100%;

      border-radius: 14px;

      padding: 10px 8px;

      border: none;

      font-size: 0.82rem;

      font-weight: 600;

      cursor: pointer;

      transition:

        transform var(--transition-fast),

        box-shadow var(--transition-fast),

        background var(--transition-fast),

        color var(--transition-fast);

      display: inline-flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: center;

      gap: 6px;

      font-family: "Inter", sans-serif;

    }



    .btn-listen {

      background: var(--neon-purple);

      color: #0b0414;

      box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.46);

    }



    .btn-speak {

      background: var(--gold);

      color: #120706;

      box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.46);

    }



    .btn-solid:active {

      transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985);

      box-shadow: none;

    }



    .tracker-footnote {

      margin-top: 6px;

      font-size: 0.75rem;

      color: var(--text-dim);

    }



    /* Capabilities (COMET-style "AI that…") */

    .capabilities-card {

      border-radius: var(--radius-card);

      padding: 12px 12px 10px;

      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.74);

      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.06);

    }



    .capabilities-grid {

      display: grid;

      gap: 8px;

    }



    .capability-pill {

      border-radius: 18px;

      padding: 8px 10px;

      background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.92);

      border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.42);

      position: relative;

      overflow: hidden;

    }



    .cap-title {

      font-size: 0.84rem;

      font-weight: 600;

    }



    .cap-badge {

      font-size: 0.68rem;

      text-transform: uppercase;

      letter-spacing: 0.12em;

      color: rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.5);

      margin-bottom: 2px;

    }



    .cap-text {

      font-size: 0.78rem;

      color: var(--text-dim);

      margin-top: 2px;

    }



    .capability-pill::after {

      content: "";

      position: absolute;

      right: -30px;

      top: -30px;

      width: 80px;

      height: 80px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25), transparent 65%);

      opacity: 0.6;

    }



    /* FAQ */

    .faq-card {

      border-radius: var(--radius-card);

      padding: 10px 12px;

      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78);

      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.06);

    }



    .faq-item {

      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.08);

    }



    .faq-item:last-child {

      border-bottom: none;

    }



    .faq-header {

      padding: 8px 2px;

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: space-between;

      gap: 8px;

      cursor: pointer;

      font-size: 0.84rem;

    }



    .faq-question {

      flex: 1;

    }



    .faq-toggle {

      width: 16px;

      height: 16px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.4);

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: center;

      font-size: 0.7rem;

      color: rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.6);

    }



    .faq-body {

      max-height: 0;

      overflow: hidden;

      transition: max-height 0.25s ease-out;

      font-size: 0.78rem;

      color: var(--text-dim);

      padding: 0 2px;

    }



    .faq-body-inner {

      padding-bottom: 8px;

    }



    .faq-item.open .faq-body {

      max-height: 200px;

    }



    .faq-item.open .faq-toggle {

      border-color: var(--gold);

      color: var(--gold);

    }



    /* Footer */

    footer.app-footer {

      padding: 6px 14px 8px;

      font-size: 0.7rem;

      color: var(--text-dim);

      display: flex;

      justify-content: space-between;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 6px;

    }



    .footer-mark {

      font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;

      letter-spacing: 0.15em;

      text-transform: uppercase;

      color: rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.4);

      font-size: 0.62rem;

    }



    .foot-pill {

      padding: 4px 8px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      border: 1px solid rgba(249, 250, 251, 0.18);

    }



    @media (max-width: 380px) {

      .hero-title {

        font-size: 1.18rem;

      }

      .hero-subtitle {

        font-size: 0.82rem;

      }

      .pulse-card {

        grid-template-columns: 1fr;

      }

    }

  </style>

</head>

<body>

  <div class="app-shell">

    <div class="app-inner">

      <header class="app-header">

        <div class="brand-block">

          <div class="brand-line">NET PET AI · V1</div>

          <div class="brand-tagline">Your daily English coach, not a textbook.</div>

        </div>

        <div class="streak-chip">

          <span class="streak-dot"></span>

          <span><span id="streak-count">0</span> day streak</span>

        </div>

      </header>



      <main class="app-main" id="scroll-root">

        <!-- HERO -->

        <section id="section-hero">

          <div class="hero-card">

            <div class="hero-comet"></div>

            <div class="section-label">The coach that works for you</div>

            <h1 class="hero-title">

              Build your <span class="hero-accent">English lifestyle</span>

              <br />45 · 15 · Every day.

            </h1>

            <p class="hero-subtitle">

              NET PET tracks your listening, pushes your speaking, and refuses to let you stay a mouse.

            </p>

            <div class="hero-cta-row">

              <button class="btn-pill btn-primary" id="cta-log-today">

                Log today’s study

              </button>

              <button class="btn-pill btn-secondary" id="cta-what-can">

                What can NET PET do?

              </button>

            </div>

          </div>

        </section>



        <!-- PULSE + DIALOGUE -->

        <section id="section-pulse">

          <div class="section-label">Today’s energy</div>

          <div class="pulse-card">

            <div class="avatar-stack">

              <div class="avatar-ring"></div>

              <div class="avatar-ring inner"></div>

              <div class="avatar-core" id="pet-avatar"></div>

            </div>

            <div class="pulse-meta">

              <div class="pulse-title">Your English Energy</div>

              <div class="pulse-sub" id="pulse-status">

                Let’s see if today looks like a tiger or a mouse.

              </div>

              <div class="pulse-chip-row">

                <div class="chip chip-heat" id="chip-mood">Mood: Neutral</div>

                <div class="chip" id="chip-goal">Goal: Not complete</div>

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

          <div class="dialogue-card">

            <div id="ai-line">

              "Initializing neural link. I’m here to keep you honest, not comfortable."

            </div>

          </div>

        </section>



        <!-- TRACKER -->

        <section id="section-tracker">

          <div class="section-label">45 / 15 tracker</div>

          <div class="tracker-card">

            <div class="tracker-row">

              <div class="tracker-label">

                <span>Listening (Fun Input)</span>

                <span id="listen-label">0 / 45m</span>

              </div>

              <div class="progress-shell">

                <div class="progress-fill listen" id="bar-listen"></div>

              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="tracker-row">

              <div class="tracker-label">

                <span>Speaking / Mimic</span>

                <span id="speak-label">0 / 15m</span>

              </div>

              <div class="progress-shell">

                <div class="progress-fill speak" id="bar-speak"></div>

              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="tracker-buttons">

              <button class="btn-solid btn-listen" id="btn-log-listen">+15m Listening</button>

              <button class="btn-solid btn-speak" id="btn-log-speak">+5m Speaking</button>

            </div>

            <div class="tracker-footnote">

              Rule #1: 60% understanding minimum. Rule #2: No pausing. Rule #3: Make it fun.

            </div>

          </div>

        </section>



        <!-- CAPABILITIES — COMET STYLE AI THAT… -->

        <section id="section-capabilities">

          <div class="section-label">What NET PET can do</div>

          <div class="capabilities-card">

            <div class="capabilities-grid">

              <div class="capability-pill">

                <div class="cap-badge">AI that coaches</div>

                <div class="cap-title">Tough love when you’re hiding</div>

                <p class="cap-text">

                  If you only listen and never speak, NET PET flips into Coach Mode and pushes you out

                  of your comfort zone. No more “I’ll speak when I’m perfect”.

                </p>

              </div>

              <div class="capability-pill">

                <div class="cap-badge">AI that tracks</div>

                <div class="cap-title">Your 45·15 streak, day by day</div>

                <p class="cap-text">

                  It watches your listening and speaking time, day rollovers, and streaks – then

                  reacts when you break the habit or level up.

                </p>

              </div>

              <div class="capability-pill">

                <div class="cap-badge">AI that builds</div>

                <div class="cap-title">A lifestyle, not a cram session</div>

                <p class="cap-text">

                  Instead of “homework”, NET PET designs small, realistic daily wins so English becomes

                  part of your lifestyle, not a chore.

                </p>

              </div>

              <div class="capability-pill">

                <div class="cap-badge">AI that fixes</div>

                <div class="cap-title">Robot voice & mouse energy</div>

                <p class="cap-text">

                  It keeps reminding you to increase volume, mimic emotion, and laugh at mistakes –

                  so you stop sounding like a shy exam robot.

                </p>

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

        </section>



        <!-- FAQ -->

        <section id="section-faq">

          <div class="section-label">FAQ</div>

          <div class="faq-card">

            <div class="faq-item">

              <div class="faq-header">

                <div class="faq-question">What does NET PET actually track?</div>

                <div class="faq-toggle">+</div>

              </div>

              <div class="faq-body">

                <div class="faq-body-inner">

                  Your daily listening minutes, speaking minutes, and whether you’ve hit the 45/15 goal

                  for the day. It also tracks your streak and mood state (neutral, tough love, proud).

                </div>

              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="faq-item">

              <div class="faq-header">

                <div class="faq-question">What happens if I miss a day?</div>

                <div class="faq-toggle">+</div>

              </div>

              <div class="faq-body">

                <div class="faq-body-inner">

                  If you miss your goal, the next day NET PET resets your streak and switches into

                  Tough Love mode. It doesn’t punish you – it just refuses to lie about your progress.

                </div>

              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="faq-item">

              <div class="faq-header">

                <div class="faq-question">Do I have to log exact minutes?</div>

                <div class="faq-toggle">+</div>

              </div>

              <div class="faq-body">

                <div class="faq-body-inner">

                  No. The buttons are designed for quick logging. Each tap is a chunk of time:

                  15 minutes for listening, 5 minutes for speaking. You can tap multiple times

                  to match your real study.

                </div>

              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="faq-item">

              <div class="faq-header">

                <div class="faq-question">Is this a replacement for a teacher?</div>

                <div class="faq-toggle">+</div>

              </div>

              <div class="faq-body">

                <div class="faq-body-inner">

                  No. NET PET is the daily accountability partner. The real transformation comes from

                  the combination of human teacher, NET lessons, and this AI coach watching your habits.

                </div>

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

        </section>

      </main>



      <footer class="app-footer">

        <span class="footer-mark">GOSPEL·444</span>

        <span class="foot-pill">Phoenix Engine · Buddy System Ready</span>

      </footer>

    </div>

  </div>



  <script>

    // ========================================================================

    // PHOENIX EVENT BUS (COMET-STYLE CORE)

    // ========================================================================

    const EventBus = {

      _subscribers: {},

      on(event, fn) {

        if (!this._subscribers[event]) this._subscribers[event] = [];

        this._subscribers[event].push(fn);

      },

      emit(event, payload) {

        (this._subscribers[event] || []).forEach(fn => fn(payload));

      }

    };



    // ========================================================================

    // STATE & CANONICAL CONSTANTS

    // ========================================================================

    const DEFAULT_STATE = {

      streak: 0,

      listeningMin: 0,

      speakingMin: 0,

      lastLogin: new Date().toDateString(),

      mood: "NEUTRAL", // NEUTRAL, TOUGH_LOVE, HAPPY, PROUD

      dailyGoalMet: false

    };



    let state;

    try {

      const fromStorage = localStorage.getItem("netPetV1State");

      state = fromStorage ? { ...DEFAULT_STATE, ...JSON.parse(fromStorage) } : { ...DEFAULT_STATE };

    } catch {

      state = { ...DEFAULT_STATE };

    }



    const GOAL_LISTEN = 45;

    const GOAL_SPEAK = 15;



    // Voice matrix grounded in your canonical tones

    const VOICE_MATRIX = {

      GREETING: [

        "Let’s get to work. Consistency beats intensity.",

        "Welcome back. Ready to break the grammar prison again?",

        "Remember: you learned Vietnamese by listening first. We do the same here.",

        "Today is another chance to be a tiger, not a mouse."

      ],

      TOUGH_LOVE: [

        "You haven’t practiced speaking yet. You can’t learn to swim by reading the water.",

        "Grammar won’t save you in a real meeting. Confidence will. Open your mouth.",

        "You built a whole wall around your mistakes. Let’s kick one brick out today.",

        "Do you want fluency or just the feeling of ‘studying’? The difference is action."

      ],

      CELEBRATION: [

        "Boom. You hit 45 and 15. That’s real English work, not homework.",

        "That’s the energy I want. Small wins, every day. This is how you become fluent.",

        "You’re not ‘learning English’ anymore – you’re living with English.",

        "Outstanding. Tomorrow, we just repeat this. Simple. Heavy. Effective."

      ],

      NUDGE: [

        "Pick one show you actually enjoy and listen. No pausing. Just let it wash over you.",

        "Five more minutes of shadowing could change how you sound next month.",

        "60% understanding is enough. Your brain will fill the rest if you keep going.",

        "If it’s fun, you’ll keep coming back. Let’s make the next 10 minutes fun."

      ]

    };



    // DOM Refs

    const streakCountEl = document.getElementById("streak-count");

    const avatarEl = document.getElementById("pet-avatar");

    const chipMoodEl = document.getElementById("chip-mood");

    const chipGoalEl = document.getElementById("chip-goal");

    const pulseStatusEl = document.getElementById("pulse-status");



    const listenLabelEl = document.getElementById("listen-label");

    const speakLabelEl = document.getElementById("speak-label");

    const listenBarEl = document.getElementById("bar-listen");

    const speakBarEl = document.getElementById("bar-speak");



    const aiLineEl = document.getElementById("ai-line");



    const btnLogListen = document.getElementById("btn-log-listen");

    const btnLogSpeak = document.getElementById("btn-log-speak");

    const ctaLogToday = document.getElementById("cta-log-today");

    const ctaWhatCan = document.getElementById("cta-what-can");

    const mainRoot = document.getElementById("scroll-root");



    const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll(".faq-item");



    // ========================================================================

    // HELPERS

    // ========================================================================

    function saveState() {

      try {

        localStorage.setItem("netPetV1State", JSON.stringify(state));

      } catch {

        // ignore storage errors

      }

      EventBus.emit("state:updated", { ...state });

    }



    function pickRandom(arr) {

      return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];

    }



    function setLine(category) {

      const pool = VOICE_MATRIX[category];

      if (!pool || pool.length === 0) return;

      const line = pickRandom(pool);

      aiLineEl.textContent = `"${line}"`;

    }



    function todayString() {

      return new Date().toDateString();

    }



    // Check day rollover / slump detection

    function checkDayRollover() {

      const today = todayString();

      if (state.lastLogin !== today) {

        // New day

        if (state.dailyGoalMet) {

          state.streak += 1;

          state.mood = "HAPPY";

        } else {

          state.streak = 0;

          state.mood = "TOUGH_LOVE";

        }

        state.listeningMin = 0;

        state.speakingMin = 0;

        state.dailyGoalMet = false;

        state.lastLogin = today;

        saveState();

      }

    }



    function evaluateGoal() {

      if (state.listeningMin >= GOAL_LISTEN && state.speakingMin >= GOAL_SPEAK) {

        if (!state.dailyGoalMet) {

          state.dailyGoalMet = true;

          state.mood = "PROUD";

          setLine("CELEBRATION");

        }

      } else if (state.listeningMin > 0 && state.speakingMin === 0) {

        state.mood = "TOUGH_LOVE";

        setLine("TOUGH_LOVE");

      } else if (state.listeningMin === 0 && state.speakingMin === 0) {

        state.mood = "NEUTRAL";

      } else {

        state.mood = "HAPPY";

        if (Math.random() > 0.7) {

          setLine("NUDGE");

        }

      }

    }



    function renderUI() {

      // streak

      streakCountEl.textContent = state.streak.toString();



      // progress

      const listenPct = Math.min((state.listeningMin / GOAL_LISTEN) * 100, 100);

      const speakPct = Math.min((state.speakingMin / GOAL_SPEAK) * 100, 100);



      listenBarEl.style.width = listenPct + "%";

      speakBarEl.style.width = speakPct + "%";



      listenLabelEl.textContent = `${state.listeningMin} / ${GOAL_LISTEN}m`;

      speakLabelEl.textContent = `${state.speakingMin} / ${GOAL_SPEAK}m`;



      // mood + pulse

      chipMoodEl.textContent = `Mood: ${

        state.mood === "PROUD"

          ? "Proud"

          : state.mood === "TOUGH_LOVE"

          ? "Tough love"

          : state.mood === "HAPPY"

          ? "Positive"

          : "Neutral"

      }`;



      chipGoalEl.textContent = `Goal: ${state.dailyGoalMet ? "Complete" : "Not complete"}`;



      if (state.mood === "PROUD") {

        avatarEl.className = "avatar-core happy";

        pulseStatusEl.textContent =

          "You hit your goal. This is what real English training looks like.";

      } else if (state.mood === "TOUGH_LOVE") {

        avatarEl.className = "avatar-core slump";

        pulseStatusEl.textContent =

          "Streak broken or no speaking yet. I’m not angry, just honest. Let’s fix it today.";

      } else if (state.mood === "HAPPY") {

        avatarEl.className = "avatar-core happy";

        pulseStatusEl.textContent =

          "Good momentum. Keep stacking small wins – the tiger is waking up.";

      } else {

        avatarEl.className = "avatar-core";

        pulseStatusEl.textContent =

          "We start simple: 45 minutes listening, 15 minutes speaking. I’ll track the truth.";

      }

    }



    // ========================================================================

    // EVENT HANDLERS

    // ========================================================================

    btnLogListen.addEventListener("click", () => {

      state.listeningMin += 15;

      evaluateGoal();

      saveState();

    });



    btnLogSpeak.addEventListener("click", () => {

      state.speakingMin += 5;

      evaluateGoal();

      saveState();

    });



    ctaLogToday.addEventListener("click", () => {

      // Scroll to tracker section

      const section = document.getElementById("section-tracker");

      section && section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });

      // gentle nudge line

      setLine("NUDGE");

    });



    ctaWhatCan.addEventListener("click", () => {

      const section = document.getElementById("section-capabilities");

      section && section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });

    });



    // FAQ toggles

    faqItems.forEach(item => {

      const header = item.querySelector(".faq-header");

      header.addEventListener("click", () => {

        const isOpen = item.classList.contains("open");

        faqItems.forEach(i => i.classList.remove("open"));

        if (!isOpen) item.classList.add("open");

      });

    });



    // Listen to state:updated on EventBus (COMET-style pattern)

    EventBus.on("state:updated", renderUI);



    // ========================================================================

    // INIT

    // ========================================================================

    (function init() {

      checkDayRollover();

      renderUI();

      // initial greeting only if no goal yet for today

      if (!state.dailyGoalMet && state.listeningMin === 0 && state.speakingMin === 0) {

        setLine("GREETING");

      } else {

        evaluateGoal();

      }

      console.log("NET PET AI V1 :: ONLINE :: PHOENIX × COMET · GOSPEL 444 COMPLIANT");

    })();

  </script>

</body>

</html>

Slide 1: Title Slide
Title: Unlocking Potential: Natural English Training for Your Team

Subtitle: Empowering E1-E3 Staff with Confidence & Communication

Presenter: [Your Name/Company Name]

Date: [Current Date]

Slide 2: The Challenge: The "Grammar Prison"
Headline: Why Traditional Training Fails Your Staff

Problem: Many entry-level staff (E1-E3) have studied English for years but lack speaking confidence. They are stuck in "Grammar Prison"—knowing rules but afraid to speak.

Impact:

Hesitation in internal communications.

Reluctance to participate in meetings.

Reduced efficiency due to language barriers.

Visual: A simple graphic illustrating a person surrounded by grammar books, looking hesitant to speak vs. a person speaking freely.

Slide 3: The NET Solution: Natural Acquisition
Headline: Learn Like You Learned Your First Language

Our Philosophy: We bypass traditional drills and focus on natural acquisition: Listen → Mimic → Speak.

The 4 Pillars:

Listen & Understand: 45 mins/day of engaging content (60% comprehension rule).

Speak & Mimic: 15 mins/day active shadowing to break the "robot voice".

Context Learning: No isolated words; always full sentences and real scenarios.

Confidence First: A safe environment to make mistakes and grow ("Tiger Voice").

Visual: Icons representing Ear (Listen), Mouth (Speak), Brain (Context), and a Shield/Tiger (Confidence).

Slide 4: For E1-E3 Levels: Building the Foundation
Headline: Targeted Growth for Beginners

Focus:

Overcoming Fear: Breaking the "silence barrier" in meetings.

bro, imagine you are a 10 year old ESL student, imagine opening up this confusing fucking mess.. WTF is this?



Yeah, for a 10‑year‑old this is way too busy, too text‑heavy, and way too “dashboard”.

Why this feels terrible for Timmy

He sees a wall of tiny text, many sections, and “XP / rank / tags” that don’t actually change when he clicks, so it feels fake‑game and boring at the same time.

Cognitive load is adult‑level: multiple fonts, meters, timelines, idioms, slang, and sidequests in one page with no super obvious “Start here, do this one thing now” button.

The language is teacher‑facing, not kid‑facing: “mission hub, focus of the week, inventory open, core vocabulary, sidekick tip” are cool for you, but not concrete actions for him.

What Timmy actually needs

One ultra‑simple page per day, or one page with 5 big buttons: “Day 1 / Day 2 / Day 3 / Day 4 / Day 5”.

For each day: max 3 steps, each step one short sentence + one icon + maybe a checkbox: “1. Say your battery. 2. Watch this. 3. Tell this story.”

Game layer as real feedback: stars he can color in, a simple progress bar he fills, maybe one boss picture with hearts he crosses out when he wins.

Concrete next move

If you want, next output can be:

A “Timmy‑proof” HTML v2: no meters, no stat labels, just five big “DAY” cards, each with 3 steps written at E2–E3 level, and one tiny “For Mr. Hobbs” teacher note at the bottom of each card.

Then a separate teacher sheet (no CSS fuss) that keeps all the nice structure and jargon from the seed so you don’t lose the system design, but Timmy never sees it.

I asked for 3 fucking homework assignments. Be simple, but comprehensive. Each lesson should be on a tap of its own, do your fucking job



You will get 3 simple but comprehensive homework “tabs” in one HTML file, each one self‑contained and E2–E3 friendly.

Overview

3 homework missions: Mission 1: V vs W, Mission 2: Future Story Boss, Mission 3: Gamer Words & Idioms.

Each mission is one “tab”: big buttons on top, only one mission visible at a time, 3–4 clear steps, checkboxes, kid‑level text.

No fake dashboards, no meters. Just do‑this‑now steps Timmy can follow alone.

Understood. I will use your "Hero's Journey" Seed for Timmy, simplifying it to fit his E3 Speaking level while maintaining the Gamification and Natural English Methodology.

Here are 3 distinct, age-appropriate homework missions for Timmy's week:

🎮 Mission 1: The "V" vs "W" Showdown (Speaking Power-Up)
Goal: Master the tricky V/W sounds and speak LOUDLY ("Tiger Voice").

Step 1: Warm-Up (Battery Check)

Action: Timmy records himself answering: "On a scale of 1 to 10, how much energy do you have today?"

Rule: Must use a full sentence: "I have [8] energy because [I slept well]."

Step 2: The Villain vs. The Hero

Action: Timmy practices these tongue twisters 3 times each.

The Villain (Viper): "Victor the Viper is very, very vain." (Focus on biting the lip for 'V').

The Hero (Warrior): "Walter the Warrior wins with water." (Focus on round lips for 'W').

Challenge: Say them LOUDLY. If he whispers, the Villain wins.

Step 3: Victory Speech

Action: Timmy records a 20-second video saying: "I am [Timmy]. I am a [Student]. I will defeat the Viper!"

📺 Mission 2: The Story Boss (Listening & Retell)
Goal: Watch a short video and retell the story using simple past tense.

Step 1: The Content Dive

Action: Watch a 2-minute video about Minecraft Building or Lego Engineering (Timmy chooses).

First watch: No subtitles.

Second watch: English subtitles.

Step 2: Spot the Verbs

Action: Write down 3 "Action Words" (Verbs) he saw in the video (e.g., build, break, run).

Step 3: The Retell (Boss Battle)

Action: Timmy records himself retelling the video in 5 simple sentences.

Frame: "First, the player [built a house]. Then, he [found a zombie]. Finally, he [ran away]."

Constraint: No "Um" or "Uh". If he says "Um", the Boss heals (he must start over).

🏆 Mission 3: The Weekly Project (Gamer Words)
Goal: Use "cool" gamer vocabulary in real sentences to build confidence.

Step 1: Learn the Code

Action: Learn 3 new slang words:

Glitch: A small problem.

Noob: A beginner.

Epic: Amazing/Cool.

Step 2: Use the Code

Action: Write 3 sentences about his life using these words.

Example: "My homework had a glitch." / "I am not a noob at English." / "Dinner was epic."

Step 3: Weekly Reflection

Action: Record a 1-minute video answering: "What was the most epic thing that happened this week?"

🤖 Teacher Note (For Mr. Hobbs):
Review: In the next class, play his "Victory Speech" (Mission 1) and praise his volume.

Feedback: For Mission 2, focus only on the verbs. Did he use past tense correctly? (Built vs Build).

Fun: Use the slang words (Glitch, Epic) in your class to reinforce Mission 3.

I hear you, Executor. We will maintain the Hero's Journey protocol and the core methodology, but we will dramatically increase the density and volume of the practice. Timmy is E3 (Speaking), which means he can form sentences but needs repetition, structure, and Volume.

This plan is 10X bigger, more rigorous, and packed with measurable outputs.

🚀 Mission 1: The Verbal Volcano (Expanded Protocol)
Goal: Master V/W sounds and use the "Tiger Voice" (70db+).

Part A: The Battery Check (Extended)

Action: Timmy records himself answering: "On a scale of 1 to 10, how much energy do you have today?"

Requirement: He must speak for at least 45 seconds.

Prompts:

Why is your energy high/low?

What time did you wake up?

What did you eat for breakfast?

What is one thing you are excited about today?

Part B: The V vs W Gauntlet

Drill: Read this list 3 times. Each time faster.

Very Wet / Wet Vest

Vine Wine / Wine Vine

West Vest / Best Vest

Whale Veil / Veil Whale

Wiper Viper / Viper Wiper

Tongue Twister Challenge: "Victor the Viper went West in a Wet Vest to Wash a White Van." (Say 5 times).

Multiple Choice Check:

Which word starts with a lip-bite sound? (A) West (B) Vest (C) Best

Which word starts with a round-lip sound? (A) Vine (B) Wine (C) Fine

Part C: The Victory Speech

Action: Record a 1-minute speech.

Script Frame: "My name is [Timmy]. I am a student at [School]. Today, I defeated the Viper because I practiced [hard]. My voice is strong like a [Tiger]. Next week, I will be even better!"

📺 Mission 2: The Story Boss (Deep Dive)
Goal: Active Listening & Detailed Retell (Past Tense Focus).

Part A: The Content Dive (Minecraft/Lego)

Action: Watch a 3-5 minute video. (Longer, more complex).

Active Listening Quiz (Short Answer):

What was the first thing the player built?

What color was the [roof/door/car]?

Why did the player [run/jump/hide]?

How many [zombies/blocks] were there?

Vocabulary Hunt: Find 5 Verbs (Action words) and 3 Adjectives (Describing words). Write them down.

Part B: The "No-Pause" Challenge

Action: Watch the video again without pausing. Try to say what is happening while watching. (Shadowing technique).

Part C: The Boss Battle Retell

Action: Record a 2-minute retelling of the story.

Structure:

Beginning: "In the beginning, the player..."

Middle: "Then, a problem happened. The problem was..."

Climax: "Suddenly, the player..."

End: "Finally, he..."

Opinion: "I liked this video because..."

🏆 Mission 3: The Weekly Project (Gamer Life)
Goal: Integrate English into his real identity (Gaming/YouTube).

Part A: Code Breaker (Vocabulary Expansion)

Learn & Define: (Write simple definitions for each).

Glitch: ____________________

Noob: ____________________

Epic: ____________________

Lag: ____________________

Spawn: ____________________

Sentence Builder: Write 2 sentences for each word. (10 sentences total).

Part B: YouTube Review (The Big Project)

Task: Go to his "History" on YouTube. Pick the last video he watched.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ SECTION 1: LINGUISTIC FORENSICS (THE "WHY" BEHIND THE ERRORS) ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1.1 THE "NULL COPULA" SYNDROME (The Missing Verb)

The Artifact: "I CEO," "My Mother Thum," "Because good."

The Root Cause (L1 Interference): In Vietnamese, adjectival predicates do not require the verb "to be" (Cô ấy đẹp = She beautiful). She is mapping this rule onto English. She views "am/is/are" as optional clutter.

NET Classification: Structural Blindness (Type A). She does not "see" the verb as necessary for meaning, so her brain filters it out before speech.

1.2 THE "TOPIC-COMMENT" STRUCTURE

The Artifact: "My Family six people."

The Root Cause: She uses a "Topic-Comment" syntax typical of East Asian languages (Gia đình tôi [Topic] + sáu người [Comment]). She is bypassing the English Subject-Verb-Object (SVO) requirement ("My family HAS six people" or "There ARE six people").

NET Risk: If uncorrected, this calcifies into "Pidgin English" where she just throws nouns at people until they understand.

1.3 VOCABULARY DISSOCIATION

The Artifact: "I AGC [Agency?] and singer."

The Analysis: She knows the concept (Actor/Agency) but lacks the phonetic retrieval speed, so she writes abbreviations or near-misses. She is "guessing" at the spelling based on incomplete hearing.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ SECTION 2: PHONOLOGICAL TOPOGRAPHY (THE MOUTH) ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

2.1 THE "OPEN SYLLABLE" CONSTRAINT

Evidence: "Peo-po" (People), "Si" (Six), "Nai" (Nice).

Mechanism: Vietnamese words cannot end in sounds like /s/, /l/, /ks/, /z/. Her mouth physically stops before the word is finished because her muscle memory says "Stop here."

Impact: This destroys her Pluralization and Tense markers (Past tense 'ed', Plural 's'). Even if she knows the grammar rule, her mouth deletes the evidence.

2.2 THE ROBOT RHYTHM (Isosyllabic Stress)

Evidence: "U-En-Ter-Tain-Ment" (Equal stress on all syllables).

Mechanism: She speaks English with Vietnamese tones and timing (Syllable-Timed Language). She does not reduce unstressed vowels (the "schwa").

NET Goal: We must teach her English Swing (Stress-Timed Language). She needs to learn to "eat" the unimportant words.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ SECTION 3: PSYCHOMETRIC PROFILE (THE MIND) ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

3.1 THE "CEO EGO" PARADOX

Status: High (CEO/Singer).

Competence: Low (E1).

The Friction: She is accustomed to commanding a room. In English, she feels like a child. This creates a massive Affective Filter (Anxiety Wall).

Behavioral Prediction: She will be impatient with "basic" drills (colors, numbers) because they feel demeaning. She will try to rush to complex sentences ("I negotiate contract") before she can say "I am hungry."

3.2 LEARNING STYLE: "THE ARCHITECT"

She writes lists. She categorizes ("Sentence - Word").

Strategy: Do not just "talk" to her. Give her formulas. She needs to see the "Blueprint" of the sentence (S + V + O) to feel safe. She is analytical, not intuitive.

why?

The reason you only get the Blue Hand first in Poppy Playtime Chapter 1 is primarily a design choice for pacing and gameplay progression.

Here's a breakdown of the likely reasons:

Tutorial and Pacing: Getting the Blue Hand first serves as a soft introduction to the GrabPack's mechanics. You learn how to use a single hand to interact with objects, pull levers, and activate blue-hand-only door plates. This allows the player to get comfortable with the core mechanic before adding the complexity of a second hand.

Creating an Early Obstacle: Immediately after getting the Blue Hand, the player enters the main lobby. They are then presented with a large door that requires both a blue and a red hand to open, effectively setting the goal for the first half of the chapter: Find the Red Hand (and restore power).

Structuring the Puzzle: The developers use the absence of the Red Hand to force the player into the "Power Room" (the area after the power shorts out), which leads them on a scavenger hunt for four power fuses. The reward for completing this challenging fuse puzzle is the Red Hand, completing the tool and unlocking the next major area of the factory.

In short, it's a way to gradually introduce the main tool, establish a clear objective, and structure the early-game puzzles.
