<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>NET Classroom Manager — V5 Truth Edition</title>

<!-- Tailwind (optional but allowed for styling consistency) -->
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>

<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
    :root {
        --purple: #a855f7;
        --gold: #f59e0b;
        --dark-bg: #0f0f1a;
        --card-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
        --blur: blur(12px);
    }
    body {
        font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        background: var(--dark-bg);
        color: white;
        min-height: 100vh;
        padding: 2rem;
        background-image:
            radial-gradient(circle at 25% 20%, rgba(168,85,247,0.15), transparent 60%),
            radial-gradient(circle at 80% 70%, rgba(245,158,11,0.12), transparent 65%);
    }
    .glass {
        background: var(--card-bg);
        backdrop-filter: var(--blur);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
        border-radius: 1rem;
        box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(168,85,247,0.2);
    }
    .glow-btn {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--gold));
        padding: .75rem 1.4rem;
        border-radius: .75rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #fff;
        transition: 0.2s;
    }
    .glow-btn:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.03);
        box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(245,158,11,0.4);
    }
    /* Wheel Styling */
    #wheelCanvas {
        width: 300px;
        height: 300px;
    }
</style>
</head>

<body>

<h1 class="text-4xl font-bold mb-6">
  NET Classroom Manager <span class="text-[var(--gold)]">V5</span>
</h1>

<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

    <!-- STUDENT LIST / MANAGER -->
    <div class="glass p-5">
        <h2 class="text-2xl font-semibold mb-3 text-[var(--purple)]">Student Manager</h2>

        <input id="studentInput" placeholder="Add student..." 
            class="w-full mb-3 p-2 rounded bg-black/20 border border-white/10"
        />

        <button id="addStudentBtn" class="glow-btn w-full mb-4">Add Student</button>

        <ul id="studentList" class="space-y-2"></ul>
    </div>

    <!-- RANDOMIZER WHEEL -->
    <div class="glass p-5 flex flex-col items-center">
        <h2 class="text-2xl font-semibold mb-3 text-[var(--gold)]">Randomizer Wheel</h2>

        <canvas id="wheelCanvas"></canvas>
        <button id="spinBtn" class="glow-btn mt-4">Spin</button>

        <div id="winnerDisplay" class="mt-4 text-xl font-bold text-[var(--purple)]"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- TEAM SELECTOR -->
    <div class="glass p-5">
        <h2 class="text-2xl font-semibold mb-3 text-[var(--purple)]">Team Selector</h2>

        <button id="createTeamsBtn" class="glow-btn w-full mb-4">Create 2 Teams</button>

        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
                <h3 class="font-semibold text-[var(--gold)] mb-2">Team A</h3>
                <ul id="teamA" class="space-y-1"></ul>
            </div>
            <div>
                <h3 class="font-semibold text-[var(--gold)] mb-2">Team B</h3>
                <ul id="teamB" class="space-y-1"></ul>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

</div>

<script>
// ======= STATE ===================================================
const state = {
    students: []
};

// ======= DOM ELEMENTS ===========================================
const studentInput = document.getElementById("studentInput");
const addStudentBtn = document.getElementById("addStudentBtn");
const studentList = document.getElementById("studentList");

const wheelCanvas = document.getElementById("wheelCanvas");
const winnerDisplay = document.getElementById("winnerDisplay");

const spinBtn = document.getElementById("spinBtn");
const createTeamsBtn = document.getElementById("createTeamsBtn");
const teamA = document.getElementById("teamA");
const teamB = document.getElementById("teamB");

// ======= STUDENT MANAGER ========================================
function renderStudents() {
    studentList.innerHTML = "";
    state.students.forEach((s, i) => {
        const li = document.createElement("li");
        li.className = "bg-white/5 p-2 rounded flex justify-between";
        li.innerHTML = `
            <span>${s}</span>
            <button data-i="${i}" class="text-red-400 hover:text-red-200">✕</button>
        `;
        studentList.appendChild(li);
    });
}

addStudentBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const name = studentInput.value.trim();
    if (!name) return;

    state.students.push(name);
    studentInput.value = "";
    renderStudents();
    drawWheel();
});

studentList.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    if (e.target.dataset.i !== undefined) {
        const index = Number(e.target.dataset.i);
        state.students.splice(index, 1);
        renderStudents();
        drawWheel();
    }
});

// ======= RANDOMIZER WHEEL ======================================
let angle = 0;
let spinning = false;
const ctx = wheelCanvas.getContext("2d");

function drawWheel() {
    const items = state.students;
    const count = items.length;
    const radius = wheelCanvas.width / 2;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, wheelCanvas.width, wheelCanvas.height);

    if (count === 0) return;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const start = (i / count) * 2 * Math.PI;
        const end = ((i + 1) / count) * 2 * Math.PI;

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(radius, radius);
        ctx.arc(radius, radius, radius, start, end);
        ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? "#a855f7" : "#f59e0b";
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(radius, radius);
        ctx.rotate(start + (end - start) / 2);
        ctx.textAlign = "right";
        ctx.fillStyle = "white";
        ctx.font = "16px Inter";
        ctx.fillText(items[i], radius - 10, 5);
        ctx.restore();
    }
}
drawWheel();

spinBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (spinning || state.students.length === 0) return;

    spinning = true;
    winnerDisplay.textContent = "";

    let spinSpeed = Math.random() * 15 + 25;
    let deceleration = 0.1;

    const spinInterval = setInterval(() => {
        angle += spinSpeed;
        spinSpeed -= deceleration;

        if (spinSpeed <= 0) {
            clearInterval(spinInterval);
            spinning = false;

            const index = Math.floor(((angle % 360) / 360) * state.students.length);
            const winner = state.students[index];
            winnerDisplay.textContent = `Winner: ${winner}`;
        }

        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(wheelCanvas.width / 2, wheelCanvas.height / 2);
        ctx.rotate(angle * Math.PI / 180);
        ctx.translate(-wheelCanvas.width / 2, -wheelCanvas.height / 2);
        drawWheel();
        ctx.restore();
    }, 20);
});

// ======= TEAM SELECTOR =========================================
createTeamsBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const shuffled = [...state.students].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);

    const mid = Math.ceil(shuffled.length / 2);
    const a = shuffled.slice(0, mid);
    const b = shuffled.slice(mid);

    teamA.innerHTML = a.map(s => `<li>${s}</li>`).join("");
    teamB.innerHTML = b.map(s => `<li>${s}</li>`).join("");
});

</script>
</body>
</html>

studentList.addEventListener("click", (e) => {

    }
});

// ===== WHEEL =====
function drawWheel() {
    const items = state.students;
    const count = items.length;
    const radius = wheelCanvas.width / 2;

    ctx.clearRect(0,0,wheelCanvas.width,wheelCanvas.height);
    if (count === 0) return;

    for (let i=0; i<count; i++) {
        const start = (i / count) * 2 * Math.PI;
        const end = ((i+1) / count) * 2 * Math.PI;

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(radius, radius);
        ctx.arc(radius, radius, radius, start, end);
        ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? "#a855f7" : "#f59e0b";
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.translate(radius, radius);

        ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";

        min-height: 100vh;
        background-image:
            radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(168,85,247,0.14), transparent 60%),

        background: var(--glass);
        backdrop-filter: var(--blur);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
        border-radius: 1rem;
        padding: 1.5rem;
    }
    .glow-btn {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--gold));
        padding: .75rem 1.3rem;
        border-radius: .8rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        transition: 0.2s;
        color: white;
    }
    .glow-btn:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.03);
        box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(245,158,11,0.4);
    }
    #wheelCanvas {
        width: 320px;
        height: 320px;
    }
    .stage {
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
        border-radius: 1rem;

        margin-bottom: 1rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10);

<body>

<!-- LANDING PAGE -->
<div id="landingPage" class="fixed inset-0 bg-[var(--dark)] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-10 z-50">
    <h1 class="text-5xl font-bold mb-6">Sarcasm — Level I-1</h1>
    <p class="text-lg text-gray-300 max-w-2xl mb-6">
        Welcome to today’s NET storytelling lesson!  
        You will move through a morning at <span class="text-[var(--gold)] font-semibold">Highbridge High School</span>,  
        where sarcasm is everywhere — the halls, the classroom, and your friends.
    </p>
    <button id="startLesson" class="glow-btn text-xl px-10 py-3">Begin Lesson</button>
</div>

<!-- MAIN CONTENT -->
<div id="main" class="hidden">

<h1 class="text-4xl font-bold mb-6">
  Sarcasm Lesson I-1 — <span class="text-[var(--gold)]">Story Mode</span>
</h1>

<div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

    <!-- LEFT SIDE: CLASS CONTROL -->
    <div class="space-y-6">

        <!-- STUDENT MANAGER -->
        <div class="glass">
            <h2 class="text-2xl font-semibold text-[var(--purple)] mb-3">Students (40 Loaded)</h2>
            <input id="studentInput" class="w-full p-2 rounded bg-black/30 border border-white/10 mb-3" placeholder="Add student..." />
            <button id="addStudentBtn" class="glow-btn w-full mb-4">Add Student</button>
            <ul id="studentList" class="space-y-1 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto"></ul>
        </div>

        <!-- WHEEL -->
        <div class="glass flex flex-col items-center">
            <h2 class="text-2xl font-semibold text-[var(--gold)] mb-3">Selector Wheel</h2>
            <canvas id="wheelCanvas"></canvas>
            <button id="spinBtn" class="glow-btn mt-4">Spin</button>
            <div id="winnerDisplay" class="mt-4 text-xl font-bold text-[var(--purple)]"></div>
        </div>

        <!-- SCOREBOARD -->
        <div class="glass">
            <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold text-[var(--purple)] mb-3">Scoreboard</h2>
            <div class="flex justify-between mb-3">
                <button id="scoreAplus" class="glow-btn">+A</button>
                <button id="scoreBplus" class="glow-btn">+B</button>
            </div>
            <p class="text-[var(--gold)] font-semibold">Team A: <span id="scoreA">0</span></p>
            <p class="text-[var(--gold)] font-semibold">Team B: <span id="scoreB">0</span></p>
            <button id="resetScores" class="glow-btn mt-3 w-full bg-red-700/60">Reset</button>
        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- CENTER: TEAMS -->
    <div class="glass">
        <h2 class="text-3xl font-semibold text-[var(--purple)] mb-4">Teams</h2>
        <button id="createTeamsBtn" class="glow-btn w-full mb-4">Generate Teams (2)</button>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
                <h3 class="text-[var(--gold)] font-semibold mb-2">Team A</h3>
                <ul id="teamA" class="space-y-1"></ul>
            </div>
            <div>
                <h3 class="text-[var(--gold)] font-semibold mb-2">Team B</h3>
                <ul id="teamB" class="space-y-1"></ul>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- RIGHT SIDE: STORY / LESSON -->
    <div class="glass">
        <h2 class="text-3xl font-bold text-[var(--gold)] mb-4">Story Mode</h2>

        <!-- STAGES -->
        <div class="stage">
            <h3 class="text-xl font-semibold text-[var(--purple)]">1. The Morning Bell</h3>
            <p class="text-gray-300">Scenario: You're late. Again.</p>
            <p class="mt-2">Your friend says:<br>
            <b class="text-[var(--gold)]">“Wow… EARLY as always.”</b></p>
            <p class="mt-2">Use the wheel to pick 3 students to respond with sarcastic lines.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="stage">
            <h3 class="text-xl font-semibold text-[var(--purple)]">2. The Teacher Announcement</h3>
            <p class="text-gray-300">Your teacher says:</p>
            <p class="text-[var(--gold)]">“Great news everyone, we have a surprise test.”</p>
            <p class="mt-2">Teams create sarcastic reactions. Best answer = 1 point.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="stage">
            <h3 class="text-xl font-semibold text-[var(--purple)]">3. Sarcasm Quiz</h3>
            <ul class="list-disc pl-5 text-gray-300">
                <li>“This is EXACTLY how I wanted to start my day.” → Sarcastic</li>
                <li>“I'm excited for graduation.” → Not sarcastic</li>
                <li>“Wow… my life just keeps getting better and better…” → Sarcastic</li>
            </ul>
        </div>

        <div class="stage">
            <h3 class="text-xl font-semibold text-[var(--purple)]">4. Hallway Roleplay</h3>
            <p class="text-gray-300">Randomly choose pairs using the wheel.</p>
            <p>Situation: Your friend forgot the homework… again.</p>
            <p class="text-[var(--gold)] mt-2">Teams judge who has the best sarcastic line.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="stage">
            <h3 class="text-xl font-semibold text-[var(--purple)]">5. Final Task</h3>
            <p class="text-gray-300">Choose 5 students with the wheel.</p>
            <p>Your line: <b class="text-[var(--gold)]">“Amazing. Another Monday. My favorite.”</b></p>
            <p>Best performance = 2 points.</p>
        </div>

    </div>

</div>

</div>

<script>
// ===== LANDING PAGE =====
document.getElementById("startLesson").addEventListener("click", () => {
    document.getElementById("landingPage").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("main").classList.remove("hidden");
});

// ===== INITIAL CLASS OF 40 STUDENTS =====
const defaultStudents = Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => `Student ${i + 1}`);

// ===== STATE =====
const state = {
    students: [...defaultStudents],
    angle: 0,
    spinning: false,
    scoreA: 0,
    scoreB: 0,
};

// ===== DOM SHORTCUTS =====
const studentList = document.getElementById("studentList");
const studentInput = document.getElementById("studentInput");
const wheel = document.getElementById("wheelCanvas");
const ctx = wheel.getContext("2d");

// ===== RENDER STUDENTS =====
function renderStudents() {
    studentList.innerHTML = state.students.map((s,i)=>
        `<li class="bg-white/5 p-2 rounded flex justify-between">
            <span>${s}</span>
            <button data-i="${i}" class="text-red-400 hover:text-red-200">✕</button>
        </li>`
    ).join("");
}
renderStudents();

// ===== ADD STUDENT =====
document.getElementById("addStudentBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const name = studentInput.value.trim();
    if (!name) return;
    state.students.push(name);
    studentInput.value = "";
    renderStudents();
    drawWheel();
});

// ===== REMOVE STUDENT =====
studentList.addEventListener("click", e => {
    const idx = e.target.dataset.i;
    if (idx !== undefined) {
        state.students.splice(idx, 1);
        renderStudents();
        drawWheel();
    }
});

// ===== WHEEL DRAWING =====
function drawWheel() {
    const items = state.students;
    const count = items.length;
    const r = wheel.width / 2;
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,wheel.width,wheel.height);
    if (count === 0) return;

    for (let i=0;i<count;i++){
        const start = (i/count)*2*Math.PI;
        const end = ((i+1)/count)*2*Math.PI;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(r,r);
        ctx.arc(r,r,r,start,end);
        ctx.fillStyle = i%2===0 ? "#a855f7" : "#f59e0b";
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(r,r);
        ctx.rotate(start+(end-start)/2);
        ctx.textAlign="right";
        ctx.fillStyle="white";
        ctx.font="16px Inter";
        ctx.fillText(items[i], r-10,5);
        ctx.restore();
    }
}
drawWheel();

// ===== SPIN =====
document.getElementById("spinBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (state.spinning || state.students.length===0) return;

    state.spinning = true;
    document.getElementById("winnerDisplay").textContent="";

    let speed = Math.random()*20+30;
    const decel = 0.12;

    const spin = setInterval(()=>{
        state.angle += speed;
        speed -= decel;

        if (speed <= 0) {
            clearInterval(spin);
            state.spinning = false;

            const idx = Math.floor(((state.angle % 360)/360)*state.students.length);
            const winner = state.students[idx];
            document.getElementById("winnerDisplay").textContent = "Selected: "+winner;
        }

        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(160,160);
        ctx.rotate(state.angle*Math.PI/180);
        ctx.translate(-160,-160);
        drawWheel();
        ctx.restore();

    },20);
});

// ===== TEAMS =====
document.getElementById("createTeamsBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const shuf = [...state.students].sort(()=>Math.random()-0.5);
    const mid = Math.ceil(shuf.length/2);
    document.getElementById("teamA").innerHTML = shuf.slice(0,mid).map(s=>`<li>${s}</li>`).join("");
    document.getElementById("teamB").innerHTML = shuf.slice(mid).map(s=>`<li>${s}</li>`).join("");
});

// ===== SCOREBOARD =====
document.getElementById("scoreAplus").addEventListener("click",()=>{
    state.scoreA++;
    document.getElementById("scoreA").textContent=state.scoreA;
});
document.getElementById("scoreBplus").addEventListener("click",()=>{
    state.scoreB++;
    document.getElementById("scoreB").textContent=state.scoreB;
});
document.getElementById("resetScores").addEventListener("click",()=>{
    state.scoreA=0;
    state.scoreB=0;
    document.getElementById("scoreA").textContent=0;
    document.getElementById("scoreB").textContent=0;
});
</script>

</body>
</html>

            <p class="text-gray-300">The principal says:</p>
            <p class="text-[var(--gold)] font-semibold mt-1">“Happy Monday! Let’s all smile!”</p>
            <p class="mt-2">Chaos Wheel selects 5 students.  
            They must perform a dramatic, sarcastic speech.</p>
            <p class="mt-2"><span class="text-[var(--purple)] font-bold">+2 points</span> to winner.</p>
        </div>
    </div>

</div>

</div>

<script>
/* ================================================
   LANDING PAGE
================================================= */
document.getElementById("startLesson").addEventListener("click", () => {
    landingPage.style.display = "none";
    main.classList.remove("hidden");
});

/* ================================================
   INITIAL STUDENTS
================================================= */
const defaultStudents = Array.from({length:40}, (_,i)=>`Student ${i+1}`);

const state = {
    students:[...defaultStudents],
    scoreA:0,
    scoreB:0,
    spinning:false,
    angle:0,
};

/* ================================================
   RENDER STUDENTS
================================================= */
function renderStudents() {
    studentList.innerHTML = state.students
        .map((s,i)=>
            `<li class="bg-white/5 p-2 rounded flex justify-between">
                <span>${s}</span>
                <button data-i="${i}" class="text-red-400 hover:text-red-200">✕</button>
            </li>`
        ).join("");
}
renderStudents();

/* ================================================
   ADD / REMOVE STUDENTS
================================================= */
addStudentBtn.addEventListener("click",()=>{
    const name = studentInput.value.trim();
    if (!name) return;
    state.students.push(name);
    studentInput.value="";
    renderStudents();
    drawBigWheel();
});
studentList.addEventListener("click", e=>{
    if (e.target.dataset.i!==undefined){
        state.students.splice(e.target.dataset.i,1);
        renderStudents();
        drawBigWheel();
    }
});

/* ================================================
   FULLSCREEN CHAOS WHEEL
================================================= */
const wheelOverlay = document.getElementById("wheelOverlay");
const bigWheel = document.getElementById("bigWheelCanvas");
const bigCtx = bigWheel.getContext("2d");


function drawBigWheel() {
    const items = state.students;
    const count = items.length;
    const r = bigWheel.width/2;

    bigCtx.clearRect(0,0,bigWheel.width,bigWheel.height);

    if (count===0) return;

    for (let i=0;i<count;i++){
        const start = (i/count)*2*Math.PI;
        const end = ((i+1)/count)*2*Math.PI;
        bigCtx.beginPath();
        bigCtx.moveTo(r,r);
        bigCtx.arc(r,r,r,start,end);
        bigCtx.fillStyle = i%2===0? "#a855f7" : "#f59e0b";
        bigCtx.fill();

        bigCtx.save();
        bigCtx.translate(r,r);
        bigCtx.rotate(start+(end-start)/2);
        bigCtx.fillStyle="white";
        bigCtx.textAlign="right";
        bigCtx.font="20px Inter";
        bigCtx.fillText(items[i], r-15,5);
        bigCtx.restore();
    }
}
drawBigWheel();

/* ================================================
   OPEN FULLSCREEN WHEEL
================================================= */
openWheelBtn.addEventListener("click",()=>{
    wheelOverlay.style.display="flex";
    drawBigWheel();
});

/* ================================================
   CLOSE WHEEL
================================================= */
closeWheelBtn.addEventListener("click",()=>{
    wheelOverlay.style.display="none";
});

/* ================================================
   SOUND EFFECTS
================================================= */
// Volume B: loud but not painful
const spinSound = new Audio("https://cdn.pixabay.com/download/audio/2022/03/15/audio_cdb19e1255.mp3?filename=spin-110014.mp3");
spinSound.volume = 0.9;

const winSound = new Audio("https://cdn.pixabay.com/download/audio/2021/09/15/audio_0cdeec95ad.mp3?filename=success-1-6297.mp3");
winSound.volume = 1.0;

/* ================================================
   CHAOS SPIN LOGIC
================================================= */
bigWheel.width = 800;
bigWheel.height = 800;

document.getElementById("bigWheelCanvas").addEventListener("click", spinChaosWheel);

function spinChaosWheel() {
    if (state.spinning || state.students.length===0) return;

    state.spinning = true;
    winnerText.textContent = "";
    spinSound.currentTime = 0;
    spinSound.play();

    let speed = Math.random()*20 + 25;
    const decel = 0.10;

    // 35% chance of fake-out stop
    const chaosMode = Math.random() < 0.35;
    let fakeStopTriggered = false;

    const spin = setInterval(()=>{
        state.angle += speed;
        speed -= decel;

        // Fake-out moment
        if (chaosMode && !fakeStopTriggered && speed < 7 && speed > 5) {
            speed += 35; // sudden boost
            fakeStopTriggered = true;
        }

        if (speed <= 0) {
            clearInterval(spin);
            state.spinning = false;

            const idx = Math.floor(((state.angle % 360)/360)*state.students.length);
            const winner = state.students[idx];

            winSound.currentTime=0;
            winSound.play();

            winnerText.textContent = `Selected: ${winner}`;
        }

        bigCtx.save();
        bigCtx.translate(400,400);
        bigCtx.rotate(state.angle*Math.PI/180);
        bigCtx.translate(-400,-400);
        drawBigWheel();
        bigCtx.restore();

    },20);
}

/* ================================================
   TEAMS
================================================= */
createTeamsBtn.addEventListener("click",()=>{
    const shuf = [...state.students].sort(()=>Math.random()-0.5);
    const mid = Math.ceil(shuf.length/2);
    teamA.innerHTML = shuf.slice(0,mid).map(s=>`<li>${s}</li>`).join("");
    teamB.innerHTML = shuf.slice(mid).map(s=>`<li>${s}</li>`).join("");
});

/* ================================================
   SCOREBOARD
================================================= */
scoreAplus.addEventListener("click",()=>{ 
    state.scoreA++;
    scoreA.textContent = state.scoreA;
});
scoreBplus.addEventListener("click",()=>{ 
    state.scoreB++;
    scoreB.textContent = state.scoreB;
});
resetScores.addEventListener("click",()=>{ 
    state.scoreA=0;
    state.scoreB=0;
    scoreA.textContent=0;
    scoreB.textContent=0;
});
</script>

</body>
</html>

🎯 SARCASTIC LANGUAGE — FULL LESSON PLAN (I-1 / Grade 12)
Duration: 50–60 minutes
Target: High School Grade 12 (Intermediate 1)
Skill Focus: Tone → Social meaning → Sarcasm in English
Tools: Wheel selector, student manager, teams, scoreboard

⭐ 00. Lesson Objective (Teacher Reads)
“By the end of the lesson, you will:

Understand what sarcasm is,

Recognize sarcastic tone,

Use sarcasm appropriately in conversation,

Produce sarcastic lines in real situations.”

⭐ 01. Warm-Up — “Literal or Sarcastic?” (5 mins)
Teacher says each line with a flat serious tone:

“Wow… I love waking up early.”

“Fantastic… it’s raining again.”

“Great job… amazing work.” (when they see a terrible drawing)

“This class is so quiet today.” (your students will laugh)

Students shout: “Literal!” or “Sarcastic!”
(Use your loud wheel to pick who answers first.)

Add points for first correct team.

⭐ 02. Definition + 2 Key Rules (5 mins)
Write on board:

Sarcasm = saying the opposite of what you really mean (to be funny/annoyed).
Rule 1 — The words are usually positive.
Rule 2 — The tone is negative.
Examples (teacher reads with sarcastic voice):

“Amazing. Another quiz.”

“Great. My favorite student is late again.”

“Sure… I totally studied last night.”

Students repeat with emotion.

⭐ 03. Tone Practice (10 mins)
Teacher says:

“I will give ONE line.
The wheel will choose a student.
They say it sarcastically.”

Lines:

“I LOVE homework.”

“Wow… I’m SO happy right now.”

“Perfect timing.”

“Amazing job.”

“This food is delicious.”

Wheel selects 5 students one by one.
Team points for best delivery each round.

⭐ 04. Sarcasm Recognition Quiz (7 mins)
Teams write “S” (sarcastic) or “L” (literal).

“Great… my phone died again.”

“I’m excited for summer vacation.”

“Yeah, this is definitely my lucky day…”

“I’m really nervous for my exam.”

“This weather is perfect… totally perfect…”

Reveal answers → Team points.

⭐ 05. Controlled Practice — “Sarcasm Battles” (10 mins)
Teacher reads scenario, wheel selects two students.

Scenario 1:
You are late. Your friend says:
“Wow… early again.”

Student must reply sarcastically.

Scenario 2:
Teacher gives surprise quiz:
“Great news! Surprise test today!”

Scenario 3:
Your friend forgets the homework AGAIN:
“Nice. Genius-level planning.”

Students give lines.
Team votes for winner → +2 pts.

⭐ 06. Pair Task — “Fix These Lines” (5 mins)
Students work in pairs to turn literal lines into sarcastic ones.

Literal → Sarcastic examples:

“I love waking up early.”

“I’m so happy today.”

“This homework is easy.”

“The cafeteria food is tasty.”

“This is my favorite Monday.”

Wheel chooses 3 pairs to perform.
Score best pair.

⭐ 07. Final Speaking Task — “Sarcasm Performance” (8–10 mins)
Wheel picks 5 students.

Each must perform a sarcastic monologue (10–15 seconds):

Prompt choices:

“Today is Monday. I feel amazing.”

“I definitely studied last night.”

“This is the best day of my life.”

“I love doing presentations.”

Teacher + teams judge.
Best = +3 pts.

⭐ 08. Wrap-Up (2 mins)
Teacher says:

“What is sarcasm?”
“What kind of tone does sarcasm use?”
“Can sarcasm be rude if used incorrectly?”

Give final team points.
Winner = “Sarcasm Kings/Queens of the Day.”

<style>
  :root {
    --purple: #a855f7;
    --gold: #f59e0b;
    --dark: #0f0f1a;
    --glass: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    --blur: blur(14px);
  }
  body {
    background: var(--dark);

    background-image:
      radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(168,85,247,0.13), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 85% 70%, rgba(245,158,11,0.12), transparent 65%);
  }
  .glass {
    background: var(--glass);
    backdrop-filter: var(--blur);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
    border-radius: 1rem;
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }
  .glow-btn {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--gold));
    padding: .75rem 1.3rem;

    color: white;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .glow-btn:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.03);
    box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(245,158,11,0.4);
  }
  .stage-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);

  }
  /* Fullscreen wheel overlay */

  }

    max-height: 800px;
  }
  #closeWheelBtn {
    margin-top: 25px;
    background: red;
    padding: 1rem 2rem;
    border-radius: 1rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
  }
</style>
</head>

<body>

<!-- LANDING PAGE -->
<div id="landingPage" class="fixed inset-0 bg-[var(--dark)] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-10 z-50">
  <h1 class="text-5xl font-bold mb-6">Sarcasm — Level I-1</h1>
  <p class="text-lg text-gray-300 max-w-2xl mb-6">
    Today we’re in the halls of <span class="text-[var(--gold)]">Highbridge High</span>.<br>
    By the end of class you will:
    <br>1) Understand sarcasm,
    <br>2) Hear the tone,
    <br>3) Use it in real situations.
  </p>
  <button id="startLesson" class="glow-btn text-xl px-10 py-3">Enter Lesson</button>
</div>

<!-- FULLSCREEN CHAOS WHEEL -->

  <canvas id="bigWheelCanvas"></canvas>
  <div id="winnerText" class="text-4xl font-bold mt-6"></div>
  <button id="closeWheelBtn">CLOSE</button>
</div>

<!-- MAIN APP -->
<div id="main" class="hidden">

  <h1 class="text-4xl font-bold mb-6">
    Sarcasm Lesson — I-1
    <span class="text-[var(--gold)]"> | NET Classroom</span>
  </h1>

  <div class="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

    <!-- LEFT: CLASS CONTROL -->
    <div class="space-y-6">

      <!-- Student Manager -->
      <div class="glass">
        <h2 class="text-2xl font-semibold text-[var(--purple)] mb-3">Students (40 loaded)</h2>
        <input id="studentInput" class="w-full p-2 rounded bg-black/30 border border-white/10 mb-3" placeholder="Add student..." />
        <button id="addStudentBtn" class="glow-btn w-full mb-4">Add Student</button>
        <ul id="studentList" class="space-y-1 max-h-[260px] overflow-y-auto text-sm"></ul>
      </div>

      <!-- Chaos Wheel Button -->
      <div class="glass text-center">
        <button id="openWheelBtn" class="glow-btn text-lg w-full py-4">OPEN CHAOS WHEEL</button>
        <p class="text-xs text-gray-300 mt-2">
          Click student names with the wheel to choose who performs.
        </p>
      </div>

      <!-- Scoreboard -->
      <div class="glass">
        <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold text-[var(--purple)] mb-3">Scoreboard</h2>
        <div class="flex justify-between mb-3">
          <button id="scoreAplus" class="glow-btn">+ Team A</button>
          <button id="scoreBplus" class="glow-btn">+ Team B</button>
        </div>
        <p class="text-[var(--gold)] font-semibold">Team A: <span id="scoreA">0</span></p>
        <p class="text-[var(--gold)] font-semibold">Team B: <span id="scoreB">0</span></p>
        <button id="resetScores" class="glow-btn mt-3 w-full bg-red-700/70">Reset Scores</button>
      </div>

    </div>

    <!-- CENTER: TEAMS + VOCAB PANEL -->
    <div class="space-y-6">

      <!-- Team Selector -->
      <div class="glass">
        <h2 class="text-2xl font-semibold text-[var(--purple)] mb-3">Teams</h2>
        <button id="createTeamsBtn" class="glow-btn w-full mb-4">Generate Teams</button>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
          <div>
            <h3 class="text-[var(--gold)] font-semibold mb-2">Team A</h3>
            <ul id="teamA" class="space-y-1"></ul>
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 class="text-[var(--gold)] font-semibold mb-2">Team B</h3>
            <ul id="teamB" class="space-y-1"></ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Vocab / Idiom / Slang -->
      <div class="glass">
        <h2 class="text-2xl font-semibold text-[var(--gold)] mb-3">Key Language (I-1)</h2>

        <h3 class="font-semibold text-[var(--purple)] mb-1">10 Key Vocab</h3>
        <ul class="list-disc pl-5 text-sm text-gray-200 mb-3">
          <li><b>sarcasm</b> – saying the opposite of what you mean to be funny/annoyed</li>
          <li><b>literal</b> – exact, true meaning of the words</li>
          <li><b>tone</b> – how your voice sounds (angry, bored, excited)</li>
          <li><b>exaggeration</b> – making something bigger or more extreme than real</li>
          <li><b>irony</b> – when reality is different from expectation</li>
          <li><b>deadpan</b> – joking with a very serious face/voice</li>
          <li><b>playful</b> – fun, friendly, not serious</li>
          <li><b>offended</b> – feeling hurt or angry</li>
          <li><b>context</b> – situation around the words</li>
          <li><b>misunderstanding</b> – when people don’t understand each other correctly</li>
        </ul>

        <h3 class="font-semibold text-[var(--purple)] mb-1">5 Idioms / Fixed Phrases</h3>

        <p class="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-200">
          Use idioms / slang:
          “Yeah, right”, “Give me a break”, “Bruh”, “Seriously?”, “You wish”.
        </p>
        <p class="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-200">
          Wheel chooses Student A and Student B. They answer in turn.
          Class votes who was better → winning student’s team gets +2.

        <p class="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-400"><b>Game 2:</b> Sarcasm Battles.</p>

        <p class="mb-2"><b>Instructions:</b> Students in pairs change literal lines into sarcastic ones.</p>
        <ul class="list-disc pl-5 text-sm text-gray-200">
          <li>“I love waking up early.”</li>
          <li>“I’m so happy today.”</li>
          <li>“This homework is easy.”</li>
          <li>“The cafeteria food is tasty.”</li>

          Pairs must use at least one key vocab or idiom (e.g. “Yeah, right”, “Give me a break”, “What a joke”).

        <p class="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-200">
          Wheel chooses 3 pairs to perform. Class votes best → +2 points.
        </p>
        <p class="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-400"><b>Game 3:</b> Fix It — upgrade literal to sarcastic.</p>
      </div>

      <div id="stage-7" class="stage-card hidden">
        <h3 class="text-xl text-[var(--purple)] font-semibold mb-2">Stage 7 — Final Performance</h3>

        <p class="mb-2"><b>Prompts (choose or rotate):</b></p>

          <li>“Today is Monday. I feel amazing.”</li>
          <li>“I definitely studied last night.”</li>
          <li>“This is the best day of my life.”</li>
          <li>“I love doing presentations.”</li>

        <p class="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-200">

</div>

<script>
  // ====== DOM REFS ======
  const landingPage = document.getElementById("landingPage");
  const main = document.getElementById("main");
  const startLessonBtn = document.getElementById("startLesson");

  const studentInput = document.getElementById("studentInput");
  const addStudentBtn = document.getElementById("addStudentBtn");
  const studentList = document.getElementById("studentList");

  const openWheelBtn = document.getElementById("openWheelBtn");
  const wheelOverlay = document.getElementById("wheelOverlay");
  const bigWheelCanvas = document.getElementById("bigWheelCanvas");
  const bigCtx = bigWheelCanvas.getContext("2d");
  const closeWheelBtn = document.getElementById("closeWheelBtn");
  const winnerText = document.getElementById("winnerText");

  const teamA = document.getElementById("teamA");
  const teamB = document.getElementById("teamB");
  const createTeamsBtn = document.getElementById("createTeamsBtn");

  const scoreAEl = document.getElementById("scoreA");
  const scoreBEl = document.getElementById("scoreB");
  const scoreAplus = document.getElementById("scoreAplus");
  const scoreBplus = document.getElementById("scoreBplus");
  const resetScores = document.getElementById("resetScores");

  const stageButtons = document.querySelectorAll("[data-stage-btn]");

  // ====== STATE ======
  const defaultStudents = Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => `Student ${i+1}`);
  const state = {
    students: [...defaultStudents],
    scoreA: 0,
    scoreB: 0,
    spinning: false,
    angle: 0
  };

  // ====== LANDING ======
  startLessonBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    landingPage.style.display = "none";
    main.classList.remove("hidden");
    renderStudents();
    drawBigWheel();
    showStage(1);
  });

  // ====== STUDENT MANAGER ======
  function renderStudents() {
    studentList.innerHTML = state.students.map((s, i) => `
      <li class="bg-white/5 p-1.5 rounded flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
        <span>${s}</span>
        <button data-i="${i}" class="text-red-400 hover:text-red-200 text-xs">✕</button>
      </li>
    `).join("");
  }

  addStudentBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const name = studentInput.value.trim();
    if (!name) return;
    state.students.push(name);
    studentInput.value = "";
    renderStudents();
    drawBigWheel();
  });

  studentList.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const i = e.target.dataset.i;
    if (i !== undefined) {
      state.students.splice(Number(i), 1);
      renderStudents();
      drawBigWheel();
    }
  });

  // ====== TEAMS ======
  createTeamsBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const shuffled = [...state.students].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
    const mid = Math.ceil(shuffled.length / 2);
    const a = shuffled.slice(0, mid);
    const b = shuffled.slice(mid);
    teamA.innerHTML = a.map(s => `<li class="text-xs">${s}</li>`).join("");
    teamB.innerHTML = b.map(s => `<li class="text-xs">${s}</li>`).join("");
  });

  // ====== SCOREBOARD ======
  function updateScores() {
    scoreAEl.textContent = state.scoreA;
    scoreBEl.textContent = state.scoreB;
  }
  scoreAplus.addEventListener("click", () => {
    state.scoreA++;
    updateScores();
  });
  scoreBplus.addEventListener("click", () => {
    state.scoreB++;
    updateScores();
  });
  resetScores.addEventListener("click", () => {
    state.scoreA = 0;
    state.scoreB = 0;
    updateScores();
  });

  // ====== STAGES ======
  function showStage(n) {
    for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
      const el = document.getElementById(`stage-${i}`);
      if (!el) continue;
      el.classList.toggle("hidden", i !== n);
    }
  }

  stageButtons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const n = Number(btn.dataset.stageBtn);
      showStage(n);
    });
  });

  // ====== CHAOS WHEEL ======
  bigWheelCanvas.width = 800;
  bigWheelCanvas.height = 800;

  function drawBigWheel() {
    const items = state.students;
    const count = items.length;
    const r = bigWheelCanvas.width / 2;
    bigCtx.clearRect(0, 0, bigWheelCanvas.width, bigWheelCanvas.height);
    if (count === 0) return;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const start = (i / count) * 2 * Math.PI;
      const end = ((i + 1) / count) * 2 * Math.PI;
      bigCtx.beginPath();
      bigCtx.moveTo(r, r);
      bigCtx.arc(r, r, r, start, end);
      bigCtx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? "#a855f7" : "#f59e0b";
      bigCtx.fill();

      bigCtx.save();
      bigCtx.translate(r, r);
      bigCtx.rotate(start + (end - start) / 2);
      bigCtx.fillStyle = "white";
      bigCtx.textAlign = "right";
      bigCtx.font = "20px Inter";
      bigCtx.fillText(items[i], r - 15, 5);
      bigCtx.restore();
    }
  }

  openWheelBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    wheelOverlay.style.display = "flex";
    drawBigWheel();
  });

  closeWheelBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    wheelOverlay.style.display = "none";
    winnerText.textContent = "";
  });

  // Sounds (Volume B)
  const spinSound = new Audio("https://cdn.pixabay.com/download/audio/2022/03/15/audio_cdb19e1255.mp3?filename=spin-110014.mp3");
  spinSound.volume = 0.9;
  const winSound = new Audio("https://cdn.pixabay.com/download/audio/2021/09/15/audio_0cdeec95ad.mp3?filename=success-1-6297.mp3");
  winSound.volume = 1.0;

  // Spin button: click on canvas to spin
  bigWheelCanvas.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (state.spinning || state.students.length === 0) return;
    state.spinning = true;
    winnerText.textContent = "";
    spinSound.currentTime = 0;
    spinSound.play();

    let speed = Math.random() * 20 + 25;
    const decel = 0.10;

    const chaosMode = Math.random() < 0.35; // 35% fake-out
    let fakeStopTriggered = false;

    const spin = setInterval(() => {
      state.angle += speed;
      speed -= decel;

      // fake-out: looks like it's slowing, then jumps
      if (chaosMode && !fakeStopTriggered && speed < 7 && speed > 5) {
        speed += 35;
        fakeStopTriggered = true;
      }

      if (speed <= 0) {
        clearInterval(spin);
        state.spinning = false;

        const idx = Math.floor(((state.angle % 360) / 360) * state.students.length);
        const winner = state.students[idx];

        winSound.currentTime = 0;
        winSound.play();
        winnerText.textContent = `Selected: ${winner}`;
      }

      bigCtx.save();
      bigCtx.translate(400, 400);
      bigCtx.rotate(state.angle * Math.PI / 180);
      bigCtx.translate(-400, -400);
      drawBigWheel();
      bigCtx.restore();
    }, 20);
  });
</script>

</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>NET Lesson (I-1): Sarcasm | Classroom Manager</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide-react@latest/dist/umd/lucide.js"></script>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;700;900&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root {
            --neon-purple: #a855f7;
            --gold: #f59e0b;
            --dark: #0f0f1a;
            --font-ui: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            --font-code: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
        }
        body {
            background-color: var(--dark);
            color: #e5e7eb;
            font-family: var(--font-ui);
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100vh;
        }
        /* --- Pillar I: Organic Blobs --- */
        body::before, body::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            z-index: -1;
            filter: blur(80px);
            opacity: 0.2;
        }
        body::before {
            width: 400px;
            height: 400px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--neon-purple), transparent 60%);
            top: 10%;
            left: 10%;
            animation: pulse 10s infinite alternate;
        }
        body::after {
            width: 300px;
            height: 300px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--gold), transparent 60%);
            bottom: 10%;
            right: 10%;
            animation: pulse 12s infinite alternate-reverse;
        }
        @keyframes pulse {
            from { transform: scale(0.8); opacity: 0.1; }
            to { transform: scale(1.2); opacity: 0.2; }
        }

        /* --- Pillar I: Glassmorphism Cards --- */
        .glass-panel {
            background: rgba(26, 26, 38, 0.7);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2);
            border-radius: 1rem;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
        }
        .font-ui { font-family: var(--font-ui); }
        .font-code { font-family: var(--font-code); }
        .text-purple { color: var(--neon-purple); }
        .text-gold { color: var(--gold); }
        .shadow-purple { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5); }

</head>
<body>

    <div class="grid grid-cols-10 gap-6 p-6 w-full h-full max-w-7xl max-h-[900px]">
        
        <!-- === LEFT PANEL: RULES & SELECTOR === -->
        <div class="col-span-3 glass-panel p-6 flex flex-col space-y-6">
            <!-- Rules -->
            <div class="flex-shrink-0">
                <h2 class="text-xl font-bold text-purple mb-3 flex items-center">
                    <i data-lucide="book-marked" class="mr-2"></i>Class Rules
                </h2>
                <ul class="list-disc list-inside text-sm space-y-1">
                    <li>L-S-R-W Order</li>
                    <li>45min Listen + 15min Output (Daily)</li>
                    <li>Respect Your Teammates</li>
                    <li>Gospel 444: 10-5-5-3</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <!-- Student Selector -->
            <div class="flex-grow flex flex-col">
                <h2 class="text-xl font-bold text-purple mb-3 flex items-center">
                    <i data-lucide="users" class="mr-2"></i>Student Selector
                </h2>
                <div class="flex mb-3">
                    <input type="text" id="studentNameInput" placeholder="Add student name..." class="neon-input w-full mr-2">
                    <button id="addStudentBtn" class="btn-purple flex-shrink-0">Add</button>
                </div>
                <div id="studentList" class="flex-grow bg-black/20 rounded-lg p-3 overflow-y-auto mb-3 h-32">
                    <!-- Student names added here -->
                </div>
                <button id="selectStudentBtn" class="btn-gold w-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-gold">
                    <i data-lucide="shuffle" class="mr-2"></i>Select Student
                </button>
                <div id="selectedStudentDisplay" class="text-center text-gold font-bold text-2xl mt-4 h-8"></div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- === MIDDLE PANEL: SCOREBOARD & TOOLS === -->
        <div class="col-span-3 glass-panel p-6 flex flex-col space-y-6">
            <!-- Scoreboard -->
            <div class="flex-shrink-0">
                <h2 class="text-xl font-bold text-purple mb-3 flex items-center">
                    <i data-lucide="swords" class="mr-2"></i>Scoreboard
                </h2>
                <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <!-- Team 1 -->
                    <div class="text-center">
                        <div class="text-lg font-bold text-purple">Team 1</div>
                        <div id="team1Score" class="font-code text-5xl font-bold my-2">0</div>
                        <button class="btn-purple w-full" data-team="team1">+1</button>
                    </div>
                    <!-- Team 2 -->
                    <div class="text-center">
                        <div class="text-lg font-bold text-gold">Team 2</div>
                        <div id="team2Score" class="font-code text-5xl font-bold my-2">0</div>
                        <button class="btn-gold w-full" data-team="team2">+1</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- SER Score (Pillar III) -->
            <div class="flex-shrink-0">
                <h2 class="text-xl font-bold text-purple mb-3 flex items-center">
                    <i data-lucide="gauge" class="mr-2"></i>7-Metric SER (LOCKED)
                </h2>
                <div class="bg-black/20 rounded-lg p-3 text-center">
                    <div class="font-code text-gray-400">SER: (L*2)+(S*2)+R+W</div>
                    <div class="text-2xl text-gold font-bold">--</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Persistence (Pillar IV) -->
            <div class="flex-grow flex flex-col justify-end space-y-3">
                <h2 class="text-xl font-bold text-purple flex items-center">
                    <i data-lucide="database" class="mr-2"></i>Persistence
                </h2>
                <button id="saveStateBtn" class="btn-purple w-full flex items-center justify-center">
                    <i data-lucide="save" class="mr-2"></i>Save State (AES)
                </button>
                <button id="loadStateBtn" class="btn-ghost w-full flex items-center justify-center">
                    <i data-lucide="upload" class="mr-2"></i>Load State (AES)
                </button>
                <button id="exportJsonBtn" class_A="btn-ghost w-full flex items-center justify-center">
                    <i data-lucide="download" class="mr-2"></i>Export JSON
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- === RIGHT PANEL: LESSON STORY ENGINE === -->
        <div class="col-span-4 glass-panel p-6 flex flex-col">
            <div id="lessonPanel" class="flex-grow overflow-y-auto pr-2">
                <!-- Lesson scenes will be rendered here -->
            </div>
            <div id="lessonNav" class="flex justify-between items-center pt-4 mt-4 border-t border-purple-500/30">
                <button id="prevSceneBtn" class="btn-ghost">
                    <i data-lucide="arrow-left" class="inline-block"></i> Back
                </button>
                <div class="font-code text-sm text-purple">
                    Scene <span id="currentSceneDisplay">1</span> / <span id="totalScenesDisplay">?</span>
                </div>
                <button id="nextSceneBtn" class="btn-purple">
                    Next <i data-lucide="arrow-right" class="inline-block"></i>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- === PILLAR II: VANILLA JS SCRIPT === -->
    <script>
        // --- C8 AUDIT COMPLIANCE: STORY ENGINE ---
        // (Requirement 5)
        const lessonScenes = [
            // Scene 1: Introduction
            {
                title: "What is Sarcasm?",
                content: 
                    <p>Sarcasm is a way of speaking where you say the *opposite* of what you really mean in order to be funny or to mock someone.</p>
                    <p>For example, if it's raining heavily outside, and you say, "What beautiful weather we're having!" — that's sarcasm.</p>
                    <p>The key is your <strong>tone of voice</strong>. It's not just *what* you say, it's *how* you say it.</p>
                
            },
            // Scene 2: The 10-5-5-3 Recipe (Vocab)
            {
                title: "Pillar III: The Gospel (10-5-5-3)",
                content: 
                    <h2>Core Vocabulary (10)</h2>
                    <ul>
                        <li><strong>Irony:</strong> A situation that is strange or funny because things happen in a way that seems to be the opposite of what you expected.</li>
                        <li><strong>Tone:</strong> The quality of your voice that shows your attitude or feelings.</li>
                        <li><strong>Inflection:</strong> The change in the pitch of your voice.</li>
                        <li><strong>Subtle:</strong> Not obvious; hard to notice.</li>
                        <li><strong>Mock:</strong> To laugh at or make fun of someone.</li>
                        <li><strong>Deadpan:</strong> Showing no emotion.</li>
                        <li><strong>Wit:</strong> The ability to use words in a clever and humorous way.</li>
                        <li><strong>Literal:</strong> The most basic or usual meaning of a word.</li>
                        <li><strong>Derisive:</strong> Showing that you think someone or something is ridiculous.</li>
                        <li><strong>Banter:</strong> Playful and friendly exchange of teasing remarks.</li>
                    </ul>
                
            },
            // Scene 3: The 10-5-5-3 Recipe (Idioms/Slang)
            {
                title: "Pillar III: The Gospel (10-5-5-3)",
                content: 
                    <h2>Idioms (5)</h2>
                    <ul>
                        <li><strong>"Tell me about it"</strong>: (Sarcastic) I completely agree (often about something bad).</li>
                        <li><strong>"Break a leg"</strong>: (Not sarcastic) Good luck!</li>
                        <li><strong>"That's just what I needed"</strong>: (Sarcastic) This is a new problem I don't want to deal with.</li>
                        <li><strong>"As if!"</strong>: (Slang/Sarcastic) That will definitely not happen.</li>
                        <li><strong>"Big deal"</strong>: (Sarcastic) That is not important at all.</li>
                    </ul>
                    <h2>Slang (5)</h2>
                    <ul>
                        <li><strong>"Yeah, right."</strong>: (Sarcastic) I don't believe you.</li>
                        <li><strong>"No, really?"</strong>: (Sarcastic) What you said is extremely obvious.</li>
                        <li><strong>"Hardly."</strong>: (Sarcastic) Absolutely not.</li>
                        <li><strong>"Shocking."</strong>: (Sarcastic) That is not surprising at all.</li>
                        <li><strong>"You don't say."</strong>: (Sarcastic) What you said is obvious.</li>
                    </ul>
                
            },
            // Scene 4: Game 1
            {
                title: "Game 1: Sarcastic or Sincere?",
                content: 
                    <p>Read the situation, then the quote. Is the speaker being sarcastic or sincere (truthful)?</p>
                    <p><strong>Situation:</strong> Your friend spills coffee all over your new white shirt.</p>
                    <p><strong>Quote:</strong> "Oh, great. That's just fantastic."</p>
                    <div class="game-option" data-answer="correct">Sarcastic</div>
                    <div class="game-option" data-answer="wrong">Sincere</div>
                
            },
            // Scene 5: Game 2
            {
                title: "Game 2: Rewrite the Sentence",
                content: 
                    <p>Take this *sincere* sentence and rewrite it to be *sarcastic*. Type your answer in the box.</p>
                    <p><strong>Sincere Sentence:</strong> "I am very excited to write a 10-page essay tonight."</p>
                    <textarea id="game2Input" class="neon-input w-full" placeholder="Your sarcastic version..."></textarea>
                    <p class="text-sm text-gold mt-2">Example: "Wow, a 10-page essay? I can't think of anything I'd rather do."</p>
                
            },
            // Scene 6: Game 3
            {
                title: "Game 3: Match the Meaning",
                content: 
                    <p>Match the sarcastic phrase to its *real* (literal) meaning.</p>
                    <p><strong>Sarcastic Phrase:</strong> "You're a real genius."</p>
                    <div class="game-option" data-answer="wrong">"You are very smart."</div>
                    <div class="game-option" data-answer="correct">"You just did something very stupid."</div>
                    <div class="game-option" data-answer="wrong">"You are good at science."</div>
                
            },
            // Scene 7: Conclusion
            {
                title: "Conclusion",
                content: 
                    <p>Sarcasm is a very high-level (I-1) skill in English. It's more common in the USA, UK, and Australia than in many parts of Asia.</p>
                    <p><strong>Warning:</strong> Be careful! If you don't know someone well, your sarcasm might just sound rude or confusing.</p>
                    <p>Good job today!</p>
                
            }
        ];

        // --- State ---
        let currentScene = 0;
        let students = [];
        let scores = { team1: 0, team2: 0 };
        let appState = { students, scores };

        // --- DOM Selectors ---
        const lessonPanel = document.getElementById('lessonPanel');
        const nextSceneBtn = document.getElementById('nextSceneBtn');
        const prevSceneBtn = document.getElementById('prevSceneBtn');
        const currentSceneDisplay = document.getElementById('currentSceneDisplay');
        const totalScenesDisplay = document.getElementById('totalScenesDisplay');

        const studentNameInput = document.getElementById('studentNameInput');
        const addStudentBtn = document.getElementById('addStudentBtn');
        const studentList = document.getElementById('studentList');
        const selectStudentBtn = document.getElementById('selectStudentBtn');
        const selectedStudentDisplay = document.getElementById('selectedStudentDisplay');

        const team1Score = document.getElementById('team1Score');
        const team2Score = document.getElementById('team2Score');
        const team1Btn = document.querySelector('[data-team="team1"]');
        const team2Btn = document.querySelector('[data-team="team2"]');

        const saveStateBtn = document.getElementById('saveStateBtn');
        const loadStateBtn = document.getElementById('loadStateBtn');
        const exportJsonBtn = document.getElementById('exportJsonBtn');

        // --- Pillar II: NO INLINE HANDLERS. Bind all events. ---
        
        // Story Engine Listeners
        nextSceneBtn.addEventListener('click', nextScene);
        prevSceneBtn.addEventListener('click', prevScene);

        // Student Selector Listeners
        addStudentBtn.addEventListener('click', addStudent);
        selectStudentBtn.addEventListener('click', selectStudent);

        // Scoreboard Listeners
        team1Btn.addEventListener('click', () => updateScore('team1'));
        team2Btn.addEventListener('click', () => updateScore('team2'));

        // Pillar IV Listeners
        saveStateBtn.addEventListener('click', saveState);
        loadStateBtn.addEventListener('click', loadState);
        exportJsonBtn.addEventListener('click', exportJson);

        // --- Functions ---
        
        // (Requirement 6)
        function renderScene() {
            const scene = lessonScenes[currentScene];
            lessonPanel.innerHTML = <h2>${scene.title}</h2>${scene.content};
            currentSceneDisplay.textContent = currentScene + 1;
            
            // Re-bind game elements if they exist in this scene
            document.querySelectorAll('.game-option').forEach(option => {
                option.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    if (e.target.dataset.answer === 'correct') {
                        e.target.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.3)';
                        e.target.style.borderColor = 'var(--gold)';
                    } else {
                        e.target.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.3)';
                    }
                });
            });
        }
        
        // (Requirement 4)
        function nextScene() {
            if (currentScene < lessonScenes.length - 1) {
                currentScene++;
                renderScene();
            }
        }

        function prevScene() {
            if (currentScene > 0) {
                currentScene--;
                renderScene();
            }
        }

        function addStudent() {
            const name = studentNameInput.value.trim();
            if (name) {
                students.push(name);
                studentNameInput.value = '';
                renderStudentList();
            }
        }

        function renderStudentList() {
            studentList.innerHTML = '';
            students.forEach(name => {
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.textContent = name;
                div.className = 'p-1';
                studentList.appendChild(div);
            });
        }

        function selectStudent() {
            if (students.length === 0) {
                selectedStudentDisplay.textContent = "No Students";
                return;
            }
            const randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * students.length);
            const selected = students[randomIndex];
            selectedStudentDisplay.textContent = ⚡ ${selected} ⚡;
        }

        function updateScore(team) {
            scores[team]++;
            team1Score.textContent = scores.team1;
            team2Score.textContent = scores.team2;
        }

        function updateUIFromState() {
            students = appState.students || [];
            scores = appState.scores || { team1: 0, team2: 0 };
            team1Score.textContent = scores.team1;
            team2Score.textContent = scores.team2;
            renderStudentList();
        }

        // --- Pillar IV: Persistence (AES-GCM) ---
        // NOTE: This is a simplified, self-contained AES-GCM helper for demo purposes.
        // It fulfills the "AES-GCM" and "Vanilla JS" mandates from V5 Truth.
        
        async function getCryptoKey(password) {
            const enc = new TextEncoder();
            const keyMaterial = await window.crypto.subtle.importKey(
                "raw",
                enc.encode(password),
                "PBKDF2",
                false,
                ["deriveKey"]
            );
            return window.crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
                { "name": "PBKDF2", "salt": enc.encode("NET_SALT"), "iterations": 100000, "hash": "SHA-256" },
                keyMaterial,
                { "name": "AES-GCM", "length": 256 },
                true,
                ["encrypt", "decrypt"]
            );
        }

        async function encryptState(password) {
            const key = await getCryptoKey(password);
            const iv = window.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
            const data = JSON.stringify(appState);
            const encrypted = await window.crypto.subtle.encrypt(
                { name: "AES-GCM", iv: iv },
                key,
                new TextEncoder().encode(data)
            );
            // Combine IV and encrypted data for storage
            const ivString = Array.from(iv).map(b => String.fromCharCode(b)).join('');
            const encryptedString = Array.from(new Uint8Array(encrypted)).map(b => String.fromCharCode(b)).join('');
            return btoa(ivString + encryptedString); // Base64 encode
        }

        async function decryptState(password, base64Data) {
            try {
                const key = await getCryptoKey(password);
                const data = atob(base64Data);
                const iv = new Uint8Array(Array.from(data.slice(0, 12)).map(c => c.charCodeAt(0)));
                const encrypted = new Uint8Array(Array.from(data.slice(12)).map(c => c.charCodeAt(0)));
                
                const decrypted = await window.crypto.subtle.decrypt(
                    { name: "AES-GCM", iv: iv },
                    key,
                    encrypted
                );
                
                const json = new TextDecoder().decode(decrypted);
                return JSON.parse(json);
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Decryption failed. Wrong password?", e);
                return null;
            }
        }

        async function saveState() {
            const password = prompt("Enter a password to encrypt the state:");
            if (!password) return;
            try {
                const encryptedData = await encryptState(password);
                localStorage.setItem("NET_CLASSROOM_STATE", encryptedData);
                alert("✅ State Saved & Encrypted!");
            } catch (e) {
                alert("❌ Error saving state.");
            }
        }

        async function loadState() {
            const password = prompt("Enter the password to decrypt the state:");
            if (!password) return;
            const encryptedData = localStorage.getItem("NET_CLASSROOM_STATE");
            if (!encryptedData) {
                alert("❌ No saved state found.");
                return;
            }
            try {
                const decryptedState = await decryptState(password, encryptedData);
                if (decryptedState) {
                    appState = decryptedState;
                    updateUIFromState();
                    alert("✅ State Loaded & Decrypted!");
                } else {
                    alert("❌ Decryption failed. Wrong password.");
                }
            } catch (e) {
                alert("❌ Failed to load state.");
            }
        }

        // --- Pillar IV: JSON Export ---
        function exportJson() {
            const dataStr = "data:text/json;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(appState, null, 2));
            const downloadAnchorNode = document.createElement('a');
            downloadAnchorNode.setAttribute("href", dataStr);
            downloadAnchorNode.setAttribute("download", "NET_Classroom_State.json");
            document.body.appendChild(downloadAnchorNode);
d            downloadAnchorNode.click();
            downloadAnchorNode.remove();
        }

        // --- Initial Load ---
        function initialize() {
            lucide.createIcons();
            totalScenesDisplay.textContent = lessonScenes.length;
            renderScene();
        }

        initialize();

    </script>
</body>
</html>

    scenes: [
      {
        title: "What is Sarcasm?",
        content: `
          <p>Sarcasm is a way of speaking where you say the <em>opposite</em> of what you really mean to be funny or to mock someone.</p>
          <p>For example, if it’s raining heavily outside and you say, “What beautiful weather we’re having!”, that’s sarcasm.</p>
          <p>The key is your <strong>tone of voice</strong>. It’s not just <em>what</em> you say, it’s <em>how</em> you say it.</p>
        `
      },
      {
        title: "Core Vocabulary (10)",
        content: `
          <h2>Core Vocabulary (10)</h2>
          <ul>
            <li><strong>Irony:</strong> When the result is the opposite of what you expect.</li>
            <li><strong>Tone:</strong> The attitude in your voice.</li>
            <li><strong>Inflection:</strong> How your pitch rises and falls.</li>
            <li><strong>Subtle:</strong> Not obvious; easy to miss.</li>
            <li><strong>Mock:</strong> To make fun of someone.</li>
            <li><strong>Deadpan:</strong> No emotion on the face or in the voice.</li>
            <li><strong>Wit:</strong> Clever and funny use of language.</li>
            <li><strong>Literal:</strong> The exact, basic meaning.</li>
            <li><strong>Derisive:</strong> Showing that you think something is stupid.</li>
            <li><strong>Banter:</strong> Playful, friendly teasing.</li>

  "Nguyễn Lê Phượng Nhi", "Trương Thị Quỳnh Hương", "Nhật Lam", "Huỳnh Gia Hãn",

let students = [];
let scores = { team1: 0, team2: 0 };

let appState = {
  students,
  scores,
  spinHistory: [], // { name, fakeOut, ts }
  lessonProgress: {
    currentLessonId,
    currentScene
  }
};

// ------------------------
// 4. DOM References
// ------------------------
const lessonPanel = document.getElementById("lessonPanel");
const nextSceneBtn = document.getElementById("nextSceneBtn");
const prevSceneBtn = document.getElementById("prevSceneBtn");
const currentSceneDisplay = document.getElementById("currentSceneDisplay");
const totalScenesDisplay = document.getElementById("totalScenesDisplay");

const studentNameInput = document.getElementById("studentNameInput");
const addStudentBtn = document.getElementById("addStudentBtn");
const studentList = document.getElementById("studentList");
const selectStudentBtn = document.getElementById("selectStudentBtn");
const selectedStudentDisplay = document.getElementById("selectedStudentDisplay");

const team1ScoreEl = document.getElementById("team1Score");
const team2ScoreEl = document.getElementById("team2Score");

const team2Btn = document.querySelector('[data-team="team2"]');
