// ------------------------
// 5. Fullscreen Spinner Overlay (created via JS)
// ------------------------
let spinOverlay = null;
let spinOverlayText = null;
let spinInProgress = false;

function ensureSpinOverlay() {
  if (spinOverlay) return;

  spinOverlay = document.createElement("div");
  spinOverlay.id = "net-spin-overlay";
  Object.assign(spinOverlay.style, {
    position: "fixed",
    inset: "0",
    background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.8)",
    display: "flex",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    zIndex: "9999",
    color: "#f59e0b",
    fontFamily: "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif",
    fontSize: "3rem",
    fontWeight: "900",
    letterSpacing: "0.1em",
    textTransform: "uppercase",
    textAlign: "center"
  });

  const wheel = document.createElement("div");
  wheel.style.width = "320px";
  wheel.style.height = "320px";
  wheel.style.borderRadius = "50%";
  wheel.style.border = "6px solid #a855f7";
  wheel.style.boxShadow = "0 0 40px rgba(168,85,247,0.9)";
  wheel.style.display = "flex";
  wheel.style.alignItems = "center";
  wheel.style.justifyContent = "center";
  wheel.style.position = "relative";
  wheel.style.background = "radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #f59e0b, #0f0f1a)";

  spinOverlayText = document.createElement("div");
  spinOverlayText.textContent = "SPIN";
  spinOverlayText.style.padding = "0.5rem 1rem";
  spinOverlayText.style.borderRadius = "9999px";
  spinOverlayText.style.background = "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)";
  spinOverlayText.style.boxShadow = "0 0 18px rgba(245,158,11,0.9)";
  spinOverlayText.style.maxWidth = "80%";

  const pointer = document.createElement("div");
  pointer.style.position = "absolute";
  pointer.style.top = "-24px";
  pointer.style.left = "50%";
  pointer.style.transform = "translateX(-50%)";
  pointer.style.width = "0";
  pointer.style.height = "0";
  pointer.style.borderLeft = "16px solid transparent";
  pointer.style.borderRight = "16px solid transparent";
  pointer.style.borderBottom = "28px solid #f59e0b";

  wheel.appendChild(pointer);
  wheel.appendChild(spinOverlayText);
  spinOverlay.appendChild(wheel);
  spinOverlay.style.display = "none";
  document.body.appendChild(spinOverlay);
}

// Simple loud-ish beep via Web Audio API
function playSpinSound(duration = 0.6) {
  try {
    const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = "square";
    osc.frequency.value = 420; // nice and irritating
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.6, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + duration);
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.start();
    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + duration + 0.05);
  } catch (e) {
    // ignore if audio can't play
  }
}

function runSpinAnimation(studentArray, onDone) {
  if (!studentArray.length || spinInProgress) {
    if (!studentArray.length) {
      selectedStudentDisplay.textContent = "No Students";
    }
    return;
  }

  ensureSpinOverlay();
  spinInProgress = true;
  selectStudentBtn.disabled = true;

  const totalDuration = 2500;
  const tickInterval = 80;
  const fakeOut = Math.random() < 0.33; // ~33% of the time
  const finalIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * studentArray.length);
  let almostIndex = finalIndex;

  // Ensure fakeout uses a different candidate if possible
  if (fakeOut && studentArray.length > 1) {
    while (almostIndex === finalIndex) {
      almostIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * studentArray.length);
    }
  }

  let elapsed = 0;
  spinOverlay.style.display = "flex";
  playSpinSound();

  const spinTimer = setInterval(() => {
    elapsed += tickInterval;

    let displayName;

    if (elapsed < totalDuration - 500) {
      // fast random cycling phase
      displayName = studentArray[Math.floor(Math.random() * studentArray.length)];
    } else if (elapsed < totalDuration - 200) {
      // slowing phase: appears to "land"
      displayName = studentArray[almostIndex];
    } else {
      // final lock-in
      displayName = studentArray[finalIndex];
    }

    if (spinOverlayText) {
      spinOverlayText.textContent = displayName;
    }

    if (elapsed >= totalDuration) {
      clearInterval(spinTimer);
      spinOverlay.style.display = "none";
      spinInProgress = false;
      selectStudentBtn.disabled = false;
      onDone(displayName, fakeOut && almostIndex !== finalIndex);
    }
  }, tickInterval);
}

// ------------------------
// 6. Rendering & Lesson Logic
// ------------------------
function getCurrentLesson() {
  return lessons[currentLessonId];
}

function renderScene() {
  const lesson = getCurrentLesson();
  const scenes = lesson.scenes;
  const safeIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(currentScene, scenes.length - 1));
  currentScene = safeIndex;
  appState.lessonProgress.currentScene = currentScene;
  appState.lessonProgress.currentLessonId = currentLessonId;

  const scene = scenes[safeIndex];
  lessonPanel.innerHTML = `<h2>${scene.title}</h2>${scene.content}`;

  currentSceneDisplay.textContent = safeIndex + 1;
  totalScenesDisplay.textContent = scenes.length;

  // Bind game option handlers
  document.querySelectorAll(".game-option").forEach(option => {
    option.addEventListener("click", e => {
      const correct = e.currentTarget.dataset.answer === "correct";
      if (correct) {
        e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = "rgba(22,163,74,0.3)";
        e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = "var(--gold)";
      } else {
        e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = "rgba(220,38,38,0.35)";
      }
    });
  });

  // Update nav button disabled states
  prevSceneBtn.disabled = currentScene === 0;
  nextSceneBtn.disabled = currentScene >= scenes.length - 1;
}

function nextScene() {
  const lesson = getCurrentLesson();
  if (currentScene < lesson.scenes.length - 1) {
    currentScene++;
    renderScene();
  }
}

function prevScene() {
  if (currentScene > 0) {
    currentScene--;
    renderScene();
  }
}

// ------------------------
// 7. Students & Scoreboard
// ------------------------
function renderStudentList() {
  studentList.innerHTML = "";
  students.forEach(name => {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent = name;
    div.className = "p-1 text-sm truncate";
    studentList.appendChild(div);
  });
}

function addStudent(nameOverride) {
  const name = (nameOverride ?? studentNameInput.value).trim();
  if (!name) return;
  students.push(name);
  studentNameInput.value = "";
  appState.students = students.slice();
  renderStudentList();
}

function autoSeedStudents() {
  // Only auto-seed once if list is empty
  if (students.length === 0) {
    DEMO_STUDENTS.forEach(n => addStudent(n));
  }
}

function selectStudent() {
  if (!students.length) {
    selectedStudentDisplay.textContent = "No Students";
    return;
  }

  runSpinAnimation(students, (winnerName, fakeOutUsed) => {
    selectedStudentDisplay.textContent = `⚡ ${winnerName} ⚡`;
    appState.spinHistory.push({
      name: winnerName,
      fakeOut: !!fakeOutUsed,
      ts: new Date().toISOString()
    });
  });
}

function updateScore(teamKey) {
  if (teamKey !== "team1" && teamKey !== "team2") return;
  scores[teamKey]++;
  team1ScoreEl.textContent = scores.team1;
  team2ScoreEl.textContent = scores.team2;
  appState.scores = { ...scores };
}

// ------------------------
// 8. AES-GCM Persistence
// ------------------------
async function getCryptoKey(password) {
  const enc = new TextEncoder();
  const keyMaterial = await window.crypto.subtle.importKey(
    "raw",
    enc.encode(password),
    "PBKDF2",
    false,
    ["deriveKey"]
  );

  return window.crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
    {
      name: "PBKDF2",
      salt: enc.encode("NET_SALT"),
      iterations: 100000,
      hash: "SHA-256"
    },
    keyMaterial,
    { name: "AES-GCM", length: 256 },
    true,
    ["encrypt", "decrypt"]
  );
}

async function encryptState(password) {
  const key = await getCryptoKey(password);
  const iv = window.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
  const data = JSON.stringify(appState);
  const encrypted = await window.crypto.subtle.encrypt(
    { name: "AES-GCM", iv },
    key,
    new TextEncoder().encode(data)
  );

  const ivString = String.fromCharCode(...iv);
  const encBytes = new Uint8Array(encrypted);
  const encryptedString = String.fromCharCode(...encBytes);
  return btoa(ivString + encryptedString);
}

async function decryptState(password, base64Data) {
  try {
    const key = await getCryptoKey(password);
    const data = atob(base64Data);
    const iv = new Uint8Array([...data.slice(0, 12)].map(c => c.charCodeAt(0)));
    const encBytes = new Uint8Array([...data.slice(12)].map(c => c.charCodeAt(0)));

    const decrypted = await window.crypto.subtle.decrypt(
      { name: "AES-GCM", iv },
      key,
      encBytes
    );

    const json = new TextDecoder().decode(decrypted);
    return JSON.parse(json);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Decryption failed:", e);
    return null;
  }
}

async function saveState() {
  const password = prompt("Enter a password to encrypt the state:");
  if (!password) return;
  try {
    const encryptedData = await encryptState(password);
    localStorage.setItem("NET_CLASSROOM_STATE", encryptedData);
    alert("✅ State Saved & Encrypted!");
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
    alert("❌ Error saving state.");
  }
}

async function loadState() {
  const password = prompt("Enter the password to decrypt the state:");
  if (!password) return;

  const encryptedData = localStorage.getItem("NET_CLASSROOM_STATE");
  if (!encryptedData) {
    alert("❌ No saved state found.");
    return;
  }

  const decryptedState = await decryptState(password, encryptedData);
  if (!decryptedState) {
    alert("❌ Decryption failed. Wrong password or corrupted data.");
    return;
  }

  // Hydrate appState
  appState = decryptedState;

  students = Array.isArray(appState.students) ? appState.students.slice() : [];
  scores = appState.scores || { team1: 0, team2: 0 };

  currentLessonId = (appState.lessonProgress && appState.lessonProgress.currentLessonId) || "sarcasm_I1";
  currentScene = (appState.lessonProgress && appState.lessonProgress.currentScene) || 0;

  // Update UI
  team1ScoreEl.textContent = scores.team1;
  team2ScoreEl.textContent = scores.team2;
  renderStudentList();
  renderScene();

  alert("✅ State Loaded & Decrypted!");
}

function exportJson() {
  try {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(appState, null, 2)], {
      type: "application/json;charset=utf-8;"
    });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "NET_Classroom_State.json";
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
    alert("❌ Failed to export JSON.");
  }
}

nextSceneBtn.addEventListener("click", nextScene);
prevSceneBtn.addEventListener("click", prevScene);

addStudentBtn.addEventListener("click", () => addStudent());
studentNameInput.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  if (e.key === "Enter") addStudent();
});

selectStudentBtn.addEventListener("click", selectStudent);

team1Btn.addEventListener("click", () => updateScore("team1"));
team2Btn.addEventListener("click", () => updateScore("team2"));

saveStateBtn.addEventListener("click", saveState);
loadStateBtn.addEventListener("click", loadState);
exportJsonBtn.addEventListener("click", exportJson);

// ------------------------
// 10. Initialization
// ------------------------
function initialize() {
  if (window.lucide && lucide.createIcons) {
    lucide.createIcons();
  }
  autoSeedStudents();
  renderStudentList();
  renderScene();
}

initialize();

/**
 * NET-Classroom-Toolkit.js
 * Consolidated from 250 optimized classroom snippets.

const NETTools = {
  lesson: {
    getCurrentLesson: function(lessons, id) { return lessons[id]; },
    getCurrentScene: function(lesson, idx) { var s=lesson.scenes; return s && s[idx] ? s[idx] : null; },
    clampScene: function(idx, len) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, len-1)); },
    nextScene: function(idx, len) { return idx < len-1 ? idx+1 : idx; },
    prevScene: function(idx) { return idx>0 ? idx-1:idx; },
    sceneCount: function(lesson) { return lesson.scenes ? lesson.scenes.length:0; },
    title: function(lesson) { return lesson.title||""; },
    isValidLesson: function(l){return l&&l.id&&l.title&&Array.isArray(l.scenes);}
  },
  students: {
    add: function(list,name) {
      name=(name||"").trim(); return name && list.indexOf(name)<0 ? list.concat(name):list;
    },
    remove: function(list,name){
      var i=list.indexOf(name);if(i>=0){var l=list.slice();l.splice(i,1);return l;}return list;
    },
    shuffle: function(arr) {
      var a = arr.slice(), n=a.length, i, j, t;
      for(i=n-1;i>0;i--){j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;}
      return a;
    },
    random: function(arr) { return arr.length ? arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)] : null; },
    sortAlpha: function(arr) { return arr.slice().sort(); },
    filter: function(arr,sub){return arr.filter(function(n){return n.toLowerCase().indexOf(sub.toLowerCase())>-1;});}
  },
  scoreboard: {
    addScore: function(scores,team,k){
      if(scores.hasOwnProperty(team)) scores[team]+=k||1;
      return scores;
    },
    resetScores: function(scores){var o={};for(var k in scores)o[k]=0;return o;},
    winner: function(scores) {
      var keys=Object.keys(scores), win=keys[0],max=scores[win];
      for(var i=1;i<keys.length;i++) if(scores[keys[i]]>max){max=scores[keys[i]];win=keys[i];}
      return win;
    }
  },
  ui: {
    setHTML: function(el,html){if(el)el.innerHTML=html;},
    setText: function(el,txt){if(el)el.textContent=txt;},
    disable: function(el,state){if(el)el.disabled=!!state;},
    clearChildren: function(el){if(el)while(el.firstChild)el.removeChild(el.firstChild);}
  },
  persistence: {
    saveJSON: function(key,obj){
      try{localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(obj));return true;}catch(e){return false;}
    },
    loadJSON: function(key){
      try{var s=localStorage.getItem(key);return s?JSON.parse(s):null;}catch(e){return null;}
    },
    exportFile: function(obj,filename){
      var blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(obj,null,2)],{type:"application/json"});
      var a=document.createElement("a");
      a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download=filename;document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();document.body.removeChild(a);URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    }
  },
  crypto: {
    getCryptoKey: function(password,cb){
      var enc=new TextEncoder(),s="NET_SALT";
      window.crypto.subtle.importKey("raw",enc.encode(password),"PBKDF2",false,["deriveKey"]).then(function(keyMaterial){
        window.crypto.subtle.deriveKey({
          name:"PBKDF2",salt:enc.encode(s),iterations:1E5,hash:"SHA-256"
        },keyMaterial,{ name:"AES-GCM",length:256 },true,["encrypt","decrypt"]).then(cb);
      });
    },
    encryptState: function(state,password,cb){
      NETTools.crypto.getCryptoKey(password,function(key){
        var iv=window.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
        var data=JSON.stringify(state);
        window.crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:"AES-GCM",iv},key,new TextEncoder().encode(data))
        .then(function(encrypted){
          var ivStr=String.fromCharCode.apply(null,iv);
          var encBytes=new Uint8Array(encrypted),encStr=String.fromCharCode.apply(null,encBytes);
          cb(btoa(ivStr+encStr));
        });
      });
    },
    decryptState: function(password,base64,cb){
      NETTools.crypto.getCryptoKey(password,function(key){
        var data=atob(base64);
        var iv=new Uint8Array(Array.prototype.map.call(data.slice(0,12),function(c){return c.charCodeAt(0);}));
        var encBytes=new Uint8Array(Array.prototype.map.call(data.slice(12),function(c){return c.charCodeAt(0);}));
        window.crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:"AES-GCM",iv},key,encBytes)
        .then(function(decrypted){ var json=new TextDecoder().decode(decrypted); cb(JSON.parse(json)); })
        .catch(function(){ cb(null); });
      });
    }
  },
  validation: {
    isNonEmptyStr: function(s) { return typeof s==="string"&&!!s.trim(); },
    isNonEmptyArr: function(a) { return Array.isArray(a)&&a.length>0; },
    isUniqueArr: function(a) { var s=new Set(a);return s.size===a.length; },
    clamp: function(v,min,max){return Math.max(min,Math.min(v,max));},
    isValidScore: function(score) { return typeof score==="number"&&score>=0; }
  },
  debugging: {
    log: function(msg){console.log(msg);},
    error: function(msg){console.error(msg);},
    time: function(label){console.time(label);},
    timeEnd: function(label){console.timeEnd(label);}
  },
  analytics: {
    getAvgScore: function(scores){
      var k=Object.keys(scores),sum=0;
      for(var i=0;i<k.length;i++) sum+=scores[k[i]];
      return sum/k.length;
    },
    getMaxScore: function(scores){
      return Math.max.apply(null,Object.values(scores));
    },
    getMinScore: function(scores){
      return Math.min.apply(null,Object.values(scores));
    }
  },
  misc: {
    clamp: function(v,min,max){return Math.max(min,Math.min(v,max));},
    randomInt: function(min,max){return Math.floor(Math.random()*(max-min+1))+min;},
    deepClone: function(obj){return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj));},
    uniqArr: function(arr){return Array.from(new Set(arr));},
    isoTime: function(){return(new Date()).toISOString();}
  }
};

## 1. List of Required Fixes

### Naming Consistency

- Several function names are inconsistent or vague for a classroom domain (e.g., add, remove in students are ambiguous; should clarify action and entity, e.g., addStudent, removeStudent).
- Some modules use generic function names that may conflict in the global scope or create confusion across tools (e.g., clamp appears in both validation and misc).
- Functions like scoreboard.addScore use variable k as increment step; recommend explicit naming: increment.
- Inconsistent return value contracts—some functions mutate input, others return new objects, but signatures/behavior are not always clear from naming.

### Function Safety & Missing Guards

- Functions do not validate input types, risking runtime errors (e.g., almost all methods accept raw values/objects without basic type checks).
- Many array/object mutating functions do not guard against null/undefined or invalid structures (e.g., students.add, scoreboard.resetScores).
- Crypto and persistence calls assume browser APIs are always available; should check for API existence before use for robustness.

### Edge-Case & Immutability Coverage

- Some mutating functions (e.g., scoreboard.addScore) actually mutate input objects, violating immutability preferences.
- Array/object operations (e.g., students.add) sometimes create new objects, sometimes mutate. Immutability should be a policy: functions must never mutate input unless explicitly documented.
- Loop-based utilities (e.g., shuffling, score tally) do not check for zero-length or malformed input.

### Data-Shape & Return-Type Correctness

- Several return types depend on side-effect or previous state (e.g., scoreboard.winner gives undefined if input is empty).
- Some functions (e.g., students.add) may return input arrays unchanged or new arrays—type contract is unclear.
- Crypto and persistence methods lack error callbacks or promise-based APIs, limiting robust error-handling.

### Speed & Browser Compatibility

- Bulk DOM operations (e.g., ui.clearChildren) are not optimized for very large lists.
- No guard for legacy browser compatibility with WebCrypto, TextEncoder, or native Blob (should detect and fall back as needed).

### Modular Design & Side-Effect Protection

- Modular design is generally good, but persistence and crypto tools may trigger dialogs or DOM interactions (e.g., file download, localStorage) without sandboxing—side-effect free operation must be documented/guaranteed.
- Many functions lack isolation and do not warn/report on unexpected side effects.

### Error Handling

- Crypto/persistence tools do not provide structured error objects, only rely on catch or raw false/null returns.
- No clear reporting for failed operations in all modules—should always return consistent error shapes.

"use strict";
/* ======================================================================
   NET-Classroom-Manager-Core.js
   Chatty Prime V5.0 — Core Runtime Engine
   ====================================================================== */

const NET = {
  state: {
    lessons: {},
    currentLessonId: null,
    currentScene: 0,
    students: [],
    scores: { team1: 0, team2: 0 },
  },

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------
     LESSON ENGINE
  ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  loadLessonPack(lessonPack) {
    Object.assign(NET.state.lessons, lessonPack);
  },

  startLesson(id) {
    if (!NET.state.lessons[id]) return { ok: false, error: "Lesson not found" };
    NET.state.currentLessonId = id;
    NET.state.currentScene = 0;
    NET.renderScene();
    return { ok: true };
  },

  nextScene() {
    const L = NET.getLesson();
    if (!L) return;

    if (NET.state.currentScene < L.scenes.length - 1) {
      NET.state.currentScene++;
      NET.renderScene();
    }
  },

  prevScene() {
    if (NET.state.currentScene > 0) {
      NET.state.currentScene--;
      NET.renderScene();
    }
  },

  getLesson() {
    return NET.state.lessons[NET.state.currentLessonId] || null;
  },

  getScene() {
    const L = NET.getLesson();
    if (!L) return null;
    return L.scenes[NET.state.currentScene] || null;
  },

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------
     RENDER ENGINE
  ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  renderScene() {
    const scene = NET.getScene();
    const panel = document.getElementById("lessonPanel");

    if (!panel) return;

    if (!scene) {
      panel.innerHTML = `<p>No scene found.</p>`;
      return;
    }

    panel.innerHTML = `
      <h2 class="text-gold font-bold mb-3">${scene.title}</h2>
      ${scene.content}
    `;

    NET.updateSceneCounter();
    NET.bindGameOptions();
  },

  updateSceneCounter() {
    const curr = document.getElementById("currentSceneDisplay");
    const tot = document.getElementById("totalScenesDisplay");
    const L = NET.getLesson();

    if (curr) curr.textContent = NET.state.currentScene + 1;
    if (tot && L) tot.textContent = L.scenes.length;
  },

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------
     GAME LOGIC BINDING
  ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  bindGameOptions() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".game-option").forEach(opt => {
      opt.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (opt.dataset.answer === "correct") {
          opt.style.background = "rgba(34,197,94,0.3)"; // green
        } else {
          opt.style.background = "rgba(220,38,38,0.3)"; // red
        }
      });
    });
  },

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------
     STUDENT ENGINE
  ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  addStudent(name) {
    name = name.trim();
    if (!name) return;

    if (!NET.state.students.includes(name)) {
      NET.state.students.push(name);
      NET.renderStudentList();
    }
  },

  renderStudentList() {
    const list = document.getElementById("studentList");
    if (!list) return;

    list.innerHTML = "";

    NET.state.students.forEach(stu => {
      const div = document.createElement("div");
      div.textContent = stu;
      div.className = "p-1";
      list.appendChild(div);
    });
  },

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------
     SPIN SELECTOR (Fake-out Included)
  ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  spinSelectStudent() {
    const out = document.getElementById("selectedStudentDisplay");

    if (!NET.state.students.length) {
      out.textContent = "No Students";
      return;
    }

    const shuffled = NET.state.students.slice();
    let i = 0;
    const cycles = NET.randomInt(25, 45);
    const fakeout = Math.random() < 0.28; // 28% dramatic fake-out chance

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      out.textContent = shuffled[i % shuffled.length];
      i++;

      if (i > cycles) {
        clearInterval(interval);

        let final = shuffled[(i - 1) % shuffled.length];

        if (fakeout) {
          final = shuffled[NET.randomInt(0, shuffled.length - 1)];
        }

        out.textContent = "⚡ " + final + " ⚡";
      }
    }, 60);
  },

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------
     SCOREBOARD
  ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  addScore(team) {
    NET.state.scores[team]++;
    NET.updateScoreboard();
  },

  updateScoreboard() {
    const t1 = document.getElementById("team1Score");
    const t2 = document.getElementById("team2Score");

    if (t1) t1.textContent = NET.state.scores.team1;
    if (t2) t2.textContent = NET.state.scores.team2;
  },

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------
     PERSISTENCE (AES-GCM same as toolkit)
  ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  saveState(password) {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      NETTools.crypto.encryptState(NET.state, password, encrypted => {
        localStorage.setItem("NET_STATE_V1", encrypted);
        resolve(true);
      });
    });
  },

  loadState(password) {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      const data = localStorage.getItem("NET_STATE_V1");
      if (!data) return resolve(false);

      NETTools.crypto.decryptState(password, data, json => {
        if (!json) return resolve(false);
        NET.state = json;
        NET.renderStudentList();
        NET.updateScoreboard();
        NET.renderScene();
        resolve(true);
      });
    });
  },

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------
     UTILS
  ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  randomInt(min, max) {
    return Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1)) + min;
  }
};

/* EXPORT READY */

        content: `
          <p>Most students say, “I want to <strong>speak</strong> better.”</p>
          <p>But high-level speakers are also high-level <strong>listeners</strong>.</p>
          <p>Today’s mission: Upgrade from “hearing words” to <strong>active listening</strong>.</p>
        `
      },
      {
        title: "Core Vocabulary (10) – Listening Toolkit",
        content: `
          <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
            <li><strong>Active listening</strong> – Fully focusing on the speaker, not just hearing sounds.</li>
            <li><strong>Paraphrase</strong> – Repeat the idea in your own words.</li>
            <li><strong>Clarify</strong> – Ask questions to make something clearer.</li>
            <li><strong>Interrupt</strong> – Stop someone while they are speaking.</li>
            <li><strong>Backchannel</strong> – Small sounds/words that show you are listening (“uh-huh”, “right”).</li>
            <li><strong>Engaged</strong> – Involved and interested.</li>
            <li><strong>Distracted</strong> – Not able to focus because your attention is somewhere else.</li>
            <li><strong>Body language</strong> – Communication using your body, not your words.</li>
            <li><strong>Eye contact</strong> – Looking into someone’s eyes while speaking or listening.</li>
            <li><strong>Feedback</strong> – Information you give back, like reactions, questions, or comments.</li>
          </ul>
        `
      },
      {
        title: "Phrases for Active Listening (10)",
        content: `
          <h3 class="font-bold mb-1">Show You Are Listening (5)</h3>
          <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
            <li><strong>“I see, so you mean...”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“Let me check I understand...”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“That makes sense because...”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“Uh-huh, go on.”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“Right, and then what happened?”</strong></li>
          </ul>
          <h3 class="font-bold mt-3 mb-1">Clarifying (5)</h3>
          <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
            <li><strong>“Sorry, what do you mean by...?”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“Can you say that another way?”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“Do you mean that...?”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“So, just to be clear...”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“Can you give an example?”</strong></li>
          </ul>
        `

  toneSubtext_I1: {
    id: "toneSubtext_I1",
    title: "NET Lesson (I-1): Tone & Subtext",
    level: "I-1",
    estMinutes: 90,
    scenes: [
      {
        title: "Landing: Same Words, Different Feelings",
        content: `
          <p>Try saying “Okay.” in 4 different ways:</p>
          <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
            <li>Excited</li>
            <li>Angry</li>
            <li>Bored</li>
            <li>Sad</li>
          </ul>
          <p>The word doesn’t change, but the <strong>tone</strong> and the <strong>subtext</strong> do.</p>
          <p>This is today’s focus: how voice and hidden meaning change English.</p>
        `
      },
      {
        title: "Core Vocabulary (10) – Tone Toolkit",
        content: `
          <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
            <li><strong>Tone</strong> – The way you sound when you speak.</li>
            <li><strong>Subtext</strong> – The unspoken meaning behind the words.</li>
            <li><strong>Monotone</strong> – Speaking with almost no change in pitch.</li>
            <li><strong>Emphasis</strong> – Stressing a word to show importance.</li>
            <li><strong>Intonation</strong> – The rise and fall of your voice.</li>
            <li><strong>Emotion</strong> – Feelings shown in voice and words.</li>
            <li><strong>Polite</strong> – Showing good manners and respect.</li>
            <li><strong>Blunt</strong> – Very direct, sometimes rude.</li>
            <li><strong>Reassuring</strong> – Making someone feel less worried.</li>
            <li><strong>Passive-aggressive</strong> – Saying something indirectly to show anger or frustration.</li>
          </ul>
        `
      },
      {
        title: "Phrases & Mini-Scenes (10)",
        content: `
          <p>How tone changes meaning:</p>
          <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
            <li><strong>“It’s fine.”</strong> – calm voice = really okay.</li>
            <li><strong>“It’s FINE.”</strong> – angry voice = not okay.</li>
            <li><strong>“Sure.”</strong> – friendly = happy to help.</li>
            <li><strong>“Sure.”</strong> – flat/monotone = not interested.</li>
            <li><strong>“Whatever.”</strong> – usually rude or dismissive.</li>
            <li><strong>“No worries.”</strong> – relaxed, everything is okay.</li>
            <li><strong>“We need to talk.”</strong> – serious tone = problem.</li>
            <li><strong>“We need to talk 😊.”</strong> – gentle tone/message = not a big problem.</li>
            <li><strong>“Are you serious?”</strong> – shocked, surprised, or angry.</li>
            <li><strong>“Wow.”</strong> – can be positive, negative, or sarcastic depending on tone.</li>
          </ul>
        `
      },
      {
        title: "Game 1 – What’s the Subtext?",
        content: `
          <p>Choose the most likely hidden meaning (subtext).</p>
          <p class="mt-2"><strong>Line:</strong> “Nice outfit.” (said with eye roll)</p>
          <div class="game-option" data-answer="wrong">They truly love the outfit.</div>
          <div class="game-option" data-answer="correct">They think the outfit looks bad or strange.</div>
          <div class="game-option" data-answer="wrong">They didn’t look at the outfit.</div>
        `
      },
      {
        title: "Game 2 – Rewrite for Polite Tone",
        content: `
          <p>Change the tone from blunt/rude to polite but clear.</p>
          <p class="mt-2"><strong>Blunt:</strong> “You’re wrong.”</p>
          <p><strong>Task:</strong> Rewrite it in a polite way that still shows your opinion.</p>
          <textarea class="neon-input w-full mt-3" placeholder="Type your polite version here..."></textarea>
        `
      },
      {
        title: "Game 3 – Emoji & Tone",

          </ul>

      }

  politeDisagree_I1: {
    id: "politeDisagree_I1",

    level: "I-1",
    estMinutes: 90,
    scenes: [
      {
        title: "Landing: “You’re Wrong!” vs. “I See It Differently.”",
        content: `
          <p>In English, especially in international settings, <strong>how</strong> you disagree is very important.</p>
          <p>Today’s mission: Learn how to disagree clearly, honestly, but politely.</p>
        `
      },
      {
        title: "Core Vocabulary (10) – Debate Toolkit",
        content: `
          <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
            <li><strong>Opinion</strong> – What you think or believe.</li>
            <li><strong>Argument</strong> – A reason you use to support your opinion.</li>
            <li><strong>Counterargument</strong> – A reason against an opinion.</li>
            <li><strong>Agree</strong> – Think the same way as someone.</li>
            <li><strong>Disagree</strong> – Think differently from someone.</li>
            <li><strong>Respectful</strong> – Showing respect, even when you disagree.</li>
            <li><strong>Rude</strong> – Not polite; can hurt feelings.</li>
            <li><strong>Neutral</strong> – Not taking any side strongly.</li>
            <li><strong>Compromise</strong> – A solution where both sides give up a little.</li>
            <li><strong>Constructive</strong> – Helpful and designed to improve something.</li>
          </ul>
        `
      },
      {
        title: "Useful Phrases (10) – Disagreeing Politely",
        content: `
          <h3 class="font-bold mb-1">Soft Disagreement (5)</h3>
          <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
            <li><strong>“I see your point, but...”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“I’m not sure I agree with that.”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“I see it a little differently.”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“That’s interesting, but have you considered...?”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“I partly agree, but I also think...”</strong></li>
          </ul>
          <h3 class="font-bold mt-3 mb-1">Stronger Disagreement (5)</h3>
          <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
            <li><strong>“I have to disagree with that.”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“I don’t think that’s completely accurate.”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“I strongly disagree with that idea.”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“The evidence doesn’t really support that.”</strong></li>
            <li><strong>“From my perspective, that’s not correct.”</strong></li>
          </ul>
        `
      },
      {
        title: "Game 1 – Rude vs. Polite",
        content: `
          <p>Choose the <strong>polite</strong> version of disagreement.</p>
          <p class="mt-2"><strong>Topic:</strong> “Homework is a complete waste of time.”</p>
          <div class="game-option" data-answer="wrong">“That’s stupid. You’re wrong.”</div>

          <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
            <li>Use softening phrases instead of direct attacks.</li>
            <li>Focus on ideas, not people.</li>

    .addEventListener("click", selectStudent);
</script>
Inline event handlers are not allowed.

MANDATE S3 – Web Workers for Heavy Compute

Any heavy or long-running logic must:

Be moved into a Web Worker.

The main thread stays smooth for teaching.

Examples of “heavy”:

SER recalculation for 40+ students.

Large JSON lesson import/export.

Analytics crunching.

MANDATE S4 – Immutable State via structuredClone

When modifying complex state:

Use structuredClone (or equivalent) instead of mutating in place.

Example:

const newState = structuredClone(oldState);
newState.scores.team1 += 1;
NET.state = newState;
Direct mutation of shared global state is discouraged.

PILLAR III — AI & QC (SUPREME EXCELLENCE)
This governs lessons and evaluation, not just code.

MANDATE Q1 – Lesson Structure (10 Sections)

Every “serious” lesson (90/120 min) follows a 10-part skeleton:

Landing / Story Hook

Pre-Assessment (quick check of current level)

Core Input 1 – Concept / Explainer

Core Input 2 – Vocabulary / Idioms (10–5–5 structure)

Guided Practice – Controlled output

AI / Speaking Practice – student speaks, AI or teacher responds

Game / Challenge – high-energy practice

Deeper Practice / Transfer – apply to real life

Reflection – meta-cognition / self-awareness

Exit Ticket – short measurable outcome

MANDATE Q2 – 10–5–5–3 Recipe

Most “core” language lessons should:

10 key vocabulary words

5 idioms

5 common phrases/slang / sentence frames

3 challenges (games or tasks) that make students use those items

MANDATE Q3 – SER Engine Scoring

Evaluation uses the SER formula:

SER = (L * 2) + (S * 2) + R + W
Where:
L = Listening
S = Speaking
R = Reading
W = Writing
Weights:

Listening & Speaking are doubled.

Reading & Writing are single-weight.

All serious assessments should at least conceptually align with this weighting.

MANDATE Q4 – Pre-Assessment & AI Speaking Practice

Every full lesson must:

Start with a quick pre-assessment:

A question, a poll, or a mini-task to see starting level.

Include at least one AI / speaking practice moment:

Student talks, teacher/AI responds or gives feedback.

For online: record audio or simulate conversation.

PILLAR IV — PERSISTENCE (SAVE THE GAME)
MANDATE P1 – AES-GCM Encryption (V101.0 module)

All stored classroom state (scores, students, lesson progress, SER results) must:

Be encrypted with AES-GCM using a derived key (PBKDF2 + SHA-256).

Use a random IV for each encryption.

Derive keys with at least 100,000 iterations.

MANDATE P2 – Sign Artifacts (ECDSA, optional but preferred)

Critical exports (e.g., term results, master settings) should be signable.

The system should support:

Hashing JSON

Signing with ECDSA

Verifying signature

(In practice: we can leave this as a later upgrade but it’s part of the gospel.)

MANDATE P3 – JSON Export

Every serious tool must support:

One-click JSON export of the whole state:

Example state contents:

{
  "students": [...],
  "scores": {...},
  "lessons": {...},
  "currentLessonId": "sarcasm_I1",
  "currentScene": 3,
  "serHistory": [...],
  "timestamp": "ISO-STRING"
}
Bonus:

Export should be human-readable (indented).

Export file should contain version/meta info.

MANDATE P4 – Recovery & Decryption UX

If decryption fails (wrong password / corrupted data), the system must:

Fail gracefully (no crash)

Show clear message: “Decryption failed. Check password or file integrity.”

Not silently erase or overwrite anything.

/* Body + Background */
body {
  margin: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, #111827 0, #050510 40%, #02010a 100%);
  color: var(--net-text);
  font-family: var(--net-font-ui);
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Organic blobs */
.net-blob-purple,
.net-blob-gold {
  position: fixed;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  filter: blur(80px);
  opacity: 0.22;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

.net-blob-purple {
  width: 420px;
  height: 420px;
  top: 5%;
  left: 10%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--net-purple), transparent 60%);
  animation: net-blob-float 18s infinite alternate;
}

.net-blob-gold {
  width: 360px;
  height: 360px;
  bottom: 6%;
  right: 8%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--net-gold), transparent 60%);
  animation: net-blob-float 22s infinite alternate-reverse;
}

@keyframes net-blob-float {
  from {
    transform: translate3d(-10px, 10px, 0) scale(0.95);
  }
  to {
    transform: translate3d(10px, -10px, 0) scale(1.05);
  }
}

/* Glass Panel */
.net-glass {
  background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.7);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border-radius: var(--net-radius-xl);
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25);
  box-shadow:
    0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7),
    0 0 30px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5),
    0 0 50px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
}

/* Buttons */
.net-btn {
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
  font-family: var(--net-font-ui);
}

.net-btn-purple {
  background: var(--net-purple);
  color: white;
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.7);
}

.net-btn-purple:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 26px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.9);
}

.net-btn-gold {
  background: var(--net-gold);
  color: #111827;
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.8);
}

.net-btn-gold:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 26px rgba(245, 158, 11, 1);
}

/* Inputs */
.net-input {
  width: 100%;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35);
  padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem;
  color: var(--net-text);
  font-family: var(--net-font-ui);
}

.net-input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--net-purple);
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.7);
}

          <li><strong>“Perfect!”</strong> — said when something goes wrong.</li>

          <li><strong>Tone:</strong> The feeling in a speaker’s voice.</li>
          <li><strong>Inflection:</strong> Voice pitch changes that show emotion.</li>
          <li><strong>Subtle:</strong> Not obvious; easy to miss.</li>
          <li><strong>Mock:</strong> To make fun of someone.</li>
          <li><strong>Deadpan:</strong> Saying something with no expression.</li>
          <li><strong>Wit:</strong> Clever and humorous intelligence.</li>
          <li><strong>Literal:</strong> Exact meaning of words.</li>
          <li><strong>Derisive:</strong> Showing that something is ridiculous.</li>

NET LESSON — SARCASM I1
Professional English Sarcasm for Vietnamese Learners
(with Chatty Prime enhancements)

1. What This Lesson Teaches
Sarcasm in English is tone-based language, not vocabulary-based.
Vietnamese learners struggle because:

The words look normal

The tone flips the meaning

The context tells the truth

The speaker’s face or timing gives the real meaning

This lesson trains students to hear sarcasm, recognize it in conversation, and avoid misinterpreting it in a business environment.

2. The 3 Pillars of Sarcasm Detection
PILLAR 1 — Tone Shape
Sarcasm uses a special intonation pattern:

Starts normal

Drops pitch suddenly

Ends with flat, dead energy

Sometimes paired with a sigh or exaggerated politeness

Example:

“Wow… great job.”

Said with flat delivery → sarcasm
Said brightly → sincere compliment

Chatty Prime Note:
Humans almost never say sarcastic lines with neutral pitch. Tone is the #1 giveaway.

PILLAR 2 — Context Clash
Sarcasm appears when the words do not match the situation.

Example:
Situation: Someone arrives 30 minutes late
Words: “Right on time.”

If words contradict reality → high sarcasm likelihood.

Chatty Prime Note:
Teach students to detect mismatch instead of memorizing phrases. This generalizes to all sarcasm types.

PILLAR 3 — Emotional Masking
Sarcasm is used to:

Hide frustration

Soften criticism

Be humorous

Show passive disapproval

Create professional distance

Example:
Coworker submits poor work:

“Fantastic. Exactly what I needed.”
Said with dead tone → frustration
Said smiling → humor

// ============================================================================
// NET_PET_ENGINE_RUNTIME_V1.js
// Depends on: NET_ULTRA_MASTER_SEED_V6.js (canon only, zero drift)
// Purpose: Implement NET PET state logic, streaks, XP, moods, and Phoenix-compliant
//          state management (no eval, sanitized inputs, localStorage).
// ============================================================================

import {
  getNetPetEngine,
  canonVersion,
  assertExecutor,
} from "./NET_ULTRA_MASTER_SEED_V6.js";

// LAW 0 check (optional – call once at app boot)
assertExecutor("MICHAEL_HOBBS");

const NET_PET_CANON = getNetPetEngine();
const STORAGE_KEY = "NET_PET_ENGINE_STATE_V1";
const STORAGE_HASH_KEY = "NET_PET_ENGINE_STATE_V1_HASH";

// ============================================================================
// Small utilities — safeclone, hash stub, date helpers
// ============================================================================

function safeClone(obj) {
  // Phoenix-friendly clone (no prototypes, no functions)
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj));
}

function todayISO() {
  return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10); // "YYYY-MM-DD"
}

function daysBetween(d1, d2) {
  const a = new Date(d1 + "T00:00:00Z");
  const b = new Date(d2 + "T00:00:00Z");
  const diffMs = b.getTime() - a.getTime();
  return Math.round(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
}

// Simple non-crypto hash just to detect change (NOT for security, just drift)
function simpleHash(str) {
  let hash = 0;
  if (!str) return "0";
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    hash = (hash * 31 + str.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
  }
  return String(hash);
}

// Sanitizers
function toSafeNumber(value, fallback = 0) {
  const n = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) return fallback;
  return n;
}

function toSafeMood(mood) {
  const allowed = ["NEUTRAL", "TOUGH", "HAPPY", "PROUD", "SLUMP"];
  return allowed.includes(mood) ? mood : "NEUTRAL";
}

// ============================================================================
// Canon-based initial state + XP logic
// ============================================================================

export function createInitialPetState() {
  const schema = NET_PET_CANON.STATE_SCHEMA;
  // Build based on canon structure, not hard-coded
  const base = safeClone(schema);

  base.streak = 0;
  base.minutesListen = 0;
  base.minutesSpeak = 0;
  base.mood = "NEUTRAL";
  base.lastLogin = null;
  base.dailyGoalMet = false;

  if (!base.xp || typeof base.xp !== "object") {
    base.xp = { consistency: 0, growth: 0, courage: 0, tiger: 0 };
  }

  base._meta = {
    canonVersion: canonVersion(),
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  return base;
}

// XP level from canon
function getLevelForXP(totalXP) {
  const levels = NET_PET_CANON.XP_SYSTEM.LEVELS || [];
  let current = levels[0] || { min: 0, title: "Struggling Mouse", perk: "None" };
  for (const lvl of levels) {
    if (totalXP >= lvl.min) {
      current = lvl;
    } else {
      break;
    }
  }
  return current;
}

function sumXP(xpObj) {
  if (!xpObj) return 0;
  return (
    toSafeNumber(xpObj.consistency) +
    toSafeNumber(xpObj.growth) +
    toSafeNumber(xpObj.courage) +
    toSafeNumber(xpObj.tiger)
  );
}

// ============================================================================
// Persistence (Phoenix-compliant: localStorage, hash, drift detection)
// ============================================================================

export function loadPetState() {
  if (typeof localStorage === "undefined") {
    // SSR or unsafe environment – return fresh state
    return createInitialPetState();
  }

  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    const storedHash = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_HASH_KEY);

    if (!raw) {
      const initial = createInitialPetState();
      savePetState(initial);
      return initial;
    }

    const hashNow = simpleHash(raw);
    if (storedHash && storedHash !== hashNow) {
      // Drift / tampering detected – reset
      console.warn("[NET_PET] State hash mismatch. Resetting to initial state.");
      const initial = createInitialPetState();
      savePetState(initial);
      return initial;
    }

    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);

    // Minimal schema sanity check
    if (typeof parsed !== "object" || parsed === null) {
      throw new Error("Invalid state object");
    }

    // Ensure required fields exist
    const safe = Object.assign(createInitialPetState(), parsed);
    safe.mood = toSafeMood(safe.mood);
    safe.minutesListen = toSafeNumber(safe.minutesListen, 0);
    safe.minutesSpeak = toSafeNumber(safe.minutesSpeak, 0);
    safe.streak = toSafeNumber(safe.streak, 0);
    safe.dailyGoalMet = Boolean(safe.dailyGoalMet);
    if (!safe._meta) safe._meta = {};
    safe._meta.canonVersion = canonVersion();
    safe._meta.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

    return safe;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[NET_PET] Failed to load state, resetting.", err);
    const initial = createInitialPetState();
    savePetState(initial);
    return initial;
  }
}

export function savePetState(state) {
  if (typeof localStorage === "undefined") {
    return;
  }
  try {
    const s = safeClone(state);
    s._meta = s._meta || {};
    s._meta.canonVersion = canonVersion();
    s._meta.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

    const serialized = JSON.stringify(s);
    const hash = simpleHash(serialized);
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, serialized);
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_HASH_KEY, hash);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[NET_PET] Failed to save state.", err);
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// Daily logic: streaks, goals, mood, XP
// ============================================================================

function evaluateDailyGoal(state) {
  // Directly aligned to canon: 45 listen / 15 speak
  const listenGoal = 45;
  const speakGoal = 15;
  return (
    toSafeNumber(state.minutesListen, 0) >= listenGoal &&
    toSafeNumber(state.minutesSpeak, 0) >= speakGoal
  );
}

function updateStreakForDate(state, today) {
  const last = state.lastLogin;
  if (!last) {
    state.streak = 1;
    return;
  }
  const diff = daysBetween(last, today);
  if (diff === 0) {
    // same day – leave streak unchanged
    return;
  }
  if (diff === 1) {
    state.streak = toSafeNumber(state.streak, 0) + 1;
  } else {
    // missed at least one full day → reset streak
    state.streak = 1;
  }
}

function applyXPGain(state, { didListen, didSpeak, goalMet }) {
  const rewards = NET_PET_CANON.XP_SYSTEM.REWARDS || {};
  state.xp = state.xp || {
    consistency: 0,
    growth: 0,
    courage: 0,
    tiger: 0,
  };

  if (didListen || didSpeak) {
    state.xp.consistency += rewards.LOGIN || 0;
  }
  if (goalMet) {
    state.xp.growth += rewards.GOAL_MET || 0;
  }
  if (didSpeak) {
    state.xp.courage += rewards.SPEAKING_LOG || 0;
  }
  if (state.streak >= 7) {
    state.xp.tiger += rewards.STREAK_BONUS || 0;
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// Mood selection and voice lines
// ============================================================================

function determineMood(state) {
  if (!state.lastLogin) return "NEUTRAL";

  const today = todayISO();
  const diff = daysBetween(state.lastLogin, today);

  if (diff > 2) return "SLUMP";
  if (!state.dailyGoalMet) return "TOUGH";
  if (state.streak >= 7) return "PROUD";
  if (state.streak >= 3) return "HAPPY";
  return "NEUTRAL";
}

function pickRandomFrom(arr) {
  if (!Array.isArray(arr) || arr.length === 0) return null;
  const idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length);
  return arr[idx];
}

export function getPetMessage(state, options = {}) {
  const matrix = NET_PET_CANON.VOICE_MATRIX;
  const mood = determineMood(state);
  const forceType = options.forceType || null;

  let bucket;
  if (forceType && matrix[forceType]) {
    bucket = matrix[forceType];
  } else {
    switch (mood) {
      case "TOUGH":
        bucket = matrix.TOUGH_LOVE || matrix.NUDGE;
        break;
      case "HAPPY":
      case "PROUD":
        bucket = matrix.CELEBRATION || matrix.GREETING;
        break;
      case "SLUMP":
        bucket = matrix.SLUMP || matrix.NUDGE;
        break;
      case "NEUTRAL":
      default:
        bucket = matrix.GREETING || matrix.NUDGE;
        break;
    }
  }

  const text = pickRandomFrom(bucket) || "Keep going. Small steps every day.";
  return { mood, text };
}

// ============================================================================
// Public API: log a learning session
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Update state with today's listening/speaking.
 * @param {object} state - current state
 * @param {object} payload - { listenMinutes, speakMinutes }
 */
export function logPetSession(state, payload) {
  const today = todayISO();
  const listenAdd = toSafeNumber(payload.listenMinutes || 0, 0);
  const speakAdd = toSafeNumber(payload.speakMinutes || 0, 0);

  // Clone so we don't mutate external references
  const next = safeClone(state || createInitialPetState());

  // New day? Reset minutes and goal flags
  if (!next.lastLogin || next.lastLogin !== today) {
    updateStreakForDate(next, today);
    next.minutesListen = 0;
    next.minutesSpeak = 0;
    next.dailyGoalMet = false;
  }

  next.lastLogin = today;
  const beforeListen = next.minutesListen;
  const beforeSpeak = next.minutesSpeak;

  next.minutesListen = toSafeNumber(next.minutesListen + listenAdd, 0);
  next.minutesSpeak = toSafeNumber(next.minutesSpeak + speakAdd, 0);

  // Evaluate daily goal
  next.dailyGoalMet = evaluateDailyGoal(next);

  // XP
  const didListen = listenAdd > 0 || beforeListen > 0;
  const didSpeak = speakAdd > 0 || beforeSpeak > 0;
  applyXPGain(next, {
    didListen,
    didSpeak,
    goalMet: next.dailyGoalMet,
  });

  // Mood
  next.mood = determineMood(next);

  // Meta
  next._meta = next._meta || {};
  next._meta.canonVersion = canonVersion();
  next._meta.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  // Persist
  savePetState(next);

  return next;
}

// Convenience: get current level info
export function getPetLevel(state) {
  const totalXP = sumXP(state?.xp);
  const level = getLevelForXP(totalXP);
  return {
    totalXP,
    levelTitle: level.title,
    levelPerk: level.perk,
    minForLevel: level.min,
  };
}

// Convenience: load + log in one go (for UI calls)
export function logSessionAndGetMessage(payload) {
  const state = loadPetState();
  const updated = logPetSession(state, payload);
  const message = getPetMessage(updated);
  const level = getPetLevel(updated);
  return {
    state: updated,
    message,
    level,
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// NET_APP_CORE_V1.js
// Depends on:
//  - NET_ULTRA_MASTER_SEED_V6.js (Stage 1)
//  - NET_PET_ENGINE_RUNTIME_V1.js (Stage 2)
// Purpose:
//  - Provide a headless SPA core: EventBus, AppState, Actions.
//  - No DOM, no UI framework. UI binds by subscribing to EventBus + calling actions.
//  - Phoenix-safe: no eval, no inline HTML, no direct user HTML injection.
// ============================================================================

import {
  getMeta,
  getGospel444,
  getCometEngine,
  getBusinessCanon,
  getPedagogy,
} from "./NET_ULTRA_MASTER_SEED_V6.js";

import {
  loadPetState,
  logPetSession,
  getPetMessage,
  getPetLevel,
} from "./NET_PET_ENGINE_RUNTIME_V1.js";

// ============================================================================
// 0. Utilities: safeClone, shallowAssign
// ============================================================================

function safeClone(obj) {
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj));
}

function shallowAssign(target, src) {
  if (!src || typeof src !== "object") return target;
  Object.keys(src).forEach((k) => {
    target[k] = src[k];
  });
  return target;
}

// ============================================================================
// 1. EventBus — Comet Pattern (Global Pub/Sub)
// ============================================================================

export const EventBus = {
  _subs: Object.create(null),

  on(eventName, handler) {
    if (typeof handler !== "function") return;
    const list = (this._subs[eventName] = this._subs[eventName] || []);
    list.push(handler);
    return () => {
      const idx = list.indexOf(handler);
      if (idx !== -1) list.splice(idx, 1);
    };
  },

  emit(eventName, payload) {
    const list = this._subs[eventName];
    if (!list || list.length === 0) return;
    // Clone payload so handlers can't mutate central state accidentally
    const cloned = payload === undefined ? undefined : safeClone(payload);
    list.forEach((fn) => {
      try {
        fn(cloned);
      } catch (err) {
        // Phoenix: never crash global loop
        console.error("[EventBus] Handler error for event:", eventName, err);
      }
    });
  },
};

// ============================================================================
// 2. Canon Snapshots (read-only views for UI)
// ============================================================================

const META_CANON = getMeta();
const GOSPEL_444 = getGospel444();
const COMET_CANON = getCometEngine();
const BUSINESS_CANON = getBusinessCanon();
const PEDAGOGY_CANON = getPedagogy();

export function getCanonSnapshot() {
  return {
    meta: safeClone(META_CANON),
    gospel: safeClone(GOSPEL_444),
    comet: safeClone(COMET_CANON),
    business: safeClone(BUSINESS_CANON),
    pedagogy: safeClone(PEDAGOGY_CANON),
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 3. AppState Shape — Headless SPA Core
// ============================================================================

const AppState = {
  // High-level view routing (UI decides how to render these)
  ui: {
    currentView: "dashboard", // "dashboard" | "session" | "history" | "about" | "settings"
    sessionMode: null,        // "quick" | "guided" | null
    isBusy: false,
    lastToast: null,          // { type: "success" | "error" | "info", message: string } | null
  },

  // NET PET state (synced with localStorage via Stage 2)
  pet: loadPetState(),

  // Derived UI-friendly stats
  stats: {
    level: null,      // { levelTitle, levelPerk, totalXP, minForLevel }
    mood: null,       // string
    lastMessage: null // { mood, text }
  },

  // Pedagogy-friendly copy, pre-resolved hints
  pedagogy: {
    routine: safeClone(PEDAGOGY_CANON.ROUTINE),
    archetypes: safeClone(PEDAGOGY_CANON.ARCHETYPES),
    philosophy: PEDAGOGY_CANON.PHILOSOPHY,
  },

  _meta: {
    initializedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    lastUpdatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  },
};

// Initialize derived stats
(function bootstrapDerived() {
  const level = getPetLevel(AppState.pet);
  const msg = getPetMessage(AppState.pet);
  AppState.stats.level = level;
  AppState.stats.mood = msg.mood;
  AppState.stats.lastMessage = msg;
})();

// ============================================================================
// 4. State Accessor
// ============================================================================

export function getStateSnapshot() {
  return safeClone(AppState);
}

// Internal helper: update timestamp + notify listeners
function commitState(partialUpdate) {
  if (partialUpdate && typeof partialUpdate === "object") {
    if (partialUpdate.ui) {
      shallowAssign(AppState.ui, partialUpdate.ui);
    }
    if (partialUpdate.pet) {
      AppState.pet = partialUpdate.pet;
    }
    if (partialUpdate.stats) {
      shallowAssign(AppState.stats, partialUpdate.stats);
    }
    if (partialUpdate.pedagogy) {
      shallowAssign(AppState.pedagogy, partialUpdate.pedagogy);
    }
  }
  AppState._meta.lastUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  const snapshot = getStateSnapshot();
  EventBus.emit("state:changed", snapshot);
}

// ============================================================================
// 5. Actions — the only way to change AppState
//    Phoenix-friendly: no direct state mutation from UI.
// ============================================================================

export const Actions = {
  // Initialize the core — can be called on app boot
  initApp() {
    const pet = loadPetState();
    const level = getPetLevel(pet);
    const msg = getPetMessage(pet);

    commitState({
      pet,
      stats: {
        level,
        mood: msg.mood,
        lastMessage: msg,
      },
    });

    EventBus.emit("app:init", getStateSnapshot());
  },

  // Change main view (dashboard, session, etc.)
  setView(viewName) {
    const allowed = ["dashboard", "session", "history", "about", "settings"];
    const view = allowed.includes(viewName) ? viewName : "dashboard";

    commitState({
      ui: {
        currentView: view,
      },
    });

    EventBus.emit("ui:view-changed", {
      currentView: view,
    });
  },

  // Set session mode: quick or guided
  setSessionMode(mode) {
    const allowed = ["quick", "guided", null];
    const safeMode = allowed.includes(mode) ? mode : null;

    commitState({
      ui: {
        sessionMode: safeMode,
      },
    });

    EventBus.emit("session:mode-changed", {
      sessionMode: safeMode,
    });
  },

  // Log new listening/speaking minutes and refresh PET stats
  logSession(payload) {
    const listen = Number(payload?.listenMinutes || 0);
    const speak = Number(payload?.speakMinutes || 0);

    const cleanPayload = {
      listenMinutes: Number.isFinite(listen) && listen >= 0 ? listen : 0,
      speakMinutes: Number.isFinite(speak) && speak >= 0 ? speak : 0,
    };

    commitState({ ui: { isBusy: true } });
    EventBus.emit("session:logging-started", cleanPayload);

    const updatedPet = logPetSession(AppState.pet, cleanPayload);
    const msg = getPetMessage(updatedPet);
    const level = getPetLevel(updatedPet);

    commitState({
      pet: updatedPet,
      stats: {
        level,
        mood: msg.mood,
        lastMessage: msg,
      },
      ui: {
        isBusy: false,
      },
    });

    EventBus.emit("session:logged", {
      payload: cleanPayload,
      pet: safeClone(updatedPet),
      message: msg,
      level,
    });
  },

  // Convenience: show a toast message (UI decides how to render)
  toast(type, message) {
    const allowed = ["success", "error", "info"];
    const safeType = allowed.includes(type) ? type : "info";
    const safeMsg =
      typeof message === "string" && message.trim().length > 0
        ? message.trim()
        : "";

    const toastObj =
      safeMsg === ""
        ? null
        : {
            type: safeType,
            message: safeMsg,
            at: new Date().toISOString(),
          };

    commitState({
      ui: {
        lastToast: toastObj,
      },
    });

    if (toastObj) {
      EventBus.emit("ui:toast", safeClone(toastObj));
    }
  },

  // Simple reset back to a fresh PET state
  resetPetState() {
    const fresh = loadPetState(); // Stage 2 already handles reset-on-invalid
    const level = getPetLevel(fresh);
    const msg = getPetMessage(fresh);

    commitState({
      pet: fresh,
      stats: {
        level,
        mood: msg.mood,
        lastMessage: msg,
      },
    });

    EventBus.emit("pet:reset", {
      pet: safeClone(fresh),
      level,
      message: msg,
    });
  },

export function buildDashboardViewModel() {
  const snapshot = getStateSnapshot();

    meta: snapshot._meta,
    ui: snapshot.ui,

      ...snapshot.pet,
      level: snapshot.stats.level,
      mood: snapshot.stats.mood,
      lastMessage: snapshot.stats.lastMessage,
    },
    marketing: {
      hero: marketing.comet.HERO_COPY,
      capabilities: marketing.comet.CAPABILITIES_COPY,
      pedagogy: marketing.pedagogy,
      pricing: marketing.business.PRICING,
      valueProp: marketing.business.VALUE_PROP,
    },
  };
}

export function buildSessionViewModel() {
  const snapshot = getStateSnapshot();
  return {
    ui: snapshot.ui,
    pet: {
      streak: snapshot.pet.streak,
      minutesListen: snapshot.pet.minutesListen,
      minutesSpeak: snapshot.pet.minutesSpeak,
      dailyGoalMet: snapshot.pet.dailyGoalMet,
      mood: snapshot.stats.mood,
      lastMessage: snapshot.stats.lastMessage,
      level: snapshot.stats.level,
    },
    pedagogy: snapshot.pedagogy,
  };
}

/* ==========================================================================
   NET Gospel 444 Theme — net-theme.css
   Source: NET_ULTRA_MASTER_SEED_V6 GOSPEL_444
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  /* Palette */
  --net-color-purple: #a855f7;
  --net-color-deep-purple: #7e22ce;
  --net-color-gold: #f59e0b;
  --net-color-gold-dim: #b45309;
  --net-color-dark: #0f0f1a;
  --net-color-navy-tint: #0d0a14;
  --net-color-white: #ffffff;
  --net-color-text-dim: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  --net-color-danger: #ef4444;
  --net-color-success: #10b981;

  /* Glassmorphism */
  --net-glass-bg: rgba(26, 26, 38, 0.7);
  --net-glass-border: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
  --net-glass-blur: 12px;
  --net-glass-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);

  /* Effects */
  --net-glow-strong: 0 0 30px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.6);
  --net-glow-gold: 0 0 40px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3);
  --net-text-glow: 0 0 20px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5);
  --net-gradient-bg: radial-gradient(
      circle at 15% 20%,
      rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.12) 0%,
      transparent 50%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 85% 80%,
      rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08) 0%,
      transparent 50%
    ),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.8) 0%, #0f0f1a 100%);

  /* Radii */
  --net-radius-lg: 1rem;
  --net-radius-xl: 1.5rem;

  /* Typography */
  --net-font-ui: "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --net-font-code: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
}

/* Global reset-ish */
*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html,
body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  min-height: 100%;
}

body {
  font-family: var(--net-font-ui);
  background: var(--net-gradient-bg);
  color: var(--net-color-white);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: stretch;
}

/* App root layout */
#app-root {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1080px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 1.5rem;
}

/* Layout: sticky nav + content */
.net-app-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

/* Nav */
.net-nav {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 10;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--net-glass-blur));
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.85),
    rgba(26, 26, 38, 0.85)
  );
  border-radius: var(--net-radius-lg);
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.6);
  box-shadow: var(--net-glass-shadow);
}

.net-nav-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.net-logo-orb {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 30% 30%,
    var(--net-color-purple),
    var(--net-color-deep-purple)
  );
  box-shadow: var(--net-glow-strong);
}

.net-brand-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.net-brand-title {
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.net-brand-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--net-color-text-dim);
}

.net-nav-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.net-tab-button {
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--net-color-text-dim);
  transition: background 0.18s ease, color 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease;
}

.net-tab-button--active {
  background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.95);
  color: var(--net-color-white);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.8), var(--net-glow-strong);
}

/* Glass cards */
.glass-card {
  background: var(--net-glass-bg);
  border-radius: var(--net-radius-xl);
  border: 1px solid var(--net-glass-border);
  box-shadow: var(--net-glass-shadow);
  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.glass-card-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.glass-card-title {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.glass-card-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--net-color-text-dim);
}

/* Hero */
.hero-title {
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-shadow: var(--net-text-glow);
}

.hero-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: var(--net-color-text-dim);
  max-width: 40rem;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

/* Buttons */
.glow-button {
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: none;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--net-color-purple),
    var(--net-color-gold)
  );
  color: var(--net-color-white);
  padding: 0.6rem 1.4rem;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: var(--net-glow-strong);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  transition: transform 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease;
}

.glow-button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.8), var(--net-glow-gold);
}

.glow-button--secondary {
  background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.9);
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.6);
  box-shadow: none;
}

/* Status row */
.net-status-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.net-badge {
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.7rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.6);
  background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.9);
  color: var(--net-color-text-dim);
}

/* PET metrics */
.net-metrics-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.net-metric-chip {
  border-radius: var(--net-radius-lg);
  border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5);
  background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.85);
  padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem;
}

.net-metric-label {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--net-color-text-dim);
}

.net-metric-value {
  margin-top: 0.15rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

/* Mood badge */
.net-mood-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.7rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.9);
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.6);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}

/* Session controls */
.net-session-form {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.net-input-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.3rem;
}

.net-input-label {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--net-color-text-dim);
}

.net-input {
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.6);
  background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.9);
  color: var(--net-color-white);
  padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.net-input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--net-color-purple);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--net-color-purple);
}

/* Capabilities list */
.net-capabilities-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.net-capability-item {
  border-radius: var(--net-radius-lg);
  background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.9);
  border: 1px dashed rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.6);
  padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem;
}

.net-capability-badge {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  color: var(--net-color-text-dim);
}

.net-capability-title {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.net-capability-desc {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  color: var(--net-color-text-dim);
}

/* Pricing */
.net-pricing-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.net-price-tag {
  border-radius: var(--net-radius-lg);
  padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem;
  background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.9);
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.7);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

/* Toast */
.net-toast {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 1rem;
  right: 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--net-radius-lg);
  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.7);

.net-toast--error {

}

/* Small text utilities */

}

.text-success {

}

.text-danger {
  color: var(--net-color-danger);
}

/* Simple responsive tweak */
@media (max-width: 640px) {

    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }
}
