// ============================================================================
// app-ui.js — NET Free App UI Shell (Vanilla SPA)
// Depends on: NET_APP_CORE_V1.js (Stage 3)
// ============================================================================

import {
  EventBus,
  Actions,
  buildDashboardViewModel,
  buildSessionViewModel,
  getStateSnapshot,
  getMarketingSnapshot,
} from "./NET_APP_CORE_V1.js";

// ============================================================================
// Small DOM helpers
// ============================================================================

function el(tag, className, text) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  if (className) node.className = className;
  if (typeof text === "string") node.textContent = text;
  return node;
}

function clear(node) {
  while (node.firstChild) node.removeChild(node.firstChild);
}

function setText(node, text) {
  node.textContent = text ?? "";
}

// ============================================================================
// Render Root
// ============================================================================

const root = document.getElementById("app-root");
const toastRoot = document.createElement("div");
document.body.appendChild(toastRoot);

function renderApp() {
  if (!root) return;

  clear(root);

  const state = getStateSnapshot();
  const shell = el("div", "net-app-shell");

  // Nav
  shell.appendChild(renderNav(state));

  // Content
  if (state.ui.currentView === "session") {
    shell.appendChild(renderSessionView());
  } else {
    shell.appendChild(renderDashboardView());
  }

  root.appendChild(shell);

  renderToast(state.ui.lastToast);
}

// ============================================================================
// Nav
// ============================================================================

function renderNav(state) {
  const nav = el("div", "net-nav");

  const left = el("div", "net-nav-left");
  const orb = el("div", "net-logo-orb");
  const brand = el("div", "net-brand-text");
  const title = el("div", "net-brand-title", "NET — PHOENIX FUSION");
  const subtitle = el(
    "div",
    "net-brand-subtitle",
    "Break the grammar prison. Build Tiger English."
  );
  brand.appendChild(title);
  brand.appendChild(subtitle);
  left.appendChild(orb);
  left.appendChild(brand);

  const right = el("div", "net-nav-tabs");

  const tabs = [
    { view: "dashboard", label: "Dashboard" },
    { view: "session", label: "Today’s Session" },
  ];

  tabs.forEach((t) => {
    const btn = el(
      "button",
      "net-tab-button" +
        (state.ui.currentView === t.view ? " net-tab-button--active" : ""),
      t.label
    );
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      Actions.setView(t.view);
    });
    right.appendChild(btn);
  });

  nav.appendChild(left);
  nav.appendChild(right);
  return nav;
}

// ============================================================================
// Dashboard View
// ============================================================================

function renderDashboardView() {
  const vm = buildDashboardViewModel();
  const marketing = getMarketingSnapshot();

  const container = el("div");
  container.style.display = "flex";
  container.style.flexDirection = "column";
  container.style.gap = "1rem";

  // Hero card
  const heroCard = el("section", "glass-card");
  const heroTitle = el("h1", "hero-title", vm.marketing.hero.TITLE);
  const heroSubtitle = el("p", "hero-subtitle", vm.marketing.hero.SUBTITLE);

  const ctaRow = el("div");
  ctaRow.style.display = "flex";
  ctaRow.style.flexWrap = "wrap";
  ctaRow.style.gap = "0.5rem";
  ctaRow.style.marginTop = "0.75rem";

  const startBtn = el(
    "button",
    "glow-button",
    vm.marketing.hero.CTA_PRIMARY
  );
  startBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    Actions.setView("session");
    Actions.toast("info", "Let’s run a 45·15 session today.");
  });

  const filmBtn = el(
    "button",
    "glow-button glow-button--secondary",
    vm.marketing.hero.CTA_SECONDARY
  );
  filmBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    Actions.toast(
      "info",
      "Imagine a short film here: The Mouse becoming the Tiger."
    );
  });

  ctaRow.appendChild(startBtn);
  ctaRow.appendChild(filmBtn);

  const statusRow = el("div", "net-status-row");
  const streakBadge = el(
    "div",
    "net-badge",
    `🔥 Streak: ${vm.pet.streak || 0} day(s)`
  );
  const levelBadge = el(
    "div",
    "net-badge",
    `⭐ Level: ${vm.pet.level?.levelTitle || "Struggling Mouse"}`
  );
  const moodBadge = el("div", "net-mood-badge");
  const moodDot = el("span", "", "●");
  const moodText = el("span", "", vm.pet.mood || "NEUTRAL");
  moodBadge.appendChild(moodDot);
  moodBadge.appendChild(moodText);

  statusRow.appendChild(streakBadge);
  statusRow.appendChild(levelBadge);
  statusRow.appendChild(moodBadge);

  heroCard.appendChild(heroTitle);
  heroCard.appendChild(heroSubtitle);
  heroCard.appendChild(ctaRow);
  heroCard.appendChild(statusRow);

  // Metrics card
  const metricsCard = el("section", "glass-card");
  const metricsHeader = el("div", "glass-card-header");
  metricsHeader.appendChild(el("div", "glass-card-title", "Your 45·15 Habit"));
  metricsHeader.appendChild(
    el(
      "div",
      "glass-card-subtitle",
      "We only care about 2 things: Listening and Speaking."
    )
  );
  metricsCard.appendChild(metricsHeader);

  const metricsGrid = el("div", "net-metrics-grid");

  const m1 = metricChip(
    "Listen Today",
    `${vm.pet.minutesListen ?? 0} min`,
    "Target: 45 min"
  );
  const m2 = metricChip(
    "Speak Today",
    `${vm.pet.minutesSpeak ?? 0} min`,
    "Target: 15 min"
  );
  const m3 = metricChip(
    "Daily Goal",
    vm.pet.dailyGoalMet ? "Completed" : "Not yet",
    vm.pet.dailyGoalMet ? "Tiger energy!" : "Hit 45·15 to clear."
  );
  const m4 = metricChip(
    "XP",
    `${vm.pet.level?.totalXP ?? 0}`,
    vm.pet.level?.levelPerk || "Keep stacking small wins."
  );

  metricsGrid.appendChild(m1);
  metricsGrid.appendChild(m2);
  metricsGrid.appendChild(m3);
  metricsGrid.appendChild(m4);

  const lastMsg = el(
    "p",
    "hero-subtitle",
    `"${vm.pet.lastMessage?.text || "Keep going. Small steps every day."}"`
  );
  lastMsg.style.marginTop = "0.75rem";

  metricsCard.appendChild(metricsGrid);
  metricsCard.appendChild(lastMsg);

  // Capabilities card
  const capabilitiesCard = el("section", "glass-card");
  const capHeader = el("div", "glass-card-header");
  capHeader.appendChild(
    el("div", "glass-card-title", "What NET PET actually does")
  );
  capHeader.appendChild(
    el(
      "div",
      "glass-card-subtitle",
      "This is not a grammar app. This is a lifestyle coach."
    )
  );
  capabilitiesCard.appendChild(capHeader);

  const capList = el("div", "net-capabilities-list");
  (marketing.comet.CAPABILITIES || []).forEach((cap) => {
    const item = el("div", "net-capability-item");
    const b = el("div", "net-capability-badge", cap.badge);
    const t = el("div", "net-capability-title", cap.title);
    const d = el("div", "net-capability-desc", cap.desc);
    item.appendChild(b);
    item.appendChild(t);
    item.appendChild(d);
    capList.appendChild(item);
  });
  capabilitiesCard.appendChild(capList);

  // Pricing card
  const pricingCard = el("section", "glass-card");
  const prHeader = el("div", "glass-card-header");
  prHeader.appendChild(el("div", "glass-card-title", "Coaching & Pricing"));
  prHeader.appendChild(
    el(
      "div",
      "glass-card-subtitle",
      marketing.business.VALUE_PROP || "We build English speakers."
    )
  );
  pricingCard.appendChild(prHeader);

  const priceRow = el("div", "net-pricing-row");
  const pricing = marketing.business.PRICING || {};

  priceRow.appendChild(
    el(
      "div",
      "net-price-tag",
      `👤 1:1 Coaching — ${pricing.PRIVATE_1V1 || "600,000 VND / hour"}`
    )
  );
  priceRow.appendChild(
    el(
      "div",
      "net-price-tag",
      `👥 Group Class — ${pricing.GROUP_CLASS || "300,000 VND / hour"}`
    )
  );
  priceRow.appendChild(
    el(
      "div",
      "net-price-tag",
      `📱 NET App — ${pricing.NET_APP_SUB || "Included with coaching"}`
    )
  );

  pricingCard.appendChild(priceRow);

  container.appendChild(heroCard);
  container.appendChild(metricsCard);
  container.appendChild(capabilitiesCard);
  container.appendChild(pricingCard);

  return container;
}

function metricChip(label, value, hint) {
  const chip = el("div", "net-metric-chip");
  chip.appendChild(el("div", "net-metric-label", label));
  chip.appendChild(el("div", "net-metric-value", value));
  if (hint) {
    const h = el("div", "net-metric-hint text-dim", hint);
    h.style.fontSize = "0.75rem";
    chip.appendChild(h);
  }
  return chip;
}

// ============================================================================
// Session View
// ============================================================================

function renderSessionView() {
  const vm = buildSessionViewModel();

  const container = el("div");
  container.style.display = "flex";
  container.style.flexDirection = "column";
  container.style.gap = "1rem";

  // Session card
  const sessionCard = el("section", "glass-card");
  const header = el("div", "glass-card-header");
  header.appendChild(el("div", "glass-card-title", "Today’s 45·15 Session"));
  header.appendChild(
    el(
      "div",
      "glass-card-subtitle",
      "We listen 45 minutes. We speak 15 minutes. No grammar prison."
    )
  );
  sessionCard.appendChild(header);

  const msg = el(
    "p",
    "hero-subtitle",
    `"${vm.pet.lastMessage?.text || "Let's get to work. Consistency beats intensity."}"`
  );
  sessionCard.appendChild(msg);

  // Form
  const form = el("div", "net-session-form");

  const listenGroup = el("div", "net-input-group");
  listenGroup.appendChild(el("label", "net-input-label", "Minutes Listening"));
  const listenInput = el("input", "net-input");
  listenInput.type = "number";
  listenInput.min = "0";
  listenInput.placeholder = "e.g. 20";
  listenGroup.appendChild(listenInput);

  const speakGroup = el("div", "net-input-group");
  speakGroup.appendChild(el("label", "net-input-label", "Minutes Speaking"));
  const speakInput = el("input", "net-input");
  speakInput.type = "number";
  speakInput.min = "0";
  speakInput.placeholder = "e.g. 10";
  speakGroup.appendChild(speakInput);

  const buttonGroup = el("div", "net-input-group");
  buttonGroup.appendChild(el("label", "net-input-label", "Quick Actions"));

  const quickRow = el("div");
  quickRow.style.display = "flex";
  quickRow.style.flexWrap = "wrap";
  quickRow.style.gap = "0.5rem";

  const btnQuick = el("button", "glow-button", "Log 45·15");
  btnQuick.addEventListener("click", () => {
    Actions.logSession({ listenMinutes: 45, speakMinutes: 15 });
    Actions.toast("success", "Nice. 45·15 locked for today.");
  });

  const btnSave = el(
    "button",
    "glow-button glow-button--secondary",
    "Save Custom"
  );
  btnSave.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const listen = Number(listenInput.value || 0);
    const speak = Number(speakInput.value || 0);
    Actions.logSession({ listenMinutes: listen, speakMinutes: speak });
    Actions.toast("success", "Session logged. Small wins today.");
  });

  quickRow.appendChild(btnQuick);
  quickRow.appendChild(btnSave);

  buttonGroup.appendChild(quickRow);

  form.appendChild(listenGroup);
  form.appendChild(speakGroup);
  form.appendChild(buttonGroup);

  sessionCard.appendChild(form);

  // Stats card
  const statsCard = el("section", "glass-card");
  const sh = el("div", "glass-card-header");
  sh.appendChild(el("div", "glass-card-title", "Your Current Status"));
  sh.appendChild(
    el(
      "div",
      "glass-card-subtitle",
      "Mouse -> Tiger. Mistakes are required. Silence is banned."
    )
  );
  statsCard.appendChild(sh);

  const metricsGrid = el("div", "net-metrics-grid");
  metricsGrid.appendChild(
    metricChip("Streak", `${vm.pet.streak || 0} day(s)`, "Protect your streak.")
  );
  metricsGrid.appendChild(
    metricChip(
      "Daily Goal",
      vm.pet.dailyGoalMet ? "Completed" : "Not yet",
      "Hit 45·15 to clear."
    )
  );
  metricsGrid.appendChild(
    metricChip(
      "Mood",
      vm.pet.mood || "NEUTRAL",
      "Tough = coach mode. Proud = Tiger mode."
    )
  );
  metricsGrid.appendChild(
    metricChip(
      "XP",
      `${vm.pet.level?.totalXP ?? 0}`,
      vm.pet.level?.levelPerk || "XP unlocks visual perks later."
    )
  );

  statsCard.appendChild(metricsGrid);

  container.appendChild(sessionCard);
  container.appendChild(statsCard);

  return container;
}

// ============================================================================
// Toast Rendering
// ============================================================================

function renderToast(toastObj) {
  clear(toastRoot);
  if (!toastObj) return;

  const box = el("div", "net-toast");
  if (toastObj.type === "success") {
    box.classList.add("net-toast--success");
  } else if (toastObj.type === "error") {
    box.classList.add("net-toast--error");
  }

  setText(box, toastObj.message || "");

  toastRoot.appendChild(box);

  // auto-hide after 3s
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (toastRoot.contains(box)) {
      toastRoot.removeChild(box);
    }
  }, 3000);
}

// ============================================================================
// Event wiring + bootstrap
// ============================================================================

EventBus.on("state:changed", () => {
  renderApp();
});

EventBus.on("app:init", () => {
  renderApp();
});

// Initial boot
Actions.initApp();
renderApp();

#### 🗣️ **2. LANGUAGE FOCUS (Corrections & Structure)**

**A. Clarifying Vocabulary (The "Flying Boat" Incident)**
* ❌ *Student said:* "I rode a flying boat."
* ✅ *Correction:* "I rode a **roller coaster**."
* *Vocabulary expansion:* Thrilling, terrifying, adrenaline, loop-the-loop.

**B. Prepositions of Place (The "Jesus" Incident)**
* ❌ *Student said:* "I walked **on** the water/sea." (This implies a miracle/magic).
* ✅ *Correction:* "I walked **beside** the sea," "I walked **along** the beach," or "I walked **on** the sand."

**C. Greetings & Professionalism**
* ❌ *Student said:* "Nice to meet you" (To Michael/Classmates they know).
* ✅ *Correction:* "Nice to **see** you again."
* *Rule:* "Meet" is for the first time only. "See" is for every time after.

**D. Employment History Structure**
* *Context:* Explaining your position when you move departments but stay in the same firm.
* *Structure:* "I am new to [Department Name], but I am not new to the company."
* *Refined Sentence:* "I have been an intern here for one year."

**E. Future Plans (Simple Future Tense)**
* *Question:* "What are you doing in the next couple of days?"
* *Key Verbs:* Relax, Chill, Work, Watch.
* *Structure:* "I **will** relax," "I **am going to** watch movies," or the casual native phrase: "Nothing special, just working."

    :root {

      --radius-lg: 1.3rem;
      --radius-xl: 1.6rem;
      --shadow: 0 22px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
      --blur: 14px;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html, body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      min-height: 100%;
    }

    body {
      font-family: "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.14) 0%, transparent 55%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 85% 80%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.10) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.9) 0%, #050509 100%);
      color: var(--white);
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* Organic blobs ---------------------------------------------------- */
    .blob {
      position: fixed;
      border-radius: 999px;
      filter: blur(60px);
      opacity: 0.65;
      z-index: -2;
      pointer-events: none;
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
    }

    .blob--purple {
      width: 420px;
      height: 420px;
      background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.65);
      top: -120px;
      left: -80px;
      animation: blobFloat1 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    .blob--gold {
      width: 380px;
      height: 380px;
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.5);
      bottom: -140px;
      right: -60px;
      animation: blobFloat2 26s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    .blob--deep {
      width: 380px;
      height: 380px;
      background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.05); /* almost invisible, slight depth */
      top: 40%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      animation: blobFloat3 32s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    @keyframes blobFloat1 {
      0% { transform: translate3d(0,0,0) scale(1); }
      100% { transform: translate3d(40px,80px,0) scale(1.1); }
    }
    @keyframes blobFloat2 {
      0% { transform: translate3d(0,0,0) scale(1); }
      100% { transform: translate3d(-60px,-40px,0) scale(1.08); }
    }
    @keyframes blobFloat3 {
      0% { transform: translate3d(-50%,0,0) scale(1); }
      100% { transform: translate3d(-48%,-40px,0) scale(1.05); }
    }

    /* Layout ----------------------------------------------------------- */
    .page-shell {
      max-width: 960px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 1.5rem 1.25rem 2.5rem;
      position: relative;
    }

    /* Sticky header ---------------------------------------------------- */
    .header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0.75rem;
      z-index: 5;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.9), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.92));
      backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur));
      border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.8);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
      padding: 0.65rem 1.1rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 0.8rem;

    .header-left {

      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.8rem;
    }

    .orb-logo {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, var(--purple), var(--purple-deep));
      box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.9);
    }

    .header-text-main {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .header-text-sub {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
    }

    .lang-toggle {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.2rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.2rem;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.9);
    }

    .lang-btn {
      border: none;
      outline: none;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.25rem 0.7rem;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease;
    }

    .lang-btn--active {
      background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.96);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    /* Cards ------------------------------------------------------------ */
    .card {
      background: var(--glass);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      padding: 1.6rem 1.5rem 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.16), transparent 55%);
      opacity: 0.8;
      z-index: -1;
    }

    .card-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 0.7rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
    }

    .card-title {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--gold);
      text-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.65);
    }

    .card-subtitle {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      text-align: right;
    }

    .divider {
      height: 1px;
      width: 100%;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.5), transparent);
      margin: 0.55rem 0 0.9rem;
    }

    .meta-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      margin: 0.4rem 0 0.2rem;
    }

    .chip {
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.7);
      color: var(--text-dim);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.35rem;
    }

    .chip-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--purple);
    }

    h3 {
      margin: 0.7rem 0 0.35rem;
      font-size: 0.98rem;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    h4 {
      margin: 0.5rem 0 0.2rem;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    p {
      margin: 0.2rem 0 0.5rem;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    ul {
      margin: 0.2rem 0 0.8rem 1.2rem;
      padding: 0;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
    }

    li {
      margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    strong {
      color: var(--purple);
    }

    .sub-note {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
    }

    /* Bilingual sections ----------------------------------------------- */
    .lang-block {
      margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
    }

    .lang-label {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.09em;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    }

    .lang {
      transition: opacity 0.16s ease;
    }

    .lang-en { display: block; }
    .lang-vi { display: none; }

    body.lang-vi .lang-en { display: none; }
    body.lang-vi .lang-vi { display: block; }

    /* Highlight blocks ------------------------------------------------- */
    blockquote {
      margin: 0.6rem 0;
      padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem;
      border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8);
      border-radius: 0.7rem;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    blockquote span.bad {
      color: var(--danger);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    blockquote span.good {
      color: var(--success);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* Homework checklist ---------------------------------------------- */
    .task-list {
      list-style: none;
      margin-left: 0;
    }

    .task {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 0.55rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .task input[type="checkbox"] {
      margin-top: 0.15rem;
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.85);
      background: rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.9);
      appearance: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
    }

    .task input[type="checkbox"]:checked {
      border-color: var(--success);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, var(--purple), var(--gold));
    }

    .task input[type="checkbox"]:checked::after {
      content: "✓";
      position: absolute;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-48%, -54%);
    }

    .task-label {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
    }

    /* Footer ----------------------------------------------------------- */
    .footer-note {
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      margin-top: 0.4rem;
    }

    /* Hover / micro-interactions ------------------------------------- */
    .card:hover {
      box-shadow: 0 24px 55px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      transition: box-shadow 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease;
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .header {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
      }
      .card {
        padding: 1.3rem 1.1rem 1.2rem;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

          if (lang === 'vi') {
            body.classList.add('lang-vi');
          } else {
            body.classList.remove('lang-vi');

<script>
    let recorders = {}; let audioChunks = { 1: [], 2: [] }; let audioBlobs = {};
    async function toggleRecord(id) {
        const btn = document.getElementById(\rec\${id}\);
        const status = document.getElementById(\status\${id}\);
        if (!recorders[id] || recorders[id].state === "inactive") {
            try {
                const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
                recorders[id] = new MediaRecorder(stream);
                audioChunks[id] = [];
                recorders[id].ondataavailable = e => audioChunks[id].push(e.data);
                recorders[id].onstop = () => {
                    const blob = new Blob(audioChunks[id], { type: 'audio/webm' });
                    audioBlobs[id] = blob;
                    status.innerText = "✅ Audio Saved!";
                    status.style.color = "#10b981";
                    btn.classList.remove("recording");
                    btn.style.background = "#10b981";
                    btn.innerText = "↺";
                };
                recorders[id].start();
                btn.classList.add("recording");
                btn.innerText = "⏹";
                status.innerText = "Recording... Tap to Stop";
                status.style.color = "#ef4444";
            } catch (err) { alert("Microphone access needed to record audio! Please enable permissions in your browser settings."); }
        } else { recorders[id].stop(); }
    }
    function generatePackage() {
        const q1 = document.getElementById('q1').value;
        const q2 = document.getElementById('q2').value;
        if(!q1 || !q2) { alert("Please answer the text questions first!"); return; }
        const data = { q1: q1, q2: q2, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
        const jsonBlob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
        const jsonUrl = URL.createObjectURL(jsonBlob);
        downloadFile(jsonUrl, "NET_Answers.json");
        let audioCount = 0;
        if(audioBlobs[1]) { const audioUrl1 = URL.createObjectURL(audioBlobs[1]); setTimeout(() => downloadFile(audioUrl1, "Audio_Intro.webm"), 500); audioCount++; }
        if(audioBlobs[2]) { const audioUrl2 = URL.createObjectURL(audioBlobs[2]); setTimeout(() => downloadFile(audioUrl2, "Audio_Weekend.webm"), 1500); audioCount++; }
        if(audioCount === 0) { alert("Warning: No audio recorded. Please record audio for a complete assessment."); } else { alert("Files downloaded! Please locate them in your phone/computer downloads folder and send them to Michael on Zalo."); }
    }
    function downloadFile(url, name) {
        const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = name; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
    }
</script>

────────────────────────────────
4. ASSET SHAPE REQUIREMENTS
────────────────────────────────

Each `asset` object MUST contain:

- `id` — machine-friendly string (`snake_case`), globally unique.
- `human_title` — short, clear, natural language title.
- `short_description` — 1–2 sentences max, plain English, easy to understand.
- `category_id` — matches its parent category (for redundancy).
- `audience` — array of tags (e.g. `["b2c", "corporate_hr", "beginner", "teacher"]`).
- `format` — e.g. `"html_template"`, `"css_snippet"`, `"js_utility_outline"`, `"text_script_outline"`, `"email_copy_block"`.
- `tags` — array of 3–10 keywords.
- `content_shape` — STRUCTURE ONLY:
  - For text: bullet list of sections or bullet points.
  - For UI: list of sections/slots.
  - For lessons: list of subcomponents (10 vocab, 5 idioms, 5 slang, 3 games).
- `example_snippet` — optional, 1–3 lines of example text or a tiny pseudo-HTML/JS/CSS fragment.

Do NOT paste huge HTML/CSS/JS inside `example_snippet`.  
Keep it tiny and illustrative.

────────────────────────────────
5. TONE, STYLE, AND ALIGNMENT
────────────────────────────────

- Use NET tone: direct, warm, slightly playful, but professional.
- Preserve canon ideas ONLY as references (e.g. “Grammar Prison”, “Tiger vs Mouse”, “Elephant Story”) without redefining the canon itself.
- Remember: this is a LIBRARY INDEX and DESIGN SPEC, not the code.

6. FINAL INSTRUCTION

// Requires: state, sessionNotesEl, sessionGoalEl, sessionLengthEl, sessionTopicEl, sessionStatusLine, saveState(), renderAll()

function sanitizeInput(input) {
  const temp = document.createElement('div');
  temp.textContent = input;
  return temp.innerHTML;
}

function saveState() {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('netAppState', JSON.stringify(state));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("PHOENIX AUDIT: Could not save state.", e);
  }
}

function loadState() {
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('netAppState');
    if (saved) Object.assign(state, JSON.parse(saved));
    renderAll();
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("PHOENIX AUDIT: Corrupted state, using default.");
  }
}

function lockSession() {
  if (!state.selectedBuddyId) {
    sessionStatusLine.textContent =
      "Choose a buddy first. This session is for two people, not a textbook.";
    return;
  }

  const buddy = state.buddies.find(b => b.id === state.selectedBuddyId);
  const sanitizedPlan = sanitizeInput(sessionNotesEl.value);

  if (!sanitizedPlan) {
    sessionStatusLine.textContent =
      "Write or auto-fill a simple plan. Keep it small and realistic.";
    return;
  }

  state.lockedSession = {
    buddyId: buddy.id,
    goal: sessionGoalEl.value,
    length: Number(sessionLengthEl.value),
    topic: sessionTopicEl.value,
    notes: sanitizedPlan
  };

  state.metrics.totalSessions += 1;
  saveState();

  sessionStatusLine.textContent =
    "Session locked with " + buddy.name +
    " for " + state.lockedSession.length +
    " minutes. The only job now: show up.";

      CORE_LOGIC_SNIPPET: String.raw`// NET PET AI — core logic sample (simplified)
const PET_BASE = {
  streak: 0,
  listeningMin: 0,
  speakingMin: 0,
  lastLogin: new Date().toDateString(),
  mood: "NEUTRAL",
  dailyGoalMet: false
};

function petToday() {
  return new Date().toDateString();
}

function petLoadState(storage = window.localStorage) {
  try {
    const raw = storage.getItem("netPetState");
    return raw ? { ...PET_BASE, ...JSON.parse(raw) } : { ...PET_BASE };
  } catch {
    return { ...PET_BASE };
  }
}

function petSaveState(state, storage = window.localStorage) {
  try {
    storage.setItem("netPetState", JSON.stringify(state));
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
}

function petCheckRollover(state) {
  if (state.lastLogin !== petToday()) {
    state.lastLogin = petToday();
    if (state.dailyGoalMet) {
      state.streak += 1;
      state.mood = "HAPPY";
    } else {
      state.streak = 0;
      state.mood = "TOUGH";
    }
    state.listeningMin = 0;
    state.speakingMin = 0;
    state.dailyGoalMet = false;
  }
}

function petEvaluate(state) {
  if (state.listeningMin >= 45 && state.speakingMin >= 15) {
    state.dailyGoalMet = true;
    state.mood = "PROUD";
    return "CELEBRATION";
  } else if (state.listeningMin > 0 && state.speakingMin === 0) {
    state.mood = "TOUGH";
    return "TOUGH_LOVE";
  } else if (state.listeningMin === 0 && state.speakingMin === 0) {
    state.mood = "NEUTRAL";
    return "GREETING";
  } else {
    state.mood = "HAPPY";
    return "NUDGE";
  }
}`,

JS helper (for reuse, components/glassPanel.js):

export function createGlassPanel({ title, body }) {
  const wrapper = document.createElement('section');
  wrapper.className = 'glass-panel';

  if (title) {
    const h = document.createElement('h2');
    h.className = 'glass-panel__title';
    h.textContent = title;
    wrapper.appendChild(h);
  }

  if (body) {
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'glass-panel__body';
    if (typeof body === 'string') {
      div.textContent = body;
    } else if (body instanceof Node) {
      div.appendChild(body);
    }
    wrapper.appendChild(div);
  }

  return wrapper;
}
11. PHOENIX MINI-CHECKLISTS (MACRO PATTERNS)
11.1 FRONTEND REQUEST CHECK

Any new fetch() must pass this Phoenix micro-audit:

Uses relative / env-based URL, not hard-coded external domain.

Wraps in try/catch.

Handles non-2xx with explicit branch, not silent fail.

Pattern (in apiClient.js):

async function safeFetchJSON(path, options = {}) {
  const url = `/api${path}`;

  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      ...options,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...(options.headers || {})
      },
      credentials: 'include' // Phoenix: use cookies for auth, not localStorage
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const text = await res.text().catch(() => '');
      throw new Error(`API_ERROR:${res.status}:${text.slice(0, 120)}`);
    }

    return await res.json();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[API CLIENT] Request failed (redacted).');
    throw err;
  }
}

app.post('/api/mood', authGuard, async (req, res, next) => {

    const { mood, note } = sanitizeMoodPayload(req.body);

    const result = await db.query(
      `INSERT INTO mood_entries (user_id, mood, note)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
       RETURNING id, created_at`,
      [req.user.id, mood, note]
    );

    // trigger async checks (e.g., CRISIS_RISK) via job queue
    queueCrisisCheck(req.user.id).catch(err =>
      console.error('CRISIS_CHECK_FAILED', err.message)
    );

    return res.status(201).json({ id: result.rows[0].id, createdAt: result.rows[0].created_at });
  } catch (err) {
    return next(err);
  }
});

sanitizeMoodPayload() strips HTML, clamps size, validates enum.

  <style>
    :root {

    }

    html,

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      background-color: var(--net-dark);
      color: var(--net-text-main);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* Background blobs (Market Forces) */

    .background-blobs {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .blob {
      position: absolute;
      width: 520px;
      height: 520px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      filter: blur(80px);
      opacity: 0.48;
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      transform-origin: center;
      animation: blobFloat 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    .blob-purple {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, var(--net-purple), transparent 60%);
      top: -120px;
      left: -80px;
    }

    .blob-gold {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 70% 70%, var(--net-gold), transparent 60%);
      bottom: -160px;
      right: -120px;
      animation-delay: 4s;
    }

    @keyframes blobFloat {
      0% {
        transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1);
      }
      50% {
        transform: translate3d(40px, -30px, 0) scale(1.05);
      }
      100% {
        transform: translate3d(-40px, 30px, 0) scale(1.08);
      }
    }
