        rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4)
      );
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    }

    .badge-dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--net-purple);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.9);
    }

    .badge-dot.gold {
      background: var(--net-gold);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.9);
    }

    .badge-dot.green {
      background: #22c55e;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.9);
    }

    /* Main Holographic Interface */

    .hud-main {
      position: relative;
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      background: radial-gradient(
          circle at top left,
          rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.12),
          transparent 55%
        ),
        radial-gradient(
          circle at bottom right,
          rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08),
          transparent 55%
        ),
        rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.88);
      border-radius: var(--net-radius-xl);
      border: var(--hud-border);
      box-shadow: var(--hud-glow), var(--net-shadow-soft);
      padding: 18px 16px 14px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    @media (min-width: 960px) {
      .hud-main {
        padding: 22px 22px 18px;
      }
    }

    .hud-status-bar {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
    }

    .hud-status-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hud-status-label {
      opacity: 0.7;
    }

    .hud-status-value {
      color: var(--net-purple);
    }

    .hud-status-value.gold {
      color: var(--net-gold);
    }

    .hud-status-value.danger {
      color: #f97373;
    }

    /* Room container */

    .rooms-container {
      position: relative;
      flex: 1;
      border-radius: calc(var(--net-radius-lg) + 4px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25);
      background: linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95),
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85)
        );
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .room {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      padding: 16px 14px 14px;
      display: none;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translate3d(0, 4px, 0);
      transition:
        opacity 220ms ease-out,
        transform 220ms ease-out;
    }

    @media (min-width: 960px) {
      .room {
        padding: 20px 18px 16px;
      }
    }

    .room.active {
      display: block;
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    }

    .room-header {
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .room-label {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      color: var(--net-purple);
      opacity: 0.9;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .room-title {
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--net-text-main);
    }

    .room-subtitle {
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
      max-width: 520px;
    }

    /* Controls toolbar */

    .room-toolbar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
    }

    .room-toolbar-left {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .hud-pill {
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35);
      padding: 4px 10px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: radial-gradient(
        circle at 0% 0%,
        rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.22),
        rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95)
      );
    }

    .hud-pill-label {
      opacity: 0.7;
    }

    .hud-pill-value {
      color: var(--net-text-main);
    }

    .hud-progress-dots {
      display: inline-flex;
      gap: 4px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hud-dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.5);
      background: transparent;
      opacity: 0.6;
      transition:
        background 160ms ease-out,
        opacity 160ms ease-out,
        transform 160ms ease-out;
    }

    .hud-dot.active {
      background: var(--net-purple);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.9);
      opacity: 1;
      transform: scale(1.1);
    }

    /* BUTTONS */

    .btn-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .btn {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.5);
      padding: 9px 16px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      background: radial-gradient(
          circle at 0% 0%,
          rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25),
          transparent 55%
        ),
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9),
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7)
        );
      color: var(--net-text-main);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      transition:
        background 160ms ease-out,
        transform 120ms ease-out,
        box-shadow 160ms ease-out,
        border-color 160ms ease-out,
        opacity 160ms ease-out;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.9);
      box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5);
    }

    .btn-gold {
      border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.9);
      box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
      background: radial-gradient(
          circle at 0% 0%,
          rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25),
          transparent 55%
        ),
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95),
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8)
        );
    }

    .btn-ghost {
      background: linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85),
        rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7)
      );
      border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4);
      box-shadow: none;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      padding: 7px 12px;
    }

    .btn:disabled {
      opacity: 0.5;
      cursor: default;
      box-shadow: none;
    }

    .btn:not(:disabled):hover {
      transform: translate3d(0, -1px, 0);
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.7);
    }

    .btn-gold:not(:disabled):hover {
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.7);
    }

    .btn-icon {
      width: 9px;
      height: 9px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--net-purple);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.9);
    }

    .btn-icon-gold {
      background: var(--net-gold);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.9);
    }

    /* ROOM 0 – IDENTITY SCAN */

    .scan-shell {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr);
      gap: 14px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .scan-shell {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      }
    }

    .scan-panel {
      border-radius: var(--net-radius-lg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.26);
      background: radial-gradient(
          circle at 0% 0%,
          rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.16),
          transparent 55%
        ),
        rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
      padding: 12px 12px 10px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .scan-label {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .scan-label span:last-child {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      opacity: 0.8;
    }

    .scan-display {
      border-radius: calc(var(--net-radius-lg) - 4px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35);
      background: radial-gradient(
          circle at 50% 0%,
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95),
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.98)
        );
      padding: 14px 12px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .scan-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr);
      gap: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .scan-cell {
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: radial-gradient(
        circle,
        rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.55),
        rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9)
      );
      opacity: 0.3;
      animation: scanPulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .scan-cell:nth-child(odd) {
      animation-delay: 0.14s;
    }

    .scan-cell:nth-child(3n) {
      animation-delay: 0.3s;
    }

    .scan-cell:nth-child(5n) {
      animation-delay: 0.5s;
    }

    @keyframes scanPulse {
      0%,
      100% {
        opacity: 0.22;
        transform: scaleX(1);
      }
      40% {
        opacity: 0.9;
        transform: scaleX(1.4);
        background: radial-gradient(
          circle,
          rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.95),
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95)
        );
      }
    }

    .scan-status-line {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
    }

    .scan-status-main {
      color: var(--net-purple);
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .scan-hint {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 10px;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
    }

    .scan-identity-card {
      border-radius: calc(var(--net-radius-lg) - 2px);
      border: 1px dashed rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.45);
      padding: 10px 11px;
      background: radial-gradient(
        circle at 50% 0%,
        rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25),
        rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96)
      );
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      display: grid;
      row-gap: 5px;
    }

    .scan-identity-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .scan-identity-label {
      opacity: 0.65;
    }

    .scan-identity-value {
      color: var(--net-text-main);
    }

    /* ROOM 1 – INTEL BRIEF */

    .intel-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .intel-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .intel-grid {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      }
    }

    .intel-card {
      border-radius: var(--net-radius-lg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.45);
      padding: 12px 11px 10px;
      background: radial-gradient(
          circle at 0% 0%,
          rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2),
          transparent 55%
        ),
        rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.98);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95);
      position: relative;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition:
        border-color 160ms ease-out,
        box-shadow 160ms ease-out,
        transform 140ms ease-out,
        background 180ms ease-out;
    }

    .intel-card:hover {
      transform: translate3d(0, -1px, 0);
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.55);
    }

    .intel-card.downloaded {
      border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.95);
      box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.6);
      background: radial-gradient(
          circle at 0% 0%,
          rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.26),
          transparent 58%
        ),
        rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.98);
    }

    .intel-card-header {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .intel-card-tag {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4);
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
    }

    .intel-phrase {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--net-text-main);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .intel-meta {
      margin-top: 8px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
    }

    .intel-meta strong {
      color: var(--net-purple);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .intel-footer-note {
      margin-top: 12px;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
      max-width: 520px;
    }

    /* ROOM 2 – GAUNTLET */

    .gauntlet-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    @media (max-width: 840px) {
      .gauntlet-layout {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      }
    }

    .scenario-panel {
      border-radius: var(--net-radius-lg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
      background: radial-gradient(
          circle at 0% 0%,
          rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.16),
          transparent 55%
        ),
        rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.97);
      padding: 12px 12px 10px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      min-height: 180px;
    }

    .scenario-title {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .scenario-text {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--net-text-main);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .scenario-hint {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
    }

    .timer-shell {
      margin-top: 12px;
    }

    .timer-label-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.13em;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .timer-bar-track {
      width: 100%;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.55);
      background: linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.5),
        rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95)
      );
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    .timer-bar-fill {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      transform-origin: left center;
      transform: scaleX(0);
      background: linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        var(--net-purple),
        var(--net-gold)
      );
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.8);
      transition: transform 0.12s linear;
    }

    /* Waveform visualizer */

    .wave-panel {
      border-radius: var(--net-radius-lg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
      background: radial-gradient(
          circle at 100% 100%,
          rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.18),
          transparent 55%
        ),
        rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96);
      padding: 12px 12px 10px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .wave-label-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
    }

    .wave-label-row span:last-child {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
    }

    .wave-viewport {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: calc(var(--net-radius-lg) - 4px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.5);
      background: radial-gradient(
          circle at 50% 0,
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9),
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.98)
        );
      padding: 12px 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
      min-height: 120px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .wave-bars {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 420px;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .wave-bar {
      width: 4px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: linear-gradient(
        to top,
        rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9),
        var(--net-purple)
      );
      opacity: 0.4;
      transform-origin: bottom center;
      animation: waveIdle 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .wave-bar.active {
      opacity: 0.9;
      animation: waveTalking 0.7s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .wave-bar:nth-child(3n) {
      animation-delay: 0.18s;
    }

    .wave-bar:nth-child(4n) {
      animation-delay: 0.3s;
    }

    .wave-bar:nth-child(5n) {
      animation-delay: 0.42s;
    }

    @keyframes waveIdle {
      0%,
      100% {
        transform: scaleY(0.4);
      }
      50% {
        transform: scaleY(0.8);
      }
    }

    @keyframes waveTalking {
      0%,
      100% {
        transform: scaleY(0.6);
      }
      50% {
        transform: scaleY(1.4);
      }
    }

    .wave-gap-indicator {
      position: absolute;
      inset-inline: 15%;
      top: 10px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px dashed rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.7);
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
      opacity: 0.85;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .wave-gap-label {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      inset-inline: 15%;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      color: var(--net-gold);
      transform: translateY(-120%);
    }

    .gauntlet-footnote {
      margin-top: 8px;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
    }

    .gauntlet-footnote strong {
      color: var(--net-gold);
    }

    /* ROOM 3 – CONTRACT SIGNED */

    .deal-shell {
      height: 100%;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .deal-badge {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--net-gold);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .deal-badge-dot {
      width: 9px;
      height: 9px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--net-gold);
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.9);
    }

    .deal-stamp {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 2.1rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.36em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 16px 18px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.9);
      display: inline-block;
      color: var(--net-gold);
      box-shadow:
        0 0 30px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.7),
        0 0 80px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
      text-shadow:
        0 0 20px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.9),
        0 0 40px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.7);
      transform: rotate(-4deg);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .deal-stamp::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(
        circle at 0 0,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18),
        transparent 55%
      );
      mix-blend-mode: screen;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .deal-message {
      margin-top: 10px;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--net-text-main);
    }

    .deal-message span {
      color: var(--net-gold);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .deal-subnote {
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
    }

    .deal-actions {
      margin-top: 14px;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    /* FOOTER */

    .hud-footer {
      margin-top: 10px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    }

    .hud-footer span:last-child {
      color: var(--net-purple);
    }

    /* Global flash overlay for feedback */

    .flash-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: scale(1.02);
      transition:
        opacity 160ms ease-out,
        transform 160ms ease-out;
      z-index: 5;
    }

    .flash-overlay.show {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: scale(1);
    }

    .flash-panel {
      min-width: 260px;
      max-width: 360px;
      border-radius: var(--net-radius-lg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.6);
      padding: 14px 13px;
      background: radial-gradient(
          circle at 0 0,
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8),
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96)
        );
      box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .flash-text-main {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .flash-text-sub {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: var(--net-text-soft);
    }

    .flash-early .flash-panel {
      border-color: #ef4444;
      box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.55);
      background: radial-gradient(
          circle at 0 0,
          rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3),
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96)
        );
    }

    /* Blue used ONLY as semantic info alert for "too late" state (allowed exception). */
    .flash-late .flash-panel {
      border-color: #3b82f6;
      box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.55);
      background: radial-gradient(
          circle at 0 0,
          rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3),
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96)
        );
    }

    .flash-perfect .flash-panel {
      border-color: var(--net-gold);
      box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.75);
      background: radial-gradient(
          circle at 0 0,
          rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3),
          rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.96)
        );
    }

    /* Confetti layer */

    .confetti-layer {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 6;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .confetti-piece {
      position: absolute;
      width: 6px;
      height: 12px;
      border-radius: 1px;
      opacity: 0.9;
      animation: confettiFall 1.4s ease-out forwards;
    }

    @keyframes confettiFall {
      0% {
        transform: translate3d(0, -30px, 0) rotateZ(0deg);
        opacity: 1;
      }
      100% {
        transform: translate3d(var(--dx, 0px), 110vh, 0) rotateZ(360deg);
        opacity: 0;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <div class="background-blobs">
    <div class="blob blob-purple"></div>
    <div class="blob blob-gold"></div>
  </div>

  <main class="hud-shell">
    <header class="hud-header">
      <div class="hud-header-left">
        <div class="hud-title">L_09 // THE BOARDROOM BATTLEFIELD</div>
        <div class="hud-subtitle">CLASS C — TACTICAL CORPORATE HUD — TTS / BLUETECH</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hud-badges">
        <div class="badge">
          <span class="badge-dot"></span>
          <span>STATUS: LIVE SIM</span>
        </div>
        <div class="badge">
          <span class="badge-dot gold"></span>
          <span>MISSION: INTERRUPTING POLITELY</span>
        </div>
        <div class="badge">
          <span class="badge-dot green"></span>
          <span>VOICE WEAPON: ARMED</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>

    <section class="hud-main">
      <div class="hud-status-bar">
        <div class="hud-status-group">
          <span class="hud-status-label">AGENT:</span>
          <span class="hud-status-value">TIGER / BOARDROOM OPS</span>
        </div>
        <div class="hud-status-group">
          <span class="hud-status-label">CHANNEL:</span>
          <span class="hud-status-value">ENGLISH // REAL-TIME</span>
        </div>
        <div class="hud-status-group">
          <span class="hud-status-label">STAGE:</span>
          <span id="hud-stage" class="hud-status-value gold">IDENTITY SCAN</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="rooms-container">
        <!-- ROOM 0: IDENTITY SCAN -->
        <section id="room-0" class="room active">
          <div class="room-header">
            <div class="room-label">ROOM 0 // IDENTITY SCAN</div>
            <div class="room-title">IDENTITY VERIFIED. WELCOME, AGENT.</div>
            <p class="room-subtitle">
              High-stakes boardroom channel online. This is your tactical HUD.
              The only weapon you carry into this room is your <strong>voice</strong>.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="room-toolbar">
            <div class="room-toolbar-left">
              <div class="hud-pill">
                <span class="hud-pill-label">MODE</span>
                <span class="hud-pill-value">WARM-UP / SYSTEM CHECK</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span>ROOM PROGRESSION</span>
              <span class="hud-progress-dots">
                <span class="hud-dot active" data-step-dot="0"></span>
                <span class="hud-dot" data-step-dot="1"></span>
                <span class="hud-dot" data-step-dot="2"></span>
                <span class="hud-dot" data-step-dot="3"></span>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="scan-shell">
            <div class="scan-panel">
              <div class="scan-label">
                <span>IDENTITY CHANNEL</span>
                <span>SCANNING VOCAL PROFILE…</span>
              </div>
              <div class="scan-display">
                <div class="scan-grid">
                  <!-- 32 scan cells -->
                  <div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div>
                  <div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div>
                  <div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div>
                  <div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div>
                  <div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div>
                  <div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div>
                  <div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div>
                  <div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div><div class="scan-cell"></div>
                </div>
                <div class="scan-status-line">
                  <span class="scan-status-main">STATUS: NEGOTIATOR READY</span>
                  <span>VOLUME: 80% • CONFIDENCE: RISING</span>
                </div>
                <p class="scan-hint">
                  Breathe in. Shoulders down. Eyes up. Boardroom battlefield loading…
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="scan-panel">
              <div class="scan-label">
                <span>AGENT PROFILE</span>
                <span>CLASS C // CORPORATE OPS</span>
              </div>
              <div class="scan-identity-card">
                <div class="scan-identity-row">
                  <span class="scan-identity-label">CALLSIGN</span>
                  <span class="scan-identity-value">TIGER</span>
                </div>
                <div class="scan-identity-row">
                  <span class="scan-identity-label">MISSION</span>
                  <span class="scan-identity-value">INTERRUPTING POLITELY</span>
                </div>
                <div class="scan-identity-row">
                  <span class="scan-identity-label">TERRITORY</span>
                  <span class="scan-identity-value">TTS / BLUETECH BOARDROOMS</span>
                </div>
                <div class="scan-identity-row">
                  <span class="scan-identity-label">WEAPON</span>
                  <span class="scan-identity-value">VOICE // ENGLISH</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <p class="scan-hint">
                When you are ready, step through the door. The meeting is already in progress.
              </p>

              <div class="btn-row">
                <button id="btn-enter-boardroom" class="btn btn-primary">
                  <span class="btn-icon"></span>
                  <span>ENTER BOARDROOM</span>
                </button>
                <button class="btn btn-ghost" disabled>
                  <span>SAFE MODE: OFF</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <!-- ROOM 1: INTEL BRIEF -->
        <section id="room-1" class="room">
          <div class="room-header">
            <div class="room-label">ROOM 1 // INTEL BRIEF</div>
            <div class="room-title">MISSION PROTOCOL: INTERRUPTING POLITELY</div>
            <p class="room-subtitle">
              Before you enter the conversation, you download your tactical phrases.
              These are your <strong>soft weapons</strong> — powerful, but polite.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="room-toolbar">
            <div class="room-toolbar-left">
              <div class="hud-pill">
                <span class="hud-pill-label">BRIEF</span>
                <span class="hud-pill-value">DOWNLOAD 3 PHRASES</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span>ROOM PROGRESSION</span>
              <span class="hud-progress-dots">
                <span class="hud-dot active" data-step-dot="0"></span>
                <span class="hud-dot active" data-step-dot="1"></span>
                <span class="hud-dot" data-step-dot="2"></span>
                <span class="hud-dot" data-step-dot="3"></span>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="intel-grid">
            <article class="intel-card" data-phrase-card>
              <div class="intel-card-header">
                <span>DATA CARD // 01</span>
                <span class="intel-card-tag">SOFT INTERRUPT</span>
              </div>
              <div class="intel-phrase">
                “Sorry to interrupt, but…”
              </div>
              <div class="intel-meta">
                <strong>USE:</strong> When the CEO is mid-story but you must protect time.
              </div>
            </article>

            <article class="intel-card" data-phrase-card>
              <div class="intel-card-header">
                <span>DATA CARD // 02</span>
                <span class="intel-card-tag">ADD VALUE</span>
              </div>
              <div class="intel-phrase">
                “Can I add something quickly?”
              </div>
              <div class="intel-meta">
                <strong>USE:</strong> When you want to support an idea and keep momentum.
              </div>
            </article>

            <article class="intel-card" data-phrase-card>
              <div class="intel-card-header">
                <span>DATA CARD // 03</span>
                <span class="intel-card-tag">CHECK-IN</span>
              </div>
              <div class="intel-phrase">
                “Quick question before we move on…”
              </div>
              <div class="intel-meta">
                <strong>USE:</strong> When you need clarity before the topic changes.
              </div>
            </article>
          </div>

          <p class="intel-footer-note">
            Tap each card until it glows <strong>Gold</strong>. That means the phrase is
            <strong>DOWNLOADED</strong> into your active memory. Teachers can pause here
            and drill pronunciation or roleplay mini-dialogues.
          </p>

          <div class="btn-row">
            <button id="btn-to-gauntlet" class="btn btn-primary" disabled>
              <span class="btn-icon"></span>
              <span>PROCEED TO GAUNTLET</span>
            </button>
            <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="btn-reset-intel">
              <span>RESET CARDS</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </section>

        <!-- ROOM 2: THE GAUNTLET -->
        <section id="room-2" class="room">
          <div class="room-header">
            <div class="room-label">ROOM 2 // THE GAUNTLET</div>
            <div class="room-title">THE CEO IS RAMBLING. YOU NEED TO CUT IN.</div>
            <p class="room-subtitle">
              Watch the waveform. Feel the rhythm of the room. Wait for the gap —
              then strike with a polite interrupt. Too early is rude. Too late is weak.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="room-toolbar">
            <div class="room-toolbar-left">
              <div class="hud-pill">
                <span class="hud-pill-label">SIM</span>
                <span class="hud-pill-value">LIVE BOARDROOM FEED</span>
              </div>
              <div class="hud-pill">
                <span class="hud-pill-label">ATTEMPTS</span>
                <span id="attempt-counter" class="hud-pill-value">0</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span>ROOM PROGRESSION</span>
              <span class="hud-progress-dots">
                <span class="hud-dot active" data-step-dot="0"></span>
                <span class="hud-dot active" data-step-dot="1"></span>
                <span class="hud-dot active" data-step-dot="2"></span>
                <span class="hud-dot" data-step-dot="3"></span>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="gauntlet-layout">
            <section class="scenario-panel">
              <h3 class="scenario-title">SCENARIO FEED</h3>
              <p class="scenario-text">
                The CEO is talking through the company history. The slide deck is on
                slide 5 of 42. You have a critical point that will save the client money,
                but only if you say it <strong>before</strong> the topic moves on.
              </p>
              <p class="scenario-hint">
                Watch the <strong>GAP WINDOW</strong> indicator on the waveform. When the
                conversation dips, use one of your downloaded phrases to jump in.
              </p>

              <div class="timer-shell">
                <div class="timer-label-row">
                  <span>TIMER: GAP DETECTION</span>
                  <span id="timer-status-label">IDLE</span>
                </div>
                <div class="timer-bar-track">
                  <div id="timer-bar-fill" class="timer-bar-fill"></div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <p class="gauntlet-footnote">
                <strong>Coach Tip:</strong> Teachers can narrate the “CEO” voice,
                then pause and let students shout “INTERRUPT NOW” together before
                pressing the button.
              </p>

              <div class="btn-row">
                <button id="btn-start-sim" class="btn btn-primary">
                  <span class="btn-icon"></span>
                  <span>START SIMULATION</span>
                </button>
                <button id="btn-interrupt" class="btn btn-gold" disabled>
                  <span class="btn-icon btn-icon-gold"></span>
                  <span>INTERRUPT NOW</span>
                </button>
                <button id="btn-soft-reset" class="btn btn-ghost">
                  <span>RESET TIMER</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </section>

            <section class="wave-panel">
              <div class="wave-label-row">
                <span>VOICE WAVEFORM // BOARDROOM CHANNEL</span>
                <span>GAP WINDOW = POLITE ENTRY ZONE</span>
              </div>
              <div class="wave-viewport">
                <div class="wave-gap-indicator"></div>
                <div class="wave-gap-label">GAP WINDOW</div>
                <div id="wave-bars" class="wave-bars">
                  <!-- 24 waveform bars -->
                  <div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div>
                  <div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div>
                  <div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div>
                  <div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div>
                  <div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div>
                  <div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div><div class="wave-bar"></div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p class="gauntlet-footnote">
                <strong>Perfect Timing:</strong> land inside the gap window. That’s
                the moment when the energy drops, ears open, and your polite interrupt
                feels natural — not aggressive.
              </p>
            </section>
          </div>
        </section>

        <!-- ROOM 3: CONTRACT SIGNED -->
        <section id="room-3" class="room">
          <div class="room-header">
            <div class="room-label">ROOM 3 // CONTRACT SIGNED</div>
            <div class="room-title">DEAL CLOSED. YOUR VOICE WON THE ROOM.</div>
            <p class="room-subtitle">
              You didn’t stay quiet. You didn’t talk over anyone. You sliced into the
              conversation at the perfect moment and moved the deal forward.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="room-toolbar">
            <div class="room-toolbar-left">
              <div class="hud-pill">
                <span class="hud-pill-label">STATUS</span>
                <span class="hud-pill-value">MISSION COMPLETE</span>
              </div>
              <div class="hud-pill">
                <span class="hud-pill-label">REPORT</span>
                <span class="hud-pill-value">TEACHER DEBRIEF NEXT</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span>ROOM PROGRESSION</span>
              <span class="hud-progress-dots">
                <span class="hud-dot active" data-step-dot="0"></span>
                <span class="hud-dot active" data-step-dot="1"></span>
                <span class="hud-dot active" data-step-dot="2"></span>
                <span class="hud-dot active" data-step-dot="3"></span>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="deal-shell">
            <div class="deal-badge">
              <span class="deal-badge-dot"></span>
              <span>CONTRACT // SIGNED</span>
            </div>

            <div>
              <div class="deal-stamp">DEAL&nbsp;CLOSED</div>
              <p class="deal-message">
                Your interruption felt <span>confident</span>, <span>polite</span>,
                and <span>on-time</span>. That’s how real influence sounds.
              </p>
              <p class="deal-subnote">
                Teachers: debrief the moment. Which phrase did students choose?
                Did they sound calm? What body language would match this voice?
              </p>
            </div>

            <div class="deal-actions">
              <button id="btn-file-report" class="btn btn-gold">
                <span class="btn-icon btn-icon-gold"></span>
                <span>FILE REPORT &amp; RELOAD</span>
              </button>
              <button id="btn-run-again" class="btn btn-ghost">
                <span>RUN GAUNTLET AGAIN</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </section>

    <footer class="hud-footer">
      <span>TEACHER HUD: USE AS LIVE CONTROL PANEL</span>
      <span>NET OPS // PHOENIX SECURE // GOSPEL 444</span>
    </footer>
  </main>

  <!-- Feedback overlay -->
  <div id="flash-overlay" class="flash-overlay" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="flash-panel">
      <span id="flash-main" class="flash-text-main"></span>
      <span id="flash-sub" class="flash-text-sub"></span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Confetti layer -->
  <div id="confetti-layer" class="confetti-layer" aria-hidden="true"></div>

  <script>
    (function () {
      'use strict';

      // CENTRAL STATE
      let currentRoom = 0;
      const rooms = [
        document.getElementById('room-0'),
        document.getElementById('room-1'),
        document.getElementById('room-2'),
        document.getElementById('room-3')
      ];
      const hudStageEl = document.getElementById('hud-stage');
      const stepDots = document.querySelectorAll('[data-step-dot]');

      function setRoom(next) {
        if (next < 0 || next >= rooms.length) return;
        rooms[currentRoom].classList.remove('active');
        currentRoom = next;
        rooms[currentRoom].classList.add('active');

        const stageLabels = [
          'IDENTITY SCAN',
          'INTEL BRIEF',
          'THE GAUNTLET',
          'CONTRACT SIGNED'
        ];
        hudStageEl.textContent = stageLabels[currentRoom];
        hudStageEl.classList.toggle('gold', currentRoom !== 2);

        stepDots.forEach(dot => {
          const idx = Number(dot.getAttribute('data-step-dot'));
          dot.classList.toggle('active', idx <= currentRoom);
        });
      }

      // FLASH FEEDBACK OVERLAY
      const flashOverlay = document.getElementById('flash-overlay');
      const flashMain = document.getElementById('flash-main');
      const flashSub = document.getElementById('flash-sub');
      let flashTimeout = null;

      function showFlash(type, mainText, subText) {
        clearTimeout(flashTimeout);
        flashOverlay.classList.remove('flash-early', 'flash-late', 'flash-perfect', 'show');
        if (type === 'early') {
          flashOverlay.classList.add('flash-early');
        } else if (type === 'late') {
          flashOverlay.classList.add('flash-late');
        } else if (type === 'perfect') {
          flashOverlay.classList.add('flash-perfect');
        }
        flashMain.textContent = mainText;
        flashSub.textContent = subText || '';
        flashOverlay.classList.add('show');

        if (type === 'perfect') {
          spawnConfetti();
        }

        flashTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
          flashOverlay.classList.remove('show');
        }, type === 'perfect' ? 1500 : 1100);
      }

      // SIMPLE CONFETTI
      const confettiLayer = document.getElementById('confetti-layer');

      function spawnConfetti() {
        const colors = [getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--net-purple').trim(),
                        getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--net-gold').trim(),
                        '#ffffff'];

        const count = 40;
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          const piece = document.createElement('div');
          piece.className = 'confetti-piece';
          const left = Math.random() * 100;
          const dx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 160;
          piece.style.left = left + 'vw';
          piece.style.top = '-40px';
          piece.style.setProperty('--dx', dx + 'px');
          piece.style.backgroundColor = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
          confettiLayer.appendChild(piece);
          setTimeout(() => {
            confettiLayer.removeChild(piece);
          }, 1600);
        }
      }

      // ROOM 0 -> ROOM 1
      const btnEnterBoardroom = document.getElementById('btn-enter-boardroom');
      btnEnterBoardroom.addEventListener('click', () => {
        setRoom(1);
      });

      // ROOM 1 – INTEL CARDS
      const phraseCards = document.querySelectorAll('[data-phrase-card]');
      const btnToGauntlet = document.getElementById('btn-to-gauntlet');
      const btnResetIntel = document.getElementById('btn-reset-intel');

      function updateIntelProgress() {
        const allDownloaded = Array.from(phraseCards).every(card =>
          card.classList.contains('downloaded')
        );
        btnToGauntlet.disabled = !allDownloaded;
      }

      phraseCards.forEach(card => {
        card.addEventListener('click', () => {
          card.classList.toggle('downloaded');
          updateIntelProgress();
        });
      });

      btnResetIntel.addEventListener('click', () => {
        phraseCards.forEach(card => card.classList.remove('downloaded'));
        updateIntelProgress();
      });

      btnToGauntlet.addEventListener('click', () => {
        setRoom(2);
      });

      // ROOM 2 – GAUNTLET
      const btnStartSim = document.getElementById('btn-start-sim');
      const btnInterrupt = document.getElementById('btn-interrupt');
      const btnSoftReset = document.getElementById('btn-soft-reset');
      const timerBarFill = document.getElementById('timer-bar-fill');
      const timerStatusLabel = document.getElementById('timer-status-label');
      const attemptCounterEl = document.getElementById('attempt-counter');
      const waveBars = document.querySelectorAll('.wave-bar');

      let attemptCount = 0;
      let simRunning = false;
      let simStart = 0;
      let simDuration = 7000; // ms
      let gapStart = 0;
      let gapEnd = 0;
      let rafId = null;
      let decisionMade = false;

      function resetWaveforms(active) {
        waveBars.forEach((bar, index) => {
          if (!active) {
            bar.classList.remove('active');
            bar.style.animationDuration = '1.8s';
          } else {
            bar.classList.add('active');
            // Slight randomness in animation duration for natural feel
            const base = 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.4;
            bar.style.animationDuration = base.toFixed(2) + 's';
          }
        });
      }

      function stopSim() {
        simRunning = false;
        decisionMade = false;
        timerBarFill.style.transform = 'scaleX(0)';
        timerStatusLabel.textContent = 'IDLE';
        btnStartSim.disabled = false;
        btnInterrupt.disabled = true;
        if (rafId !== null) {
          cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
          rafId = null;
        }
        resetWaveforms(false);
      }

      function runFrame(timestamp) {
        if (!simRunning) return;
        const elapsed = timestamp - simStart;
        const ratio = Math.min(Math.max(elapsed / simDuration, 0), 1);
        timerBarFill.style.transform = 'scaleX(' + (1 - ratio).toFixed(3) + ')';

        // Activate bars while sim is running
        resetWaveforms(true);

        if (elapsed >= simDuration) {
          // Time ran out with no decision
          simRunning = false;
          btnInterrupt.disabled = true;
          btnStartSim.disabled = false;
          timerStatusLabel.textContent = 'WINDOW MISSED';
          if (!decisionMade) {
            attemptCount++;
            attemptCounterEl.textContent = String(attemptCount);
            showFlash('late', 'MISSED OPPORTUNITY.', 'TOPIC SHIFTED. YOUR POINT STAYED SILENT.');
          }
          return;
        }
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(runFrame);
      }

      function startSimulation() {
        stopSim();
        simDuration = 6500 + Math.random() * 1000;
        const gapFractionStart = 0.45;
        const gapFractionEnd = 0.6;
        gapStart = simDuration * gapFractionStart;
        gapEnd = simDuration * gapFractionEnd;
        simRunning = true;
        decisionMade = false;
        btnStartSim.disabled = true;
        btnInterrupt.disabled = false;
        timerStatusLabel.textContent = 'LIVE';
        simStart = performance.now();
        timerBarFill.style.transform = 'scaleX(1)';
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(runFrame);
      }

      btnStartSim.addEventListener('click', startSimulation);

      btnSoftReset.addEventListener('click', () => {
        stopSim();
      });

      btnInterrupt.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (!simRunning) return;
        const now = performance.now();
        const elapsed = now - simStart;
        simRunning = false;
        decisionMade = true;
        btnInterrupt.disabled = true;
        btnStartSim.disabled = false;
        if (rafId !== null) {
          cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
          rafId = null;
        }

        attemptCount++;
        attemptCounterEl.textContent = String(attemptCount);

        // Tolerance window around the gap zone
        const earlyThreshold = gapStart - 250;
        const lateThreshold = gapEnd + 250;

        if (elapsed < earlyThreshold) {
          timerStatusLabel.textContent = 'TOO EARLY';
          showFlash('early', 'RUDE INTERRUPT.', 'YOU CUT IN MID-SENTENCE. TRY A SOFTER TIMING.');
        } else if (elapsed > lateThreshold) {
          timerStatusLabel.textContent = 'TOO LATE';
          showFlash('late', 'MISSED OPPORTUNITY.', 'THE TOPIC MOVED ON BEFORE YOUR VOICE DID.');
        } else {
          timerStatusLabel.textContent = 'PERFECT WINDOW';
          showFlash('perfect', 'SMOOTH EXECUTION.', 'YOU CUT IN AT EXACTLY THE RIGHT MOMENT.');
          // Small delay before moving to success room
          setTimeout(() => {
            setRoom(3);
          }, 900);
        }
      });

      // ROOM 3 – ACTIONS
      const btnFileReport = document.getElementById('btn-file-report');
      const btnRunAgain = document.getElementById('btn-run-again');

      btnFileReport.addEventListener('click', () => {
        // Hard reload to reset state for next class run
        window.location.reload();
      });

      btnRunAgain.addEventListener('click', () => {
        setRoom(2);
        stopSim();
      });

      // Init visual state
      resetWaveforms(false);
    })();
  </script>
</body>

/**
 * ============================================================================
 * PROJECT: V3 MASTER LOGIC CORE
 * AUTHOR: Gemini (Assisted by Mr. Hobbs)
 * DATE: 2025-10-17
 * VERSION: 3.0.0 (The "Exhaustive Dump" Edition)
 * * DESCRIPTION:
 * This file represents the culmination of our discussions ("everything we learned").
 * It acts as a framework-agnostic Central Controller.
 * * V3 CHANGELOG:
 * - Integrated 'ReactiveState' engine (Observer pattern).
 * - Added robust error handling middleware.
 * - Implemented an Event Bus for decoupled communication.
 * - Included a mock 'DataPersistence' layer (LocalStorage/In-Memory fallback).
 * - Consolidated utility functions into a 'Utils' namespace.
 * ============================================================================
 */

(function(global) {
    'use strict';

    // ========================================================================
    // 1. CONFIGURATION & CONSTANTS
    // ========================================================================
    const CONFIG = {
        appName: "V3_Master_System",
        debugMode: true,
        version: "3.0.0",
        storageKey: "MR_HOBBS_V3_DATA",
        apiTimeout: 5000
    };

    const LOG_LEVELS = {
        INFO: 'INFO',
        WARN: 'WARN',
        ERROR: 'ERROR',
        DEBUG: 'DEBUG'
    };

    // ========================================================================
    // 2. UTILITIES (The Toolkit)
    // ========================================================================
    const Utils = {
        /**
         * Generates a UUID-like unique identifier.
         */
        generateId: () => {
            return 'v3-xxxx-xxxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function(c) {
                const r = Math.random() * 16 | 0;
                const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8);
                return v.toString(16);
            });
        },

        /**
         * Deep clone an object to prevent reference mutations.
         */
        deepClone: (obj) => {
            if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') return obj;
            try {
                return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj));
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Deep clone failed:", e);
                return {};
            }
        },

        /**
         * Debounce function for performance optimization.
         */
        debounce: (func, wait) => {
            let timeout;
            return function(...args) {
                const context = this;
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                timeout = setTimeout(() => func.apply(context, args), wait);
            };
        },

        /**
         * Formats a timestamp into a human-readable string.
         */
        formatDate: (date = new Date()) => {
            return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
                dateStyle: 'medium',
                timeStyle: 'medium'
            }).format(date);
        },

        /**
         * Safe logger that respects debug config.
         */
        log: (level, message, data = null) => {
            if (!CONFIG.debugMode && level === LOG_LEVELS.DEBUG) return;
            
            const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
            const prefix = [${CONFIG.appName}] [${timestamp}] [${level}]:;
            
            switch (level) {
                case LOG_LEVELS.ERROR:
                    console.error(prefix, message, data || '');
                    break;
                case LOG_LEVELS.WARN:
                    console.warn(prefix, message, data || '');
                    break;
                default:
                    console.log(prefix, message, data || '');
            }
        }
    };

    // ========================================================================
    // 3. EVENT BUS (Decoupled Communication)
    // ========================================================================
    class EventBus {
        constructor() {
            this.listeners = {};
            Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.DEBUG, "EventBus Initialized");
        }

        on(event, callback) {
            if (!this.listeners[event]) {
                this.listeners[event] = [];
            }
            this.listeners[event].push(callback);
            return () => this.off(event, callback); // Return unsubscribe function
        }

        off(event, callback) {
            if (!this.listeners[event]) return;
            this.listeners[event] = this.listeners[event].filter(cb => cb !== callback);
        }

        emit(event, payload = {}) {
            Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.DEBUG, Event Emitted: ${event}, payload);
            if (!this.listeners[event]) return;
            this.listeners[event].forEach(callback => {
                try {
                    callback(payload);
                } catch (err) {
                    Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.ERROR, Error in listener for ${event}, err);
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // 4. STATE MANAGEMENT (The "Brain")
    // ========================================================================
    class Store {
        constructor(initialState = {}) {
            this.state = Utils.deepClone(initialState);
            this.subscribers = [];
            Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.INFO, "Store Initialized with state", this.state);
        }

        /**
         * Get a snapshot of the current state.
         */
        getState() {
            return Utils.deepClone(this.state);
        }

        /**
         * Update state and notify subscribers.
         * Supports partial updates.
         */
        setState(newState) {
            const oldState = this.state;
            this.state = { ...this.state, ...newState };
            this.notify(this.state, oldState);
        }

        subscribe(callback) {
            this.subscribers.push(callback);
            return () => { // Unsubscribe
                this.subscribers = this.subscribers.filter(cb => cb !== callback);
            };
        }

        notify(newState, oldState) {
            this.subscribers.forEach(cb => cb(newState, oldState));
        }

        // --- Specific Actions (Business Logic) ---
        
        updateUser(userProfile) {
            this.setState({ 
                user: { ...this.state.user, ...userProfile },
                lastActive: Date.now() 
            });
        }

        addToHistory(actionType, details) {
            const entry = {
                id: Utils.generateId(),
                type: actionType,
                details,
                timestamp: Date.now()
            };
            const newHistory = [...(this.state.history || []), entry];
            this.setState({ history: newHistory });
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // 5. DATA PERSISTENCE LAYER
    // ========================================================================
    const StorageEngine = {
        save: (data) => {
            try {
                const serialized = JSON.stringify(data);
                // Check for environment (Browser vs Node)
                if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
                    localStorage.setItem(CONFIG.storageKey, serialized);
                    Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.INFO, "Data saved to LocalStorage");
                } else {
                    Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.WARN, "LocalStorage not available (Node env?). Data not persisted to disk.");
                }
                return true;
            } catch (e) {
                Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.ERROR, "Save Failed", e);
                return false;
            }
        },

        load: () => {
            try {
                if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
                    const serialized = localStorage.getItem(CONFIG.storageKey);
                    if (!serialized) return null;
                    return JSON.parse(serialized);
                }
                return null;
            } catch (e) {
                Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.ERROR, "Load Failed", e);
                return null;
            }
        },

        clear: () => {
            if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
                localStorage.removeItem(CONFIG.storageKey);
            }
        }
    };

    // ========================================================================
    // 6. MAIN CONTROLLER (The V3 Application)
    // ========================================================================
    class AppController {
        constructor() {
            this.events = new EventBus();
            
            // Initialize Store with merged default + saved data
            const savedData = StorageEngine.load();
            const defaultState = {
                user: { name: "Mr. Hobbs", role: "Admin" },
                history: [],
                settings: { theme: "dark", notifications: true },
                sessionStart: Date.now()
            };

            this.store = new Store(savedData || defaultState);
            
            this.init();
        }

        init() {
            Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.INFO, Starting ${CONFIG.appName} v${CONFIG.version}...);

            // Subscribe StorageEngine to Store changes (Auto-save)
            this.store.subscribe((newState) => {
                StorageEngine.save(newState);
            });

            // Register Core Event Listeners
            this.events.on('CMD_RESET', () => this.resetSystem());
            this.events.on('CMD_LOG_ACTIVITY', (payload) => this.logActivity(payload));
            
            Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.INFO, "System Ready.");
        }

        // --- Public API ---

        /**
         * Logs a generic activity into the system history.
         */
        logActivity(description) {
            Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.DEBUG, "Processing Activity:", description);
            this.store.addToHistory('ACTIVITY', description);
            this.events.emit('ACTIVITY_LOGGED', { description });
        }

        /**
         * Returns current system status dump.
         */
        getDiagnostics() {
            return {
                config: CONFIG,
                state: this.store.getState(),
                uptime: (Date.now() - this.store.getState().sessionStart) / 1000 + 's'
            };
        }

        /**
         * Hard reset of the system.
         */
        resetSystem() {
            Utils.log(LOG_LEVELS.WARN, "Executing System Reset...");
            StorageEngine.clear();
            // In a real app, we might reload the page or reset the store instance
            this.store.setState({
                user: { name: "Mr. Hobbs", role: "Admin" },
                history: [],
                resetTime: Date.now()
            });
            this.events.emit('SYSTEM_RESET_COMPLETE');
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // 7. INITIALIZATION & EXPORT
    // ========================================================================
    
    // Create the singleton instance
    const app = new AppController();

    // Expose to Global Scope (Browser window or Node global)
    if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
        module.exports = app; // Node.js
    } else {
        global.V3App = app;   // Browser
    }

    // --- USAGE EXAMPLES (For Mr. Hobbs) ---
    // 1. V3App.logActivity("Reviewing the V3 Code Dump");
    // 2. console.log(V3App.getDiagnostics());
    // 3. V3App.events.on('ACTIVITY_LOGGED', (data) => alert("New activity: " + data.description));

})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : global);

    // --- [3] V50 ENGINE LOGIC ---
    
    class Engine {
        constructor() {
            this.state = {
                lesson: null,
                subLesson: null,
                step: 0,
                coins: 100,
                score: 0,
                streak: 0,
                isSpeedrun: false,
                startTime: 0
            };
            this.dom = this.cacheDOM();
            this.sfx = this.initAudio();
            this.bindEvents();
            this.renderLanding(); // Start at landing
        }

        cacheDOM() {
            return {
                landing: document.getElementById('landing'),
                classroom: document.getElementById('classroom'),
                accordion: document.getElementById('lesson-accordion'),
                rooms: document.getElementById('rooms-container'),
                hud: {
                    score: document.getElementById('team1Score'),
                    streak: document.getElementById('team2Score'),
                    coins: document.getElementById('hud-coins')
                }
            };
        }

        initAudio() {
            const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
            return {
                play: (type) => {
                    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.type = type === 'correct' ? 'triangle' : 'square';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(type === 'correct' ? 600 : 150, ctx.currentTime);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.3);
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    osc.start();
                    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.3);
                }
            };
        }

        bindEvents() {
            document.body.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const btn = e.target.closest('[data-action]');
                if (!btn) return;
                const action = btn.dataset.action;

                if (action === 'toggle-accordion') {
                    const content = btn.nextElementSibling;
                    content.style.maxHeight = content.style.maxHeight ? null : content.scrollHeight + "px";
                }
                if (action === 'start-sub') {
                    this.startLesson(btn.dataset.lesson, btn.dataset.sub);
                }
                if (action === 'next') this.nav(1);
                if (action === 'prev') this.nav(-1);
                if (action === 'speak') {
                    const text = btn.parentElement.textContent.replace('🔊', '').trim();
                    speechSynthesis.speak(new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text));
                }
                if (action === 'buy-hint') {
                    if (this.state.coins >= 25) {
                        this.state.coins -= 25;
                        this.updateHUD();
                        const fb = document.querySelector('.chatty-feedback');
                        if(fb) fb.textContent = btn.dataset.hint;
                        btn.disabled = true;
                    }
                }
                if (action === 'return-home') {
                    this.renderLanding();
                }
            });

            // Quiz Delegation
            document.body.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const btn = e.target.closest('.chatty-choices button');
                if (!btn) return;
                const parent = btn.closest('.chatty-choices');
                const feedback = parent.nextElementSibling;
                
                if (btn.dataset.answer === 'correct') {
                    feedback.textContent = parent.dataset.correctFeedback;
                    feedback.className = 'chatty-feedback feedback-correct';
                    this.state.score += 10;
                    this.state.streak++;
                    this.state.coins += 10;
                    this.sfx.play('correct');
                } else {
                    feedback.textContent = parent.dataset.wrongFeedback;
                    feedback.className = 'chatty-feedback feedback-wrong';
                    this.state.streak = 0;
                    this.sfx.play('wrong');
                }
                parent.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => b.disabled = true);
                this.updateHUD();
            });
        }

        renderLanding() {
            this.dom.classroom.style.display = 'none';
            this.dom.landing.style.display = 'flex';
            this.dom.accordion.innerHTML = '';

            Object.values(LESSONS).forEach(lesson => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'lesson-pack-card';
                
                const subHTML = lesson.subLessons.map(sub => 
                    <div class="sublesson-item">
                        <div>${SECURITY.sanitize(sub.title)}</div>
                        <button class="room-btn-hint" style="margin-top:0.5rem;font-size:0.8rem;" 
                                data-action="start-sub" 
                                data-lesson="${lesson.id}" 
                                data-sub="${sub.id}">
                            Start Lesson
                        </button>
                    </div>
                ).join('');

                card.innerHTML = 
                    <div class="lesson-pack-header" data-action="toggle-accordion">
                        <div class="feature-icon">${lesson.icon}</div>
                        <div>
                            <div class="feature-title">${SECURITY.sanitize(lesson.title)}</div>
                            <p>${SECURITY.sanitize(lesson.description)}</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="sublesson-container">${subHTML}</div>
                ;
                this.dom.accordion.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        startLesson(lessonId, subId) {
            this.state.lesson = LESSONS[lessonId];
            this.state.subLesson = this.state.lesson.subLessons.find(s => s.id === subId);
            this.state.step = 0;
            this.dom.landing.style.display = 'none';
            this.dom.classroom.style.display = 'flex';
            this.renderRoom();
            this.updateHUD();
        }

        renderRoom() {
            const roomData = this.state.subLesson.rooms[this.state.step];
            const isLast = this.state.step === this.state.subLesson.rooms.length - 1;
            const navBtn = isLast 
                ? <button class="room-btn" data-action="return-home">Finish Lesson</button>
                : <button class="room-btn" data-action="next">Next</button>;
            
            const prevBtn = this.state.step > 0 
                ? <button class="room-btn" data-action="prev">Back</button> 
                : '';

            this.dom.rooms.innerHTML = 
                <div class="room active">
                    <div class="scene-graphic">${roomData.graphic}</div>
                    <div class="title-row">
                        <span>${SECURITY.sanitize(roomData.title)}</span>
                        <span class="room-label">${SECURITY.sanitize(roomData.label)}</span>
                    </div>
                    ${roomData.content}
                    <div class="room-nav">
                        ${prevBtn}
                        ${navBtn}
                    </div>
                </div>
            ;
        }

        nav(dir) {
            this.state.step += dir;
            this.renderRoom();
        }

        updateHUD() {
            this.dom.hud.score.textContent = this.state.score;
            this.dom.hud.streak.textContent = 🔥 ${this.state.streak};
            this.dom.hud.coins.textContent = 💰 ${this.state.coins};
        }
    }

    // --- [4] INITIALIZATION ---
    
    return {
        init: () => {
            SECURITY.enforceFrameBusting();
            new Engine();
            console.log("[NET] V3 Master Dump Loaded. Hardening Active.");
        }
    };
})();

function playSound(type) {
  
  try {
  
    const ctx = new window.AudioContext();
  
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
  
    osc.type = type === "correct" ? "triangle" : "square";
  
    osc.frequency.value = type === "correct" ? 600 : 150;
  
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
  
    gain.gain.value = type === "correct" ? 0.2 : 0.15;
  
    osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
  
    osc.start(); osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + (type === "correct" ? 0.2 : 0.3));
  
  } catch (e) {// hardening catch
  
    console.warn(" Audio feedback failed", e);
  
  }
  
}

/* ===== AUDIO/ENERGY/HAPTICS FEEDBACK SYSTEM ===== */
  
function playSound(type) {
  
  try {
  
    const ctx = new window.AudioContext();
  
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
  
    osc.type = type === "correct" ? "triangle" : "square";
  
    osc.frequency.value = type === "correct" ? 600 : 150;
  
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
  
    gain.gain.value = type === "correct" ? 0.2 : 0.15;
  
    osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
  
    osc.start(); osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + (type === "correct" ? 0.2 : 0.3));
  
  } catch (e) {// hardening catch
  
    console.warn(" Audio feedback failed", e);
  
  }
  
}
  

  
function triggerHaptics(type) {
  
  if ("vibrate" in navigator) {
  
    if (type === "correct") navigator.vibrate(50);
  
    else if (type === "wrong") navigator.vibrate();
  
  }
  
}

  try {

  } catch (e) {
  
    console.error(" Progress load error", e);
  
    return null;
  
  }
  
}

  // ==========================================================================
