<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <!--
    ======================================================================================
    BLUETECH DUO-TRACK LESSON PLAN (E3 + I1)
    VERSION: 2.1 (HTML TEACHING EDITION)
    AUTHOR: Michael Hobbs (Coach)
    AESTHETIC: Gospel 444 (Purple + Gold, No Blue)

    INTERNAL AUDIT LOG (SIMULATED):
    - PLEXY_UI_AUDIT: PASS (Layout + Readability OK)
    - CLAUDE_PEDAGOGY_AUDIT: PASS (Scaffolding E3 → I1 coherent)
    - C7_AUDITOR_STRUCTURE: PASS (Timelines + Objectives present)
    - C8_GOSPEL_AUDITOR: PASS (444 Aesthetic, no blue, secure wording)
    ======================================================================================
  -->
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>BlueTech Dual-Track Lesson: E3 + I1 (90 Minutes)</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />

  <!-- Fonts -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;700;900&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />

  <style>
    :root {
      --purple: #a855f7;
      --gold: #f59e0b;
      --dark: #050510;
      --glass: rgba(15, 15, 30, 0.9);
      --border: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
      --text: #ffffff;
      --text-dim: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
      --accent-green: #10b981;
      --accent-red: #ef4444;
      --radius: 18px;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    body {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 0% 0%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.16), transparent 60%),
                  radial-gradient(circle at 100% 100%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12), transparent 60%),
                  var(--dark);
      font-family: "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.6;
      padding: 24px 12px 72px;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 1040px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 3.4rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.1;
      text-align: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff, var(--purple));
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    h2 {
      font-size: 1.8rem;
      color: var(--gold);
      margin: 40px 0 18px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
      padding-bottom: 6px;
    }

    h3 {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: var(--purple);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    h4 {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    p {
      color: var(--text-dim);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gold);
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--gold);
      font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .glass-card {
      background: var(--glass);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 20px 22px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .flex {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .flex-2 {
      flex: 1 1 260px;
    }

    .pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      margin: 3px 4px 3px 0;
    }

    .pill span {
      font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
      margin-right: 4px;
      color: var(--gold);
      font-size: 0.7rem;
    }

    .timeline {
      border-left: 2px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.6);
      padding-left: 16px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }

    .timeline-item {
      position: relative;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      padding-left: 4px;
    }

    .timeline-item::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--purple);
      left: -22px;
      top: 4px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.9);
    }

    .time-label {
      font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--gold);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    ul {
      margin: 8px 0 8px 18px;
      padding-left: 4px;
    }

    li {
      margin-bottom: 5px;
      color: var(--text-dim);
    }

    .code {
      font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
      color: var(--gold);
      overflow-x: auto;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    .block-label {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.09em;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .highlight-box {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 0 0, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.22), transparent 55%);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 14px 14px;
      margin-top: 8px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
    }

    .badge {
      display: inline-block;
      font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
      color: var(--text-dim);
      margin-right: 6px;
    }

    .badge--e3 {
      border-color: var(--accent-green);
      color: var(--accent-green);
    }

    .badge--i1 {
      border-color: var(--purple);
      color: var(--purple);
    }

    .two-column {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }

    .callout {
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
      margin-top: 10px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      body {
        padding: 18px 10px 60px;
      }

      .glass-card {
        padding: 16px 16px;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="container">
    <!-- HEADER -->
    <div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:32px;">
      <span class="tag">BlueTech Dual-Track</span>
      <h1>E3 + I1 Lesson Plan — Context & Attitude</h1>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:0.95rem;">
        90-Minute Extended Protocol · Track A: E3 Core (with easier E2 support) · Track B: I1 Expansion
      </p>
    </div>

    <!-- META -->
    <div class="glass-card">
      <div class="flex">
        <div class="flex-2">
          <h3>Session Meta</h3>
          <p><span class="block-label">Instructor</span>Michael Hobbs (Coach)</p>
          <p><span class="block-label">Format</span>Online (Google Meet) · Group Class</p>
          <p><span class="block-label">Duration</span>90 minutes total</p>
        </div>
        <div class="flex-2">
          <h3>Tracks</h3>
          <p>
            <span class="badge badge--e3">E3 Core</span>
            <span class="badge badge--i1">I1 Plus</span>
          </p>
          <p style="margin-top:6px;">
            E3 content = main spine of the lesson (clear, structured, accessible for stronger E2 as well).<br />
            I1 content = "plus" tasks layered on top (longer answers, nuance, sarcasm, leadership talk).
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- HIGH-LEVEL FLOW -->
    <div class="glass-card">
      <h2>🧭 1. High-Level Flow (90 Minutes)</h2>
      <div class="timeline">
        <div class="timeline-item">
          <div class="time-label">0 – 15 min</div>
          <h4>Warm-Up · Weekend Plans + Mini Sarcasm</h4>
          <p>E3: simple past tense, weekend highlights. I1: add tone, mild sarcasm, micro-story.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="timeline-item">
          <div class="time-label">15 – 35 min</div>
          <h4>Company Context Challenge</h4>
          <p>E3: basic explanation of company / divisions. I1: add “division, subsidiary, B2B, client-facing”.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="timeline-item">
          <div class="time-label">35 – 55 min</div>
          <h4>Input: Short Clip (The Office or Similar)</h4>
          <p>E3: Who is the boss? What happens? I1: Why is it awkward? Tone vs literal meaning.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="timeline-item">
          <div class="time-label">55 – 70 min</div>
          <h4>Speaking Lab: Apology or Explanation</h4>
          <p>E3: simple explanation / apology. I1: formal apology with attitude or subtle humor.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="timeline-item">
          <div class="time-label">70 – 88 min</div>
          <h4>Debate Game: “OP or Nerf?” (Is it too strong or needs to change?)</h4>
          <p>E3: short opinion with one reason. I1: mini argument + idiom + counterpoint.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="timeline-item">
          <div class="time-label">88 – 90 min</div>
          <h4>Exit Ticket</h4>
          <p>One sentence using <strong>context</strong> or <strong>tone</strong> to describe what they learned.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- WARM UP -->
    <div class="glass-card">
      <h2>🔥 2. Warm-Up (0–15 min) – Weekend Plans & Tone</h2>

      <div class="two-column">
        <div>
          <h3>Teacher Script (Core)</h3>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <p><strong>Step 1 – Simple check-in (E3-friendly, E2-safe):</strong></p>
            <div class="code">
Teacher: "How was your weekend?"<br />
Teacher: "What did you do on Saturday or Sunday?"<br /><br />
Target answers:<br />
• "I stayed at home. I watched movies."<br />
• "I went to the mall with my friends."<br />
• "I visited my family."
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="highlight-box">
            <p><strong>Step 2 – Weekend plans (future):</strong></p>
            <div class="code">
Teacher: "What are your plans for this weekend?"<br /><br />
E3 target:<br />
• "I will visit my parents."<br />
• "I will meet my friends and have coffee."<br />
• "I will relax and sleep."<br /><br />
I1 plus:<br />
• "I'm planning to catch up on sleep and do absolutely nothing – very exciting life."<br />
• "I’ll be working all weekend… living the dream."
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <h3>E3 vs I1 Targets</h3>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <span class="badge badge--e3">E3 Core</span>
            <ul>
              <li>Correct use of <strong>past tense</strong>: went, saw, stayed, watched.</li>
              <li>Correct use of <strong>will</strong> / “going to” for weekend plans.</li>
              <li>1–2 short, clear sentences.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>

          <div class="highlight-box">
            <span class="badge badge--i1">I1 Plus</span>
            <ul>
              <li>Add <strong>tone</strong> (bored, excited, sarcastic).</li>
              <li>Use soft sarcasm:</li>
            </ul>
            <div class="code">
"I have a super exciting plan: I will clean my apartment for 5 hours."<br />
"Wow, I can't wait to answer emails all weekend."
            </div>
            <p style="margin-top:6px;">Check they understand: the words are positive, but the <strong>tone</strong> is negative or bored.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- COMPANY CONTEXT -->
    <div class="glass-card">
      <h2>🏢 3. Company Context Challenge (15–35 min)</h2>

      <div class="two-column">
        <div>
          <h3>Task</h3>
          <p>Students explain their company / team structure in simple English first, then upgrade with business vocabulary.</p>

          <div class="highlight-box">
            <h4>E3 Core Prompt</h4>
            <ul>
              <li>"What does your company do?"</li>
              <li>"What does your team do?"</li>
              <li>"Who are your customers?" (companies / people?)</li>
            </ul>
            <div class="code">
E3 answer sample:<br />
• "My company makes health products. My team works with customers."<br />
• "We sell ingredients to factories. I support clients when they use our products."
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <h3>I1 Expansion</h3>
          <p>Add more precise vocabulary and structure.</p>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <h4>Key Terms (Teach & Drill)</h4>
            <ul>
              <li><strong>Division</strong> – a big section of a company.</li>
              <li><strong>Subsidiary</strong> – a company owned by another company.</li>
              <li><strong>Client-facing</strong> – working directly with customers.</li>
              <li><strong>B2B</strong> – business-to-business.</li>
              <li><strong>B2C</strong> – business-to-consumer.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <h4>I1 Target Answer Pattern</h4>
            <div class="code">
"My company has three main divisions. One focuses on ingredients for other
businesses (B2B), another sells finished health products to consumers (B2C),
and my team is client-facing – we support key customers with applications
and technical questions."
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- INPUT: CLIP -->
    <div class="glass-card">
      <h2>📺 4. Input Block – Short Clip & Cringe Analysis (35–55 min)</h2>

      <p>Use a short scene from <strong>The Office</strong> or similar office comedy: boss making a bad joke, awkward meeting, or “team-building gone wrong”.</p>

      <div class="two-column">
        <div>
          <h3>Step 1 – E3 Comprehension</h3>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <p>Play 60–90 seconds of the clip (with English subtitles allowed).</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Ask basic questions:</li>
            </ul>
            <div class="code">
"Who is the boss?"<br />
"What happens in the scene?"<br />
"Is everyone happy or uncomfortable?"
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <p>Goal: E3 students can say:</p>
            <ul>
              <li>"The boss is talking too much."</li>
              <li>"The staff feel uncomfortable."</li>
              <li>"He thinks it is funny, but the team does not laugh."</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <h3>Step 2 – I1 Tone & Context</h3>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <p>I1 discussion questions:</p>
            <ul>
              <li>"Why is this scene awkward?"</li>
              <li>"What does the boss want to do? What actually happens?"</li>
              <li>"Is he a good leader in this moment? Why or why not?"</li>
              <li>"What is the difference between his <strong>words</strong> and the <strong>reality</strong>?"</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <h4>Literal vs Context</h4>
            <div class="code">
Literal: "We are like a family here."<br />
Context: People look tired and annoyed.<br />
Meaning: "We work too much and there are no boundaries."
            </div>
            <p>Make them say: <strong>"The sentence sounds positive, but the context and faces show the opposite."</strong></p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SPEAKING LAB -->
    <div class="glass-card">
      <h2>🎙️ 5. Speaking Lab – Explanation / Apology (55–70 min)</h2>

      <div class="two-column">
        <div>
          <h3>E3 Core: Simple Explanation</h3>
          <p>Pick a harmless situation: late email reply, small mistake at work, or missing a meeting by 5 minutes.</p>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <h4>Prompt</h4>
            <div class="code">
"Imagine you replied to your client one day late.<br />
Explain or apologize in 2–3 simple sentences."
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <h4>Target E3 Answer</h4>
            <div class="code">
"I'm sorry for the late reply. I had another urgent task yesterday.
Next time I will try to answer you faster."
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <h3>I1 Plus: Formal but Slightly Humorous</h3>
          <p>Same situation, but require a more formal structure. Encourage subtle humor if they’re comfortable.</p>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <h4>I1 Model</h4>
            <div class="code">
"Thank you for your patience and I apologize for the delayed response.
We had an unexpected issue with another project yesterday, but your email
is now my top priority. I appreciate your understanding."
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <h4>Optional Sarcastic Version (For Advanced I1)</h4>
            <p>Meta exercise only – not for real clients:</p>
            <div class="code">
"Thank you for your heroic patience with my one-day delay.
I promise not to keep you in suspense like this again."
            </div>
            <p>Then discuss why this is <strong>not</strong> appropriate in real emails but useful to understand sarcasm/tone.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- DEBATE GAME -->
    <div class="glass-card">
      <h2>⚖️ 6. Game – OP or Nerf? (70–88 min)</h2>
      <p><strong>OP</strong> = overpowered / too strong · <strong>Nerf</strong> = needs to be reduced or controlled.</p>

      <div class="two-column">
        <div>
          <h3>Setup</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>Pick 2–3 topics:</li>
          </ul>
          <div class="code">
• "Working from home is the best."<br />
• "Meetings should be only 10 minutes."<br />
• "We should have a 2-hour lunch break."<br />
• "We should have a 'no email after 6pm' rule."
          </div>
          <ul style="margin-top:8px;">
            <li>Divide students into small groups or have them answer one by one.</li>
            <li>Each student has <strong>30 seconds</strong> to speak.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>

        <div>
          <h3>E3 vs I1 Requirements</h3>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <span class="badge badge--e3">E3 Core</span>
            <ul>
              <li>Say if it is good or bad.</li>
              <li>Give at least <strong>one reason</strong>.</li>
            </ul>
            <div class="code">
"I think working from home is good<br />
because I save time in traffic."<br /><br />
"I think 2-hour lunch is bad<br />
because we will work too late."
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="highlight-box">
            <span class="badge badge--i1">I1 Plus</span>
            <ul>
              <li>Give a clearer argument (2–3 sentences).</li>
              <li>Use <strong>one idiom</strong> (e.g., "piece of cake", "drive me crazy", "at the end of the day").</li>
              <li>Optional: one small sarcastic line.</li>
            </ul>
            <div class="code">
"Working from home is great for focus and saves hours of commuting.
However, it can also drive people crazy if they never leave the house.
At the end of the day, I think a hybrid model is the best option."
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- EXIT TICKET + HOMEWORK -->
    <div class="glass-card">
      <h2>🎫 7. Exit Ticket & Homework (88–90 min + After Class)</h2>

      <div class="two-column">
        <div>
          <h3>Exit Ticket (In-Class)</h3>
          <p>Ask each student for <strong>one sentence</strong> using <strong>context</strong> or <strong>tone</strong>.</p>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <h4>E3 Targets</h4>
            <div class="code">
"In English, context is important."<br />
"The tone is serious in this meeting."
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <h4>I1 Targets</h4>
            <div class="code">
"Without context, it's hard to know if someone is joking or serious."<br />
"Her words were polite, but her tone made it clear she was annoyed."
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <h3>Homework Protocols</h3>
          <div class="highlight-box">
            <span class="badge badge--e3">E3 Core</span>
            <p><strong>Task:</strong> Watch 1 short YouTube video about “healthy living” or “work–life balance”.</p>
            <p><strong>Write 3 sentences:</strong></p>
            <div class="code">
"I will..."<br />
• "I will drink more water."<br />
• "I will sleep earlier."<br />
• "I will exercise two times a week."
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="highlight-box">
            <span class="badge badge--i1">I1 Plus</span>
            <p><strong>Task:</strong> Prepare a 1-minute story about a time you misunderstood a joke or tone.</p>
            <p><strong>Include:</strong></p>
            <ul>
              <li>What was said (literal sentence).</li>
              <li>What you thought it meant.</li>
              <li>What it <strong>actually</strong> meant in context.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- FOOTER -->
    <footer style="text-align:center; margin-top:40px; color:var(--text-dim); font-size:0.8rem;">
      <p>BlueTech Dual-Track Lesson · E3 Core + I1 Plus · 90-Minute Protocol</p>
      <p style="margin-top:8px; font-style:italic;">
        Context + Tone + Confidence = Real-world English.
      </p>
    </footer>
  </div>

<div class="hud-container">
    
    <div class="hud-header">
        <span class="mission-id">L_11 // NEGOTIATION</span>
        <div class="progress-dots">
            <div class="dot active" id="d0"></div>
            <div class="dot" id="d1"></div>
            <div class="dot" id="d2"></div>
            <div class="dot" id="d3"></div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="room active" id="r0">
        <div style="text-align: center; margin-bottom: 30px;">
            <span style="font-size: 4rem;">💼</span>
        </div>
        <h1>The Stakes</h1>
        <p>You are in a meeting. The client is demanding a <strong>50% discount</strong> or they will walk away.</p>
        <p>If you say "Yes," you lose money. If you say "No" aggressively, you lose the client.</p>
        <p class="highlight">MISSION: Find the "Gold Zone" — The Soft No.</p>
        <button id="btn-start" class="btn-primary">ENTER MEETING ROOM</button>
    </div>

    <div class="room" id="r1">
        <h2>Download Protocol</h2>
        <p>Equip these 3 shield phrases to survive the negotiation. Click to download.</p>
        
        <div class="phrase-grid">
            <div class="phrase-card" id="card1">
                <div class="phrase-title">THE BRIDGE</div>
                <div class="phrase-text">"I understand why budget is a concern..."</div>
            </div>
            <div class="phrase-card" id="card2">
                <div class="phrase-title">THE PIVOT</div>
                <div class="phrase-text">"However, cutting the price risks the quality..."</div>
            </div>
            <div class="phrase-card" id="card3">
                <div class="phrase-title">THE OFFER</div>
                <div class="phrase-text">"What I can do is add extra support..."</div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top: 30px;">
            <button id="btn-armory" class="btn-primary" disabled>EQUIP & PROCEED</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="room" id="r2">
        <div class="sim-container">
            <div style="font-family: 'JetBrains Mono'; color: var(--net-dim); margin-bottom: 10px;">CLIENT MOOD</div>
            <span id="client-face" class="client-face">😐</span>
            
            <p style="font-size: 1.2rem; color: #fff; font-weight: 700;">"This is too expensive. Give me a discount."</p>
            
            <div class="slider-wrapper">
                <input type="range" id="tension-slider" min="0" max="100" value="0">
                <div class="slider-labels">
                    <span>MOUSE (Give In)</span>
                    <span style="color: var(--net-gold);">BALANCE</span>
                    <span>TIGER (Attack)</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <p id="response-preview" style="height: 60px; color: var(--net-purple); font-style: italic;">"..."</p>
        </div>
        <button id="btn-submit-sim" class="btn-primary" style="margin-top: 20px;">SUBMIT RESPONSE</button>
        <p id="sim-feedback" style="text-align: center; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 0.9rem; height: 20px;"></p>
    </div>

    <div class="room" id="r3">
        <div style="text-align: center;">
            <span style="font-size: 4rem;">🤝</span>
            <h1 style="color: var(--net-gold);">DEAL SECURED</h1>
            <p>You held your ground. You kept the value. You kept the client.</p>
        </div>
        
        <div style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 20px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px;">
            <p style="margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 0.9rem;"><strong>Final Task:</strong> Write your own "Soft No" for a deadline request.</p>
            <input type="text" class="net-input" placeholder="I cannot do Friday, but I can...">
        </div>

        <button id="btn-finish" class="btn-primary">COMPLETE MISSION</button>
    </div>

    <div id="toast" class="toast">PHRASE DOWNLOADED</div>

</div>

<script>
    // --- STATE MANAGEMENT ---
    const state = {
        phrasesCollected: 0,
        tension: 0
    };

    // --- DOM ELEMENTS ---
    const rooms = [
        document.getElementById('r0'),
        document.getElementById('r1'),
        document.getElementById('r2'),
        document.getElementById('r3')
    ];
    const dots = [
        document.getElementById('d0'),
        document.getElementById('d1'),
        document.getElementById('d2'),
        document.getElementById('d3')
    ];

    // --- NAVIGATION ---
    function goToRoom(index) {
        rooms.forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active'));
        dots.forEach(d => d.classList.remove('active'));
        
        rooms[index].classList.add('active');
        dots[index].classList.add('active');
    }

    // --- ROOM 0 LOGIC ---
    document.getElementById('btn-start').addEventListener('click', () => goToRoom(1));

    // --- ROOM 1 LOGIC (ARMORY) ---
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.phrase-card');
    const btnArmory = document.getElementById('btn-armory');
    const toast = document.getElementById('toast');

    cards.forEach(card => {
        card.addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (this.classList.contains('collected')) return;
            
            this.classList.add('collected');
            state.phrasesCollected++;
            
            // Show Toast
            toast.innerText = "DATA ACQUIRED";
            toast.classList.add('show');
            setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 1500);

            // Check Completion
            if (state.phrasesCollected === 3) {
                btnArmory.removeAttribute('disabled');
                btnArmory.innerText = "ENTER NEGOTIATION";
            }
        });
    });

    btnArmory.addEventListener('click', () => goToRoom(2));

    // --- ROOM 2 LOGIC (TENSION SIM) ---
    const slider = document.getElementById('tension-slider');
    const face = document.getElementById('client-face');
    const preview = document.getElementById('response-preview');
    const feedback = document.getElementById('sim-feedback');
    const btnSim = document.getElementById('btn-submit-sim');

    const responses = {
        mouse: "Sorry! I will give you the discount immediately.",
        tiger_bad: "No! That is impossible. Don't ask again.",
        tiger_good: "I understand budget is tight, but I cannot lower the price without lowering quality."
    };

    slider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        const val = parseInt(e.target.value);
        state.tension = val;

        if (val < 30) {
            face.innerText = "🤨"; // Disrespect
            preview.innerText = "${responses.mouse}";
            preview.style.color = "var(--net-dim)";
        } else if (val > 70) {
            face.innerText = "😠"; // Angry
            preview.innerText = "${responses.tiger_bad}";
            preview.style.color = "var(--net-danger)";
        } else {
            face.innerText = "🤔"; // Listening
            preview.innerText = "${responses.tiger_good}";
            preview.style.color = "var(--net-gold)";
        }
    });

    btnSim.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const val = state.tension;
        if (val >= 40 && val <= 60) {
            face.innerText = "🤝";
            feedback.innerText = "PERFECT BALANCE ACHIEVED.";
            feedback.style.color = "var(--net-success)";
            setTimeout(() => goToRoom(3), 1000);
        } else if (val < 40) {
            face.innerText = "😤";
            feedback.innerText = "TOO WEAK. You lost value.";
            feedback.style.color = "var(--net-danger)";
        } else {
            face.innerText = "🤬";
            feedback.innerText = "TOO AGGRESSIVE. Client walked away.";
            feedback.style.color = "var(--net-danger)";
        }
    });

    // --- ROOM 3 LOGIC ---
    document.getElementById('btn-finish').addEventListener('click', () => {
        alert("MISSION COMPLETE. Report to Michael.");
    });

</script>

</body>
</html>

// --- Spatial Hash ---
class SpatialHash {
    constructor(cellSize = 50) {
        this.CellSize = cellSize;
        this.Grid = {};
    }
    _key(x, y, z) { return ${x}.${y}.${z}; }
    _indices(pos) {
        return [
            Math.floor(pos.X / this.CellSize),
            Math.floor(pos.Y / this.CellSize),
            Math.floor(pos.Z / this.CellSize)
        ];
    }
    GetCell(pos) {
        const [x, y, z] = this._indices(pos);
        const key = this._key(x, y, z);
        if (!this.Grid[key]) this.Grid[key] = [];
        return this.Grid[key];
    }
    Insert(obj, pos) {
        const [x, y, z] = this._indices(pos);
        for (let xi = x - 1; xi <= x + 1; xi++)
            for (let yi = y - 1; yi <= y + 1; yi++)
                for (let zi = z - 1; zi <= z + 1; zi++) {
                    let key = this._key(xi, yi, zi);
                    if (!this.Grid[key]) this.Grid[key] = [];
                    if (!this.Grid[key].includes(obj)) this.Grid[key].push(obj);
                }
    }
    Remove(obj, pos) {
        const [x, y, z] = this._indices(pos);
        for (let xi = x - 1; xi <= x + 1; xi++)
            for (let yi = y - 1; yi <= y + 1; yi++)
                for (let zi = z - 1; zi <= z + 1; zi++) {
                    let key = this._key(xi, yi, zi);
                    let cell = this.Grid[key];
                    if (cell) {
                        let idx = cell.indexOf(obj);
                        if (idx !== -1) cell.splice(idx, 1);
                    }
                }
    }
    Update(obj, oldPos, newPos) {
        this.Remove(obj, oldPos);
        this.Insert(obj, newPos);
    }
    Query(pos, radius) {
        let results = [];
        const [x, y, z] = this._indices(pos);
        let r = Math.ceil(radius / this.CellSize);
        for (let xi = x - r; xi <= x + r; xi++)
            for (let yi = y - r; yi <= y + r; yi++)
                for (let zi = z - r; zi <= z + r; zi++) {
                    let key = this._key(xi, yi, zi);
                    let cell = this.Grid[key];
                    if (cell) results.push(...cell);
                }
        return results;
    }
    Clear() { this.Grid = {}; }
}

class StateMachine {

        this.States = {};

        // AI properties:
        this.Target = null;
        this.IsDead = false;
        this.PathQueue = [];

        this.AttackCooldown = 1.5;
        this.AttackRange = 5;
        this.AttackDamage = 10;

    AddState(state) { this.States[state.Name] = state; }
    SetState(name) {
        if (this.CurrentState && this.States[this.CurrentState].Exit) this.States[this.CurrentState].Exit(this);
        this.CurrentState = name;
        if (this.States[name].Enter) this.States[name].Enter(this);
    }
    Update(dt) {
        if (this.IsDead) return;
        if (this.CurrentState && this.States[this.CurrentState].Update)
            this.States[this.CurrentState].Update(this, dt);
    }
    RequestPathUpdate(targetPos) {
        this.PathQueue.push({fsm: this, target: targetPos});
        this.RequestedTargetPosition = targetPos;
    }
    ProcessPath() {
        // Simulate pathfinding: Owner’s position to RequestedTargetPosition
        if (this.RequestedTargetPosition)
            this.Owner.MoveTo(this.RequestedTargetPosition);
        this.RequestedTargetPosition = null;
    }
    ApplyDamage(target) {
        if (target) target.Humanoid.Health -= this.AttackDamage;
    }
}

class IdleState extends State {
    constructor() { super('Idle'); }
    Enter(fsm) { fsm.IdleTimer = 0; fsm.Owner.Stop(); }
    Update(fsm, dt) {
        fsm.IdleTimer += dt;
        if (fsm.IdleTimer > 2) {
            let target = fsm.Owner.FindNearestPlayer();
            if (target) { fsm.Target = target; fsm.SetState('Chase'); }
            else { fsm.IdleTimer = 0; }
        }
    }
    Exit(fsm) {}
}
class ChaseState extends State {
    constructor() { super('Chase'); }
    Enter(fsm) { fsm.Owner.SetWalkSpeed(fsm.ChaseSpeed); }
    Update(fsm, dt) {
        if (!fsm.Target) { fsm.SetState('Idle'); return; }
        if (fsm.Owner.Position.distanceTo(fsm.Target.Position) < fsm.AttackRange) {
            fsm.SetState('Attack');
        } else {
            fsm.RequestPathUpdate(fsm.Target.Position);
        }
    }
    Exit(fsm) { fsm.Target = null; }
}
class AttackState extends State {
    constructor() { super('Attack'); }
    Enter(fsm) { fsm.Owner.SetWalkSpeed(0); fsm.LastAttackTime = 0; }
    Update(fsm, dt) {
        fsm.LastAttackTime += dt;
        if (fsm.LastAttackTime > fsm.AttackCooldown && fsm.Target) {
            fsm.ApplyDamage(fsm.Target);
            fsm.LastAttackTime = 0;
        }
        if (!fsm.Target || fsm.Owner.Position.distanceTo(fsm.Target.Position) > fsm.AttackRange) {
            fsm.SetState('Chase');
        }
    }
    Exit(fsm) {}
}
class DieState extends State {
    constructor() { super('Die'); }
    Enter(fsm) { fsm.IsDead = true; fsm.Owner.SetWalkSpeed(0); fsm.Owner.Cleanup(); }
    Update(fsm, dt) {}
    Exit(fsm) {}
}

// --- Manager ---
class ZombieManager {
    constructor() {
        this.FSMs = [];
        this.PathQueue = [];
        this.PathTimer = 0;
        this.PathInterval = 0.1;
    }
    AddFSM(fsm) { this.FSMs.push(fsm); }
    RemoveFSM(fsm) {
        this.FSMs = this.FSMs.filter(z => z !== fsm);
    }
    UpdateAll(dt) { this.FSMs.forEach(fsm => fsm.Update(dt)); }
    ProcessPathQueue(dt) {
        this.PathTimer += dt;
        if (this.PathTimer > this.PathInterval && this.PathQueue.length) {
            let job = this.PathQueue.shift();
            job.fsm.ProcessPath();
            this.PathTimer = 0;
        }
    }
}

    this.wave++;

  // Spawning functions
  spawnWave() {
    const nZombies = Math.floor(this.config.zombieSpawnBase + this.wave * this.config.zombieSpawnGrowth);
    this.zombies = [];
    for(let i=0; i<nZombies; i++)
      this.zombies.push(new Zombie(this.wave));
    if(this.wave % this.config.bossFrequency === 0) {
      const which = this.wave / this.config.bossFrequency % this.config.bossTypes.length;
      this.bosses.push(new Boss(this.config.bossTypes[which], this.wave));
    }
  },

  // Tick/game step (dt in seconds)
  step(dt) {
    if(this.gameOver) return;
    this.stats.duration += dt;
    this.player.step(dt, this);
    this.zombies.forEach(z => z.step(dt, this));
    this.bosses.forEach(b => b.step(dt, this));
    // Remove dead
    this.zombies = this.zombies.filter(z => !z.dead);
    this.bosses = this.bosses.filter(b => !b.dead);
    // Win/loss checks
    if(this.player.dead) this.gameOver = true;
    else if(this.zombies.length === 0 && this.bosses.length === 0)
      this.nextWave();
  }

// --- Player ---
class Player {
  constructor() {
    this.health = 100;
    this.ammo = 60;
    this.maxAmmo = 120;
    this.superSaiyan = false;
    this.superSaiyanTime = 0;
    this.superSaiyanDuration = BrainrotGame.config.superSaiyanBase;
    this.brainrotted = false;
    this.brainrotLevel = 0;
    this.pos = {x: 320, y: 240};
    this.dead = false;
    this.bullets = [];
    this.particles = [];
    this.score = 0;
  }

  step(dt, game) {
    // Health regen, if enabled
    if(!this.brainrotted && this.health < 100)
      this.health = Math.min(100, this.health + game.config.healthRegen * dt);

    // Super Saiyan logic
    if(this.superSaiyan) {
      this.superSaiyanTime += dt;
      if(this.superSaiyanTime >= this.superSaiyanDuration) {
        this.superSaiyan = false;
        this.superSaiyanTime = 0;
      }
    }

    // Brainrot penalty over time
    if(this.brainrotted) {
      this.brainrotLevel += BrainrotGame.config.brainrotIncrement * dt;
      this.health -= this.brainrotLevel * 0.5 * dt;
      if(this.health <= 0) this.dead = true;
    }

    // Bullets step
    this.bullets.forEach(b => b.step(dt, game));
    this.bullets = this.bullets.filter(b => !b.dead);

    // Particles step (visual only, for hooks)
    this.particles.forEach(p => p.step(dt));
    this.particles = this.particles.filter(p => p.alive);
  }

  fire() {
    if(this.ammo > 0 && !this.dead) {
      this.ammo--;
      BrainrotGame.stats.bulletsFired++;
      this.bullets.push(new Bullet(this.pos.x, this.pos.y, this.superSaiyan));
    }
  }

  superSaiyanActivate() {
    if(this.dead || this.superSaiyan) return false;
    this.superSaiyan = true;
    this.superSaiyanTime = 0;
    BrainrotGame.stats.superSaiyanUsed++;
    return true;
  }

  applyBrainrot() {
    this.brainrotted = true;
    this.brainrotLevel = 1;
  }

  heal() {
    this.health = Math.min(100, this.health + 15);
    if(this.brainrotted) {
      this.brainrotted = false;
      this.brainrotLevel = 0;
    }
  }

  pickupAmmo(n=10) {
    this.ammo = Math.min(this.maxAmmo, this.ammo + n);
  }
}

// --- Zombie ---
class Zombie {
  constructor(wave) {
    this.type = "zombie";
    this.health = 40 + (wave * 4);
    this.speed = 32 + Math.random() * (8 + wave);
    this.pos = {x: Math.random()*640, y: Math.random()*480};
    this.dead = false;
  }

  step(dt, game) {
    if(this.dead) return;
    // Move toward player
    const dx = game.player.pos.x - this.pos.x;
    const dy = game.player.pos.y - this.pos.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) || 1;
    this.pos.x += (dx/dist) * this.speed * dt * 0.7;
    this.pos.y += (dy/dist) * this.speed * dt * 0.7;

    // Attack if close
    if(dist < 25) {
      game.player.health -= 7 * dt;
      game.stats.damageTaken += 7 * dt;
      if(game.player.health <= 0) game.player.dead = true;
    }
  }
}

// --- Boss ---
class Boss {
  constructor(type, wave) {
    this.type = "boss";
    this.subtype = type;
    this.health = 120 + (wave * 20);
    this.speed = 20 + wave * 2;
    this.pos = {x: Math.random()*640, y: Math.random()*480};
    this.dead = false;
  }

  step(dt, game) {
    if(this.dead) return;
    // Move toward player
    const dx = game.player.pos.x - this.pos.x;
    const dy = game.player.pos.y - this.pos.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) || 1;
    this.pos.x += (dx/dist) * this.speed * dt * 0.5;
    this.pos.y += (dy/dist) * this.speed * dt * 0.5;

    // Special attack if close
    if(dist < 40) {
      game.player.health -= 17 * dt;
      game.stats.damageTaken += 17 * dt;
      if(game.player.health <= 0) game.player.dead = true;
    }
  }
}

// --- Bullet ---
class Bullet {
  constructor(x, y, powered) {
    this.pos = {x, y};
    this.speed = powered ? 420 : 290;
    this.lifetime = 2;
    this.dead = false;
    this.powered = powered;
    this.dx = Math.random()*2-1;
    this.dy = Math.random()*2-1;
  }

  step(dt, game) {
    this.lifetime -= dt;
    if(this.lifetime < 0) { this.dead = true; return; }
    this.pos.x += this.dx * this.speed * dt;
    this.pos.y += this.dy * this.speed * dt;

    // Hit logic (zombies)
    for(const z of game.zombies) {
      const dx = z.pos.x - this.pos.x, dy = z.pos.y - this.pos.y;
      if(Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)<16 && !z.dead) {
        z.health -= this.powered ? 40 : 13;
        BrainrotGame.stats.bulletsHit++;
        if(z.health<=0) { z.dead = true; BrainrotGame.stats.zombiesKilled++; }
        this.dead = true;
        return;
      }
    }
    // Hit logic (bosses)
    for(const b of game.bosses) {
      const dx = b.pos.x - this.pos.x, dy = b.pos.y - this.pos.y;
      if(Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)<22 && !b.dead) {

        BrainrotGame.stats.bulletsHit++;
        if(b.health<=0) { b.dead = true; BrainrotGame.stats.bossesKilled++; }
        this.dead = true;
        return;
      }
    }
  }
}

// --- Environment Hazards ---
class Hazard {
  constructor(type, area, damagePerSecond, duration) {
    this.type = type; // e.g. "acid", "trap", "fire"
    this.area = area; // {x, y, radius}
    this.dps = damagePerSecond;
    this.duration = duration;
    this.ttl = duration;
    this.active = true;
  }

  step(dt, game) {
    if (!this.active) return;
    this.ttl -= dt;
    if (this.ttl <= 0) { this.active = false; return; }
    // Damage player if within area
    const p = game.player;
    const dx = p.pos.x - this.area.x, dy = p.pos.y - this.area.y;
    if (Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) < this.area.radius) {
      p.health -= this.dps * dt;
      game.stats.damageTaken += this.dps * dt;
      if (p.health <= 0) p.dead = true;
    }
  }
}

// Add to BrainrotGame:
BrainrotGame.hazards = [];

BrainrotGame.spawnHazard = function(type, center, dps, duration) {
  this.hazards.push(new Hazard(type, center, dps, duration));
};

// Example: acid pool in center for 10 seconds
// BrainrotGame.spawnHazard("acid", {x:320,y:240,radius:60}, 6, 10);

// In step(), add:
BrainrotGame.step = function(dt) {
  if(this.gameOver) return;
  this.stats.duration += dt;
  this.player.step(dt, this);
  this.zombies.forEach(z=>z.step(dt,this));
  this.bosses.forEach(b=>b.step(dt,this));
  this.hazards.forEach(h=>h.step(dt,this));
  this.hazards = this.hazards.filter(h=>h.active);
  this.zombies = this.zombies.filter(z=>!z.dead);
  this.bosses = this.bosses.filter(b=>!b.dead);
  if(this.player.dead) this.gameOver = true;
  else if(this.zombies.length === 0 && this.bosses.length === 0)
    this.nextWave();
};

  this.listeners[event].push(cb);
};

BrainrotGame.emit = function(event, payload) {
  (this.listeners[event] || []).forEach(cb => { try {cb(payload);} catch(e){} });
};

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Class 2: EventBus
----------------------------------------------------------------------

local EventBus = {}
EventBus.__index = EventBus

function EventBus.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, EventBus)
    self._listeners = {}
    return self
end

function EventBus:on(eventName, callback)
    local list = self._listeners[eventName]
    if not list then
        list = {}
        self._listeners[eventName] = list
    end
    table.insert(list, callback)
end

function EventBus:emit(eventName, payload)
    local list = self._listeners[eventName]
    if not list then return end
    for _, cb in ipairs(list) do
        local ok, err = pcall(cb, payload)
        if not ok then
            warn("[Brainrot] Event error for", eventName, err)
        end
    end
end

-- Class 3: GameState (BrainrotGame)

local GameState = {}
GameState.__index = GameState

function GameState.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, GameState)

    self.EventBus = EventBus.new()

    self.Wave = 1
    self.MaxWaves = Config.Game.MaxWaves

    self.PlayerControllers = {} -- [Player] = PlayerController
    self.Zombies = {}
    self.Bosses = {}
    self.Hazards = {}
    self.Particles = {}

    self.GameOver = false

    self.Stats = {
        BulletsFired = 0,
        BulletsHit = 0,
        ZombiesKilled = 0,
        BossesKilled = 0,
        DamageTaken = 0,
        Duration = 0,
        WavesSurvived = 0,
        SuperSaiyanUsed = 0,
    }

    return self
end

    -- Replace with map-aware spawn logic.
    return Vector3.new(math.random(-80, 80), 5, math.random(-80, 80))
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Class 4: PlayerController
----------------------------------------------------------------------

local PlayerController = {}
PlayerController.__index = PlayerController

function PlayerController.new(player, gameState)
    local self = setmetatable({}, PlayerController)
    self.Player = player
    self.GameState = gameState

    self.Health = 100
    self.MaxHealth = 100

    self.Ammo = 60
    self.MaxAmmo = 120

    self.Brainrotted = false
    self.BrainrotLevel = 0

    self.SuperSaiyan = false
    self.SuperSaiyanTime = 0
    self.SuperSaiyanDuration = Config.Game.SuperSaiyanBaseDuration
    self.SuperSaiyanCooldown = 0
    self.SuperSaiyanJustOn = false

    self.Score = 0
    self.XP = 0

    self.Bullets = {}
    self.IsDead = false

    return self
end

function PlayerController:getCharacter()
    local char = self.Player.Character
    if not char or not char.Parent then return nil end
    return char
end

function PlayerController:getRoot()
    local char = self:getCharacter()
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

function PlayerController:getHumanoid()
    local char = self:getCharacter()
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

function PlayerController:applyDamage(amount)
    self.Health -= amount
    self.GameState.Stats.DamageTaken += amount
    if self.Health <= 0 then
        self.IsDead = true
        local humanoid = self:getHumanoid()
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.Health = 0
        end
    end
end

function PlayerController:heal(amount)
    self.Health = math.min(self.MaxHealth, self.Health + amount)
    if self.Brainrotted then
        self.Brainrotted = false
        self.BrainrotLevel = 0
    end
end

function PlayerController:pickupAmmo(amount)
    self.Ammo = math.min(self.MaxAmmo, self.Ammo + amount)
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Class 5: SuperSaiyanSystem (logic on PlayerController)
----------------------------------------------------------------------

function PlayerController:canActivateSuperSaiyan()
    if self.IsDead then return false end
    if self.SuperSaiyan then return false end
    if self.SuperSaiyanCooldown > 0 then return false end
    return true
end

function PlayerController:activateSuperSaiyan()
    if not self:canActivateSuperSaiyan() then return false end
    self.SuperSaiyan = true
    self.SuperSaiyanTime = 0
    self.SuperSaiyanJustOn = true
    self.SuperSaiyanCooldown = 8
    self.SuperSaiyanDuration = math.max(6, self.SuperSaiyanDuration - 1)

    self.Ammo = math.min(self.MaxAmmo, self.Ammo + 10) -- refill on activate
    self.GameState.Stats.SuperSaiyanUsed += 1

    self.GameState.EventBus:emit("SuperSaiyanStart", {
        player = self.Player,
        controller = self,
    })

    return true
end

function PlayerController:updateSuperSaiyan(dt)
    -- Cooldown tick
    if self.SuperSaiyanCooldown > 0 then
        self.SuperSaiyanCooldown = math.max(0, self.SuperSaiyanCooldown - dt)
    end

    if not self.SuperSaiyan then
        self.SuperSaiyanJustOn = false
        return
    end

    self.SuperSaiyanTime += dt

    -- Brainrot interaction: SS clears brainrot
    if self.Brainrotted then
        self.Brainrotted = false
        self.BrainrotLevel = 0
    end

    -- Early end if over duration
    if self.SuperSaiyanTime >= self.SuperSaiyanDuration then
        self.SuperSaiyan = false
        self.SuperSaiyanTime = 0
        return
    end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Class 6: Bullet
----------------------------------------------------------------------

local Bullet = {}
Bullet.__index = Bullet

function Bullet.new(originCFrame, direction, powered)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Bullet)
    self.Position = originCFrame.Position
    self.Direction = direction.Unit
    self.Powered = powered
    self.Speed = powered and 420 or 290
    self.Lifetime = 2
    self.Dead = false
    self.BaseDamage = powered and 40 or 13
    return self
end

function Bullet:step(dt, gameState, ownerController)
    if self.Dead then return end
    self.Lifetime -= dt
    if self.Lifetime <= 0 then
        self.Dead = true
        return
    end

    self.Position += self.Direction * self.Speed * dt

    -- Simple distance checks vs zombies/bosses
    local hitRadiusZombie = 4
    local hitRadiusBoss = 6

    for _, z in ipairs(gameState.Zombies) do
        if not z.Dead then
            local dist = (z.Position - self.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < hitRadiusZombie then
                local dmg = self.BaseDamage
                if ownerController.SuperSaiyan then
                    dmg *= 2.1
                end
                z:applyDamage(dmg, gameState)
                gameState.Stats.BulletsHit += 1
                self.Dead = true
                return
            end
        end
    end

    for _, b in ipairs(gameState.Bosses) do
        if not b.Dead then
            local dist = (b.Position - self.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < hitRadiusBoss then
                local dmg = self.BaseDamage * 0.65
                if ownerController.SuperSaiyan then
                    dmg *= 2.1
                end
                b:applyDamage(dmg, gameState)
                gameState.Stats.BulletsHit += 1
                self.Dead = true
                return
            end
        end
    end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Class 7: BulletManager
----------------------------------------------------------------------

local BulletManager = {}
BulletManager.__index = BulletManager

function BulletManager.new(gameState)
    local self = setmetatable({}, BulletManager)
    self.GameState = gameState
    return self
end

function BulletManager:fireBullet(controller)
    if controller.Ammo <= 0 or controller.IsDead then return end
    controller.Ammo -= 1
    self.GameState.Stats.BulletsFired += 1
    self.GameState.EventBus:emit("ShotFired", { player = controller.Player })

    local root = controller:getRoot()
    if not root then return end

    -- Simple forward shot
    local direction = root.CFrame.LookVector
    local bullet = Bullet.new(root.CFrame, direction, controller.SuperSaiyan)
    table.insert(controller.Bullets, bullet)
end

function BulletManager:step(dt)
    for _, controller in pairs(self.GameState.PlayerControllers) do
        local newList = {}
        for _, bullet in ipairs(controller.Bullets) do
            bullet:step(dt, self.GameState, controller)
            if not bullet.Dead then
                table.insert(newList, bullet)
            end
        end
        controller.Bullets = newList
    end
end

local Zombie = {}
Zombie.__index = Zombie

function Zombie.new(wave, spawnPos)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Zombie)
    self.Type = "Zombie"
    self.Wave = wave
    self.Health = 40 + wave * 4
    self.Speed = 32 + math.random() * (8 + wave)
    self.Position = spawnPos or randomSpawnPos()
    self.Dead = false
    self.Model = nil -- optionally assign NPC model
    self.LastPathUpdate = 0
    self.Path = nil
    return self
end

function Zombie:applyDamage(amount, gameState)
    self.Health -= amount
    if self.Health <= 0 then
        self.Dead = true
        gameState.Stats.ZombiesKilled += 1
    end
end

function Zombie:updateModelPosition()
    if self.Model and self.Model.PrimaryPart then
        self.Model:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(self.Position))
    end
end

function Zombie:step(dt, gameState)
    if self.Dead then return end
    local targetController = nil
    local closestDist = math.huge

    for _, controller in pairs(gameState.PlayerControllers) do
        if not controller.IsDead then
            local root = controller:getRoot()
            if root then
                local dist = (root.Position - self.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < closestDist then
                    closestDist = dist
                    targetController = controller
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if not targetController then return end

    local root = targetController:getRoot()
    if not root then return end

    local toPlayer = root.Position - self.Position
    local dist = toPlayer.Magnitude
    local dir = toPlayer.Unit
    local speedFactor = 0.7
    self.Position += dir * self.Speed * dt * speedFactor
    self:updateModelPosition()

    if dist < 6 then
        local damage = 7 * dt
        targetController:applyDamage(damage)
    end
end

    return self
end

function Hazard:step(dt, gameState)
    if not self.Active then return end
    self.TTL -= dt
    if self.TTL <= 0 then
        self.Active = false
        return
    end

    for _, controller in pairs(gameState.PlayerControllers) do
        if not controller.IsDead then
            local root = controller:getRoot()
            if root then
                local dist = (root.Position - self.Center.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < self.Radius then
                    controller:applyDamage(self.DPS * dt)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Class 13: HazardManager
----------------------------------------------------------------------

local HazardManager = {}
HazardManager.__index = HazardManager

function HazardManager.new(gameState)
    local self = setmetatable({}, HazardManager)
    self.GameState = gameState
    return self
end

function HazardManager:spawnHazard(hType, worldPos, radius, dps, duration)
    local center = {
        Position = worldPos,
        Radius = radius,
    }
    table.insert(self.GameState.Hazards, Hazard.new(hType, center, dps, duration))
end

function HazardManager:step(dt)
    local newList = {}
    for _, h in ipairs(self.GameState.Hazards) do
        h:step(dt, self.GameState)
        if h.Active then
            table.insert(newList, h)
        end
    end
    self.GameState.Hazards = newList
end

local AchievementSystem = {}
AchievementSystem.__index = AchievementSystem

function AchievementSystem.new(gameState)
    local self = setmetatable({}, AchievementSystem)
    self.GameState = gameState
    self.Unlocked = {}
    return self
end

local function hasAchievement(self, name)
    return self.Unlocked[name] == true
end

function AchievementSystem:unlock(name)
    if hasAchievement(self, name) then return end
    self.Unlocked[name] = true
    self.GameState.EventBus:emit("Achievement", { name = name })
end

function AchievementSystem:step()
    local s = self.GameState.Stats
    if s.WavesSurvived >= 10 then
        self:unlock("TEN_WAVES")
    end
    if s.ZombiesKilled >= 100 then
        self:unlock("KILL_100")
    end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Class 16: SaveSystem (DataStore)
----------------------------------------------------------------------

local SaveSystem = {}
SaveSystem.__index = SaveSystem

function SaveSystem.new(gameState)
    local self = setmetatable({}, SaveSystem)
    self.GameState = gameState
    self.DataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("BrainrotGame")
    return self
end

function SaveSystem:serializePlayer(controller)
    return {
        Health = controller.Health,
        Ammo = controller.Ammo,
        Brainrotted = controller.Brainrotted,
        BrainrotLevel = controller.BrainrotLevel,
        SuperSaiyanDuration = controller.SuperSaiyanDuration,
        Score = controller.Score,
        XP = controller.XP,
    }
end

function SaveSystem:saveForPlayer(player)
    local controller = self.GameState.PlayerControllers[player]
    if not controller then return end

    local payload = {
        Wave = self.GameState.Wave,
        Stats = self.GameState.Stats,
        Player = self:serializePlayer(controller),
    }

    task.spawn(function()
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            self.DataStore:SetAsync("BR_" .. player.UserId, payload)
        end)
        if not success then
            warn("[Brainrot] Save failed:", err)
        end
    end)
end

function SaveSystem:loadForPlayer(player)
    local result
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        result = self.DataStore:GetAsync("BR_" .. player.UserId)
    end)
    if not success or not result then
        return
    end

    self.GameState.Wave = result.Wave or 1
    if typeof(result.Stats) == "table" then
        for k, v in pairs(result.Stats) do
            self.GameState.Stats[k] = v
        end
    end

    local controller = self.GameState.PlayerControllers[player]
    if controller and typeof(result.Player) == "table" then
        for k, v in pairs(result.Player) do
            if controller[k] ~= nil then
                controller[k] = v
            end
        end
    end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Class 19: WaveManager
----------------------------------------------------------------------

local WaveManager = {}
WaveManager.__index = WaveManager

function WaveManager.new(gameState, zombieManager, bossManager)
    local self = setmetatable({}, WaveManager)
    self.GameState = gameState
    self.ZombieManager = zombieManager
    self.BossManager = bossManager
    return self
end

function WaveManager:startWave()
    local gs = self.GameState
    if gs.Wave > gs.MaxWaves then
        gs.GameOver = true
        return
    end

    self.ZombieManager:spawnWaveZombies(gs.Wave)
    self.BossManager:spawnBossForWave(gs.Wave)
    gs.EventBus:emit("WaveStart", { wave = gs.Wave })
end

function WaveManager:checkWaveEnd()
    local gs = self.GameState
    if #gs.Zombies == 0 and #gs.Bosses == 0 then
        gs.Stats.WavesSurvived += 1
        gs.Wave += 1
        self:startWave()
    end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Class 20: BrainrotGame (Public API wrapper)
----------------------------------------------------------------------

local BrainrotGame = {}
BrainrotGame.__index = BrainrotGame

function BrainrotGame.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, BrainrotGame)

    self.State = GameState.new()
    self.ZombieManager = ZombieManager.new(self.State)
    self.BossManager = BossManager.new(self.State)
    self.HazardManager = HazardManager.new(self.State)
    self.BulletManager = BulletManager.new(self.State)
    self.AchievementSystem = AchievementSystem.new(self.State)
    self.AnalyticsSystem = AnalyticsSystem.new(self.State)
    self.SaveSystem = SaveSystem.new(self.State)
    self.TrainController = TrainController.new(self.State)
    self.ParticleFX = ParticleFX.new(self.State)
    self.WaveManager = WaveManager.new(self.State, self.ZombieManager, self.BossManager)

    self._running = false
    self._lastTick = os.clock()

    return self
end

function BrainrotGame:Init()
    -- Player join/leave wiring
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
        local controller = PlayerController.new(player, self.State)
        self.State.PlayerControllers[player] = controller
        self.SaveSystem:loadForPlayer(player)
    end)

    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
        self.SaveSystem:saveForPlayer(player)
        self.State.PlayerControllers[player] = nil
    end)

    -- Start initial wave
    self.WaveManager:startWave()

    -- Tick loop
    self._running = true
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not self._running then return end
        self:Step(dt)
    end)
end

function BrainrotGame:Step(dt)
    local s = self.State
    if s.GameOver then return end

    s.Stats.Duration += dt

    -- Update players
    for _, controller in pairs(s.PlayerControllers) do
        -- Regen
        if not controller.Brainrotted and controller.Health < controller.MaxHealth then
            controller.Health = math.min(controller.MaxHealth,
                controller.Health + Config.Game.HealthRegen * dt)
        end

        -- Brainrot penalty
        if controller.Brainrotted then
            controller.BrainrotLevel += Config.Game.BrainrotIncrement * dt
            controller:applyDamage(controller.BrainrotLevel * 0.5 * dt)
        end

        controller:updateSuperSaiyan(dt)

        if controller.IsDead then
            -- game over if single-player; adjust later for coop
            s.GameOver = true
        end
    end

    self.ZombieManager:step(dt)
    self.BossManager:step(dt)
    self.HazardManager:step(dt)
    self.BulletManager:step(dt)
    self.TrainController:step(dt)
    self.AchievementSystem:step()
    self.AnalyticsSystem:step(dt)

    self.WaveManager:checkWaveEnd()
end

return BrainrotGame.new()

2) DeadRailsGameCore.lua (SYSTEM SKELETON)
This is the thin coordinator that pulls from DeadRailsContent and gives you clean hooks for:

Spawning classes / weapons

Waves & towns

Train as moving base

Rizz mode plug-in later

This is intentionally lean so you can wire it into your existing FSM / Brainrot engine.

-- DeadRailsGameCore.lua
-- Core coordinator for 99 Brains on the Dead Rails

local RunService      = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players         = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Content         = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DeadRailsContent"))

local GameCore = {}
GameCore.__index = GameCore

function GameCore.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, GameCore)

    -- Data
    self.Content = Content

    -- Runtime state
    self.PlayersState = {}   -- [Player] = { ClassId, Weapons = {...}, Perks = {...}, Data = {...} }
    self.Day           = 1
    self.Segment       = 1
    self.TownIndex     = 1
    self.ActiveTown    = nil
    self.TrainLayout   = {}  -- list of TrainCar Ids in order

    self.Running       = false
    self.Accumulator   = 0

    return self
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PLAYER SETUP
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameCore:AssignDefaultClass(player)
    local defaultClass = self.Content.Classes[1] -- Railrunner
    self.PlayersState[player] = self.PlayersState[player] or {}
    self.PlayersState[player].ClassId = defaultClass.Id
    self.PlayersState[player].Weapons = { self.Content.Weapons[1].Id } -- Pump shotgun
    self.PlayersState[player].Perks   = {}
end

function GameCore:GetPlayerLoadout(player)
    local state = self.PlayersState[player]
    if not state then return nil end
    return {
        Class  = self:GetClassById(state.ClassId),
        Weapons= self:GetWeaponsByIds(state.Weapons),
        Perks  = self:GetPerksByIds(state.Perks),
    }
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- LOOKUP HELPERS
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameCore:GetClassById(id)
    for _, c in ipairs(self.Content.Classes) do
        if c.Id == id then return c end
    end
end

function GameCore:GetWeaponById(id)
    for _, w in ipairs(self.Content.Weapons) do
        if w.Id == id then return w end
    end
end

function GameCore:GetPerkById(id)
    for _, p in ipairs(self.Content.Perks) do
        if p.Id == id then return p end
    end
end

function GameCore:GetTownById(id)
    for _, t in ipairs(self.Content.TownTypes) do
        if t.Id == id then return t end
    end
end

function GameCore:GetWeaponsByIds(ids)
    local out = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(ids or {}) do
        local w = self:GetWeaponById(id)
        if w then table.insert(out, w) end
    end
    return out
end

function GameCore:GetPerksByIds(ids)
    local out = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(ids or {}) do
        local p = self:GetPerkById(id)
        if p then table.insert(out, p) end
    end
    return out
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TRAIN LAYOUT
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameCore:BuildDefaultTrain()
    -- Basic recommended layout for early game
    self.TrainLayout = {
        "engine_car",
        "shield_car",
        "campfire_car",
        "armory_car",
        "barracks_car",
        "storage_car",
        "sniper_roof_car",
        "medbay_car",
    }
end

function GameCore:GetTrainCars()
    local cars = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(self.TrainLayout) do
        for _, c in ipairs(self.Content.TrainCars) do
            if c.Id == id then
                table.insert(cars, c)
                break
            end
        end
    end
    return cars
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TOWN / SEGMENT LOGIC (LIGHT)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameCore:SelectNextTown()
    -- Cycles through the TownTypes list for now
    self.TownIndex = ((self.TownIndex - 1) % #self.Content.TownTypes) + 1
    self.ActiveTown = self.Content.TownTypes[self.TownIndex]
end

function GameCore:GetCurrentTown()
    return self.ActiveTown
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GAME LOOP (SKELETON)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameCore:Init()
    self:BuildDefaultTrain()
    self:SelectNextTown()

    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
        self:AssignDefaultClass(player)
        -- You hook into your character spawns, set tools according to GetPlayerLoadout(player), etc.
    end)

    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
        self.PlayersState[player] = nil
    end)

    self.Running = true
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if self.Running then
            self:Step(dt)
        end
    end)
end

function GameCore:Step(dt)
    -- This is where you hook into:
    --  - your AI update
    --  - wave logic
    --  - town stop / train movement
    --  - rizz / SS mode
    self.Accumulator += dt

    -- Example: progress segment timer; when done, go to next town/segment
    -- (You already have a more complex loop from your Brainrot engine; plug this data in there.)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SIMPLE EXPORT
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local singleton = GameCore.new()

return singleton

local ZombieAI = {}
ZombieAI.__index = ZombieAI

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

function ZombieAI.new(model, stats)
    local self = setmetatable({}, ZombieAI)

    self.Model = model
    self.Humanoid = model:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    self.Stats = stats

    self.Target = nil
    self.Dead = false
    self.Cooldown = 0

    self.Humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        self.Dead = true
    end)

    return self
end

function ZombieAI:FindTarget()
    local closest = nil
    local closestDist = math.huge

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local char = player.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local dist = (char.HumanoidRootPart.Position - self.Model.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < closestDist then
                closest = char
                closestDist = dist
            end
        end
    end

    self.Target = closest
end

function ZombieAI:Step(dt)
    if self.Dead then return end
    if not self.Target then self:FindTarget() end
    if not self.Target then return end

    local targetHRP = self.Target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHRP then return end

    local distance = (targetHRP.Position - self.Model.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude

    if distance > self.Stats.AttackRange then
        self.Humanoid:MoveTo(targetHRP.Position)
    else
        -- Attack
        if self.Cooldown <= 0 then
            self.Target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(self.Stats.AttackDamage)
            self.Cooldown = self.Stats.AttackCooldown
        end
    end

    self.Cooldown -= dt
end

return ZombieAI
This is the Roblox version of your StateMachine, Idle/Chase/Attack logic.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

function WaveManager:Init(GameCore)
    self.GameCore = GameCore
    self.Wave = 1
    self.Timer = 0
    self.Interval = 35
    self.Running = true

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if self.Running then self:Step(dt) end
    end)
end

function WaveManager:Step(dt)
    self.Timer += dt
    if self.Timer >= self.Interval then
        self.Timer = 0
        self:SpawnWave()
    end
end

function WaveManager:SpawnWave()
    print("[DeadRails] Spawning wave", self.Wave)

    local enemyCount = 8 + math.floor(self.Wave * 1.6)
    local enemyTypes = Content.EnemyTypes

    for i = 1, enemyCount do
        local randomEnemy = enemyTypes[math.random(1, #enemyTypes)]
        self:SpawnEnemy(randomEnemy)
    end

    if self.Wave % 5 == 0 then
        local bossList = Content.Bosses
        local boss = bossList[((self.Wave / 5 - 1) % #bossList) + 1]
        self:SpawnBoss(boss)
    end

    self.Wave += 1
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local RemotesFolder = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local UpdateHUD = RemotesFolder:WaitForChild("UpdateHUD")
local UpdateBoss = RemotesFolder:WaitForChild("UpdateBoss")
local UpdateRizz = RemotesFolder:WaitForChild("UpdateRizz")

local hud = playerGui:WaitForChild("DeadRailsHUD")

local classLabel     = hud.ClassFrame.ClassLabel
local weaponLabel    = hud.WeaponFrame.WeaponLabel
local waveLabel      = hud.WaveFrame.WaveLabel
local bossNameLabel  = hud.BossFrame.BossNameLabel
local bossHealthBar  = hud.BossFrame.BossHealthBar
local ammoLabel      = hud.AmmoFrame.AmmoLabel
local rizzBar        = hud.RizzFrame.RizzBar

local function clamp01(x)
    if x < 0 then return 0 elseif x > 1 then return 1 else return x end
end

UpdateHUD.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
    -- data: { ClassName, WeaponName, Wave, Ammo, MaxAmmo }
    if data.ClassName then
        classLabel.Text = data.ClassName
    end
    if data.WeaponName then
        weaponLabel.Text = data.WeaponName
    end
    if data.Wave then
        waveLabel.Text = "Wave " .. tostring(data.Wave)
    end
    if data.Ammo and data.MaxAmmo then
        ammoLabel.Text = string.format("%d / %d", data.Ammo, data.MaxAmmo)
    end
end)

UpdateBoss.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
    -- data: { Name, Health, MaxHealth, Visible }
    if data.Visible == false then
        bossNameLabel.Text = ""
        bossHealthBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, bossHealthBar.Size.Y.Scale, bossHealthBar.Size.Y.Offset)
        return
    end

    bossNameLabel.Text = data.Name or "Boss"
    if data.Health and data.MaxHealth and data.MaxHealth > 0 then
        local ratio = clamp01(data.Health / data.MaxHealth)
        bossHealthBar.Size = UDim2.new(ratio, 0, bossHealthBar.Size.Y.Scale, bossHealthBar.Size.Y.Offset)
    end
end)

UpdateRizz.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
    -- data: { Rizz, MaxRizz }
    if not data.Rizz or not data.MaxRizz or data.MaxRizz <= 0 then return end
    local ratio = clamp01(data.Rizz / data.MaxRizz)
    rizzBar.Size = UDim2.new(ratio, 0, rizzBar.Size.Y.Scale, rizzBar.Size.Y.Offset)
end)

-- ReplicatedStorage/Modules/Player/WeaponSystem.lua

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Content = require(RS:WaitForChild("DeadRailsContent"))

local WeaponSystem = {}
WeaponSystem.__index = WeaponSystem

function WeaponSystem.GetWeaponData(id)
    for _, w in ipairs(Content.Weapons) do
        if w.Id == id then
            return w
        end
    end
end

function WeaponSystem.CalculateDamage(weaponId, headshot)
    local w = WeaponSystem.GetWeaponData(weaponId)
    if not w then return 0 end
    local dmg = w.Damage or 0
    if headshot then
        dmg *= 1.5
    end
    return dmg
end

function WeaponSystem.GetFireDelay(weaponId)
    local w = WeaponSystem.GetWeaponData(weaponId)
    if not w or not w.RPM then return 0.5 end
    return 60 / w.RPM
end

return WeaponSystem
2.2 Tool server script template

-- Tool.Script: ServerWeapon (inside a Tool)
local Tool = script.Parent
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local WeaponSystem = require(RS:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("Player"):WaitForChild("WeaponSystem"))

local WeaponId = Tool:GetAttribute("WeaponId") or "pump_shotgun"
local FireRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
FireRemote.Name = "Fire"
FireRemote.Parent = Tool

local lastFire = {}

local function canFire(player)
    local now = os.clock()
    local delay = WeaponSystem.GetFireDelay(WeaponId)
    local last = lastFire[player] or 0
    if now - last < delay then return false end
    lastFire[player] = now
    return true
end

FireRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, mousePos)
    if not canFire(player) then return end

    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    local origin = hrp.Position
    local direction = (mousePos - origin).Unit * 500

    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist

    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
    local headshot = false

    if result and result.Instance then
        local hitPart = result.Instance
        local model = hitPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        if model and model:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            if hitPart.Name == "Head" then
                headshot = true
            end
            local dmg = WeaponSystem.CalculateDamage(WeaponId, headshot)
            model.Humanoid:TakeDamage(dmg)
        end
    end
end)
