3.1 BossAI module
Place: ReplicatedStorage/Modules/Entity/BossAI.lua

-- ReplicatedStorage/Modules/Entity/BossAI.lua

local BossAI = {}
BossAI.__index = BossAI

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

function BossAI.new(model, data)
    local self = setmetatable({}, BossAI)

    self.Model = model
    self.Data = data
    self.Humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    self.Root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
    self.Health = self.Humanoid and self.Humanoid.MaxHealth or 1000
    self.MaxHealth = self.Health
    self.Enabled = true
    self.Target = nil
    self.Cooldown = 0
    self.Behavior = data.Theme or "Default"

    if self.Humanoid then
        self.Humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            self.Enabled = false
        end)
    end

    return self
end

function BossAI:FindTarget()
    local closest
    local closestDist = math.huge

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local char = player.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and char.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            local dist = (char.HumanoidRootPart.Position - self.Root.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < closestDist then
                closestDist = dist
                closest = char
            end
        end
    end

    self.Target = closest
end

function BossAI:TakeDamage(amount)
    if not self.Enabled then return end
    if self.Humanoid then
        self.Humanoid:TakeDamage(amount)
        self.Health = self.Humanoid.Health
    else
        self.Health -= amount
        if self.Health <= 0 then
            self.Enabled = false
        end
    end
end

local function moveTowards(self, targetPos, speed, dt)
    if not self.Root then return end
    local dir = (targetPos - self.Root.Position)
    local dist = dir.Magnitude
    if dist < 1e-3 then return end
    dir = dir.Unit
    self.Root.CFrame = self.Root.CFrame + dir * speed * dt
end

function BossAI:Step(dt)
    if not self.Enabled then return end
    if not self.Target or not self.Target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        self:FindTarget()
        if not self.Target then return end
    end

    local targetHRP = self.Target.HumanoidRootPart
    local targetHum = self.Target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not targetHum or targetHum.Health <= 0 then
        self.Target = nil
        return
    end

    local dist = (targetHRP.Position - self.Root.Position).Magnitude
    self.Cooldown -= dt

    if self.Behavior == "Charge / Grease" then
        -- Sigma Hotdog behavior stub
        if dist > 15 then
            moveTowards(self, targetHRP.Position, 28, dt)
        else
            if self.Cooldown <= 0 then
                targetHum:TakeDamage(30)
                self.Cooldown = 2
            end
        end

    elseif self.Behavior == "Charm / Confuse" then
        -- Rizzlord: keep distance, do heavy hits up close
        if dist > 35 then
            moveTowards(self, targetHRP.Position, 18, dt)
        else
            if self.Cooldown <= 0 then
                targetHum:TakeDamage(40)
                self.Cooldown = 3
            end
        end

    else
        -- Default: just chase and hit
        if dist > 10 then
            moveTowards(self, targetHRP.Position, 20, dt)
        else
            if self.Cooldown <= 0 then
                targetHum:TakeDamage(20)
                self.Cooldown = 2
            end
        end
    end
end

return BossAI

-- ServerScriptService/BossManager.lua

local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Content = require(RS:WaitForChild("DeadRailsContent"))
local BossAI = require(RS:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("Entity"):WaitForChild("BossAI"))

local RemotesFolder = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local UpdateBoss = RemotesFolder:WaitForChild("UpdateBoss")

local BossManager = {}
BossManager.__index = BossManager

function BossManager:Init(GameCore)
    self.GameCore = GameCore
    self.ActiveBoss = nil
    self.ActiveBossData = nil

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        self:Step(dt)
    end)
end

function BossManager:SpawnBossById(bossId, spawnCFrame)
    if self.ActiveBoss then
        warn("[BossManager] Boss already active")
        return
    end

    local data
    for _, b in ipairs(Content.Bosses) do
        if b.Id == bossId then
            data = b
            break
        end
    end
    if not data then
        warn("[BossManager] Unknown boss id", bossId)
        return
    end

    local bossesFolder = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Bosses")
    local modelTemplate = bossesFolder:FindFirstChild(bossId)
    if not modelTemplate then
        warn("[BossManager] Missing boss model:", bossId)
        return
    end

    local model = modelTemplate:Clone()
    model.Parent = workspace
    model:MoveTo(spawnCFrame.Position)

    local ai = BossAI.new(model, data)
    self.ActiveBoss = ai
    self.ActiveBossData = data

    UpdateBoss:FireAllClients({
        Name = data.Name,
        Health = ai.Health,
        MaxHealth = ai.MaxHealth,
        Visible = true,
    })

    print("[BossManager] Spawned boss:", data.Name)
end

function BossManager:DespawnBoss()
    if not self.ActiveBoss then return end
    local model = self.ActiveBoss.Model
    if model and model.Parent then
        model:Destroy()
    end

    self.ActiveBoss = nil
    self.ActiveBossData = nil

    UpdateBoss:FireAllClients({ Visible = false })
end

function BossManager:Step(dt)
    if not self.ActiveBoss then return end
    local boss = self.ActiveBoss

    boss:Step(dt)

    UpdateBoss:FireAllClients({
        Name = self.ActiveBossData.Name,
        Health = boss.Health,
        MaxHealth = boss.MaxHealth,
        Visible = boss.Enabled,
    })

    if not boss.Enabled or boss.Health <= 0 then
        print("[BossManager] Boss defeated:", self.ActiveBossData.Name)
        self:DespawnBoss()
        -- reward logic hook here (loot, XP, etc.)
    end
end

return setmetatable({}, BossManager)

-- ReplicatedStorage/Shared/RizzMode.lua
-- ULTRA SAIYAN RIZZ SYSTEM

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local UpdateRizz = Remotes:WaitForChild("UpdateRizz")

local RizzMode = {}
RizzMode.__index = RizzMode

function RizzMode.new(player)
	local self = setmetatable({}, RizzMode)

	self.Player = player
	self.Rizz = 0
	self.MaxRizz = 100
	self.Active = false
	self.Cooldown = 0

	return self
end

-- External systems call this when:
--  - Headshot
--  - Emote
--  - Combo attack
--  - Boss kill
function RizzMode:Add(amount)
	if self.Active then return end
	if self.Cooldown > 0 then return end

	self.Rizz = math.clamp(self.Rizz + amount, 0, self.MaxRizz)

	UpdateRizz:FireClient(self.Player, { Rizz = self.Rizz, MaxRizz = self.MaxRizz })

	if self.Rizz >= self.MaxRizz then
		self:Activate()
	end
end

function RizzMode:Activate()
	self.Active = true
	self.Rizz = 0
	self.Duration = 8
	self.Boost = 1.25

	-- Tell client to start animation/FX
	UpdateRizz:FireClient(self.Player, { Rizz = 1, MaxRizz = 1 })

	-- Server stat buffs
	local char = self.Player.Character
	if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed *= self.Boost
	end
end

function RizzMode:Deactivate()
	if not self.Active then return end
	self.Active = false
	self.Cooldown = 10

	local char = self.Player.Character
	if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed /= self.Boost
	end

	UpdateRizz:FireClient(self.Player, { Rizz = 0, MaxRizz = self.MaxRizz })
end

function RizzMode:Step(dt)
	if self.Active then
		self.Duration -= dt
		if self.Duration <= 0 then
			self:Deactivate()
		end
	else
		if self.Cooldown > 0 then
			self.Cooldown -= dt
		end
	end
end

return RizzMode

-- ReplicatedStorage/Shared/SSMode.lua

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UpdateHUD = RS.Remotes:WaitForChild("UpdateHUD")

local SSMode = {}
SSMode.__index = SSMode

function SSMode.new(player)
	local self = setmetatable({}, SSMode)

	self.Player = player
	self.Active = false
	self.Time = 0
	self.MaxTime = 10
	self.Cooldown = 0

	return self
end

function SSMode:Activate()
	if self.Active or self.Cooldown > 0 then return end

	self.Active = true
	self.Time = 0
	self.MaxTime = 10

	-- Apply Buffs
	local char = self.Player.Character
	if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed *= 1.6
		char.Humanoid.JumpPower *= 1.3
	end

	-- Ammo bonus
	local dataEvent = self.Player:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
	if dataEvent then
		dataEvent.Ammo.Value += 12
	end

	-- Client UI update (SS Mode On)
	UpdateHUD:FireClient(self.Player, { SSActive = true })
end

function SSMode:Deactivate()
	if not self.Active then return end

	self.Active = false
	self.Cooldown = 20

	local char = self.Player.Character
	if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed /= 1.6
		char.Humanoid.JumpPower /= 1.3
	end

	UpdateHUD:FireClient(self.Player, { SSActive = false })
end

function SSMode:Step(dt)
	if self.Active then
		self.Time += dt
		if self.Time >= self.MaxTime then
			self:Deactivate()
		end
	else
		if self.Cooldown > 0 then
			self.Cooldown -= dt
		end
	end
end

return SSMode

-- ReplicatedStorage/Train/CarBuilder.lua
-- Handles train layout, car adding/removing, and car stats

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Content = require(RS:WaitForChild("DeadRailsContent"))

local CarBuilder = {}
CarBuilder.__index = CarBuilder

-- Quick index for cars by id
local CAR_INDEX = {}
for _, car in ipairs(Content.TrainCars) do
    CAR_INDEX[car.Id] = car
end

function CarBuilder.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, CarBuilder)

    -- Ordered list of car IDs, from front (engine) to back
    self.Layout = {
        "engine_car",
        "shield_car",
        "campfire_car",
        "armory_car",
        "barracks_car",
    }

    -- HP per car (you can tune these)
    self.CarHealth = {}
    for _, carId in ipairs(self.Layout) do
        self.CarHealth[carId] = 100
    end

    return self
end

function CarBuilder:GetCarData(carId)
    return CAR_INDEX[carId]
end

function CarBuilder:GetLayout()
    return self.Layout
end

function CarBuilder:AddCar(carId, positionIndex)
    if not CAR_INDEX[carId] then
        warn("[CarBuilder] Unknown car id:", carId)
        return false
    end
    if positionIndex then
        table.insert(self.Layout, positionIndex, carId)
    else
        table.insert(self.Layout, carId)
    end
    self.CarHealth[carId] = self.CarHealth[carId] or 100
    return true
end

function CarBuilder:RemoveCar(carId)
    for i, id in ipairs(self.Layout) do
        if id == carId then
            table.remove(self.Layout, i)
            self.CarHealth[carId] = nil
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function CarBuilder:DamageCar(carId, amount)
    if not self.CarHealth[carId] then return end
    self.CarHealth[carId] -= amount
    if self.CarHealth[carId] <= 0 then
        self.CarHealth[carId] = 0
        -- engine_car = run over
        if carId == "engine_car" then
            return "ENGINE_DESTROYED"
        end
    end
end

function CarBuilder:GetTotalArmor()
    local armor = 0
    for _, carId in ipairs(self.Layout) do
        local car = CAR_INDEX[carId]
        if car and car.Slot == "Defense" then
            armor += 10
        end
    end
    return armor
end

return CarBuilder

-- ServerScriptService/TrainRuntime.lua
-- Train movement + base HP + integration with CarBuilder

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local CarBuilder = require(RS:WaitForChild("Train"):WaitForChild("CarBuilder"))

local TrainRuntime = {}
TrainRuntime.__index = TrainRuntime

function TrainRuntime:Init(GameCore)
    self.GameCore = GameCore
    self.CarBuilder = CarBuilder.new()

    self.TrainModel = Workspace:WaitForChild("TrainModel")
    self.Speed = 24
    self.Distance = 0
    self.SegmentLength = 300  -- distance between towns
    self.NextTownAt = self.SegmentLength

    self.Running = true

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if self.Running then
            self:Step(dt)
        end
    end)
end

function TrainRuntime:GetTrainLayout()
    return self.CarBuilder:GetLayout()
end

function TrainRuntime:Step(dt)
    if not self.TrainModel or not self.TrainModel.PrimaryPart then return end

    -- Movement
    local moveDelta = Vector3.new(self.Speed * dt, 0, 0)
    self.TrainModel:TranslateBy(moveDelta)
    self.Distance += moveDelta.Magnitude

    -- Segment / town triggers
    if self.Distance >= self.NextTownAt then
        self.Distance = 0
        self.NextTownAt = self.SegmentLength
        if self.GameCore.SelectNextTown then
            self.GameCore:SelectNextTown()
        end
        -- notify TownRuntime that we've arrived
        local townRuntime = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("TownRuntime"))
        if townRuntime and townRuntime.OnTrainArrived then
            townRuntime:OnTrainArrived(self.GameCore:GetCurrentTown())
        end
    end
end

-- Called by zombie projectiles, boss attacks, hazards, etc.
function TrainRuntime:DamageFrontCar(amount)
    local layout = self.CarBuilder:GetLayout()
    local frontCarId = layout[1]
    if not frontCarId then return end

    local result = self.CarBuilder:DamageCar(frontCarId, amount)
    if result == "ENGINE_DESTROYED" then
        self.Running = false
        warn("[DeadRails] Engine destroyed. Run over.")
        -- hook game over logic here
    end
end

return setmetatable({}, TrainRuntime)

-- ReplicatedStorage/Towns/TownObjectives.lua
-- Core objective logic for town stops

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TownObjectives = {}

-- Each objective returns an "objectiveState" table with:
--  state.Start()     -- called on town arrival
--  state.Step(dt)    -- called every frame by TownRuntime
--  state.IsDone      -- bool
--  state.Success     -- bool (true = done and success)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- REFUEL: collect fuel items and bring them to the train
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function TownObjectives.Refuel(GameCore, town)
    local state = {
        Type = "Refuel",
        RequiredFuel = 5,
        Delivered = 0,
        IsDone = false,
        Success = false,
    }

    function state.Start()
        print("[TownObjectives] Refuel started at town:", town.Name)
        -- You can spawn fuel barrels around the map here
    end

    function state.Step(dt)
        if state.IsDone then return end
        -- In your real game, you'd track when players bring fuel to a trigger.
        -- Here it's a stub; call TownRuntime:MarkFuelDelivered() to bump Delivered.
        if state.Delivered >= state.RequiredFuel then
            state.IsDone = true
            state.Success = true
            print("[TownObjectives] Refuel success")
        end
    end

    return state
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CLEAR DEPOT: kill all enemies in an area
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function TownObjectives.ClearDepot(GameCore, town)
    local state = {
        Type = "ClearDepot",
        IsDone = false,
        Success = false,
        EnemiesRemaining = 20, -- placeholder; hook to EnemySpawner
    }

    function state.Start()
        print("[TownObjectives] ClearDepot started at:", town.Name)
        -- spawn enemies in depot region
    end

    function state.Step(dt)
        if state.IsDone then return end
        if state.EnemiesRemaining <= 0 then
            state.IsDone = true
            state.Success = true
            print("[TownObjectives] Depot cleared")
        end
    end

    return state
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- DEFEND TOWER: hold a point for fixed time
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function TownObjectives.DefendTower(GameCore, town)
    local state = {
        Type = "DefendTower",
        Timer = 60,
        IsDone = false,
        Success = false,
        TowerHealth = 100,
    }

    function state.Start()
        print("[TownObjectives] DefendTower started:", town.Name)
    end

    function state.Step(dt)
        if state.IsDone then return end
        state.Timer -= dt
        if state.TowerHealth <= 0 then
            state.IsDone = true
            state.Success = false
            print("[TownObjectives] Tower destroyed, failed")
        elseif state.Timer <= 0 then
            state.IsDone = true
            state.Success = true
            print("[TownObjectives] Tower defended successfully")
        end
    end

    return state
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SURVIVE TIMER: simple holdout for X seconds
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function TownObjectives.SurviveTimer(GameCore, town)
    local state = {
        Type = "SurviveTimer",
        Timer = 45,
        IsDone = false,
        Success = false,
    }

    function state.Start()
        print("[TownObjectives] SurviveTimer started:", town.Name)
    end

    function state.Step(dt)
        if state.IsDone then return end
        state.Timer -= dt
        if state.Timer <= 0 then
            state.IsDone = true
            state.Success = true
            print("[TownObjectives] Survive success")
        end
    end

    return state
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CLEANSE CHURCH: destroy X totems in a church
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function TownObjectives.CleanseChurch(GameCore, town)
    local state = {
        Type = "CleanseChurch",
        TotemsRequired = 3,
        TotemsDestroyed = 0,
        IsDone = false,
        Success = false,
    }

    function state.Start()
        print("[TownObjectives] CleanseChurch started:", town.Name)
        -- spawn/detect cursed totems in church
    end

    function state.Step(dt)
        if state.IsDone then return end
        if state.TotemsDestroyed >= state.TotemsRequired then
            state.IsDone = true
            state.Success = true
            print("[TownObjectives] Church cleansed")
        end
    end

    return state
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Utility: factory from string key
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function TownObjectives.CreateObjective(objectiveId, GameCore, town)
    if objectiveId == "Refuel" then
        return TownObjectives.Refuel(GameCore, town)
    elseif objectiveId == "ClearDepot" then
        return TownObjectives.ClearDepot(GameCore, town)
    elseif objectiveId == "DefendTower" then
        return TownObjectives.DefendTower(GameCore, town)
    elseif objectiveId == "SurviveTimer" then
        return TownObjectives.SurviveTimer(GameCore, town)
    elseif objectiveId == "CleanseChurch" then
        return TownObjectives.CleanseChurch(GameCore, town)
    else
        warn("[TownObjectives] Unknown objective id:", objectiveId)
        -- fallback to survive
        return TownObjectives.SurviveTimer(GameCore, town)
    end
end

return TownObjectives
5.2 TownRuntime.lua
Place: ServerScriptService/TownRuntime.lua
Coordinates town stops, pulls a random objective from the town’s ObjectivePool, runs it, then signals success/fail.

-- ServerScriptService/TownRuntime.lua
-- Manages town stops, objective lifecycle, and rewards

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Content = require(RS:WaitForChild("DeadRailsContent"))
local TownObjectives = require(RS:WaitForChild("Towns"):WaitForChild("TownObjectives"))

local TownRuntime = {}
TownRuntime.__index = TownRuntime

function TownRuntime:Init(GameCore)
    self.GameCore = GameCore
    self.ActiveTown = nil
    self.ActiveObjective = nil
    self.InTown = false
    self.ResultCallback = nil

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        self:Step(dt)
    end)
end

-- Called by TrainRuntime when train reaches a town
function TownRuntime:OnTrainArrived(town)
    print("[TownRuntime] Train arrived at town:", town and town.Name)
    self.ActiveTown = town
    self.InTown = true

    -- Pick objective from town.ObjectivePool
    local objectivePool = town.ObjectivePool or {"SurviveTimer"}
    local objId = objectivePool[math.random(1, #objectivePool)]

    self.ActiveObjective = TownObjectives.CreateObjective(objId, self.GameCore, town)
    if self.ActiveObjective.Start then
        self.ActiveObjective.Start()
    end

    -- You might want to freeze train movement here
end

function TownRuntime:Step(dt)
    if not self.InTown or not self.ActiveObjective then return end
    if self.ActiveObjective.Step then
        self.ActiveObjective.Step(dt)
    end

    if self.ActiveObjective.IsDone then
        self:OnObjectiveFinished(self.ActiveObjective.Success)
    end
end

function TownRuntime:OnObjectiveFinished(success)
    print("[TownRuntime] Objective finished. Success:", success)

    self.InTown = false

    if success then
        -- reward: loot, fuel, XP etc.
        -- integrate with LootSystem / XPSystem later
    else
        -- maybe small penalty, extra wave on departure, etc.
    end

    self.ActiveObjective = nil
    self.ActiveTown = nil

    -- tell TrainRuntime it can resume full speed if you paused it
end

-- Example hooks used by objectives:
function TownRuntime:MarkFuelDelivered()
    if self.ActiveObjective and self.ActiveObjective.Type == "Refuel" then
        self.ActiveObjective.Delivered += 1
        print("[TownRuntime] Fuel delivered:", self.ActiveObjective.Delivered, "/", self.ActiveObjective.RequiredFuel)
    end
end

function TownRuntime:DamageTower(amount)
    if self.ActiveObjective and self.ActiveObjective.Type == "DefendTower" then
        self.ActiveObjective.TowerHealth -= amount
        print("[TownRuntime] Tower HP:", self.ActiveObjective.TowerHealth)
    end
end

function TownRuntime:TotemDestroyed()
    if self.ActiveObjective and self.ActiveObjective.Type == "CleanseChurch" then
        self.ActiveObjective.TotemsDestroyed += 1
        print("[TownRuntime] Totems:", self.ActiveObjective.TotemsDestroyed, "/", self.ActiveObjective.TotemsRequired)
    end
end

return setmetatable({}, TownRuntime)

6️⃣ DAY 1–5 GAME LOOP — GameLoopManager.lua
Place: ServerScriptService/GameLoopManager.lua

Orchestrates:

Day count

Town arrival → objective → depart

Wave intensity scaling

Boss schedule for first 5 days

-- ServerScriptService/GameLoopManager.lua
-- Day 1–5 scripted loop for 99 Brains on the Dead Rails

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Content = require(RS:WaitForChild("DeadRailsContent"))

local GameLoopManager = {}
GameLoopManager.__index = GameLoopManager

function GameLoopManager:Init(GameCore, WaveManager, TrainRuntime, TownRuntime, BossManager)
	self.GameCore = GameCore
	self.WaveManager = WaveManager
	self.TrainRuntime = TrainRuntime
	self.TownRuntime = TownRuntime
	self.BossManager = BossManager

	self.Day = 1
	self.State = "ON_TRAIN" -- ON_TRAIN, IN_TOWN, BOSS_FIGHT, TRANSITION
	self.TimeInState = 0

	self.CurrentPlan = self:BuildDayPlan()

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		self:Step(dt)
	end)

	print("[GameLoop] Day 1–5 manager online.")
end

function GameLoopManager:BuildDayPlan()
	-- Hard-scripted structure for first 5 days.
	-- After Day 5 you can fall back to generic logic.
	local plans = {

		[1] = {
			-- Day 1: tutorial-lite, no boss
			TrainWaveCount = 2,
			TownObjectiveWeights = {"Refuel", "SurviveTimer"},
			BossId = nil,
		},

		[2] = {
			-- Day 2: more waves, simple boss
			TrainWaveCount = 3,
			TownObjectiveWeights = {"Refuel", "DefendTower"},
			BossId = "rizzlord_rails",
		},

		[3] = {
			-- Day 3: first real spike
			TrainWaveCount = 4,
			TownObjectiveWeights = {"ClearDepot", "DefendTower", "SurviveTimer"},
			BossId = "sigma_hotdog",
		},

		[4] = {
			-- Day 4: more mixed objectives
			TrainWaveCount = 4,
			TownObjectiveWeights = {"Refuel", "CleanseChurch", "ClearDepot"},
			BossId = "cornfield_rizzwarden",
		},

		[5] = {
			-- Day 5: mini-gauntlet
			TrainWaveCount = 5,
			TownObjectiveWeights = {"ClearDepot", "DefendTower", "SurviveTimer"},
			BossId = "skibidi_conductor",
		},
	}

	return plans
end

function GameLoopManager:GetCurrentDayPlan()
	return self.CurrentPlan[self.Day]
end

function GameLoopManager:AdvanceDay()
	self.Day += 1
	self.TimeInState = 0
	print("[GameLoop] Advancing to day:", self.Day)

	if self.Day > 5 then
		print("[GameLoop] Past Day 5 – switch to generic loop or endless mode.")
		-- Up to you: fall back to generic scaling or continue table expansion.
	end
end

function GameLoopManager:Step(dt)
	self.TimeInState += dt
	local plan = self:GetCurrentDayPlan()
	if not plan then return end

	if self.State == "ON_TRAIN" then
		-- We let WaveManager control spawn timing; we just set meta knobs
		self.WaveManager.BaseCount = 6 + self.Day * 2
		self.WaveManager.DifficultyScale = 1 + (self.Day - 1) * 0.15
		-- Town arrival is triggered by TrainRuntime via TownRuntime already.

		-- Simple rule: after N waves for this day, next town counts as "Day done".
		if not self.WaveManager.DayWaveCounter then
			self.WaveManager.DayWaveCounter = 0
		end

	elseif self.State == "IN_TOWN" then
		-- TownRuntime will run objective; we watch completion flag.
		-- For now we just rely on TownRuntime logging. Hooks can be added here.

	elseif self.State == "BOSS_FIGHT" then
		-- BossManager handles health & defeat; we listen to boss end.
	end
end

-- External hooks to be called from other systems (simple events to drive the loop)
function GameLoopManager:OnDayStart()
	self.State = "ON_TRAIN"
	self.TimeInState = 0
	print("[GameLoop] Day "..self.Day.." started.")
end

function GameLoopManager:OnTownEntered(town)
	self.State = "IN_TOWN"
	self.TimeInState = 0
	print("[GameLoop] Entered town for Day "..self.Day..": "..town.Name)
end

function GameLoopManager:OnTownObjectiveFinished(success)
	if not success then
		print("[GameLoop] Town failed. You can decide to punish or let them continue.")
	end

	local plan = self:GetCurrentDayPlan()
	if not plan then return end

	if plan.BossId then
		self.State = "BOSS_FIGHT"
		self.TimeInState = 0

		-- spawn boss at a pre-placed spawn point
		local spawnCF = CFrame.new(0, 10, 0)
		self.BossManager:SpawnBossById(plan.BossId, spawnCF)
	else
		-- no boss for this day, go to next day
		self:AdvanceDay()
		self:OnDayStart()
	end
end

function GameLoopManager:OnBossDefeated()
	print("[GameLoop] Boss defeated for Day "..self.Day)
	self.State = "TRANSITION"
	self.TimeInState = 0

	self:AdvanceDay()
	self:OnDayStart()
end

return setmetatable({}, GameLoopManager)

function Profiles.RandomByTier(tier)
	local pool = {}
	for _, data in pairs(Profiles) do
		if Content.EnemyTypes then
			-- find original tier
			for _, e in ipairs(Content.EnemyTypes) do
				if e.Id == data.Id and e.Tier == tier then
					table.insert(pool, data)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if #pool == 0 then
		-- fallback
		for _, data in pairs(Profiles) do
			table.insert(pool, data); break
		end
	end
	return pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
end

7.2 EnemySpawner.lua
Place: ReplicatedStorage/Modules/Entity/EnemySpawner.lua

Uses EnemyProfiles + ZombieAI and spawns enemies at spawners in Workspace.

-- ReplicatedStorage/Modules/Entity/EnemySpawner.lua

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local EnemyProfiles = require(RS.Modules.Entity:WaitForChild("EnemyProfiles"))
local ZombieAI = require(RS.Modules.Entity:WaitForChild("ZombieAI"))

local EnemySpawner = {}
EnemySpawner.__index = EnemySpawner

function EnemySpawner.new()
	local self = setmetatable({}, EnemySpawner)

	self.Spawners = {}  -- list of spawn points
	self.ActiveEnemies = {}

	-- Collect spawnpoints tagged "EnemySpawn" under Workspace.EnemySpawners
	local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("EnemySpawners")
	if root then
		for _, part in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				table.insert(self.Spawners, part)
			end
		end
	end

	return self
end

function EnemySpawner:GetRandomSpawn()
	if #self.Spawners == 0 then return nil end
	return self.Spawners[math.random(1, #self.Spawners)]
end

function EnemySpawner:SpawnEnemyById(enemyId)
	local profile = EnemyProfiles.Get(enemyId)
	if not profile then
		warn("[EnemySpawner] Unknown enemy id:", enemyId)
		return
	end

	local spawnPoint = self.GetRandomSpawn(self)
	if not spawnPoint then
		warn("[EnemySpawner] No spawn points found")
		return
	end

	-- models must be in ServerStorage/Enemies, named by enemy Id
	local enemyFolder = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Enemies")
	local template = enemyFolder:FindFirstChild(enemyId)
	if not template then
		warn("[EnemySpawner] Missing enemy model:", enemyId)
		return
	end

	local model = template:Clone()
	model.Parent = Workspace
	model:MoveTo(spawnPoint.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))

	local stats = {
		AttackRange = profile.AttackRange,
		AttackDamage = profile.AttackDamage,
		AttackCooldown = profile.AttackCooldown,
	}
	local ai = ZombieAI.new(model, stats)

	-- custom per-tag modifications (server side)
	if table.find(profile.Tags, "Exploder") then
		-- you can extend ZombieAI to support on-death AoE
	end
	if table.find(profile.Tags, "HazardTrail") then
		-- leave grease or acid on path (hook into hazards later)
	end

	table.insert(self.ActiveEnemies, {
		Profile = profile,
		AI = ai,
	})

	return ai
end

function EnemySpawner:Step(dt)
	for i = #self.ActiveEnemies, 1, -1 do
		local entry = self.ActiveEnemies[i]
		local ai = entry.AI
		if ai.Dead or not ai.Model or not ai.Model.Parent then
			table.remove(self.ActiveEnemies, i)
		else
			ai:Step(dt)
		end
	end
end

return EnemySpawner
7.3 Hook EnemySpawner into WaveManager.lua
Replace your previous WaveManager.lua with this upgraded version:

-- ServerScriptService/WaveManager.lua
-- Uses EnemySpawner + EnemyProfiles

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Content = require(RS:WaitForChild("DeadRailsContent"))
local EnemyProfiles = require(RS.Modules.Entity:WaitForChild("EnemyProfiles"))
local EnemySpawner = require(RS.Modules.Entity:WaitForChild("EnemySpawner"))

local WaveManager = {}
WaveManager.__index = WaveManager

function WaveManager:Init(GameCore)
	self.GameCore = GameCore
	self.Spawner = EnemySpawner.new()

	self.Wave = 1
	self.Timer = 0
	self.Interval = 35
	self.Running = true

	self.BaseCount = 8      -- scaled by GameLoop
	self.DifficultyScale = 1

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if self.Running then
			self:Step(dt)
			self.Spawner:Step(dt)
		end
	end)
end

function WaveManager:Step(dt)
	self.Timer += dt
	if self.Timer >= self.Interval then
		self.Timer = 0
		self:SpawnWave()
	end
end

function WaveManager:SpawnWave()
	print("[WaveManager] Spawning wave", self.Wave)

	local base = self.BaseCount or 8
	local count = math.floor(base * (1 + (self.Wave - 1) * 0.1) * self.DifficultyScale)

	for i = 1, count do
		local tier
		if self.Wave <= 2 then
			tier = 1
		elseif self.Wave <= 5 then
			tier = math.random(1,2)
		else
			tier = math.random(2,3)
		end
		local enemyProfile = EnemyProfiles.RandomByTier(tier)
		if enemyProfile then
			self.Spawner:SpawnEnemyById(enemyProfile.Id)
		end
	end

	-- every 5th wave → ask BossManager to spawn a boss (GameLoop may also handle this)
	if self.Wave % 5 == 0 then
		local bossList = Content.Bosses
		local BossManager = require(game.ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("BossManager"))
		local boss = bossList[((self.Wave / 5 - 1) % #bossList) + 1]
		local spawnCF = CFrame.new(0, 15, 0)
		BossManager:SpawnBossById(boss.Id, spawnCF)
	end

	self.Wave += 1
end

return setmetatable({}, WaveManager)

    -- RIZZ / SS SYNERGY
    ["rizz_booster"] = {
        Name = "Rizz Booster",
        RizzGainMult = 1.4,
    },
    ["ss_siphon"] = {
        Name = "SS Siphon",
        SSChargeOnHit = 0.2,
    },
}

-- Apply a list of modIds to base weapon data
function WeaponMods.Apply(baseWeapon, modIds)
    if not modIds or #modIds == 0 then
        return baseWeapon
    end

    local result = {}
    for k,v in pairs(baseWeapon) do
        result[k] = v
    end

    result.Tags = result.Tags or {}
    result.Mods = {}

    local function mult(field, factor)
        if result[field] then
            result[field] = result[field] * factor
        end
    end

    for _, id in ipairs(modIds) do
        local mod = WeaponMods.Definitions[id]
        if mod then
            table.insert(result.Mods, id)

            if mod.DamageMult then mult("Damage", mod.DamageMult) end
            if mod.HeadshotMult then
                result.HeadshotMult = (result.HeadshotMult or 1) * mod.HeadshotMult
            end
            if mod.FireRateMult then
                result.RPM = (result.RPM or 60) * mod.FireRateMult
            end
            if mod.RecoilMult then
                result.RecoilMult = (result.RecoilMult or 1) * mod.RecoilMult
            end
            if mod.MagBonus then
                result.MagSize = (result.MagSize or 24) + mod.MagBonus
            end
            if mod.ReserveBonusMult then
                result.ReserveMult = (result.ReserveMult or 1) * mod.ReserveBonusMult
            end
            if mod.RizzGainMult then
                result.RizzGainMult = (result.RizzGainMult or 1) * mod.RizzGainMult
            end
            if mod.SSChargeOnHit then
                result.SSChargeOnHit = (result.SSChargeOnHit or 0) + mod.SSChargeOnHit
            end
            if mod.Tag then
                table.insert(result.Tags, mod.Tag)
            end
        end
    end

    return result
end

return WeaponMods

-- ReplicatedStorage/Modules/Player/WeaponSystem.lua
-- Now supports WeaponMods while staying backward compatible

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Content = require(RS:WaitForChild("DeadRailsContent"))
local WeaponMods = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("WeaponMods"))

local WeaponSystem = {}
WeaponSystem.__index = WeaponSystem

function WeaponSystem.GetWeaponData(id)
    for _, w in ipairs(Content.Weapons) do
        if w.Id == id then
            return w
        end
    end
end

-- Optional mods: { "rail_piercer", "mag_extender", ... }
function WeaponSystem.GetEffectiveWeapon(id, mods)
    local base = WeaponSystem.GetWeaponData(id)
    if not base then return nil end
    if not mods or #mods == 0 then
        return base
    end
    return WeaponMods.Apply(base, mods)
end

-- Kept same signature, add optional mods param
function WeaponSystem.CalculateDamage(weaponId, headshot, mods)
    local w = WeaponSystem.GetEffectiveWeapon(weaponId, mods) or WeaponSystem.GetWeaponData(weaponId)
    if not w then return 0 end

    local dmg = w.Damage or 0
    if headshot then
        local headMult = w.HeadshotMult or 1.5
        dmg = dmg * headMult
    end

    return dmg
end

function WeaponSystem.GetFireDelay(weaponId, mods)
    local w = WeaponSystem.GetEffectiveWeapon(weaponId, mods) or WeaponSystem.GetWeaponData(weaponId)
    if not w or not w.RPM then return 0.5 end
    return 60 / w.RPM
end

return WeaponSystem

local function spawnHazardAt(position, hazardType)
    -- If you build a real Hazard system, call into it here.

        p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 255)
    end
    p.Parent = Workspace
    game.Debris:AddItem(p, 6)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- THEME: "Charge / Grease" (Sigma Hotdog)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function BossAbilities.ChargeGreaseStep(boss, dt)
    boss._abilityTimer = (boss._abilityTimer or 0) + dt
    boss._chargeCD = boss._chargeCD or 5
    boss._chargeState = boss._chargeState or "IDLE"

    if boss._chargeState == "IDLE" then
        boss._chargeCD -= dt
        if boss._chargeCD <= 0 and boss.Target and boss.Target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            boss._chargeState = "CHARGING"
            boss._chargeDir = (boss.Target.HumanoidRootPart.Position - boss.Root.Position).Unit
            boss._chargeTime = 1.5
        end

    elseif boss._chargeState == "CHARGING" then
        if boss._chargeTime > 0 then
            boss._chargeTime -= dt
            boss.Root.CFrame = boss.Root.CFrame + boss._chargeDir * 40 * dt
            spawnHazardAt(boss.Root.Position, "Grease")
        else
            boss._chargeState = "IDLE"
            boss._chargeCD = 7
        end
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- THEME: "Charm / Confuse" (Rizzlord of the Rails)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function BossAbilities.CharmConfuseStep(boss, dt)
    boss._charmCD = (boss._charmCD or 4) - dt
    if boss._charmCD > 0 then return end
    boss._charmCD = 6

    -- fake "charm": burst damage or camera shake hook
    if boss.Target and boss.Target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        boss.Target.Humanoid:TakeDamage(10)
        spawnHazardAt(boss.Root.Position, "Charm")
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- THEME: "Signals / Adds" (Skibidi Conductor)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function BossAbilities.SignalsAddsStep(boss, dt)
    boss._signalCD = (boss._signalCD or 5) - dt
    if boss._signalCD > 0 then return end
    boss._signalCD = 10

    -- Example: call enemy spawner for extra adds
    local EnemySpawner = require(RS.Modules.Entity:WaitForChild("EnemySpawner"))
    local spawner = EnemySpawner.new()
    spawner:SpawnEnemyById("rail_clinger")
    spawner:SpawnEnemyById("signal_screecher")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- THEME: "Totems / Buffs" (Cornfield Rizz Warden)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function BossAbilities.TotemsBuffsStep(boss, dt)
    boss._totemCD = (boss._totemCD or 8) - dt
    if boss._totemCD > 0 then return end
    boss._totemCD = 12

    local pos = boss.Root.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-20,20), 0, math.random(-20,20))
    spawnHazardAt(pos, "Charm")
    -- Ideally these represent buff totems; tie them to a buff system if needed.
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Default dispatcher
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function BossAbilities.StepByTheme(boss, dt, theme)
    if theme == "Charge / Grease" then
        BossAbilities.ChargeGreaseStep(boss, dt)
    elseif theme == "Charm / Confuse" then
        BossAbilities.CharmConfuseStep(boss, dt)
    elseif theme == "Signals / Adds" then
        BossAbilities.SignalsAddsStep(boss, dt)
    elseif theme == "Totems / Buffs" then
        BossAbilities.TotemsBuffsStep(boss, dt)
    else
        -- default: no special ability
    end
end

return BossAbilities

-- ReplicatedStorage/Modules/Entity/BossAI.lua
-- Boss logic + advanced abilities per Theme

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local BossAbilities = require(RS.Modules.Entity:WaitForChild("BossAbilities"))

local BossAI = {}
BossAI.__index = BossAI

function BossAI.new(model, data)
    local self = setmetatable({}, BossAI)

    self.Model = model
    self.Data = data
    self.Humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    self.Root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
    self.Health = (self.Humanoid and self.Humanoid.Health) or 1000
    self.MaxHealth = (self.Humanoid and self.Humanoid.MaxHealth) or self.Health
    self.Enabled = true
    self.Target = nil
    self.Cooldown = 0
    self.Behavior = data.Theme or "Default"

    if self.Humanoid then
        self.Humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            self.Enabled = false
        end)
    end

    return self
end

function BossAI:FindTarget()
    local closest
    local closestDist = math.huge

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local char = player.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and char.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            local dist = (char.HumanoidRootPart.Position - self.Root.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < closestDist then
                closestDist = dist
                closest = char
            end
        end
    end

    self.Target = closest
end

function BossAI:TakeDamage(amount)
    if not self.Enabled then return end
    if self.Humanoid then
        self.Humanoid:TakeDamage(amount)
        self.Health = self.Humanoid.Health
    else
        self.Health -= amount
        if self.Health <= 0 then
            self.Enabled = false
        end
    end
end

local function moveTowards(self, targetPos, speed, dt)
    if not self.Root then return end
    local dir = (targetPos - self.Root.Position)
    local dist = dir.Magnitude
    if dist < 1e-3 then return end
    dir = dir.Unit
    self.Root.CFrame = self.Root.CFrame + dir * speed * dt
end

function BossAI:Step(dt)
    if not self.Enabled then return end
    if not self.Target or not self.Target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        self:FindTarget()
        if not self.Target then return end
    end

    local targetHRP = self.Target.HumanoidRootPart
    local targetHum = self.Target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not targetHum or targetHum.Health <= 0 then
        self.Target = nil
        return
    end

    local dist = (targetHRP.Position - self.Root.Position).Magnitude
    self.Cooldown -= dt

    -- Baseline chase / attack
    local baseSpeed = 20
    if dist > 12 then
        moveTowards(self, targetHRP.Position, baseSpeed, dt)
    else
        if self.Cooldown <= 0 then
            targetHum:TakeDamage(20)
            self.Cooldown = 2
        end
    end

    -- Ability overlay per theme
    BossAbilities.StepByTheme(self, dt, self.Behavior)
end

return BossAI

        AttackCooldown = profile.AttackCooldown,

function ZombieAI:Step(dt)
    if self.Dead then return end
    if not self.Target then self:FindTarget() end
    if not self.Target then return end

    local targetHRP = self.Target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHRP then return end

    local myRoot = self.Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    local distance = (targetHRP.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
    local attackRange = self.Stats.AttackRange or 4
    local damage = self.Stats.AttackDamage or 8
    local cdBase = self.Stats.AttackCooldown or 1.6

    -- personality tweaks
    local personality = self.Personality
    local cd = cdBase

    if personality == "Aggressive" then
        cd = cdBase * 0.8
    elseif personality == "Coward" then
        -- run away if low HP
        if self.Humanoid.Health < (self.Humanoid.MaxHealth * 0.4) then
            local away = (myRoot.Position - targetHRP.Position).Unit
            self.Humanoid:MoveTo(myRoot.Position + away * 10)
            self.Cooldown -= dt
            return
        end
    elseif personality == "Chaotic" then
        -- slight random drifting
        if math.random() < 0.2 then
            local randomOffset = Vector3.new(
                math.random(-5,5),
                0,
                math.random(-5,5)
            )
            self.Humanoid:MoveTo(myRoot.Position + randomOffset)
        end
    elseif personality == "Sneaky" then
        -- stays a bit further away before attacking
        attackRange = attackRange + 2
    end

    if distance > attackRange then
        self.Humanoid:MoveTo(targetHRP.Position)
    else
        if self.Cooldown <= 0 then
            local hum = self.Target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                hum:TakeDamage(damage)
            end
            self.Cooldown = cd
        end
    end

    self.Cooldown -= dt
end

Our game is a survival game on a scary train. The train moves through empty towns and dark places. Players must protect the train from zombies and brainrot monsters. If the train is destroyed, the run is over.

Trò chơi của chúng tôi là một game sinh tồn trên một chuyến tàu đáng sợ. Con tàu chạy qua các thị trấn bỏ hoang và những nơi tối tăm. Người chơi phải bảo vệ con tàu khỏi zombie và quái vật brainrot. Nếu tàu bị phá hủy, ván chơi sẽ kết thúc.

2.
EN:
You can choose different classes, like sniper, medic, builder, or fighter. Each class has its own weapon and special power. You can work together with your friends and use your different roles to survive longer.

VI:
Bạn có thể chọn nhiều lớp nhân vật khác nhau, như xạ thủ, cứu thương, thợ sửa, hoặc đấu sĩ. Mỗi lớp có vũ khí và kỹ năng đặc biệt riêng. Bạn có thể phối hợp với bạn bè và dùng các vai trò khác nhau để sống sót lâu hơn.

3.
EN:
The train is your moving home base. You can add train cars like armory, medbay, campfire, or turret car. These cars help you heal, get weapons, and defend the train better as the game gets harder.

VI:
Con tàu là căn cứ di động của bạn. Bạn có thể thêm các toa tàu như kho vũ khí, phòng y tế, toa lửa trại, hoặc toa súng tự động. Những toa này giúp bạn hồi máu, lấy vũ khí, và bảo vệ con tàu tốt hơn khi trò chơi ngày càng khó.

4.
EN:
Sometimes the train stops at towns. In each town, you have a mission. You might need to refuel the train, defend a tower, cleanse a church, or clear all zombies in an area. If you finish the mission, you get rewards and the train becomes stronger.

VI:
Thỉnh thoảng tàu sẽ dừng ở các thị trấn. Ở mỗi thị trấn, bạn có một nhiệm vụ. Bạn có thể phải đổ nhiên liệu cho tàu, bảo vệ một cái tháp, thanh tẩy nhà thờ, hoặc dọn sạch zombie trong một khu vực. Nếu hoàn thành nhiệm vụ, bạn sẽ nhận phần thưởng và con tàu sẽ mạnh hơn.

5.
EN:
Each new day and each new wave makes the zombies stronger and faster. Bosses like Rizzlord or Sigma Hotdog are very dangerous and need teamwork to defeat. The goal is simple: stay alive, protect the train, and survive the brainrot as long as you can.

VI:
Mỗi ngày mới và mỗi đợt tấn công mới làm zombie mạnh hơn và nhanh hơn. Các trùm như Rizzlord hoặc Sigma Hotdog rất nguy hiểm và cần cả đội hợp tác để đánh bại. Mục tiêu rất đơn giản: sống sót, bảo vệ con tàu, và chống lại brainrot lâu nhất có thể.

local function setupAdminCommands()
    local Remotes = RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    if not Remotes then return end
    
    -- Create admin remote
    local adminRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
    adminRemote.Name = "AdminCommand"
    adminRemote.Parent = Remotes
    
    adminRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, command, ...)
        local args = {...}
        
        -- Check if player is admin (implement your own system)
        if not player:GetRankInGroup(0) >= 255 then return end -- Example check
        
        if command == "spawnwave" then
            waveManager:StartWave()
            
        elseif command == "spawnboss" then
            local bossId = args[1] or "rizzlord_rails"
            local spawnCF = CFrame.new(0, 20, 0)
            bossManager:SpawnBossById(bossId, spawnCF)
            
        elseif command == "giverizz" then
            local data = playerRuntime.PlayerData[player]
            if data then
                data.RizzMode:AddRizz(100)
            end
            
        elseif command == "givess" then
            local data = playerRuntime.PlayerData[player]
            if data then
                data.SSMode:Activate()
            end
            
        elseif command == "givecoins" then
            local amount = tonumber(args[1]) or 1000
            GameCore:AwardCoins(player, amount, "Admin Command")
            
        elseif command == "nextday" then
            gameLoopManager:AdvanceDay()
            gameLoopManager:OnDayStart()
            
        elseif command == "heal" then
            local char = player.Character
            if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                char.Humanoid.Health = char.Humanoid.MaxHealth
            end
            
        elseif command == "killall" then
            waveManager.Spawner:ClearAll()
        end
    end)
end

setupAdminCommands()

-- ANALYTICS & PERFORMANCE MONITORING

local function startAnalytics()
    local startTime = os.clock()
    local frameCount = 0
    
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        frameCount += 1
        
        -- Log stats every 60 seconds
        if frameCount % (60 * 60) == 0 then
            local uptime = os.clock() - startTime
            local playerCount = #Players:GetPlayers()
            local activeEnemies = waveManager.Spawner:GetActiveCount()
            local currentWave = waveManager.Wave
            local currentDay = GameCore.Day
            
            print(string.format(
                "[Analytics] Uptime: %ds | Players: %d | Wave: %d | Day: %d | Enemies: %d",
                math.floor(uptime), playerCount, currentWave, currentDay, activeEnemies
            ))
        end
    end)
end

startAnalytics()

end

        -- Advance day
        if dayTimer >= dayLength then

        end
    end)
end

    while true do
        task.wait(math.random(300, 600)) -- Every 5-10 minutes
        
        local eventRoll = math.random()
        
        if eventRoll < 0.3 then
            -- Supply drop event
            print("🎁 SUPPLY DROP EVENT!")
            -- Spawn supply crates around the map
            
        elseif eventRoll < 0.5 then
            -- Blood moon (extra enemies)
            print("🌙 BLOOD MOON! Extra enemies incoming!")
            waveManager.DifficultyScale = 1.5
            task.wait(120)
            waveManager.DifficultyScale = 1
            
        elseif eventRoll < 0.7 then
            -- Double XP event
            print("⚡ DOUBLE XP EVENT!")
            -- Would modify XP rates temporarily
        end
    end
end

local function setupErrorHandling()
    local function safeCall(func, name)
        local success, err = pcall(func)
        if not success then
            warn(string.format("[ERROR] %s failed: %s", name, tostring(err)))
            
            -- Log to analytics service
            -- Could integrate with external logging
        end
    end
    
    -- Wrap critical functions
    local originalWaveStep = waveManager.Step
    waveManager.Step = function(...)
        safeCall(function() originalWaveStep(...) end, "WaveManager.Step")
    end
end

## 📦 PHASE 8B: GAME LOOP MANAGER (ORCHESTRATES EVERYTHING)

### **ServerScriptService/GameLoopManager**

lua
-- GameLoopManager.lua
-- MASTER GAME FLOW ORCHESTRATOR - DAY 1 TO 99 COMPLETE EXPERIENCE

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Content = require(RS:WaitForChild("DeadRailsContent"))

local GameLoopManager = {}
GameLoopManager.__index = GameLoopManager

function GameLoopManager.new(GameCore, WaveManager, TrainRuntime, TownRuntime, BossManager)
    local self = setmetatable({}, GameLoopManager)
    
    self.GameCore = GameCore
    self.WaveManager = WaveManager
    self.TrainRuntime = TrainRuntime
    self.TownRuntime = TownRuntime
    self.BossManager = BossManager
    
    self.Day = 1
    self.MaxDays = 99
    self.State = "STARTING" -- STARTING, ON_TRAIN, IN_TOWN, BOSS_FIGHT, INTERMISSION
    self.StateTimer = 0
    
    -- Day progression
    self.WavesPerDay = 5
    self.CurrentDayWaves = 0
    
    return self
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- DAY ADVANCEMENT
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameLoopManager:AdvanceDay()
    self.Day += 1
    self.CurrentDayWaves = 0
    self.StateTimer = 0
    
    self.GameCore.Day = self.Day
    
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════")
    print("        🌅 DAY", self.Day, "BEGINS! 🌅")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════")
    
    if self.Day > self.MaxDays then
        self:OnVictory()
        return
    end
    
    -- Notify players
    self:NotifyPlayers(
        "🌅 DAY " .. self.Day .. " 🌅",
        "Survive the day!",
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
    )
    
    -- Scale difficulty
    self.WaveManager.DifficultyScale = 1 + (self.Day - 1) * 0.15
    
    -- Day milestones
    if self.Day == 5 then
        self:NotifyPlayers("🎉 DAY 5 MILESTONE!", "Difficulty increases!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0))
    elseif self.Day == 10 then
        self:NotifyPlayers("🔥 DAY 10 MILESTONE!", "Elite enemies unlocked!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
        self:UnlockEliteEnemies()
    elseif self.Day == 25 then
        self:NotifyPlayers("💎 DAY 25 MILESTONE!", "Legendary rewards available!", Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 255))
    elseif self.Day == 50 then
        self:NotifyPlayers("⚡ DAY 50 MILESTONE!", "ULTRA MODE ACTIVATED!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255))
        self:ActivateUltraMode()
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STATE MACHINE
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameLoopManager:Step(dt)
    self.StateTimer += dt
    
    if self.State == "STARTING" then
        -- Tutorial/intro phase
        if self.StateTimer > 5 then
            self:OnDayStart()
        end
        
    elseif self.State == "ON_TRAIN" then
        -- Normal gameplay on moving train
        -- WaveManager handles spawning
        
        -- Check if day waves complete
        if self.CurrentDayWaves >= self.WavesPerDay then
            self:TransitionToTown()
        end
        
    elseif self.State == "IN_TOWN" then
        -- TownRuntime handles objectives
        -- Automatically transitions via callbacks
        
    elseif self.State == "BOSS_FIGHT" then
        -- BossManager handles fight
        -- Transitions via OnBossDefeated callback
        
    elseif self.State == "INTERMISSION" then
        -- Rest period between days
        if self.StateTimer > 10 then
            self:AdvanceDay()
            self:OnDayStart()
        end
    end
end

function GameLoopManager:OnDayStart()
    self.State = "ON_TRAIN"
    self.StateTimer = 0
    self.CurrentDayWaves = 0
    
    print("[GameLoop] Day", self.Day, "gameplay begins")
    
    -- Update UI
    self:UpdateUI()
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TOWN TRANSITION
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameLoopManager:TransitionToTown()
    print("[GameLoop] Transitioning to town...")
    
    self.State = "IN_TOWN"
    self.StateTimer = 0
    
    -- Train will auto-stop at town via TrainRuntime
end

function GameLoopManager:OnTownComplete(success)
    print("[GameLoop] Town objective complete. Success:", success)
    
    -- Boss wave check
    if self.Day % 5 == 0 then
        self:TransitionToBoss()
    else
        -- End of day
        self:TransitionToIntermission()
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BOSS FIGHT
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameLoopManager:TransitionToBoss()
    print("[GameLoop] Boss fight incoming!")
    
    self.State = "BOSS_FIGHT"
    self.StateTimer = 0
    
    -- BossManager already handles spawning via WaveManager
    -- This just changes state
end

function GameLoopManager:OnBossDefeated()
    print("[GameLoop] Boss defeated! Day complete.")
    
    -- Massive rewards
    self:AwardDayCompletion()
    
    -- Next day
    self:TransitionToIntermission()
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- INTERMISSION
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameLoopManager:TransitionToIntermission()
    print("[GameLoop] Intermission - rest & prepare")
    
    self.State = "INTERMISSION"
    self.StateTimer = 0
    
    self:NotifyPlayers(
        "✅ DAY " .. self.Day .. " COMPLETE!",
        "Next day in 10 seconds...",
        Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
    )
    
    -- Heal all players
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local char = player.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            char.Humanoid.Health = char.Humanoid.MaxHealth
        end
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- REWARDS
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameLoopManager:AwardDayCompletion()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local coinReward = 1000 * self.Day
        local xpReward = 500 * self.Day
        local brainCellReward = 5 * self.Day
        
        self.GameCore:AwardCoins(player, coinReward, "Day Complete")
        self.GameCore:AwardXP(player, xpReward, "Day Complete")
        
        local data = self.GameCore:GetPlayerData(player)
        if data then
            data.BrainCells += brainCellReward
            
            -- Track highest day
            if self.Day > (data.HighestDay or 0) then
                data.HighestDay = self.Day
                
                -- Update leaderboard
                if player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") then
                    player.leaderstats.Day.Value = self.Day
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SPECIAL MODES
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameLoopManager:UnlockEliteEnemies()
    -- Increase elite spawn chance
    print("[GameLoop] Elite enemies now spawning!")
end

function GameLoopManager:ActivateUltraMode()
    -- Day 50+ ultra difficulty
    self.WaveManager.IntensityMultiplier = 2
    self.WaveManager.DifficultyScale = 2
    
    print("[GameLoop] ULTRA MODE ACTIVATED - MAXIMUM DIFFICULTY!")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- VICTORY (REACH DAY 99)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameLoopManager:OnVictory()
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════")
    print("     🏆 GAME COMPLETE - YOU SURVIVED! 🏆")
    print("═══════════════════════════════════════════════")
    
    self.State = "VICTORY"
    
    -- Notify all players
    self:NotifyPlayers(
        "🏆 VICTORY! 🏆",
        "YOU SURVIVED 99 DAYS!",
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
    )
    
    -- Massive final rewards
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        self.GameCore:AwardCoins(player, 50000, "VICTORY")
        
        local data = self.GameCore:GetPlayerData(player)
        if data then
            data.BrainCells += 500
        end
    end
    
    -- Stop all systems
    self.WaveManager.Running = false
    self.TrainRuntime.Running = false
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CALLBACKS (CALLED FROM OTHER SYSTEMS)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameLoopManager:OnWaveComplete()
    self.CurrentDayWaves += 1
    print("[GameLoop] Wave complete. Progress:", self.CurrentDayWaves, "/", self.WavesPerDay)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- NOTIFICATIONS
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameLoopManager:NotifyPlayers(title, subtitle, color)
    local Remotes = RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    if not Remotes then return end
    
    local notifyRemote = Remotes:FindFirstChild("GameNotification")
    if not notifyRemote then
        notifyRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
        notifyRemote.Name = "GameNotification"
        notifyRemote.Parent = Remotes
    end
    
    notifyRemote:FireAllClients(title, subtitle, color)
end

function GameLoopManager:UpdateUI()
    local Remotes = RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    if not Remotes then return end
    
    local updateRemote = Remotes:FindFirstChild("UpdateHUD")
    if not updateRemote then return end
    
    updateRemote:FireAllClients({
        Day = self.Day,
        Wave = self.WaveManager.Wave
    })
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- INIT
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function GameLoopManager:Init()
    -- Hook into wave completion
    self.WaveManager.OnWaveComplete = function()
        self:OnWaveComplete()
    end
    
    -- Start game
    task.delay(5, function()
        self:OnDayStart()
    end)
    
    -- Main loop
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        self:Step(dt)
    end)
    
    print("[GameLoopManager] Initialized - Game starts in 5 seconds")
end

return GameLoopManager

## 📦 PHASE 8C: NOTIFICATION SYSTEM (CLIENT)

### **StarterPlayerScripts/NotificationController**

lua
-- NotificationController.lua
-- BEAUTIFUL IN-GAME NOTIFICATION SYSTEM

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Create notification GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "NotificationSystem"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local notificationContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
notificationContainer.Name = "Container"
notificationContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 1, 0)
notificationContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0, 0)
notificationContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
notificationContainer.Parent = screenGui

local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
listLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
listLayout.Parent = notificationContainer

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- NOTIFICATION CREATION
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local function createNotification(title, subtitle, color, duration)
    duration = duration or 5
    color = color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    
    -- Frame
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 100)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 3
    frame.BorderColor3 = color
    frame.Parent = notificationContainer
    
    -- Corner
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    corner.Parent = frame
    
    -- Title
    local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
    titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
    titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    titleLabel.TextSize = 24
    titleLabel.TextColor3 = color
    titleLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    titleLabel.Text = title
    titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    titleLabel.Parent = frame
    
    -- Subtitle
    local subtitleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    subtitleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
    subtitleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
    subtitleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    subtitleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    subtitleLabel.TextSize = 18
    subtitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    subtitleLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
    subtitleLabel.Text = subtitle
    subtitleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    subtitleLabel.Parent = frame
    
    -- Slide in animation
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    local slideIn = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    })
    slideIn:Play()
    
    -- Auto-remove
    task.delay(duration, function()
        local slideOut = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
            Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
        })
        slideOut:Play()
        slideOut.Completed:Wait()
        frame:Destroy()
    end)
    
    -- Sound effect
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://6114974207"
    sound.Volume = 0.3
    sound.Parent = frame
    sound:Play()
    game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(sound, 2)
end

## 📦 PHASE 8D: PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZER

### **ServerScriptService/PerformanceOptimizer**

lua
-- PerformanceOptimizer.lua
-- KEEPS THE GAME RUNNING SMOOTH EVEN WITH TONS OF ENEMIES

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PerformanceOptimizer = {}

-- Settings
local MAX_ZOMBIES_RENDERED = 50
local CULL_DISTANCE = 200
local UPDATE_INTERVAL = 1

local timer = 0

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- DISTANCE CULLING
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local function optimizeZombies()
    local players = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()
    if #players == 0 then return end
    
    -- Find all zombie models
    local zombies = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and obj.Name ~= "TrainModel" then
            table.insert(zombies, obj)
        end
    end
    
    -- Cull distant zombies
    for _, zombie in ipairs(zombies) do
        local hrp = zombie:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            local closestDist = math.huge
            
            for _, player in ipairs(players) do
                local char = player.Character
                if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local dist = (char.HumanoidRootPart.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < closestDist then
                        closestDist = dist
                    end
                end
            end
            
            -- Disable if too far
            if closestDist > CULL_DISTANCE then
                -- Disable rendering but keep AI
                for _, part in ipairs(zombie:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        part.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            else
                -- Re-enable
                for _, part in ipairs(zombie:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                        part.CanCollide = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- MEMORY CLEANUP
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local function cleanupDebris()
    -- Remove old particles, effects, etc.
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("Part") and obj:GetAttribute("Debris") then
            obj:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- MAIN LOOP
---------------------------------------------------------------------

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    timer += dt
    
    if timer >= UPDATE_INTERVAL then
        timer = 0
        optimizeZombies()
        cleanupDebris()
    end
end)

print("[PerformanceOptimizer] Running")

return PerformanceOptimizer

## 📦 PHASE 8E: SAVE/LOAD DATA SYSTEM (FINAL)

### **ServerScriptService/SaveData**

lua
-- SaveData.lua
-- COMPLETE SAVE/LOAD SYSTEM WITH DATASTORES

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local SaveData = {}
SaveData.__index = SaveData

local PlayerDataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("BrainrotPlayerData_v1")

function SaveData.new(GameCore)
    local self = setmetatable({}, SaveData)
    self.GameCore = GameCore
    return self
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SAVE PLAYER DATA
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function SaveData:SavePlayer(player)
    local data = self.GameCore:GetPlayerData(player)
    if not data then return end
    
    local saveData = {
        -- Progression
        Level = data.Level,
        XP = data.XP,
        Coins = data.Coins,
        BrainCells = data.BrainCells,
        PrestigeLevel = data.PrestigeLevel,
        
        -- Unlocks
        UnlockedClasses = data.UnlockedClasses,
        UnlockedWeapons = data.UnlockedWeapons,
        Cosmetics = data.Cosmetics,
        
        -- Stats
        HighestDay = data.HighestDay,
        TotalKills = data.TotalKills,
        TotalBossKills = data.TotalBossKills,
        
        -- Streak
        LoginStreak = data.LoginStreak,
        LastLogin = os.time(),
        
        -- Timestamp
        SavedAt = os.time()
    }
    
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        PlayerDataStore:SetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, saveData)
    end)
    
    if success then
        print("💾 Saved data for", player.Name)
    else
        warn("❌ Save failed for", player.Name, ":", err)
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- LOAD PLAYER DATA
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function SaveData:LoadPlayer(player)
    local success, saveData = pcall(function()
        return PlayerDataStore:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
    end)
    
    if not success or not saveData then
        print("📁 No save data found for", player.Name, "- Using defaults")
        return
    end
    
    local data = self.GameCore:GetPlayerData(player)
    if not data then return end
    
    -- Restore data
    data.Level = saveData.Level or 1
    data.XP = saveData.XP or 0
    data.Coins = saveData.Coins or 0
    data.BrainCells = saveData.BrainCells or 0
    data.PrestigeLevel = saveData.PrestigeLevel or 0
    
    data.UnlockedClasses = saveData.UnlockedClasses or {"railrunner"}
    data.UnlockedWeapons = saveData.UnlockedWeapons or {"pump_shotgun"}
    data.Cosmetics = saveData.Cosmetics or {}
    
    data.HighestDay = saveData.HighestDay or 0
    data.TotalKills = saveData.TotalKills or 0
    data.TotalBossKills = saveData.TotalBossKills or 0
    
    data.LoginStreak = saveData.LoginStreak or 0
    data.LastLogin = saveData.LastLogin or 0
    
    print("✅ Loaded data for", player.Name)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- INIT
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function SaveData:Init()
    -- Save on player leave
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
        self:SavePlayer(player)
    end)
    
    -- Auto-save every 2 minutes (handled in ServerMain)
    
    print("[SaveData] Initialized")
end

return SaveData
