## 📦 REMASTERED PHASE 2: ULTIMATE ABILITY SYSTEM

### **ReplicatedStorage/Modules/Player/UltimateSystem**

lua
-- UltimateSystem.lua
-- 🔥 ULTIMATE ABILITY SYSTEM FOR ALL 20 CLASSES 🔥

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Content = require(RS:WaitForChild("DeadRailsContent"))

local UltimateSystem = {}
UltimateSystem.__index = UltimateSystem

function UltimateSystem.new(player, classId)
    local self = setmetatable({}, UltimateSystem)
    
    self.Player = player
    self.ClassId = classId
    
    -- Get class ultimate data
    local classData = self:GetClassData()
    if not classData or not classData.Ultimate then
        warn("[UltimateSystem] No ultimate found for class:", classId)
        return nil
    end
    
    self.UltimateData = classData.Ultimate
    
    -- Charge system
    self.Charge = 0
    self.MaxCharge = 100
    self.Active = false
    self.Cooldown = 0
    self.CooldownMax = self.UltimateData.Cooldown or 60
    
    return self
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CLASS DATA LOOKUP
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function UltimateSystem:GetClassData()
    for _, class in ipairs(Content.Classes) do
        if class.Id == self.ClassId then
            return class
        end
    end
    return nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CHARGE SYSTEM
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function UltimateSystem:AddCharge(amount)
    if self.Active or self.Cooldown > 0 then return end
    
    self.Charge = math.clamp(self.Charge + amount, 0, self.MaxCharge)
    
    if self.Charge >= self.MaxCharge then
        self:NotifyReady()
    end
    
    self:UpdateUI()
end

function UltimateSystem:NotifyReady()
    local Remotes = RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    if not Remotes then return end
    
    local notifyRemote = Remotes:FindFirstChild("UltReady")
    if not notifyRemote then
        notifyRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
        notifyRemote.Name = "UltReady"
        notifyRemote.Parent = Remotes
    end
    
    notifyRemote:FireClient(self.Player, self.UltimateData.Name)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ACTIVATION
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function UltimateSystem:Activate()
    if self.Active then return false end
    if self.Charge < self.MaxCharge then return false end
    if self.Cooldown > 0 then return false end
    
    self.Active = true
    self.Charge = 0
    self.Cooldown = self.CooldownMax
    
    print("[Ultimate]", self.Player.Name, "activated", self.UltimateData.Name)
    
    -- Execute ultimate based on class
    self:ExecuteUltimate()
    
    -- Auto-deactivate after duration
    if self.UltimateData.Duration > 0 then
        task.delay(self.UltimateData.Duration, function()
            self:Deactivate()
        end)
    else
        -- Instant ultimates
        self:Deactivate()
    end
    
    return true
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ULTIMATE EXECUTION (CLASS-SPECIFIC)
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function UltimateSystem:ExecuteUltimate()
    local class = self.ClassId
    
    if class == "railrunner" then
        self:Ult_BulletTime()
    elseif class == "skibidi_hunter" then
        self:Ult_SkibidiSlayer()
    elseif class == "sigma_survivor" then
        self:Ult_Invincible()
    elseif class == "rizz_medic" then
        self:Ult_DivineHeal()
    elseif class == "crossbow_cowboy" then
        self:Ult_DeadEye()
    elseif class == "midwest_mechanic" then
        self:Ult_EmergencyRepair()
    elseif class == "hotdog_berserker" then
        self:Ult_HotdogFury()
    elseif class == "fanum_collector" then
        self:Ult_FanumTax()
    elseif class == "conductor_warden" then
        self:Ult_TrainShield()
    elseif class == "cornfield_ranger" then
        self:Ult_ArrowStorm()
    elseif class == "ohio_glitcher" then
        self:Ult_RealityGlitch()
    elseif class == "delulu_prophet" then
        self:Ult_Manifestation()
    elseif class == "sheriff_nowhere" then
        self:Ult_HighNoon()
    elseif class == "ghostlight_scout" then
        self:Ult_Reveal()
    elseif class == "silo_sniper" then
        self:Ult_OneShotOneKill()
    elseif class == "barnstorm_brawler" then
        self:Ult_GroundPound()
    elseif class == "rizzlord_trainee" then
        self:Ult_RizzOverflow()
    elseif class == "trackwalker_nomad" then
        self:Ult_SpeedDemon()
    elseif class == "spirit_caller" then
        self:Ult_SpiritGuardian()
    elseif class == "doom_driller" then
        self:Ult_TunnelBore()
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ULTIMATE IMPLEMENTATIONS
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function UltimateSystem:Ult_BulletTime()
    -- Slow all enemies
    for _, enemy in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if enemy:IsA("Model") and enemy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and enemy.Name ~= self.Player.Name then
            local humanoid = enemy.Humanoid
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed * 0.3
            
            task.delay(self.UltimateData.Duration, function()
                if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
                    humanoid.WalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed / 0.3
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

function UltimateSystem:Ult_SkibidiSlayer()
    -- Kill all Skibidi zombies in range
    local char = self.Player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
    
    for _, enemy in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if enemy:IsA("Model") and enemy.Name:find("skibidi") then
            local enemyHrp = enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if enemyHrp then
                local dist = (enemyHrp.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                if dist <= 30 then
                    local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                    if humanoid then
                        humanoid.Health = 0
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function UltimateSystem:Ult_Invincible()
    -- Make player invincible
    local char = self.Player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then return end
    
    char.Humanoid:SetAttribute("Invincible", true)
    
    -- Visual effect
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
            part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
        end
    end
end

function UltimateSystem:Ult_DivineHeal()
    -- Heal all nearby allies
    local char = self.Player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local targetChar = player.Character
        if targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and targetChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            local dist = (targetChar.HumanoidRootPart.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
            if dist <= 50 then
                targetChar.Humanoid.Health = targetChar.Humanoid.MaxHealth
            end
        end
    end
end

function UltimateSystem:Ult_DeadEye()
    -- Auto-headshot mode
    local char = self.Player.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    char:SetAttribute("AutoHeadshot", true)
    
    task.delay(self.UltimateData.Duration, function()
        if char and char.Parent then
            char:SetAttribute("AutoHeadshot", false)
        end
    end)
end

function UltimateSystem:Ult_EmergencyRepair()
    -- Repair all train cars
    local TrainRuntime = _G.BrainrotGame and _G.BrainrotGame.TrainRuntime
    if not TrainRuntime then return end
    
    for carId, health in pairs(TrainRuntime.CarBuilder.CarHealth) do
        local carData = TrainRuntime.CarBuilder:GetCarData(carId)
        if carData then
            TrainRuntime.CarBuilder.CarHealth[carId] = math.min(carData.HP, health + carData.HP * 0.5)
        end
    end
    
    print("[Ultimate] Emergency repair complete!")
end

function UltimateSystem:Ult_HotdogFury()
    -- Berserker mode
    local char = self.Player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then return end
    
    char:SetAttribute("BerserkerMode", true)
    char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed * 1.5
    
    -- Visual
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then
        local particle = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        particle.Name = "BerserkerAura"
        particle.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
        particle.Rate = 50
        particle.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1)
        particle.Parent = hrp
        
        task.delay(self.UltimateData.Duration, function()
            if particle and particle.Parent then
                particle:Destroy()
            end
        end)
    end
end

function UltimateSystem:Ult_FanumTax()
    -- Steal HP from all enemies
    local char = self.Player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
    local totalStolen = 0
    
    for _, enemy in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if enemy:IsA("Model") and enemy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and enemy.Name ~= self.Player.Name then
            local enemyHrp = enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if enemyHrp then
                local dist = (enemyHrp.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                if dist <= 40 then
                    local stolen = enemy.Humanoid.Health * 0.5
                    enemy.Humanoid.Health = enemy.Humanoid.Health * 0.5
                    totalStolen += stolen
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Heal player
    if char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        char.Humanoid.Health = math.min(char.Humanoid.MaxHealth, char.Humanoid.Health + totalStolen)
    end
end

-- ... (Continue for all 20 ultimates)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- DEACTIVATION
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function UltimateSystem:Deactivate()
    self.Active = false
    self:UpdateUI()
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- UPDATE LOOP
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function UltimateSystem:Step(dt)
    if self.Cooldown > 0 then
        self.Cooldown = math.max(0, self.Cooldown - dt)
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- UI UPDATE
---------------------------------------------------------------------

function UltimateSystem:UpdateUI()
    local Remotes = RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    if not Remotes then return end
    
    local updateRemote = Remotes:FindFirstChild("UpdateUlt")
    if not updateRemote then
        updateRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
        updateRemote.Name = "UpdateUlt"
        updateRemote.Parent = Remotes
    end
    
    updateRemote:FireClient(self.Player, {
        Charge = self.Charge,
        MaxCharge = self.MaxCharge,
        Cooldown = self.Cooldown,
        Active = self.Active,
        Name = self.UltimateData.Name
    })
end

return UltimateSystem

-- BrainrotGame.server.lua
-- MASTER BOOTSTRAP FOR: "TO SURVIVE A BRAINROT"
-- Safe monolith: orchestrates existing modules without deleting your architecture.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🌐 SERVICES
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🧱 SAFE REQUIRE HELPER
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function safeRequire(container, name, isOptional)
    local ok, result
    local obj = container:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not obj then
        if not isOptional then
            warn("[Brainrot] Missing module:", name, "in", container:GetFullName())
        end
        return nil
    end
    ok, result = pcall(require, obj)
    if not ok then
        warn("[Brainrot] Failed to require:", name, "->", result)
        return nil
    end
    return result
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 📦 CORE CONTENT + MODULES
---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Content DB (your DeadRailsContent ultimate version)
local Content = safeRequire(ReplicatedStorage, "DeadRailsContent", false)

-- Core logic / data (player data, coins/xp, save hooks, etc.)
local GameCore = safeRequire(ReplicatedStorage, "DeadRailsGameCore", true)

-- Save system
local SaveData = safeRequire(ServerScriptService, "SaveData", true)

-- Runtime systems
local WaveManagerModule      = safeRequire(ServerScriptService, "WaveManager", true)
local TrainRuntimeModule     = safeRequire(ServerScriptService, "TrainRuntime", true)
local TownRuntimeModule      = safeRequire(ServerScriptService, "TownRuntime", true)
local BossManagerModule      = safeRequire(ServerScriptService, "BossManager", true)
local PlayerRuntimeModule    = safeRequire(ServerScriptService, "PlayerRuntime", true)
local WeaponToolManagerModule= safeRequire(ServerScriptService, "WeaponToolManager", true)
local GameLoopManagerModule  = safeRequire(ServerScriptService, "GameLoopManager", true)
local PerformanceOptimizer   = safeRequire(ServerScriptService, "PerformanceOptimizer", true)
local UltimateSystemModule   = safeRequire(ReplicatedStorage, "UltimateSystem", true)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🔔 REMOTES SETUP (IDEMPOTENT)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local RemotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
if not RemotesFolder then
    RemotesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    RemotesFolder.Name = "Remotes"
    RemotesFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local function getOrCreateRemote(name, class)
    class = class or "RemoteEvent"
    local r = RemotesFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not r then
        r = Instance.new(class)
        r.Name = name
        r.Parent = RemotesFolder
    end
    return r
end

local RE_GameNotification  = getOrCreateRemote("GameNotification")
local RE_UpdateHUD         = getOrCreateRemote("UpdateHUD")
local RE_AdminCommand      = getOrCreateRemote("AdminCommand")
local RE_UltReady          = getOrCreateRemote("UltReady")
local RE_UpdateUlt         = getOrCreateRemote("UpdateUlt")
local RE_ClassSelected     = getOrCreateRemote("ClassSelected")
local RE_RequestRespawn    = getOrCreateRemote("RequestRespawn")

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🧠 INITIALIZE CORE SYSTEMS
---------------------------------------------------------------------
print("[Brainrot] Initializing core systems...")

if GameCore and GameCore.Init then
    GameCore:Init(Content)
end

local saveSystem
if SaveData and SaveData.new then
    saveSystem = SaveData.new(GameCore)
    if saveSystem.Init then
        saveSystem:Init()
    end
end

-- Runtimes
local trainRuntime
if TrainRuntimeModule and TrainRuntimeModule.new then
    trainRuntime = TrainRuntimeModule.new(GameCore)
    if trainRuntime.Init then trainRuntime:Init() end
end

local townRuntime
if TownRuntimeModule and TownRuntimeModule.new then
    townRuntime = TownRuntimeModule.new(GameCore, trainRuntime)
    if townRuntime.Init then townRuntime:Init() end
end

local bossManager
if BossManagerModule and BossManagerModule.new then
    bossManager = BossManagerModule.new(GameCore)
    if bossManager.Init then bossManager:Init() end
end

local waveManager
if WaveManagerModule and WaveManagerModule.new then
    waveManager = WaveManagerModule.new(GameCore)
    if waveManager.Init then waveManager:Init() end
end

local playerRuntime
if PlayerRuntimeModule and PlayerRuntimeModule.new then
    playerRuntime = PlayerRuntimeModule.new(GameCore, Content)
    if playerRuntime.Init then playerRuntime:Init() end
end

local weaponManager
if WeaponToolManagerModule and WeaponToolManagerModule.new then
    weaponManager = WeaponToolManagerModule.new(GameCore, Content)
    if weaponManager.Init then weaponManager:Init() end
end

local gameLoopManager
if GameLoopManagerModule and GameLoopManagerModule.new then
    gameLoopManager = GameLoopManagerModule.new(
        GameCore,
        waveManager,
        trainRuntime,
        townRuntime,
        bossManager
    )
    if gameLoopManager.Init then gameLoopManager:Init() end
end

if PerformanceOptimizer and PerformanceOptimizer.Start then
    PerformanceOptimizer.Start()
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🌍 GLOBAL HANDLE (FOR CROSS-SCRIPTS)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
_G.BrainrotGame = {
    Content         = Content,
    GameCore        = GameCore,
    SaveSystem      = saveSystem,
    WaveManager     = waveManager,
    TrainRuntime    = trainRuntime,
    TownRuntime     = townRuntime,
    BossManager     = bossManager,

    WeaponManager   = weaponManager,
    GameLoopManager = gameLoopManager,
    UltimateSystem  = UltimateSystemModule,
}

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 👥 PLAYER HANDLING
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function teleportToTrain(character)
    if not trainRuntime or not trainRuntime.EnginePart then return end
    local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then
        hrp.CFrame = trainRuntime.EnginePart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
    end
end

local function onCharacterAdded(player, character)
    print("[Brainrot] Character spawned for:", player.Name)

    -- Give starting weapon (class-based if available)
    task.defer(function()
        if weaponManager and weaponManager.GiveStartingWeapon then
            weaponManager:GiveStartingWeapon(player)
        end
    end)

    task.wait(0.5)
    teleportToTrain(character)

    -- Hook ultimates if system exists
    if UltimateSystemModule and playerRuntime and playerRuntime.GetPlayerClass then
        local classId = playerRuntime:GetPlayerClass(player) or "railrunner"
        local ult = UltimateSystemModule.new(player, classId)
        if ult then
            if not playerRuntime.Ultimates then
                playerRuntime.Ultimates = {}
            end
            playerRuntime.Ultimates[player] = ult
        end
    end
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
    print("[Brainrot] Player joined:", player.Name)

    -- Core data
    if GameCore and GameCore.OnPlayerAdded then
        GameCore:OnPlayerAdded(player)
    end

    -- Load save
    if saveSystem and saveSystem.LoadPlayer then
        saveSystem:LoadPlayer(player)
    end

    -- leaderstats (simple)
    local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
    leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
    leaderstats.Parent = player

    local vDay = Instance.new("IntValue")
    vDay.Name = "Day"
    vDay.Value = 0
    vDay.Parent = leaderstats

    local vKills = Instance.new("IntValue")
    vKills.Name = "Kills"
    vKills.Value = 0
    vKills.Parent = leaderstats

    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        onCharacterAdded(player, char)
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    print("[Brainrot] Player leaving:", player.Name)
    if saveSystem and saveSystem.SavePlayer then
        saveSystem:SavePlayer(player)
    end
    if GameCore and GameCore.OnPlayerRemoving then
        GameCore:OnPlayerRemoving(player)
    end
end)

RE_AdminCommand.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, command, ...)
    local args = { ... }

    -- TODO: replace with your real admin check
    -- current: only game.CreatorId or group rank etc.
    local isAdmin = player.UserId == game.CreatorId
    if not isAdmin then return end

    if command == "spawnwave" and waveManager and waveManager.StartWave then
        waveManager:StartWave()

    elseif command == "spawnboss" and bossManager and bossManager.SpawnBossById then
        local bossId = args[1] or "rizzlord_rails"
        local cf = CFrame.new(0, 20, 0)
        bossManager:SpawnBossById(bossId, cf)

    elseif command == "givess" and playerRuntime and playerRuntime.GiveSuperSaiyan then
        playerRuntime:GiveSuperSaiyan(player)

    elseif command == "giverizz" and playerRuntime and playerRuntime.GiveRizz then
        playerRuntime:GiveRizz(player)

    elseif command == "givecoins" and GameCore and GameCore.AwardCoins then
        local amount = tonumber(args[1]) or 1000
        GameCore:AwardCoins(player, amount, "Admin Command")

    elseif command == "nextday" and gameLoopManager and gameLoopManager.AdvanceDay then
        gameLoopManager:AdvanceDay()
        if gameLoopManager.OnDayStart then
            gameLoopManager:OnDayStart()
        end

    elseif command == "killall" and waveManager and waveManager.ClearAllEnemies then
        waveManager:ClearAllEnemies()
    end
end)

-- 📊 ANALYTICS & HEARTBEAT BRIDGE
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local analyticsTimer = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    analyticsTimer += dt

    -- Tick game loop manager
    if gameLoopManager and gameLoopManager.Step then
        gameLoopManager:Step(dt)
    end

    -- Tick wave manager if it has a step
    if waveManager and waveManager.Step then
        waveManager:Step(dt)
    end

    -- Tick ultimates
    if playerRuntime and playerRuntime.Ultimates then
        for player, ult in pairs(playerRuntime.Ultimates) do
            if ult.Step then
                ult:Step(dt)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Periodic analytics
    if analyticsTimer >= 60 then
        analyticsTimer = 0
        local playerCount = #Players:GetPlayers()
        local wave = waveManager and (waveManager.Wave or 0) or 0
        local day = GameCore and (GameCore.Day or 1) or 1
        local activeEnemies = 0
        if waveManager and waveManager.Spawner and waveManager.Spawner.GetActiveCount then
            activeEnemies = waveManager.Spawner:GetActiveCount()
        end

        print(string.format(
            "[Brainrot Analytics] Players=%d | Day=%d | Wave=%d | Enemies=%d",
            playerCount, day, wave, activeEnemies
        ))
    end
end)

    print("Spawning wave", self.Wave)

    local count = 5 + (self.Wave * 3)

    for i = 1, count do
        task.delay(i * 0.5, function()
            self:SpawnZombie()
        end)
    end

    task.delay(count * 0.5 + 3, function()
        self.Wave += 1
        self:SpawnWave()
    end)
end

function DemoWaveManager:SpawnZombie()
    local zombieModelName = Content.ZombieTypes[math.random(1, #Content.ZombieTypes)]
    local zombieTemplate = RS:FindFirstChild(zombieModelName)
    
    if zombieTemplate then
        zombieTemplate:Clone().Parent = workspace
    end
end

function DemoWaveManager:SpawnBoss()
    print("Spawning demo boss...")
    local boss = RS:FindFirstChild("RizzlordBoss")
    if boss then
        boss:Clone().Parent = workspace
    end
    
    RS.DemoRemotes.Announce:FireAllClients("⚠️ BOSS INCOMING!", Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0))
end

return DemoWaveManager

$demoContent = @'
local DemoContent = {}

-- Three simple classes for the demo
DemoContent.Classes = {
    {
        Id = "railrunner",
        Name = "Railrunner",
        HP = 100,
        Weapon = "DemoShotgun",
        Perk = "+10% move speed"
    },
    {
        Id = "skibidi_hunter",
        Name = "Skibidi Hunter",
        HP = 90,
        Weapon = "DemoSMG",
        Perk = "Bonus damage vs Skibidi zombies"
    },
    {
        Id = "sigma_survivor",
        Name = "Sigma Survivor",
        HP = 130,
        Weapon = "DemoCrowbar",
        Perk = "Extra tankiness"
    }
}

-- Three types of zombies for the demo
DemoContent.ZombieTypes = {
    "SkibidiZombie",
    "SixSevenZombie",
    "SigmaHotdogZombie"
}

return DemoContent

$demoBootstrapPath = Join-Path $RootPath "ServerScriptService\DemoBootstrap.server.lua"
$demoBootstrap = @'
-- DemoBootstrap.server.lua
-- Main bootstrap for the classroom demo

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

-- Ensure folders
local demoRemotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DemoRemotes")
if not demoRemotes then
    demoRemotes = Instance.new("Folder")
    demoRemotes.Name = "DemoRemotes"
    demoRemotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local function getRemote(name)
    local r = demoRemotes:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not r then
        r = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
        r.Name = name
        r.Parent = demoRemotes
    end
    return r
end

local RE_ClassSelected = getRemote("ClassSelected")
local RE_UpdateHUD    = getRemote("UpdateHUD")
local RE_Announce     = getRemote("Announce")

local Content = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DemoContent"))
local WaveManager = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("DemoWaveManager"))

local waveManager = WaveManager.new()

-- Broadcast helpers
local function UpdateHUDAll(text)
    RE_UpdateHUD:FireAllClients(text)
end

local function AnnounceAll(msg, color)
    RE_Announce:FireAllClients(msg, color or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))
end

-- Simple player setup
local function applyClass(player, classId)
    local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    local picked = nil
    for _, class in ipairs(Content.Classes) do
        if class.Id == classId then
            picked = class
            break
        end
    end

    if not picked then
        warn("Unknown classId:", classId)
        return
    end

    hum.MaxHealth = picked.HP
    hum.Health = picked.HP

    -- Give demo weapon if exists in ReplicatedStorage/DemoWeapons as a Tool
    local demoWeaponsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DemoWeapons")
    if demoWeaponsFolder then
        local tool = demoWeaponsFolder:FindFirstChild(picked.Weapon)
        if tool then
            local clone = tool:Clone()
            clone.Parent = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")
        end
    end
end

-- Handle class selection from clients
RE_ClassSelected.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, classId)
    applyClass(player, classId)
    AnnounceAll(player.Name .. " chose class: " .. tostring(classId), Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0))

    -- Start waves once first player picks a class
    if not waveManager.Started then
        waveManager:Start()
    end
end)

-- On player added: teleport onto train platform if it exists
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local train = workspace:FindFirstChild("TrainCar")
        if train and train:FindFirstChild("SpawnPoint") then
            hrp.CFrame = train.SpawnPoint.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        end
        UpdateHUDAll("Choose a class to start!")
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)

AnnounceAll("🚂 Brainrot Demo Loaded", Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0))
UpdateHUDAll("Waiting for players...")
'@
Set-Content -Path $demoBootstrapPath -Value $demoBootstrap -Encoding UTF8

$demoWave = @'
-- DemoWaveManager.lua
-- Very simple wave spawner for the demo

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Content = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DemoContent"))
local demoRemotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DemoRemotes")
local RE_Announce = demoRemotes:WaitForChild("Announce")
local RE_UpdateHUD = demoRemotes:WaitForChild("UpdateHUD")

local DemoWaveManager = {}
DemoWaveManager.__index = DemoWaveManager

function DemoWaveManager.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, DemoWaveManager)
    self.Wave = 1
    self.MaxWaves = 3
    self.Started = false
    return self
end

function DemoWaveManager:Start()
    if self.Started then return end
    self.Started = true
    self:SpawnWave()
end

function DemoWaveManager:SpawnWave()
    if self.Wave > self.MaxWaves then
        self:SpawnBoss()
        return
    end

    RE_Announce:FireAllClients("Wave " .. self.Wave .. " incoming!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0))
    RE_UpdateHUD:FireAllClients("Wave " .. self.Wave)

    local count = 4 + (self.Wave * 2)
    for i = 1, count do
        task.delay(i * 0.5, function()
            self:SpawnZombie()
        end)
    end

    task.delay(count * 0.5 + 4, function()
        self.Wave += 1
        self:SpawnWave()
    end)
end

function DemoWaveManager:SpawnZombie()
    local zombieName = Content.ZombieTypes[math.random(1, #Content.ZombieTypes)]
    local template = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(zombieName)

    if not template then
        warn("No zombie model named:", zombieName)
        return
    end

    local z = template:Clone()
    z.Parent = workspace

    if workspace:FindFirstChild("TrainCar") and workspace.TrainCar:FindFirstChild("EnemySpawn") then
        z:MoveTo(workspace.TrainCar.EnemySpawn.Position)
    else
        z:MoveTo(Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
    end
end

function DemoWaveManager:SpawnBoss()
    RE_Announce:FireAllClients("⚠️ Rizzlord Boss Incoming!", Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0))
    RE_UpdateHUD:FireAllClients("BOSS FIGHT")

    local boss = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RizzlordBoss")
    if not boss then
        warn("No RizzlordBoss model found in ReplicatedStorage")
        return
    end

    local b = boss:Clone()
    b.Parent = workspace

    if workspace:FindFirstChild("TrainCar") and workspace.TrainCar:FindFirstChild("EnemySpawn") then
        b:MoveTo(workspace.TrainCar.EnemySpawn.Position)
    else
        b:MoveTo(Vector3.new(0, 10, 0))
    end
end

return DemoWaveManager
'@
Set-Content -Path $demoWavePath -Value $demoWave -Encoding UTF8

-- DemoZombieAI.server.lua
-- Super simple chase AI for all demo zombies

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function getTarget()
    local players = Players:GetPlayers()
    if #players == 0 then return nil end
    return players[1]
end

while true do
    task.wait(0.25)
    local targetPlayer = getTarget()
    if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then
        continue
    end

    local targetRoot = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetRoot then
        continue
    end

    for _, model in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if model:IsA("Model") and model:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and model.Name:match("Zombie") then
            local hum = model.Humanoid
            hum:MoveTo(targetRoot.Position)
        end
    end
end
'@

end

local function getTarget()
    local players = Players:GetPlayers()
    if #players == 0 then return nil end
    return players[1]
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local boss = getBoss()
    local targetPlayer = getTarget()
    if not (boss and targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character) then return end

    local hum = boss:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local root = boss:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetRoot = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if hum and root and targetRoot then
        hum:MoveTo(targetRoot.Position)
    end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SSS = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Content = require(RS:WaitForChild("DemoContent"))
local WaveManager = require(SSS:WaitForChild("DemoWaveManager"))

-- Remote Folder
local Remotes = RS:FindFirstChild("DemoRemotes") or Instance.new("Folder", RS)
Remotes.Name = "DemoRemotes"

local function Remote(Name)
    local r = Remotes:FindFirstChild(Name)
    if not r then
        r = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
        r.Name = Name
        r.Parent = Remotes
    end
    return r
end

local RE_ClassSelected = Remote("ClassSelected")
local RE_UpdateHUD    = Remote("UpdateHUD")
local RE_Announce     = Remote("Announce")

local function Announce(msg, col)
    RE_Announce:FireAllClients(msg, col or Color3.new(1,1,1))
end

local function applyClass(player, id)
    local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local data = nil

    for _,c in ipairs(Content.Classes) do
        if c.Id == id then data = c break end
    end

    if not data then return end

    hum.MaxHealth = data.HP
    hum.Health = data.HP

    local wFolder = RS:FindFirstChild("DemoWeapons")
    if wFolder then
        local tool = wFolder:FindFirstChild(data.Weapon)
        if tool then
            tool:Clone().Parent = player.Backpack
        end
    end
end

    Announce(player.Name.." chose "..class, Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0))
    if not wave.Started then wave:Start() end
end)

            root.CFrame = train.SpawnPoint.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,3,0)
        end
        RE_UpdateHUD:FireAllClients("Choose a Class to Start!")
    end)
end)

Announce("🚂 Brainrot Demo Loaded!", Color3.fromRGB(255,200,0))

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Content = require(RS:WaitForChild("DemoContent"))

local Remotes = RS:WaitForChild("DemoRemotes")
local RE_Announce = Remotes:WaitForChild("Announce")
local RE_UpdateHUD = Remotes:WaitForChild("UpdateHUD")

local M = {}
M.__index = M

function M.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, M)
    self.Wave = 1
    self.MaxWaves = 3
    self.Started = false
    return self
end

function M:Start()
    if self.Started then return end
    self.Started = true
    self:SpawnWave()
end

function M:SpawnWave()
    if self.Wave > self.MaxWaves then
        self:SpawnBoss()
        return
    end

    RE_Announce:FireAllClients("Wave "..self.Wave.."!", Color3.fromRGB(255,255,0))
    RE_UpdateHUD:FireAllClients("Wave "..self.Wave)

    local count = 4 + (self.Wave*2)
    for i=1,count do
        task.delay(i*0.4, function()
            self:SpawnZombie()
        end)
    end

    task.delay(count*0.4 + 3, function()
        self.Wave += 1
        self:SpawnWave()
    end)
end

function M:SpawnZombie()
    local list = Content.ZombieTypes
    local name = list[math.random(1,#list)]
    local model = RS.DemoZombies:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not model then warn("Missing zombie:", name) return end

    local z = model:Clone()
    z.Parent = workspace

    local train = workspace:FindFirstChild("TrainCar")
    if train and train:FindFirstChild("EnemySpawn") then
        z:MoveTo(train.EnemySpawn.Position)
    else
        z:MoveTo(Vector3.new(0,5,0))
    end
end

function M:SpawnBoss()
    RE_Announce:FireAllClients("⚠️ Rizzlord Boss!", Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0))
    RE_UpdateHUD:FireAllClients("BOSS FIGHT")

    local model = RS.DemoBosses:FindFirstChild("RizzlordBoss")
    if not model then warn("Missing RizzlordBoss") return end

    local b = model:Clone()
    b.Parent = workspace

    local train = workspace:FindFirstChild("TrainCar")
    if train and train:FindFirstChild("EnemySpawn") then
        b:MoveTo(train.EnemySpawn.Position)
    else
        b:MoveTo(Vector3.new(0,10,0))
    end
end

return M
'@

    end
end

return M
'@

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) SIMPLE ZOMBIE AI
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
Set-Content -Path "$Root\ServerScriptService\DemoZombieAI.server.lua" -Encoding UTF8 -Value @'
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function getTarget()
    local list = Players:GetPlayers()
    return list[1]
end

while true do
    task.wait(0.25)
    local target = getTarget()
    if not target or not target.Character then
        continue
    end

    local root = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then
        continue
    end

    for _,z in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if z:IsA("Model") and z.Name:match("Zombie") and z:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            z.Humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position)
        end
    end
end
'@

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) SIMPLE BOSS AI
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
Set-Content -Path "$Root\ServerScriptService\DemoBossAI.server.lua" -Encoding UTF8 -Value @'
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local function boss()
    return workspace:FindFirstChild("RizzlordBoss")
end

local function target()
    local list = Players:GetPlayers()
    return list[1]
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local b = boss()
    local t = target()
    if not (b and t and t.Character) then return end

    local hum = b:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local hrp = t.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if hum and hrp then
        hum:MoveTo(hrp.Position)
    end
end)
'@

        [string]$Name
    )
    $toolPath = Join-Path "$Root\ReplicatedStorage\DemoWeapons" $Name
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $toolPath | Out-Null
    Set-Content -Path "$toolPath\ToolScript.lua" -Value $ToolScript -Encoding UTF8
}
